Description:
Job Title: Learning Deployment Specialist
Job Summary:
Talent Services is a core service function within the Global Delivery Services organization, providing multiple HR and learning related support services including Recruitment support, Onboarding support, People Data Administration, Learning Administration, Cross Border Travel, Global Mobility and Performance Management support to EY member firms.
Talent Services supports Europe West (EW) as part of the extended Region Learning team. It is fully integrated with onshore colleagues in Europe West and participates in meetings, projects and planning activities as part of one team. It is aligned with the Learning Global Process Model and initiates learning processes through the existing workflow for execution by the CAT and DAT teams.
The person selected for this role will be at the rank of Senior Associate and will be responsible for the deployment of multiple courses within one or more curricula for Europe West, working alongside the Senior Deployment Specialist and/or Learning Program Manager. The Senior Associate will oversee learning administration activities and report on course feedback. (50%)
The Senior Associate will support the end-to-end program lifecycle, including program planning, stakeholder coordination, participant and facilitator management, communications, learning logistics, program documentation, delivery readiness, evaluation, and continuous improvement. (50%)
Applications Used: SuccessFactors (Learning Management System), ServiceNow
Essential Functions of the Job (Responsibilities)
Deployment (0.5 FTE)
Ensure end-to-end coordination of learning deployment activities, including validating training request forms, submitting item and class requests, and ensuring that CE credits are awarded.
Submit requests for online, virtual, and physical classroom sessions, as well as program requests in SuccessFactors for learner consumption.
Address learner queries related to credits, class requests, and compliance.
Monitor participant nominations and manage cancellations, no-shows and missed sessions.
Monitor and analyse reports, including credit reports, NASBA reports and evaluation feedback.
Ensure CE credits are awarded to learning participants and instructors, where applicable.
Build and maintain close working relationships with the EW Learning team.
Program Management (0.5 FTE)
Support EW Tax Learning Leads in executing regional learning priorities and learning initiatives.
Coordinate the planning and delivery of Europe West Tax learning programs, including timelines, action trackers, governance activities and key deliverables.
Manage participant, facilitator and stakeholder engagement activities, including nominations, communications, briefing activities and delivery readiness.
Support stakeholder meetings and governance forums, including agenda preparation, documentation, action tracking and follow-up.
Maintain program documentation, status reports, trackers and learning resources.
Support virtual and face-to-face learning events, including learner experience, logistics coordination and delivery support.
Monitor risks, dependencies and program actions, escalating issues where appropriate.
Analyse participant and stakeholder feedback, evaluate program outcomes and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
Build and maintain strong working relationships with business stakeholders, facilitators and learning teams across Europe West.
Knowledge and Skills Requirements:
Deployment
Understanding of EY and EY Talent.
Stakeholder management.
Strong IT skills in the Microsoft Office 365 suite, including Teams, Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook and SharePoint.
Strong written and oral communication skills and the ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels.
Strong team player with an enthusiastic, can-do approach and the ability to coordinate and work as one team’.
Drive the delivery of quality services and products to Talent.
Ability to learn new processes and skills quickly.
Proactive problem solver with a solution-oriented mindset.
Flexible and dependable; willing to adjust the work schedule as necessary to meet peak demands and customer requirements.
Program Management:
Strong program coordination and organizational skills.
Strong program coordination, organizational and prioritization skills.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior business stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and competing demands simultaneously.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and attention-to-detail skills.
Ability to interpret learning metrics, feedback and program data to support decision-making and continuous improvement.
Ability to think creatively and identify opportunities to enhance the learner experience.
Proficiency in Microsoft 365 tools, including Teams, SharePoint, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook; advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills are desirable.
Ability to work effectively across countries, cultures and time zones.
Learner and client-service focused, with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
Job Requirements:
Education:
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in human resources, Business or a related discipline.
Experience:
Deployment
5 to 8 years of relevant experience.
Significant experience working in HR within a professional services or corporate environment.
Experience working in Learning and Development is desirable.
Experience working in international and diverse environments.
Program Management
5-8 years of experience in Learning & Development, Talent, Program Management, People Development, or a related field.
Experience supporting the planning and delivery of learning programs, talent initiatives, or business projects.
Experience supporting regional or global initiatives within a matrix and stakeholder-driven environment.
Experience working with senior stakeholders and managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
Experience coordinating virtual and/or classroom learning events, workshops, or development programs.
Experience collaborating with geographically dispersed and cross-functional teams.
Experience in professional services and/or international environments is desirable.

Description:
EY- Process & Controls Risk Consulting – Manager -IA Capital Projects
As part of our Risk Consulting, you will be supporting the team in client engagements related to Risk Consulting, Internal Audit, GRC Consulting for various clients across the MENA region. The client base spans across various sectors and includes collaboration with other teams within Consulting services.
The opportunity
We’re looking for experienced professionals with experience in the Real Estate and Construction sector and Internal Audit/ Risk to join our Process & Controls Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering. This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the beautiful state of Kerala.
Working in our practice, you will have the opportunity to work with clients to provide practical risk management, internal audit solutions and gaining valuable experience in a variety of clients.
Your key responsibilities
The current role requires executing internal audit and other risk consulting engagements for Real Estate construction companies. As part of the role, the candidate is expected to:
Responsible for leading and executing client engagements and meeting the expectations of the client and the onsite team within the MENA region.
Ability to interact with all levels of management, including C-Suite executives.
Perform end-to-end internal audits from planning to reporting including process understanding, walkthroughs, preparation of risk and control matrix / audit work program, control testing to assess their design and operating effectiveness, preparation of audit report and agreeing issues/ actions with management.
Have an in-depth understanding of the Real Estate, Capital Projects, and Construction industry risks/issues/trends and end-to-end business processes.
Demonstrate knowledge and experience of the project delivery (EPC) lifecycle, including understanding of governance structures, organizational design, and Delegation of Authority frameworks.
Assess business cases for capital projects, analyzing their structure, assumptions, and feasibility.
Lead audits with engineering, planning, or cost-related components, including review of master planning, engineering phases, stage gate methods, and design maturity.
Understand cost estimating principles, cost estimate classifications, LPM build-up techniques, and perform BoQ analysis and material take-offs.
Evaluate procurement, contract, and commercial practices, and apply project control principles (schedule, cost, risk, reporting).
Analyze integrity, completeness and accuracy of project plans, cost estimates, risk plans, and interpret project documentation such as contracts, reports, and dashboards.
Review and interpret resource plans and schedules to assess alignment with project objectives.
Deliver/manage engagements on time, within budget, and at high quality.
Identify key areas of improvement in the client's business processes and add value through insightful recommendations.
Contribute to business development activities such as proposal preparation and lead identification.
Always comply with the firm’s quality and risk management policies.
Manage multiple assignments and associated project teams.
Maintain excellent rapport and proactive communication with clients.
Mentor and coach junior team members, enabling them to meet performance goals and grow their careers.
Manage engagement budgets and support superiors in developing marketing collaterals, proposals, and new solutions/methodologies.
Skills and attributes for success
Exceptional command on spoken and written English
Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations at a short notice
Highly analytical, organised and meticulous consulting skills
Demonstrating and applying strong project management skills, inspiring teamwork and responsibility with engagement team members
Ability to multi-task, work well under pressure with commitment to deliver under tight deadline
Strong organizational skills with ability to prioritize effectively
Attention to detail and quality assurance
Proficient in MS-Office Suite, data analysis & validation
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 8 years of relevant work experience in Internal Audit / Risk Management, with a focus on the Real Estate, Construction, or Capital Projects sector.
Experience leading or supporting audits involving cost estimation, engineering reviews, procurement, and project controls.
Ability to interpret and assess detailed project documentation, including project charters, schedules, cost plans, and risk assessments.
A valid passport and willingness to travel internationally.

Description:
EY-Process & Controls Risk Consulting – O&G Upstream Senior
As part of our Risk Consulting, you will be supporting the Team in client engagements related to Risk Management, Internal Audit, GRC solutions for various clients across the MENA region. The client base spans across various sectors and includes collaboration with other teams within Consulting services.
The opportunity
We’re looking for experienced professionals with experience in the Energy sector and Internal Audit/ Risk to join our Process & Controls Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering. This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the beautiful state of Kerala.
Working in our practice, you will have the opportunity to work with clients to provide practical risk management, internal audit solutions and gaining valuable experience in a variety of clients.
Your key responsibilities
The current role requires executing internal audit and other risk consulting engagements for energy companies. As part of the role, the candidate is expected to:
Assist in executing client engagements and meeting the expectations of the client and the onsite team within the MENA region.
Support in performing end-to-end internal audits from planning to reporting including process understanding, walkthroughs, preparation of risk and control matrix / audit work program, control testing to assess their design and operating effectiveness, preparation of audit report and agreeing issues/ actions with management.
Have an in-depth understanding of the Oil & Gas upstream industry risks/ issues / trends and end-to-end business processes.
Have thorough knowledge and understanding of Internal Audit methodology and IIA requirements.
Deliver engagements to time, cost and high quality.
Identify key areas of improvement in the client's business processes and add value by preparing insightful recommendations.
Contribute to business development activities such as preparing proposals, lead identification
Always comply with the firm’s quality and risk management policies
Manage multiple assignments and related project teams.
Maintain excellent rapport and proactive communication with the client
Skills and attributes for success
Exceptional command on spoken and written English
Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations at a short notice
Highly analytical, organised and meticulous consulting skills
Demonstrating and applying strong project management skills, inspiring teamwork and responsibility with engagement team members
Ability to multi-task, work well under pressure with commitment to deliver under tight deadline
Strong organizational skills with ability to prioritize effectively
Attention to detail and quality assurance
Proficient in MS-Office Suite, data analysis & validation
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor’s degree in engineering with specialisation in Oil & Gas or relevant professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CIA.
PMP certification holders will be preferred
Experience in Internal Audit /Risk Management with Oil & Gas upstream sector focus or working in Oil and Gas Drilling and / or Oil Field Service Companies, or Exploration & Production (E&P) Companies or working as Drilling Engineers, Rig Foreman, or in Warehousing and Logistics for Drilling Operations.
Experience leading or supporting risk-based internal audits across upstream operations, including drilling and well operations, rig management, production operations, workover activities, petroleum engineering processes, drilling materials and inventory management, supply chain and logistics, contract management, HSE compliance.
Knowledge of key upstream business and operational processes, including Exploration & Appraisal activities, Field Development Planning, Work Programs & Budgets (WP&B), Authorization for Expenditure (AFE), Petroleum Cost Recovery, Joint Venture (JV) Accounting, Cost Allocations, Affiliate and Related Party Charges, Production Allocation, Reservoir Management, and Hydrocarbon Measurement controls.
Experience evaluating operational and financial controls related to drilling campaigns, rig utilization, non-productive time (NPT), well costs, contractor performance, procurement and contracting, warehousing and drilling materials management, inventory controls, logistics operations, and production reporting.
Strong understanding of Process Safety Management (PSM), Health, Safety & Environment (HSE), Well Integrity Management, Asset Integrity, Reliability Engineering, and applicable industry standards and frameworks (e.g., API, IADC, ISO 55000, OSHA PSM, IWCF/IADC well control requirements, and other upstream industry standards).
A minimum of 4 years of relevant work experience
A valid passport for travel.
Internal Audit Software Such as Teammate and ERP Exposure such as SAP, Oracle to extract reports (contracting/procurement/material management modules).

Description:
EY Risk Consulting – Manager (Risk Analytics)
As part of our Digital Risk (DR) team within Risk Consulting, we are seeking a Manager with strong business understanding, analytical capability and handson experience in process mining and data analytics to join the DR team and work with our clients on some of the most prestigious projects catering to various sectors across the MENA region. This is an excellent opportunity to join a leading consulting practice and contribute to shaping nextgeneration digital and analyticsdriven risk solutions.
The opportunity
As a Manager, you will engage with clients to strengthen their digital risk posture by bridging business requirements with technical capabilities. You will work on engagements across advanced analytics, data visualization, automation, data governance, process mining, etc. ensuring solutions are aligned with organizational objectives, regulatory expectations and leading practices.
You will work with multidisciplinary teams across data, tech and business functions to design, assess and implement analyticsenabled risk processes and governance structures.
This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the state of Kerala.
Your key responsibilities
Design, develop and oversee the deployment of process mining dashboards using platforms such as Celonis and Power BI to analyze and optimize processes.
Perform and validate deep-dive analysis on core business processes, identifying bottlenecks, root causes and improvement opportunities.
Develop and review root-cause-driven insights and actionable recommendations to improve efficiency, quality and compliance.
Extract, transform and prepare data from ERP and business applications (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, Salesforce, Workday, etc.) to support process mining and analytics initiatives.
Design and develop ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL, Python and data integration tools to create process mining event logs and reporting datasets.
Perform data mapping, data modelling and process event reconstruction to enable end-to-end process visibility.
Support the onboarding of new data sources into process mining platforms such as Celonis, Signavio and ARIS.
Validate process mining datasets through reconciliation, completeness checks and data quality assessments.
Assist in developing process mining use cases, KPIs and dashboards by leveraging transactional and master data from enterprise systems.
Lead a team of Senior Consultants and independently drive client discussions and communications.
Groom junior resources and participate in business development activities.
Provide timely and constructive feedback to junior staff and manage team/individual KPIs and other performance metrices.
Skills and attributes for success
Hands-on experience with:
Process Mining & Analytics
Experience with Celonis, Signavio, ARIS Process Mining or similar platforms preferred.
Candidates with strong SQL, ETL, Data Engineering or Data Analytics experience and willingness to learn Process Mining are encouraged to apply.
Understanding of business process analysis, workflow optimization and operational excellence concepts.
Data Engineering & Integration
Strong SQL skills including complex joins, stored procedures, views and performance optimization.
Experience developing ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL, Python, SSIS, Informatica, Talend, Azure Data Factory, Alteryx or similar tools.
Experience working with large transactional datasets from ERP and enterprise applications.
Understanding of data modelling, data lineage, data transformation and data quality concepts.
Programming & Analytics
Python, SQL, PQL (preferred), R (optional).
Data analysis, automation and scripting experience.
Exposure to machine learning and statistical analysis is advantageous.
Dashboarding & Visualization
Power BI, Tableau, Qlik or similar BI platforms.
Enterprise Platforms
SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, Workday, Azure, AWS, GCP or similar enterprise ecosystems.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in computer science, data science or a related field.
8 to 10 years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
Process Mining
Data Analytics
Data Engineering
Business Intelligence
Process Improvement
Experience working with Big4 is a strong advantage.
A valid passport for travel.
Preferred Experience
Experience creating event logs and process datasets from SAP, Oracle, Dynamics 365 or other ERP platforms.
Exposure to process mining concepts such as event logs, case IDs, process variants, conformance checking and root cause analysis.
Knowledge of process mining platforms such as Celonis, SAP Signavio or ARIS is desirable but not mandatory.
Experience with data integration, data warehousing and cloud-based analytics platforms.
Understanding of Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R), HR or similar business processes.
What working at EY offers
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around.
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that is right for you.

Red Teaming, Social Engineering Assessments, Purple Teaming, Physical Security, Secure Code Review
Hands-on Experience with findings remediation and security log analysis

Experience with infrastructure penetration testing and vulnerability assessments
Experience with Active directory assessments 
Experience with Wireless Network Penetration testing

Knowledge of Linux administration, TCP/IP, DNS and Network protocols

AI Developer (Python) Experience 4-8 years’ experience
Skills and attributes for success
Candidate must possess proficiency in the following technologies:
Core AI Engineering & LLM Frameworks:
Python, LangChain, LangGraph, Auto Gen, Google Agent SDK, Model Context Protocol, Skills-based agent frameworks.
GenAI / Agentic AI Systems:
LLM application development, agentic AI architectures, multi-agent workflows, prompt engineering, AI system design, tool/function calling, enterprise AI integration.
RAG, Embeddings & Vector Search:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines, embeddings, semantic search, context retrieval strategies, Azure AI Search, Pinecone, FAISS, Redis Vector, pgvector.
Backend & API Engineering:
Python, Fast API, REST API design, scalable API platforms, event-driven systems, microservices architecture, third-party system integration.
Cloud, Infrastructure & Containers:
Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, cloud-native application development, containerized deployments.
Databases & Data Platforms:
SQL, NoSQL, MongoDB, Redis, ClickHouse, database design, performance optimization, data accuracy and integrity.
AI Model Engineering:
Model fine-tuning, LoRA, BERT, LLM architecture understanding, evaluation techniques, AI performance monitoring.
AI Governance, Security & Responsible AI:
PII protection, data privacy, AI security, compliance, responsible AI practices, governance controls, monitoring and observability frameworks.
DevOps & Engineering Practices:
GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CI/CD pipelines, source control, automated testing, production deployment practices, observability and monitoring.
Preferred Technologies:
Rust, Go, Kubernetes, OpenShift, advanced vector database platforms, enterprise-scale LLM deployment patterns.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Minimum of 4+ years of professional engineering experience, with hands-on experience in backend/platform engineering and GenAI/LLM systems.
Bachelor’s degree B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, or related engineering discipline.
Strong hands-on proficiency in Python for AI application development, backend services, and platform engineering.
Demonstrable experience building LLM-powered applications, including RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, prompt engineering, and enterprise AI integrations.
Hands-on expertise with LangChain and LangGraph, with exposure to frameworks such as AutoGen, Google Agent SDK, Model Context Protocol, or Skills-based agent frameworks.
Experience designing and implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines using vector databases such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, FAISS, Redis Vector, or pgvector.
Strong understanding of embeddings, semantic search, context retrieval strategies, chunking approaches, ranking, and retrieval optimization.
Proficiency in building scalable backend services using Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, microservices, and event-driven architecture.
Experience working with Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Services for enterprise-grade AI solution development.
Strong understanding of Docker and containerized deployments, with exposure to Kubernetes or OpenShift preferred.

Description:
EY- Process & Controls Risk Consulting – Senior - IA Capital Projects
As part of our Risk Consulting, you will be supporting the team in client engagements related to Risk Consulting, Internal Audit, GRC Consulting for various clients across the MENA region. The client base spans across various sectors and includes collaboration with other teams within Consulting services.
The opportunity
We’re looking for experienced professionals with experience in the Real Estate and Construction sector and Internal Audit/ Risk to join our Process & Controls Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering. This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the beautiful state of Kerala.
Working in our practice, you will have the opportunity to work with clients to provide practical risk management, internal audit solutions and gaining valuable experience in a variety of clients.
Your key responsibilities
The role requires supporting and executing internal audit and other risk consulting engagements for Real Estate and construction companies. As part of the role, the candidate is expected to:
Execute assigned workstreams in client engagements and coordinate effectively with the onsite team across the MENA region.
Interact professionally with client stakeholders and support discussions with senior management.
Perform end-to-end internal audit activities, including process understanding, walkthroughs, preparation of risk and control matrices and audit work programs, control testing, documentation of findings, and preparation of draft reports.
Apply knowledge of risks, issues, trends, and end-to-end business processes in the Real Estate, Capital Projects, and Construction sectors.
Support reviews of the project delivery (EPC) lifecycle, governance structures, organizational design, and Delegation of Authority frameworks.
Review capital project business cases, including key assumptions, structure, and feasibility.
Perform audit procedures covering engineering, planning, and cost-related areas, including master planning, engineering phases, stage-gate methods, and design maturity.
Apply cost-estimating principles, cost-estimate classifications, LPM build-up techniques, and undertake BoQ analysis and material take-offs.
Review procurement, contract, and commercial practices and apply project-control principles relating to schedule, cost, risk, and reporting.
Analyze the integrity, completeness, and accuracy of project plans, cost estimates, and risk plans, and interpret contracts, reports, and dashboards.
Review resource plans and schedules to assess their alignment with project objectives.
Complete assigned work within agreed timelines, budgets, and quality standards, and promptly escalate issues to engagement leadership.
Identify process improvement opportunities and develop practical, evidence-based recommendations.
Support business development activities, including research, proposal preparation, and development of marketing collateral.
Comply with the firm’s quality and risk management policies at all times.
Manage multiple assigned tasks and workstreams under the guidance of engagement leadership.
Maintain proactive communication and professional working relationships with clients and team members.
Guide junior team members on assigned tasks and review their work where required.
Support engagement administration, budget monitoring, methodology development, and preparation of new solutions.
Skills and attributes for success
Excellent command of spoken and written English
Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations at short notice
Strong analytical, organizational, and consulting skills
Ability to manage assigned workstreams, collaborate effectively, and take ownership of deliverables
Ability to multitask and deliver quality work under tight deadlines
Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize effectively
Attention to detail and commitment to quality
Proficiency in MS Office Suite, data analysis, and validation
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 3–5 years of relevant experience in Internal Audit or Risk Management, preferably within the Real Estate, Construction, or Capital Projects sector.
Experience executing or supporting audits involving cost estimation, engineering reviews, procurement, or project controls.
Ability to interpret and assess project documentation, including project charters, schedules, cost plans, and risk assessments.
A valid passport and willingness to travel internationally.

Own the end-to-end hiring targets for delivery partners across assigned cities/zones - drive planning, execution, and daily monitoring of performance against targets, with root cause analysis and corrective action for underperforming locations.

EY-Process Controls- Risk Consulting -Manager
As part of our Risk Consulting, you will be supporting the Team in client engagements related to Risk Management, Internal Audit, GRC solutions for various clients across the MENA region. The client base spans across various sectors and includes collaboration with other teams within Consulting services.
The opportunity
We re looking for experienced professionals with experience in the Risk Consulting and Internal Audit to join our Process Controls Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering. This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the beautiful state of Kerala.
Working in our practice, you will have the opportunity to work with clients to provide practical risk management, internal audit solutions and gaining valuable experience in a variety of clients.
Your key responsibilities
The current role requires executing internal audit and other risk consulting engagements for EY clients. As part of the role, the candidate is expected to:
Responsible for leading and executing client engagements and meeting the expectations of the client and the onsite team within the MENA region.
Ability to interact with all levels of management, including C-Suite management
Perform end-to-end internal audits from planning to reporting including process understanding, walkthroughs, preparation of risk and control matrix / audit work program, control testing to assess their design and operating effectiveness, preparation of audit report and agreeing issues/ actions with management.
Have an in-depth understanding of the various industry risks/ issues / trends and end-to-end business processes.
Have thorough knowledge and understanding of Internal Audit methodology and IIA requirements.
Deliver / manage engagements to time, cost and high quality.
Identify key areas of improvement in the clients business processes and add value by preparing insightful recommendations.
Contribute to business development activities such as preparing proposals, lead identification
Always comply with the firm s quality and risk management policies
Manage multiple assignments and related project teams.
Maintain excellent rapport and proactive communication with the client
Mentor and coach junior team members, enabling them to meet their performance goals and successfully grow their careers
Manage the engagement budgets and support superiors in developing marketing collaterals, business proposals and new solution / methodology development
Skills and attributes for success
Exceptional command on spoken and written English
Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations at a short notice.
Highly analytical, organised and meticulous consulting skills
Demonstrating and applying strong project management skills, inspiring teamwork and responsibility with engagement team members
Ability to multi-task, work well under pressure with commitment to deliver under tight deadline
Strong organizational skills with ability to prioritize effectively
Attention to detail and quality assurance
Proficient in MS-Office Suite, data analysis validation
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor s degree or relevant professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CIA etc.
Experience in Internal Audit / Risk Management.
A minimum of 8 years of relevant work experience
A valid passport for travel.
At EY, we re dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to :
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that s right for you

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY - Risk Consulting - Manager, Enterprise Risk Management
As part of Risk Consulting, you will lead and support client engagements focused on Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), risk governance and GRC transformation across the MENA region. You will work with clients across sectors and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design practical, sustainable and technology-enabled risk management solutions.
The opportunity
We are looking for an experienced professional with a strong background in Enterprise Risk Management to join our Risk Management team. This is an opportunity to contribute to the growth of a leading risk advisory practice while helping clients strengthen risk-informed decision-making, resilience and governance. The position will be based in Kochi or Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.
Working in our practice, you will advise clients across a variety of industries and operating environments, lead high-quality engagements and develop your experience in ERM frameworks, risk appetite, risk reporting, risk culture and GRC solutions.
Your key responsibilities
As part of the role, you will:
Lead and manage ERM, risk governance and GRC advisory engagements from planning through delivery.
Design, implement and enhance ERM frameworks aligned with recognised standards such as ISO 31000 and COSO ERM.
Facilitate enterprise-wide risk assessments, risk workshops and risk identification sessions with senior stakeholders.
Develop and maintain risk taxonomies, enterprise and functional risk registers, risk appetite statements, tolerance thresholds and key risk indicators.
Integrate risk management into strategy, business planning, budgeting, performance management and decision-making processes.
Establish risk monitoring, escalation and reporting mechanisms, including executive and Board-level dashboards.
Assess strategic, operational, financial, technology, cyber, regulatory, third-party, sustainability and emerging risks.
Review risk governance structures, management and Board risk committee arrangements and alignment with the three-lines model.
Lead risk maturity assessments, benchmarking exercises and ERM transformation programmes, and develop pragmatic improvement roadmaps.
Support the evaluation, design and implementation of GRC technology solutions and risk data visualisation.
Advise on operational resilience, business continuity and crisis risk management frameworks, where relevant.
Manage engagement scope, economics, resources, risks, quality, timelines and client expectations.
Build trusted relationships with senior management, risk committees and other key stakeholders, translating complex risk matters into clear recommendations.
Coach and mentor team members and foster a culture of quality, collaboration and continuous learning.
Develop proposals, thought leadership and go-to-market initiatives that support the growth of the ERM practice.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong knowledge of ERM frameworks, risk governance, risk appetite, risk culture, risk reporting and the three-lines model.
Ability to translate complex risk information into concise executive and Board-level reporting.
Strong workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Proven project and engagement management capability, including the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within tight deadlines.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with confidence presenting to senior management and governance forums.
Strong proposal development, account management and business development capabilities.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with data analytics, Power BI or GRC platforms would be advantageous.
Knowledge of regulatory environments and risk practices across the MENA region would be advantageous.
To qualify for the role, you must have
A bachelor s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering or a related discipline.
A minimum of eight years of relevant experience, including experience managing ERM or risk advisory engagements.
Demonstrable experience in risk assessments, risk appetite, KRIs, risk reporting, governance and ERM improvement initiatives.
Experience managing teams and engaging with senior client stakeholders.
Ideally, you ll also have
A relevant professional certification such as CRMA, CIA, FRM, CRM, RIMS-CRMP, CISA, ACCA, CA or an equivalent risk, audit, finance or governance qualification.
Prior consulting or professional-services experience.
A master s degree or MBA.
Arabic language capability, where relevant to client engagements in the MENA region.
Mobility and travel
Willingness and ability to travel to client locations, sometimes at short notice.
A valid passport and ability to meet applicable travel requirements.
At EY, we re dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You will work on inspiring and meaningful projects, supported by education, coaching and practical experience. We value our people and provide opportunities to shape your development through challenging assignments, knowledge exchange and collaboration. We offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from engaging colleagues.
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that is right for you.
EY | Building a better working world

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Engagement Business Partner
The Engagement Business Partner (EBP) is a finance professional with comprehensive knowledge of systems, processes, and policies. In this internal role, the EBP acts as the Finance single point of contact, collaborating closely with client-serving engagement teams to enable the successful delivery of engagements across the full engagement lifecycle, from opportunity creation to final record archiving. Please note: this is not a technical accounting role.
The opportunity
As an Engagement Business Partner, you will play a pivotal role in supporting client-serving teams by ensuring the accurate and timely execution of all engagement lifecycle activities. The main components of this role are:
Serving as the Finance single point of contact for Engagement Partners and Managers, offering guidance and overseeing all aspects of the Opportunity Engagement Lifecycle (OEL).
Overseeing the completion of OEL tasks by delegating to Centres of Excellence (CoEs), and monitoring progress to ensure timely delivery.
Proactively managing financial and quality related risks across your engagement portfolio, intervening where needed to provide strategic advice to uplift the compliance and revenue stability of your portfolio.
Ensure compliance with service line specific policies and parameters.
Supporting the annual external audit process.
This is a dynamic and rewarding role that contributes to profitable growth and high-quality client service.
Your key responsibilities
Manage a portfolio of client opportunities and engagements as the Finance single contact point for assigned Engagement Partners and Managers.
Coordinate with client servers and CoEs to:
Apply knowledge of service line specific OEL policies and guidelines to ensure compliance across the OEL lifecycle.
Monitor and advise on risk assessment and compliance processes.
Advise on pricing models and engagement budgets.
Assess financial implications of engagement structures and budgets.
Support and challenge the Estimate-to-Complete (ETC) processes and related financial updates.
Support the portfolio s working capital activity.
Provide challenge and best practice insights to client servers where required such as through optimal margin, pricing plans or engagement structures.
Upskill and share knowledge with client servers on OEL best practice, standards and tools.
Develop a diverse network of relationships across Finance and non-Finance stakeholders to provide holistic Finance support for Engagement Partners and escalate queries beyond remit to other functional experts within Finance (e.g. PFAs).
Review work performed by CoEs for accuracy and take ownership of OEL tasks when urgent needs arise.
Seek to understand client-server needs, demands, and the nuances of the specific Service Line to deepen insights and strategic thinking.
Share best practices across the EBP group to drive consistency and excellence.
Engage with CoE Managers to flag issues, trends or knowledge required for CoE upskilling.
Provide subject matter expertise in delivering training on OEL best practices for CoEs.
Support continuous improvement through identifying opportunities for innovation and automation.
Skills and attributes for success
Deliver with pace ensuring activities are executed accurately in a fast-moving environment.
Ability to engage proactively with Engagement Partners to anticipate upcoming needs and ensure OEL requirements are met on time.
Strong interpersonal skills with a good understanding of the client server perspective and ability to build relationships with them.
Confident communicator who can challenge constructively and influence outcomes.
Excellent analytical and commercial acumen, with high attention to detail.
Take ownership of monthly activities, driving progress and proactively managing business outcomes to meet deadlines and performance targets.
Quick learner with a proactive approach and eager to share knowledge with others.
Ability to translate complex technical system language into business-relevant terms.
Skilled listener with sound judgment and the ability to escalate appropriately.
To qualify for the role, you must have
A minimum of two to three years experience in a client-facing or finance-related role within a professional services or corporate environment.
Experience managing stakeholders and delivering high-impact client service.
Experience working in hybrid and fast-paced environments.
Used to working in a fast-paced environment with a strong work ethic
Ability to build relationships with people at all levels within the firm.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, SharePoint).
Adaptability and resilience in fast-paced environments.
What we look for
Highly motivated, good communicators who can establish credibility with client servers and convey financial impacts in business language back to client servers. You will also need to be a team player who is not only looking to enhance their own career but recognises the value in strengthening the team.
What we offer
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with MyReward you can select benefits that suit your needs, including holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. In addition, you will benefit from:
Continuous learning: You ll have access to EY s world-class learning offerings, on-the-job coaching, and structured development programmes designed to deepen your expertise, broaden your perspective, and help you grow into the next stage of your career.
Success as defined by you: Define what success looks like for you, and we ll provide the tools and flexibility to help you achieve it.
Transformative leadership: Gain the insights, coaching, and confidence to lead with purpose and impact.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The opportunity
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced SAP Senior to perform our technical reviews and assessment of complex SAP ERP security design control reviews and assessment projects. Your key responsibilities
Perform technical review in the SAP security design, implementation of SAP ERP and SAP Cloud solutions.
Review technical specifications and design documents.

Contribute to the Risk Consulting team as a key member and assist with facilitating practice wide training (SAP ITGC/ SAP ITAC /SAP Pre Post Implementation reviews) curriculum.
Work closely with onshore, cross-functional teams and develop strong relationships across the organization, especially with Onsite team.
Skills and attributes for success
Minimum 3 years of experience in SAP Solution security design, review and implementation.

Experience in Data Migration, Templates, Knowledge of data models and web services in cloud

Experience in performance tuning of SAP Security configurations is highly desirable.
Strong team player, highly motivated, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of SAP S4 Hana, SAP ECC, SAP Cloud services and architecture.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools like JIRA.
Basic Experience with machine learning and AI integration in SAP Cloud applications.
Knowledge of security best practices and compliance standards in cloud environments.

Should have hands on experience and strong knowledge on technical activities performed in S4 Hana and Success factors covering all key modules of Finance, HR and Payroll
Must have valid passport with minimum 6 free pages and should be willing to travel on short term for client site work assignments especially to Middle East as and when required depends on project requirements.
Excellent communication, presentation skills and consulting mindset
Client handling experience.
Willing to work in MENA Shift timings (Sunday to Thursday).
A valid passport for travel.

SAP certified professional

A bachelors or masters degree (B.TECH/B.E/M.TECH/MBA-Finance)

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY- Process Controls - Risk Consulting - Senior - IA Capital Projects
As part of our Risk Consulting, you will be supporting the team in client engagements related to Risk Consulting, Internal Audit, GRC Consulting for various clients across the MENA region. The client base spans across various sectors and includes collaboration with other teams within Consulting services.
The opportunity
We re looking for experienced professionals with experience in the Real Estate and Construction sector and Internal Audit/ Risk to join our Process Controls Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering. This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the beautiful state of Kerala.
Working in our practice, you will have the opportunity to work with clients to provide practical risk management, internal audit solutions and gaining valuable experience in a variety of clients.
Your key responsibilities
The role requires supporting and executing internal audit and other risk consulting engagements for Real Estate and construction companies. As part of the role, the candidate is expected to:
Execute assigned workstreams in client engagements and coordinate effectively with the onsite team across the MENA region.
Interact professionally with client stakeholders and support discussions with senior management.
Perform end-to-end internal audit activities, including process understanding, walkthroughs, preparation of risk and control matrices and audit work programs, control testing, documentation of findings, and preparation of draft reports.
Apply knowledge of risks, issues, trends, and end-to-end business processes in the Real Estate, Capital Projects, and Construction sectors.
Support reviews of the project delivery (EPC) lifecycle, governance structures, organizational design, and Delegation of Authority frameworks.
Review capital project business cases, including key assumptions, structure, and feasibility.
Perform audit procedures covering engineering, planning, and cost-related areas, including master planning, engineering phases, stage-gate methods, and design maturity.
Apply cost-estimating principles, cost-estimate classifications, LPM build-up techniques, and undertake BoQ analysis and material take-offs.
Review procurement, contract, and commercial practices and apply project-control principles relating to schedule, cost, risk, and reporting.
Analyze the integrity, completeness, and accuracy of project plans, cost estimates, and risk plans, and interpret contracts, reports, and dashboards.
Review resource plans and schedules to assess their alignment with project objectives.
Complete assigned work within agreed timelines, budgets, and quality standards, and promptly escalate issues to engagement leadership.
Identify process improvement opportunities and develop practical, evidence-based recommendations.
Support business development activities, including research, proposal preparation, and development of marketing collateral.
Comply with the firm s quality and risk management policies at all times.
Manage multiple assigned tasks and workstreams under the guidance of engagement leadership.
Maintain proactive communication and professional working relationships with clients and team members.
Guide junior team members on assigned tasks and review their work where required.
Support engagement administration, budget monitoring, methodology development, and preparation of new solutions.
Skills and attributes for success
Excellent command of spoken and written English
Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations at short notice
Strong analytical, organizational, and consulting skills
Ability to manage assigned workstreams, collaborate effectively, and take ownership of deliverables
Ability to multitask and deliver quality work under tight deadlines
Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize effectively
Attention to detail and commitment to quality
Proficiency in MS Office Suite, data analysis, and validation
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor s or Master s degree in Engineering, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 3-5 years of relevant experience in Internal Audit or Risk Management, preferably within the Real Estate, Construction, or Capital Projects sector.
Experience executing or supporting audits involving cost estimation, engineering reviews, procurement, or project controls.
Ability to interpret and assess project documentation, including project charters, schedules, cost plans, and risk assessments.
A valid passport and willingness to travel internationally.
What working at EY offers
At EY, we re dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that s right for you

Working in our practice, you will have the opportunity to work with clients to provide practical risk management, internal audit solutions and gaining valuable experience in a variety of clients.
Your key responsibilities
The role requires supporting and executing internal audit and other risk consulting engagements for Real Estate and construction companies. As part of the role, the candidate is expected to:
Execute assigned workstreams in client engagements and coordinate effectively with the onsite team across the MENA region.
Interact professionally with client stakeholders and support discussions with senior management.
Perform end-to-end internal audit activities, including process understanding, walkthroughs, preparation of risk and control matrices and audit work programs, control testing, documentation of findings, and preparation of draft reports.
Apply knowledge of risks, issues, trends, and end-to-end business processes in the Real Estate, Capital Projects, and Construction sectors.
Support reviews of the project delivery (EPC) lifecycle, governance structures, organizational design, and Delegation of Authority frameworks.
Review capital project business cases, including key assumptions, structure, and feasibility.
Perform audit procedures covering engineering, planning, and cost-related areas, including master planning, engineering phases, stage-gate methods, and design maturity.
Apply cost-estimating principles, cost-estimate classifications, LPM build-up techniques, and undertake BoQ analysis and material take-offs.
Review procurement, contract, and commercial practices and apply project-control principles relating to schedule, cost, risk, and reporting.
Analyze the integrity, completeness, and accuracy of project plans, cost estimates, and risk plans, and interpret contracts, reports, and dashboards.
Review resource plans and schedules to assess their alignment with project objectives.
Complete assigned work within agreed timelines, budgets, and quality standards, and promptly escalate issues to engagement leadership.
Identify process improvement opportunities and develop practical, evidence-based recommendations.
Support business development activities, including research, proposal preparation, and development of marketing collateral.
Comply with the firm s quality and risk management policies at all times.
Manage multiple assigned tasks and workstreams under the guidance of engagement leadership.
Maintain proactive communication and professional working relationships with clients and team members.
Guide junior team members on assigned tasks and review their work where required.
Support engagement administration, budget monitoring, methodology development, and preparation of new solutions.
Skills and attributes for success
Excellent command of spoken and written English
Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations at short notice
Strong analytical, organizational, and consulting skills
Ability to manage assigned workstreams, collaborate effectively, and take ownership of deliverables
Ability to multitask and deliver quality work under tight deadlines
Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize effectively
Attention to detail and commitment to quality
Proficiency in MS Office Suite, data analysis, and validation
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor s or Master s degree in Engineering, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 3-5 years of relevant experience in Internal Audit or Risk Management, preferably within the Real Estate, Construction, or Capital Projects sector.
Experience executing or supporting audits involving cost estimation, engineering reviews, procurement, or project controls.
Ability to interpret and assess project documentation, including project charters, schedules, cost plans, and risk assessments.
A valid passport and willingness to travel internationally.
What working at EY offers
At EY, we re dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that s right for you

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Job Summary:
(Briefly describe the main objectives and purpose of the job. Why does the job exist What is it expected to accomplish)
We are looking for an Application Operations/Product Specialist. As the Application Specialist, you will be responsible to perform operational and Level 3 supports for production applications. You will also involve the daily management of incidents, operational maintenance and support, development support, and proactive or preventative analysis of systems. You should able to demonstrate knowledge of key business processes, products and services, within agreed areas of expertise. The role also includes coordinating with application teams to remediate system and application vulnerabilities identified by the Global Vulnerability Management team.
Essential Functions of the Job:
(Identify and describe essential functions, or primary duties and responsibilities. Assume that the reader does not know the role or function of the job.)
In your role as an Application Operations/Product Specialist you will be involved in:
Re-creation, analysis, troubleshooting, and diagnosis of incidents relating to off-the-shelf and proprietary applications and/or platforms;
To determine root cause of incidents (configuration vs defect);
Liaison with appropriate teams for the development of corrective actions or viable workarounds to resolve incidents;
Installation of applications in supported environments;
Deployment of application upgrades and fixes;
Responding to automated alerts on the health of systems;
Executing scheduled or unscheduled tasks relating to operational maintenance and monitoring of applications;
Performing routine audits of systems for the purpose of preventative maintenance of applications and reporting on their status;
Adhere to EY and ITIL guidelines for Incident, Problem and Change Management;
Effective call management including logging, monitoring/updating, prioritizing and resolving calls in a timely fashion;
Ensures all work is carried out and documented in accordance with required standards, methods and procedures;
Selects appropriately from applicable standards, methods, tools and applications and use accordingly;
Demonstrates analytical and systematic approach to problem solving;
Communicates fluently orally and in writing and can present complex technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences;
Plan, schedule and monitor work activities in order to meet time and quality targets;
Absorb rapidly new technical information, business acumen, and apply it effectively;
Address system and application vulnerabilities identified by the Global Vulnerability Management team, working collaboratively with the application team to remediate them in a timely manner;

Applies judgment in implementing application support tasks
Sound analytical skills and problem-solving skills needed to manage multiple technical challenges simultaneously when needed.

Takes accountability for quality technical deliverables and responsibilities.
Knowledge and Skills Requirements:

Knowledge of .NET framework 4.0 and above
Full stack front end Technology : HTML , Jquery , java script
Experience with web development frameworks - C# ,MVC and Bootstrap
Demonstrable Intermediate to Advanced knowledge of web platform such as IIS, SSL, SFTP, etc.
Good knowledge in SQL Server 2019, SSIS, SQL Reporting Services
General knowledge of Oracle 19c
Familiarity with SQL DBMS interface and integrated tools
Demonstrable knowledge of Windows 2019 server O/S
Knowledge of troubleshooting tools and techniques related to networks and systems i.e. remote access tools, Windows Support tools, connectivity tests, etc.
Experience in supporting applications in shared or virtual environments

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for selling hotel rooms, event spaces, and other services to potential customers. This role involves identifying and prospecting potential clients, making sales pitches, and closing deals to maximize revenue. As a Sales Executive, you re not just supporting sales operations and lead generation to help drive new business - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field
Minimum 1 year of experience in hotel sales preferred
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to build and maintain client relationships
Basic understanding of sales processes and revenue generation
Proficient in hotel systems (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey)
Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and able to work in a fast-paced environment
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Perform daily sales operations: Provide administrative support including data entry, invoice distribution, Salesforce activity tracking, and recordkeeping to ensure efficient team operations
Support sales documentation and reporting: Assist with preparing contracts, proposals, RFP responses, client call summaries, and booking and loyalty reports
Generate and qualify new business leads: Research, identify, and evaluate unmanaged and prospect accounts to build and maintain a qualified pipeline
Build collaborative relationships: Partner with Hilton Worldwide Sales peers, customers, and hotel partners to identify and qualify new opportunities, conduct discovery calls for unmanaged accounts, and deliver tailored solutions
Assist with special projects and events: Support departmental initiatives, customer engagement activities, and participation in meetings and conferences as needed

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! Overseeing daily restaurant operations to ensure everything runs smoothly and efficiently, you will create a warm and welcoming atmosphere where every guest feels like a VIP. You are responsible for developing a menu that creates unique dining experiences that will leave our guests in awe. As an Restaurant Manager you re not just elevating the dining experience - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Proven experience as an Outlet Manager or similar role in a high-end restaurant or hotel, or 2-3 years as an Assistant Manager.
Assistant Manager: The ideal candidate should possess at least 1 year of experience as an Assistant Outlet Manager.
High school diploma or equivalent; hospitality training is a plus
Excellent communication, grooming, and interpersonal skills
Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage
Friendly, professional, and guest-focused
Able to work flexible shifts
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Operational Oversight: Manage daily outlet operations to ensure smooth service and adherence to brand standards.
Team Leadership: Supervise, train, and motivate staff to deliver exceptional guest experiences and maintain high performance.
Guest Experience Management: Ensure personalized service, handle guest feedback, and resolve issues promptly to enhance satisfaction.
Inventory Cost Control: Monitor stock levels, manage ordering, and control costs to optimize profitability.
Sales Revenue Support: Drive upselling initiatives, monitor sales performance, and support revenue targets.
Compliance Hygiene: Ensure adherence to health, safety, and hygiene regulations across all outlet areas.
Coordination Communication: Collaborate with kitchen, housekeeping, and other departments for seamless service delivery.
Food Safety Regulations: Ensuring that all food safety standards are met.

Description:

Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! Description:
EY-Process & Controls Risk Consulting –Senior
As part of our Risk Consulting, you will be supporting the Team in client engagements related to Risk Management, Internal Audit, GRC solutions for various clients across the MENA region. The client base spans across various sectors and includes collaboration with other teams within Consulting services.
The opportunity
We’re looking for a Senior Consultant with experience in the Risk Consulting and Internal Audit to join our Process & Controls Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering. This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the beautiful state of Kerala.
Working in our practice, you will have the opportunity to work with clients to provide practical risk management, internal audit solutions and gaining valuable experience in a variety of clients.
Your key responsibilities
The current role requires executing internal audit and other risk consulting engagements for EY clients. As part of the role, the candidate is expected to:
Perform end-to-end internal audits from planning to reporting including process understanding, walkthroughs, preparation of risk and control matrix / audit work program, control testing to assess their design and operating effectiveness, preparation of audit report and agreeing issues/ actions with management.
Have an in-depth understanding of the various industry risks/ issues / trends and end-to-end business processes.
Have thorough knowledge and understanding of Internal Audit methodology and IIA requirements.
Deliver / manage engagements to time, cost and high quality.
Identify key areas of improvement in the client's business processes and add value by preparing insightful recommendations.
Contribute to business development activities such as preparing proposals, lead identification
Always comply with the firm’s quality and risk management policies
Manage multiple assignments and related project teams.
Maintain excellent rapport and proactive communication with the client
Mentor and coach junior team members, enabling them to meet their performance goals and successfully grow their careers
Manage the engagement budgets and support superiors in developing marketing collaterals, business proposals and new solution / methodology development
Skills and attributes for success
Exceptional command on spoken and written English
Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations at a short notice
Highly analytical, organised and meticulous consulting skills
Demonstrating and applying strong project management skills, inspiring teamwork and responsibility with engagement team members
Ability to multi-task, work well under pressure with commitment to deliver under tight deadline
Strong organizational skills with ability to prioritize effectively
Attention to detail and quality assurance
Proficient in MS-Office Suite, data analysis & validation
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor’s degree or relevant professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CIA etc..
A minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience in Internal Audit or Risk Management.
A valid passport for travel.
What working at EY offers
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you
