Description:
Job Title - Senior Manager - Testing - ACS Song
Management Level:Level6 - Senior Manager
Location:Kochi
Must have skills:RFP / Test Proposal Experience / Solutioning & Presales

Good to have skills:Experience in Digital Commerce
Experience:15+ years of experience in Testing

Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager Testing with 15 years of experience in Software Testing, Test Automation, and Quality Assurance Engineering. The ideal candidate will be responsible for shaping QA and automation strategies, leading testing teams, supporting RFP responses, presales and solutioning initiatives, and driving the adoption of modern quality engineering practices, including CI/CD, Continuous Testing, and AI-enabled testing. This role requires a strong blend of technical leadership, testing practice management, solutioning expertise, and client engagement experience to drive quality transformation across complex technology programs. Experience in Digital Commerce, Retail, or other large-scale customer-facing platforms is highly desirable.


Roles and Responsibilities
Define and lead enterprise and programme-level Quality Assurance strategies aligned with business objectives, technology architecture, delivery models, and risk. Assess existing testing practices and establish QA transformation roadmaps, target operating models, governance frameworks, engineering standards, and measurable quality outcomes.
Design scalable, maintainable, and fit-for-purpose test automation architectures covering UI, API, integration, component, contract, and end-to-end testing. Define automation frameworks, reusable components, test-data strategies, reporting, environment requirements, maintenance approaches, and technology selection based on application architecture, project requirements, scalability, maintainability, and overall QA strategy.
Define and implement CI/CD-integrated Quality Assurance and continuous testing strategies that provide fast, reliable, and actionable feedback throughout the software delivery lifecycle. Establish appropriate test execution strategies across pull requests, builds, deployments, integration and staging environments, regression cycles, and production validation.
Address and optimise the practical engineering challenges associated with continuous testing, including pipeline efficiency, test reliability, execution time, environment readiness, test-data management, dependencies, parallelisation, selective test execution, quality gates, and pipeline stability. Establish practices such as test impact analysis, risk-based test selection, mocking, tagging, and other optimisation techniques to improve feedback time and pipeline reliability.
Define and monitor QA and CI/CD metrics including automation coverage, execution time, test reliability, flakiness, pipeline stability, defect leakage, release confidence, and other relevant engineering and business outcomes.
Define and lead Performance Testing strategies for critical applications, services, and customer journeys, covering workload modelling, test planning, scripting, execution, scalability, capacity assessment, performance monitoring, bottleneck identification, detailed test-result analysis, performance optimisation, and performance regression.
Lead detailed analysis of Performance Test results by correlating application, infrastructure, and monitoring metrics to identify performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, resource utilisation issues, and system-level degradation. Translate findings into actionable recommendations for performance optimisation, scalability, capacity planning, and engineering improvements.
Define and implement API, Contract, and Component Testing strategies, establishing the appropriate balance across component, contract, API, integration, UI, end-to-end, and performance testing based on application architecture, business risk, and delivery requirements.
Define test planning and test case design approaches across programmes, ensuring appropriate test scope, scenarios, coverage, traceability, risk-based prioritisation, test data, environment requirements, entry/exit criteria, and execution strategies aligned with business and technical requirements.
Partner with Development, DevOps, Architecture, Product, and Platform Engineering teams within and outside the organisation to embed quality throughout the software development and delivery lifecycle and promote shift-left, continuous testing, and engineering-led quality practices.
Lead or significantly contribute to RFP, RFI, RFQ, presales, and client solutioning engagements from a Quality Assurance perspective. Translate client requirements and technology challenges into differentiated QA solutions, including QA strategies, automation architectures, CI/CD and continuous testing approaches, performance strategies, implementation roadmaps, effort estimates, resource models, timelines, assumptions, dependencies, risks, delivery approaches, and expected outcomes. Participate in client discovery sessions, solution workshops, proposal discussions, technical presentations, and solution defence activities.
Drive the adoption of AI, GenAI, Agentic, and MCP-based testing across Quality Assurance, identifying and implementing high-value use cases such as test generation, automation code generation, test maintenance, test-data generation, failure and defect analysis, intelligent test selection, test optimisation, and test-result analysis. Lead the evaluation and adoption of AI-enabled solutions capable of planning, generating, executing, analysing, and adapting testing activities.
Mentor and develop QA professionals across technical testing, test automation, performance testing, modern testing practices, solutioning, proposals, RFP/RFI/RFQ engagements, and client-facing activities. Provide technical guidance, knowledge sharing, coaching, and career development support while building strong testing capabilities and technical leadership within the team.
Act as a trusted Quality Assurance advisor to senior stakeholders and clients, providing technical direction, influencing technology and delivery decisions, communicating risks and recommendations, and aligning QA outcomes with broader business objectives.


Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills
Extensive experience defining and executing Quality Assurance and Quality Engineering strategies, driving testing transformation initiatives, and establishing Testing Centres of Excellence (TCoE) across enterprise programmes.
Proven expertise in Test Automation Strategy, Architecture, and Framework Design, with the ability to build scalable, maintainable, and reusable automation solutions across web, mobile, API, and cloud-based applications - selecting appropriate technologies based on application architecture, business risk, scalability, maintainability, and delivery requirements.
Strong technical leadership in modern Quality Engineering practices, including automation-first approaches, shift-left and shift-right testing, test optimisation, and continuous quality improvement.
Demonstrated success in managing and growing a Testing Practice, including capability development, competency building, resource planning, governance, offshore delivery management, and mentoring of QA and automation teams.
Strong hands-on experience across API, Contract, Component, Integration, End-to-End, and Performance Testing, with a thorough understanding of modern testing strategies and the appropriate balance across test levels based on architecture, risk, and delivery requirements.
Strong practical experience in Performance Testing, including workload modelling, test planning, scripting, execution, scalability and capacity assessment, performance regression, and optimisation. Demonstrated ability to analyse and correlate application, infrastructure, and monitoring metrics to identify bottlenecks, resource constraints, and scalability limitations - and provide actionable engineering recommendations.
Strong practical experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and DevOps delivery models, with the ability to design continuous testing strategies and address real-world challenges including test reliability, execution time, environment dependencies, test data, parallelisation, selective execution, pipeline stability, quality gates, and feedback optimisation.
Experience with test execution optimisation practices such as risk-based test selection, test impact analysis, parallel execution, test tagging, mocking, test-data management, environment strategy, and automation maintenance.
Strong understanding and practical experience of cloud technologies and cloud-native architectures, including validation of microservices, APIs, distributed systems, serverless architectures, and modern cloud platforms. Strong knowledge of containerisation technologies such as Docker and their application in test environment management and scalable automation execution.
Proven experience in RFP, RFI, RFQ, presales, and client solutioning - including proposal development, QA solution design, effort estimation, resource planning, costing, technical presentations, client workshops, and solution defence. Ability to translate client requirements into competitive, practical QE solutions covering strategy, automation architecture, CI/CD, performance, delivery model, risks, and measurable business outcomes.
Demonstrated experience adopting AI and GenAI for Software Testing and Quality Assurance, with a strong focus on identifying practical, high-value use cases that improve automation productivity, coverage, execution efficiency, maintenance, defect detection, and engineering effectiveness.
Mandatory hands-on experience with AI-assisted, Agentic, or MCP-based Testing - including evaluating, designing, building, or implementing AI agents and frameworks for test generation, automation code generation, test execution, test maintenance, intelligent test selection, failure analysis, and test-result interpretation. Ability to establish responsible AI adoption by evaluating solutions against criteria of accuracy, reliability, maintainability, security, governance, and appropriate human oversight.
Ability to define and drive enterprise-wide automation roadmaps, technology adoption strategies, and testing innovation initiatives - including AI and agentic testing - aligned with organisational objectives and measurable business outcomes.

Description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Cost Accountant to join our growing team. In this role, you will play a key part in analyzing manufacturing/operational costs, evaluating inventory, and maintaining cost accounting systems. Your insights will directly influence pricing strategies, budget controls, and profitability across our operations.
  Key Responsibilities
  Cost & Margin Analysis
Analyze manufacturing, labor, overhead, and raw material costs to determine standard cost standards and variances.
Perform variance analysis between standard costs and actual costs; report findings and recommended corrective actions to management.
Conduct margin and profitability analysis by product line, department, or project.
Inventory & Asset Management
Oversee inventory valuations, reconciliations, and cycle count auditing.
Monitor lower-of-cost- or-net-realizable-value (LCNRV) adjustments and identify obsolete or slow-moving inventory.
Partner with supply chain and operations teams to verify physical inventory counts and resolve discrepancies.
Budgeting, Forecasting & Reporting
Assist in the preparation of annual operating budgets, cost forecasts, and financial models.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual cost accounting reports for management.
Ensure accurate allocation of overhead costs in accordance with GAAP/IFRS standards.
Process Improvement & Systems
Evaluate existing internal controls and cost accounting procedures to identify areas for efficiency and cost reduction.
Support ERP system implementations, upgrades, or module optimizations related to cost tracking and inventory management.
Qualifications & Skills
Education: Bachelors degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
Experience: [25+] years of accounting experience, specifically focused on cost accounting or inventory accounting within [manufacturing / distribution / construction / relevant industry].
Certifications: Certified Management Accountant (CMA), CPA or ICWA
Technical Skills:
Proficiency in ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics).
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, index/match, pivot tables, financial modeling).
Core Competencies:
Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
Excellent communication skills to bridge financial data with non-financial department heads.
Close attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in standard costing and activity-based costing (ABC) methodologies.
Background working in a high-volume manufacturing or multi-site distribution environment.
Benefits:
Paid sick time
Paid time off

Description:
We are hiring a UX Writer into the growth team to own those words. This is a conversion-focused writing role, not a product documentation one. You will write and test the copy across our website, landing pages, lifecycle email, paid campaigns, pricing pages and upgrade flows, and you will be measured on what the copy does to the numbers.
Responsibilities
Own the copy across all growth surfaces: homepage, product and feature pages, campaign landing pages, pricing page, comparison pages, and the signup and upgrade flows.
Write lifecycle and marketing email: onboarding sequences, activation nudges, trial and upgrade prompts, win-back, feature announcements and newsletters.
Write ad and social copy for paid campaigns across Google, Meta and LinkedIn, and keep iterating on the variants that perform.
Build campaign and partner landing pages with design and performance marketing, and ship them without waiting on engineering.
Run copy experiments and own the test backlog for words: headlines, value propositions, CTAs, form length, pricing framing, social proof placement.
Turn privacy and compliance language into benefit-led copy a small business owner understands in one read.
Keep the message consistent across the funnel, from ad to landing page to onboarding email, and maintain the messaging and voice guidelines the rest of the team writes against.
Write the in-product growth surfaces: upgrade prompts, plan limits, paywalls and activation nudges, with product and design.
Work with SEO and content so that pages rank and convert, rather than one at the expense of the other.
Requirements
3+ years writing conversion-focused copy for a digital product across websites, landing pages, email or paid campaigns.
A portfolio with outcomes attached: what you wrote, what it replaced, and what happened to the metric.
Hands-on experience running A/B tests on copy, and the honesty to report a flat result as flat.
Working knowledge of an email or lifecycle platform such as HubSpot, Customer.io, Klaviyo or Braze.
Comfort in a CMS or page builder such as WordPress, Webflow or Unbounce.
Understanding of SEO GEO fundamentals and how they shape, and sometimes constrain, conversion copy.
Comfort working in Figma, Claude Design, Chat GPT Codex alongside designers.
Fluent, precise English with an ear for tone, and the discipline to cut.
Good to Have
Experience writing for a B2B SaaS product with a freemium or free-trial motion.
Familiarity with privacy, compliance, fintech or another regulated category.
Experience writing for a global, largely non-native-English audience.
Basic understanding of HTML and CSS.

Description:
Job Summary
We are hiring a Meta Ads Specialist to own that channel properly: paid social as a measurable acquisition engine, not a brand-awareness line item.
You will run Facebook and Instagram campaigns end to end, from audience strategy and creative testing through to attribution and payback. You will own the spend and the number it produces.
Responsibilities
Own Meta paid acquisition end to end: strategy, campaign structure, audiences, budgets, bidding, and daily optimisation.
Run prospecting, retargeting and lookalike campaigns against a defined CPA and payback target, and report honestly on which of them actually incrementally works.
Drive creative volume. Brief, test and iterate on a high cadence of static, video and UGC-style creative with design and the growth writer, and kill losers fast.
Own the measurement plan: pixel and Conversions API implementation, event mapping, offline and server-side conversions, and deduplication against other channels.
Configure tracking that survives a consent-first world. We sell consent management, so our own measurement setup has to be compliant and we have to be able to explain how.
Work with the growth writer and design on landing pages, and treat post-click conversion rate as part of your job rather than someone else s.
Run structured incrementality and holdout tests rather than trusting platform-reported ROAS alone.
Report weekly on spend, CPA, signup quality, free-to-paid conversion and contribution to MRR.
Extend into adjacent paid social channels such as LinkedIn, Reddit or X where the audience justifies it.
Requirements
3+ years managing Meta Ads spend hands-on, with direct responsibility for a monthly budget you can quantify.
Deep working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager: campaign structure, Advantage+ and manual setups, audience building, bid strategies and creative testing frameworks.
Practical experience with Meta Pixel and Conversions API, including server-side setup and event quality troubleshooting.
Strong creative judgement. You can look at a set of ads and predict which will work, and brief a designer so the next batch is better.
Analytical fluency in GA4 and spreadsheets, with an understanding of attribution windows, view-through inflation and where platform numbers overstate reality.
Experience optimising for a downstream event such as a paid conversion or qualified signup, not just a form fill.
Clear reporting. You can explain to a non-marketer why a campaign is scaling or being switched off.
Good to Have
Experience running paid social for B2B SaaS or a product-led, self-serve product.
Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads or Reddit Ads experience alongside Meta.
Familiarity with consent mode, privacy-safe measurement and modelled conversions.
Comfort with basic video editing or AI creative tooling to prototype ad concepts without waiting on design.

Description:
We are hiring an Affiliate Marketing Manager to set the strategy for the program and then run it: recruiting, activating and scaling a global base of publishers, agencies, developers, newsletter operators and content creators. This is an operator role with a clear number attached. You will own affiliate-sourced paid signups and the revenue behind them.
Responsibilities
Build the strategy for the affiliate program: which partner segments to pursue, which geographies and platforms to prioritise, what the commission and incentive model should be, and what the program needs to look like at three times its current size.
Own affiliate recruitment: identify, pitch and onboard publishers, review sites, agencies, YouTube creators, newsletter operators and niche communities in our category.
The metric that matters is not affiliates signed up, but affiliates producing revenue. Own the journey from signup to first conversion, including repeat revenue and retention or reactivation.
Design and iterate the commission structure, including tiered and performance-based models for high-volume partners, testing new approaches and incentives, while benchmarking competitor affiliate programs to keep CookieYes s commissions, attribution model, incentives and overall partner proposition competitive.
Manage the program day to day on platforms such as Tapfiliate or PartnerStack, including tracking, attribution, approvals and payouts.
Equip affiliates: creatives, landing pages, comparison content, product briefs, demo assets and campaign calendars.
Run affiliate-specific campaigns around launches, seasonal moments and regulatory deadlines.
Police quality. Monitor for brand-bidding violations, misleading claims, coupon abuse and fraudulent traffic, and enforce program terms.
Report weekly on signups, conversion rate, revenue per affiliate, activation rate, retention and payout efficiency, and act on what the numbers say.
Work with content, design and the growth team to produce assets affiliates actually use, and to fold partner content back into our own channels.
Requirements
2+ years running or supporting an affiliate, partner or performance marketing program, ideally for a SaaS or subscription product.
Hands-on experience with an affiliate platform such as Tapfiliate, PartnerStack, Impact, ShareASale or similar.
Familiarity with building and managing influencer partnerships across channels such as Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), newsletters, and other relevant platforms, with an eye for repurposing and integrating influencer content into existing growth channels such as organic, paid, social, and content marketing.
Comfort with tracking and attribution mechanics: cookies, postbacks, coupon codes, and deduplication against other channels.
Strong outbound and relationship skills. A large part of this job is cold outreach that does not read as cold.
Analytical rigour in spreadsheets, and the judgement to spot a channel that looks good but is cannibalising organic.
Clear written English for partner communication, newsletters and program documentation.
Bachelor s degree in marketing, management or a related field.
Good To Have
Experience automating partner onboarding, payouts and engagement workflows.
Experience in a WordPress, Shopify or other CMS plugin ecosystem.
Exposure to paid affiliate or co-funded ad programs.
Basic SEO knowledge, enough to judge the quality of an affiliate s traffic.

Description:
Responsibilities
Create high-quality, engaging, and technically accurate content for websites, blogs, landing pages, case studies, whitepapers, social media, email campaigns, and other marketing materials.
Research technology trends, industry developments, competitor activities, and global IT market trends to develop relevant content strategies.
Write SEO-optimized content to improve search rankings, website traffic, and lead generation.

Edit, proofread, and optimize content to ensure accuracy, consistency, readability, and adherence to brand guidelines.
Create content for social media creatives, including posters, banners, brochures, presentations, and infographics in collaboration with the design team.
Write captions, taglines, campaign messages, and promotional copy for digital marketing campaigns.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather information and support business and marketing initiatives.
Monitor content performance and suggest improvements based on analytics and engagement metrics.
Stay updated with technology trends, content marketing practices, AI tools, and digital marketing strategies.

Bachelor s degree in English, Journalism, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

Description:
Job Title: Assistant Manager - CAT - Loyalty
Company: Axis Max Life Insurance


As an Assistant Manager in the Customer Analytics Team focused on Loyalty at Axis Max Life Insurance, you will play a pivotal role in enhancing customer engagement and retention strategies. You will be responsible for analyzing customer data to identify trends, preferences, and behaviors that drive loyalty. Your insights will support the development of targeted marketing campaigns and loyalty programs aimed at improving customer experience and increasing retention rates. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including marketing, sales, and IT, to implement strategies that foster long-term customer relationships.

Key Responsibilities:
- Analyze customer data to derive insights that inform loyalty strategy and customer engagement initiatives.
- Develop and execute targeted loyalty programs based on customer segmentation and behavior analysis.
- Collaborate with marketing teams to design and implement campaigns that drive customer retention and enhance brand loyalty.
- Monitor and report on the performance of loyalty programs, making data-driven recommendations for improvements.
- Utilize advanced analytics tools to track customer engagement and satisfaction metrics.
- Work with IT and data teams to ensure accurate data collection and reporting processes.
- Stay updated on industry trends and best practices to continuously enhance loyalty programs.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis and interpretation.
- Proficiency in data analytics tools such as Excel, SQL, or similar software.
- Familiarity with CRM systems and customer loyalty platforms.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration.
- Strong project management abilities to execute loyalty initiatives effectively.
- Ability to think strategically and translate insights into actionable strategies.
- Knowledge of the insurance industry and customer behavior trends is an advantage.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of innovative loyalty programs that enhance customer satisfaction and drive business growth at Axis Max Life Insurance.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

- Monitors employees to ensure performance expectations are met.

Description:
Summary
We are seeking a proactive and experienced Oracle Fusion HCM Technical Consultant - Senior, with strong expertise in Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), BI Publisher (BIP), and Fast Formula, supported by hands-on experience across Oracle Time and Labor (OTL), Absence Management, and Payroll. The ideal candidate will have a strong Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM technical background and proven experience delivering integrations, reports, extracts, formulas, data conversions, and production support for complex HCM transformation initiatives.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities
Design, develop, test, deploy, and support Oracle Fusion HCM integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), including HCM adapters, REST and SOAP services, HDL, HCM Extracts, transformations, fault handling, monitoring, and third-party integrations.
Develop and maintain BI Publisher (BIP) reports, data models, templates, bursting configurations, payroll documents, extracts, and operational reports for HCM processes.
Design, develop, validate, and troubleshoot Fast Formulas for Oracle Time and Labor, Absence Management, and Payroll, including time-entry rules, overtime and premium calculations, accruals, eligibility, validations, payroll elements, earnings, deductions, and calculation logic.
Support end-to-end technical solutions for OTL, Absence, and Payroll, working closely with functional consultants to translate business requirements into scalable integrations, reports, extracts, and formulas.
Develop inbound and outbound interfaces for employee, assignment, time, absence, payroll, costing, and payment-related data using OIC, HCM Extracts, HDL, REST, SOAP, and secure file-transfer mechanisms.
Deliver high-quality work across the full SDLC, including technical design, code reviews, unit testing, SIT, UAT, release management, production deployment, reconciliation, and Hypercare support.
Diagnose integration, reporting, formula, time, absence, and payroll issues; identify root causes; optimize performance; and resolve production incidents within agreed service levels.
Build strong relationships with clients and internal teams while supporting Managers in meeting client commitments and internal KPIs.
Job Requirements
Strong hands-on experience in Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), BI Publisher (BIP), and Oracle Fusion HCM Fast Formula.
Minimum 5 years of relevant Oracle Fusion Cloud technical experience, including at least 2-3 full life-cycle implementations and one end-to-end HCM implementation or major rollout.
Extensive OIC experience covering Oracle HCM Cloud adapters, REST, SOAP, FTP/SFTP, scheduled and event-based integrations, mappings, lookups, fault handling, monitoring, and performance troubleshooting.
Strong BIP expertise covering SQL-based data models, RTF, Excel, eText, and XML templates, bursting, scheduling, security, troubleshooting, and report performance optimization.
Proven Fast Formula experience across OTL, Absence Management, and Payroll, including database items, contexts, inputs, defaults, formula functions, validation, compilation, testing, debugging, and performance optimization.
Good functional and technical understanding of OTL configurations and rules, time-entry validation, overtime, shift differentials, premium calculations, approval and transfer processes, and payroll integration.
Good understanding of Absence Management, including absence plans and types, accruals, eligibility, carryover, proration, entitlement, validations, and payroll impact.
Good understanding of Oracle Fusion Payroll, including elements, balances, earnings, deductions, calculation cards, costing, payroll flows, prepayments, payments, reconciliation, and legislative considerations.
Proficiency in HCM Extracts, HDL, OTBI, REST and SOAP web services, Oracle Cloud security, and related HCM reporting and integration technologies.
Experience with HCM data migration, conversion, reconciliation, and interface scheduling, including handling effective-dated employee and payroll data.
Experience preparing technical design documents, formula specifications, interface mappings, report designs, test scripts, deployment plans, and support documentation, with working knowledge of SIT, UAT, SDLC, and change management.
Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills, with a commitment to secure, compliant, and controlled delivery.
Competencies / Skills
Strong ability to drive projects along with the team and independently
Strong communication skills and ability to translate requirements into design documents.
Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines
Excellent organizational and time management skills, strong analytical & problem-solving skills
Ability to acquire, absorb, and apply complex technical knowledge to problems quickly
Ability to multitask and still stay focused on release priorities
Must have a valid passport.
Willing to work in MENA Shift timings (Sunday to Thursday).
Client site work / Business Traveling involve
Education: Should be a Oracle Certified and a graduate with a BTECH or MBA

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud EPM Financial Consolidation and Close (FCCS) and Account Reconciliation (ARCS) Senior Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in statutory and management consolidation, period-end close, multi-GAAP reporting, currency translation, intercompany eliminations, ownership management, journals, reporting and close-process automation account reconciliation, Reconciliation Compliance, high-volume. The role will support solution design and independently deliver application configuration, integrations, testing, deployment, documentation and production support under the guidance of project leadership.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities
Participate in end-to-end Oracle Cloud EPM Financial Consolidation and Close &
Account Reconciliation (ARCS) implementations, rollouts, enhancements and support engagements.
Conduct requirement-gathering, fit-to-standard and design discussions; document business requirements and translate them into scalable consolidation and close solutions.
Configure FCCS dimensions, metadata, application settings, validation accounts, substitution variables, security, forms, dashboards and navigation flows.
Configure ARCS solution architecture covering periods, calendars, currencies, organisational units, attributes, formats, profiles, reconciliation methods, risk ratings, workflow, rules, tolerances, variance analysis, attachments and audit evidence.
Configure consolidation methods, ownership structures, entity hierarchies, partial ownership, acquisitions, disposals and equity pickup requirements.
Implement currency translation, foreign-exchange calculations, CTA, historical rates, multi-currency and multi-GAAP reporting requirements.
Configure intercompany matching, eliminations, plug accounts, partner reporting and related reconciliation processes.
Develop and optimise configurable calculations, consolidation rules, member formulas, cash-flow logic, movement schedules and validation controls.
Configure consolidation journals, journal templates, approvals, posting workflows, recurring journals and audit controls; exposure to Enterprise Journals is desirable.
Configure Task Manager and close calendars to coordinate, monitor and automate period-end close activities; exposure to Supplemental Data Manager is desirable.
Build statutory, management and consolidation reports using Oracle Cloud EPM Reports, books, bursting, charts, grids, dashboards and Smart View.
Develop and support integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, E-Business Suite, SAP, other ERPs and data warehouses using Data Integration, EPM Automate, REST APIs and file-based interfaces.
Execute CRP, SIT, UAT, data migration, trial-balance reconciliation, parallel close, cutover, go-live and hypercare activities; investigate defects and support root-cause resolution.
Prepare configuration workbooks, solution designs, specifications, test scripts, training materials, close procedures and deployment documentation.
Collaborate with finance, controllership, audit, tax and technical teams; guide junior consultants, participate in peer reviews and support demonstrations and estimations.
Experience
Minimum 5+ years of Oracle EPM experience, including strong hands-on experience with Oracle Cloud EPM Financial Consolidation and Close.
At least two full-lifecycle Oracle EPM implementations, including one FCCS implementation.
Strong knowledge of consolidation accounting, legal and management consolidation, currency translation, intercompany eliminations, ownership, journals, cash flow and multi-GAAP reporting.
Hands-on experience with FCCS application configuration, configurable calculations, data loads, reconciliations, close execution and performance troubleshooting.
Demonstrable ARCS experience with Reconciliation Compliance and Transaction Matching, including profiles, formats, rules, match types, data sources, adjustments, exceptions and dashboards
Strong reporting experience with Oracle Cloud EPM Reports, Smart View, dashboards and management reporting packs.
Experience integrating FCCS with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP or other source systems using Data Integration, EPM Automate, REST APIs or file-based integrations.
Experience supporting workshops, configuration, testing, migration, cutover, go-live and post-production support.
Industry experience in government, retail, energy, real estate, oil and gas, financial services, or power and utilities is preferred.
Competencies / Skills
Oracle Cloud EPM Financial Consolidation and Close application configuration and administration
Consolidation methods, ownership management, equity pickup, intercompany matching and eliminations
Currency translation, CTA, historical rates, cash-flow statements, movement schedules and multi-GAAP reporting
Configurable calculations, consolidation rules, member formulas, validation controls and performance optimisation
Consolidation Journals, Enterprise Journals, Task Manager, Supplemental Data Manager and close orchestration
Oracle Cloud EPM Reports, books, bursting, charts, grids, dashboards, Smart View and executive reporting packs
Data Integration, EPM Automate, REST APIs, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and third-party ERP integrations
Close-process controls, segregation of duties, audit trails, reconciliations and statutory reporting
Awareness of AI-assisted close monitoring, anomaly detection, variance analysis and narrative commentary is desirable
Strong analytical, accounting, problem-solving, documentation, teamwork and stakeholder communication skills
Valid passport and willingness to travel to client locations and work MENA business timings, Sunday to Thursday
Education
CA, CMA, ACCA, MBA Finance or an equivalent finance/business qualification is preferred.
Relevant Oracle Cloud EPM Financial Consolidation and Close certification is preferred; integration, reporting or close-process

Description:
Oracle Fusion - PPM & FIN Functional - Senior
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Project Portfolio Management (PPM) and Finance Functional Senior with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience and sound project management and project financials domain knowledge. The role requires hands-on implementation and support experience across Project Foundation, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Control, Project Contracts and Finance modules, with exposure to Project Execution Management, Project Resource Management, Grants Management and capital projects preferred. The successful candidate will independently deliver assigned functional areas and actively support requirement gathering, configuration, testing, deployment and post-go-live activities.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities
Deliver assigned Oracle Fusion PPM functional areas across implementations, rollouts, upgrades and support engagements.
Configure and support Project Foundation, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Control and Project Contracts, Finance Modules (Accounts Payables, General Ledger) with exposure to other PPM modules preferred.
Analyse project management and project accounting requirements and map them to standard Oracle Fusion Cloud PPM processes.
Configure project organizations, project units, templates, classifications, expenditure structures, burden schedules, rate schedules, budgets, forecasts, billing plans and revenue methods under solution lead guidance.
Participate in fit-to-standard workshops, requirement gathering, process design and solution walkthroughs.
Prepare functional design documents, configuration workbooks, process flows, test scripts, training materials and operating procedures.
Support PPM integrations with Financials, Procurement, HCM, Time and Labor, Expenses, Supply Chain, EPM, reporting and external applications.
Execute CRP, SIT, UAT, data migration, cutover, go-live and hypercare activities, including project cost reconciliation and defect resolution.
Validate cost collection, capitalization, burdening, budgeting, forecasting, invoicing, revenue recognition and project performance reporting.
Track assigned activities, risks, issues, dependencies and deliverables, and provide timely status updates.
Collaborate with functional, technical, integration, data, finance and reporting teams and support junior consultants as required.
Experience
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Oracle Projects or Project Portfolio Management, including hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud PPM and Oracle FInancils
Strong implementation or support experience in Project Foundation, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Control and Project Contracts.
Good understanding of project lifecycle and project financial management concepts, including planning, budgeting, forecasting, cost collection, burdening, capitalization, billing, revenue recognition and performance reporting.
Experience in at least two full lifecycle Oracle Projects or PPM implementations, including at least one Oracle Fusion Cloud PPM implementation.
Hands-on experience in requirement analysis, configuration, testing, data migration, cutover and post-go-live support.
Exposure to PPM integrations with Financials, Procurement, HCM, Time and Labor, Expenses, SCM or EPM is preferred.
Experience in client-facing delivery, documentation, issue resolution and stakeholder communication.
Experience in project-centric sectors such as government, engineering and construction, professional services, energy, real estate, oil and gas, or power and utilities is preferred.
Competencies / Skills
Strong Oracle Fusion PPM functional, customer handling and teamwork skills.
Ability to independently manage assigned PPM work areas, work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Good knowledge of project management, project accounting and project financial control processes.
Effective communication skills and ability to translate business requirements into functional documentation.
Strong organizational, time management, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to learn complex business processes and apply knowledge effectively.
Ability to follow defined delivery and release management processes and remain focused on priorities.
Must have a valid passport for business travel involving work at client sites and be willing to work MENA shift timings (Sunday to Thursday).
Awareness of AI applications in project portfolio management, including automation, predictive analytics and AI-driven project insights.
Education
Mandatory qualification: Bachelor s or master s degree in engineering, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Project Management or a related discipline from a recognised institution.
Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Management certification is preferred; PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification is an advantage.

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a proactive and experienced Oracle Fusion Technical Consultant - Senior, with primary expertise in Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and BI Publisher (BIP), complemented by hands-on experience in Oracle Visual Builder Studio (VB Studio) and Oracle AI Agents. The ideal candidate will have a strong Oracle Fusion Cloud technical background and proven experience delivering integrations, reporting solutions, application extensions, intelligent automation, and transformation initiatives across ERP, SCM, PROC, HCM, PPM, and IT support.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities
Design, develop, test, deploy, and support integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), including connections, adapters, orchestration, transformations, error handling, monitoring, and third-party integrations.
Develop and maintain BI Publisher (BIP) reports, data models, templates, bursting configurations, extracts, and enterprise payment or document formats.
Build and extend Oracle Fusion Cloud user experiences using Oracle Visual Builder Studio (VB Studio), including application extensions, service connections, business objects, pages, fragments, and deployment pipelines.
Configure and develop Oracle AI Agents and supporting tools, knowledge sources, prompts, business-object interactions, BIP reports, and OIC or REST integrations to deliver secure, governed automation.
Translate functional and business requirements into scalable technical designs, specifications, integrations, reports, extensions, and AI-enabled solutions.
Deliver high-quality work across the full SDLC, including code reviews, unit testing, SIT, UAT, release management, production deployment, and Hypercare support.
Identify technical and delivery risks, resolve issues proactively, and escalate concerns where appropriate.
Build strong relationships with clients and internal teams while supporting Managers in meeting client commitments and internal KPIs.
Job Requirements
Strong hands-on experience in Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and BI Publisher (BIP), supported by relevant Oracle Fusion Cloud technical experience.
Minimum 5 years of relevant Oracle Fusion Cloud technical experience, Should have worked in at least 2-3 full life cycle implementations with relevant experience developing Oracle Fusion Cloud technical solutions, including at least one end-to-end implementation or major rollout.
Extensive OIC experience covering REST, SOAP, FTP/SFTP, database, Oracle ERP, HCM, and SCM Cloud adapters; mappings, lookups, schedules, fault handling, monitoring, and performance troubleshooting.
Strong BIP expertise covering SQL-based data models, layouts, eText and XML templates, bursting, scheduling, security, troubleshooting, and report performance optimization.
Hands-on experience with Oracle Visual Builder Studio (VB Studio), including Fusion application extensions, web applications, service connections, business objects, dynamic pages or forms, Git repositories, build jobs, and deployment pipelines.
Experience with Oracle AI Agents or AI Agent Studio, including agent and tool configuration, prompt design, knowledge sources, business objects, documents, external REST services, BIP reports, OIC integrations, testing, security, and deployment governance.
Good understanding of Oracle Fusion modules across ERP, SCM, HCM, and Projects, with the ability to work closely with functional teams.
Proficiency in OTBI, SQL, PL/SQL, REST and SOAP web services, Oracle Cloud security, and related reporting or integration technologies.
Experience with data migration and conversion using FBDI, HDL, spreadsheet loaders, and relevant Oracle Cloud import processes.
Experience preparing technical design documents, specifications, test scripts, deployment plans, and support documentation, with working knowledge of SIT, UAT, code reviews, SDLC, and change management.
Knowledge of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Autonomous Database, Oracle Analytics Cloud, DevOps practices, and Agile delivery tools is preferred.
Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills, with a commitment to secure and compliant delivery.
Competencies / Skills
Strong ability to drive projects along with the team and independently
Strong communication skills and ability to translate requirements into design documents.
Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines
Excellent organizational and time management skills, strong analytical & problem-solving skills
Ability to acquire, absorb, and apply complex technical knowledge to problems quickly
Ability to multitask and still stay focused on release priorities
Must have a valid passport.
Willing to work in MENA Shift timings (Sunday to Thursday).
Client site work / Business Traveling involve
Education
Should be a Oracle Certified and a graduate with a BTECH or MBA

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Cloud Supply Chain Management (SCM) and Procurement (PROC) Functional Consultant at Senior level with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience. The successful candidate will independently support and deliver Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation, transformation, rollout and support engagements across Procurement and related SCM areas, including Self Service Procurement, Purchasing, Sourcing, Supplier Qualification and Management, Procurement Contracts, Inventory Management, Order Management, Product Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain Planning, Cost Management, Maintenance and Logistics. The role requires strong hands-on functional capability, client-facing delivery experience and relevant industry/domain expertise to translate real-world source-to-pay and supply-chain requirements into scalable Oracle Fusion solutions. Knowledge of Oracle Redwood user experience and Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio is also expected.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities
Deliver Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM and Procurement implementation, transformation, rollout and support activities from requirements gathering through design, configuration, testing, deployment and stabilization.
Manage assigned workstream tasks, plans, risks, issues, dependencies, quality and stakeholder updates under the guidance of the project lead or manager.
Facilitate business workshops, assess current-state industry processes and translate requirements into scalable future-state Oracle Fusion SCM and Procurement solutions aligned with leading practices.
Perform functional fit-gap analysis, configuration, prototyping, conference room pilots, testing, training, cutover and go-live support.
Design integrated source-to-pay, procure-to-pay and supply-chain solutions across Procurement, Inventory Management, Order Management, Cost Management and related SCM modules, coordinating dependencies with Payables, Finance, Projects, reporting, integration, security and data teams.
Prepare high-quality functional designs, configuration workbooks, process flows, test artefacts, user guides and training materials in line with Oracle implementation methodologies.
Assess Oracle Redwood readiness, support business-process redesign for Redwood pages and guided experiences, and execute adoption, testing and change-impact activities.
Identify suitable SCM use cases for Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio and support the definition of agent topics, instructions, tools, data access, human-approval checkpoints and expected outcomes.
Collaborate with technical, security and integration teams to configure, test, publish and monitor AI agents and agentic workflows within Oracle Fusion.
Follow responsible AI controls covering role-based access, data privacy, traceability, testing, monitoring and business-owner approval.
Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, cutover and production support, and drive timely resolution of defects and functional queries.
Contribute to client presentations, solution demonstrations, estimates, proposals, knowledge assets and practice-development initiatives.
Guide junior consultants, review assigned deliverables and maintain delivery quality and internal KPIs.
Experience
Minimum 5 years of relevant Oracle SCM and Procurement experience, including strong hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud.
At least two end-to-end ERP implementation or transformation engagements, including at least one Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM implementation.
Strong functional expertise in Oracle Fusion Procurement-including Self Service Procurement, Purchasing, Sourcing, Supplier Qualification and Management, Supplier Portal and Procurement Contracts-together with hands-on knowledge of at least one core SCM area such as Inventory Management, Order Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain Planning, Product Management, Cost Management, Maintenance or Logistics.
Hands-on experience with source-to-pay and procure-to-pay process design, enterprise structures, procurement business units, requisitioning, purchasing, approvals, catalogs, supplier onboarding, sourcing, contracts, receiving, integrations, data migration, reporting and operational controls.
Practical knowledge of Oracle Redwood UX, including Redwood page adoption, process redesign, extension considerations, testing and end-user change management.
Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio, including agent configuration concepts, topics, instructions, tools, workflow orchestration, deployment, security and monitoring.
Ability to support high-value agentic SCM use cases, such as supplier onboarding assistance, procurement policy guidance, order exception management, inventory insights or planning support.
Client-facing delivery experience with sound planning, estimation, risk management, testing and quality assurance capabilities.
Demonstrable industry/domain experience in at least one sector-such as retail, government, energy, real estate, oil and gas, manufacturing, utilities, logistics or consumer products-with practical understanding of sector-specific procurement, supplier, inventory, fulfilment, planning and operational-control requirements.
Competencies / Skills
Strong stakeholder management, consulting, collaboration and junior-team mentoring skills.
Ability to independently manage assigned functional workstreams, priorities and deliverables within agreed timelines.
Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills, with the ability to explain business and functional concepts clearly.
Strong analytical, industry-process design, problem-solving and decision-making capabilities, with the ability to apply domain knowledge to Oracle Fusion SCM and Procurement solutions.
Sound understanding of responsible AI, data privacy, access controls, human oversight and governance for enterprise agentic solutions.
Awareness of Oracle quarterly updates and the ability to assess new SCM, Redwood and embedded-AI capabilities for business adoption.
Proficiency in delivery and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Azure DevOps or equivalent.
Valid passport and willingness to travel to client sites and work MENA business schedules, including Sunday to Thursday, where required.
Education
Bachelor s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, Information Systems or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.
Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM and/or Procurement certification in relevant modules is preferred; credentials or demonstrated training in Oracle Redwood and Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio are an added advantage.

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Project Financials Functional Senior with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience and strong project accounting and financial management expertise. Chartered Accountant qualification is mandatory. The role requires hands-on implementation and support experience across Project Foundation, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts and Project Control, including budgeting, forecasting, cost collection, burdening, capitalization, intercompany and interproject processing, invoicing, revenue recognition, accounting and reconciliation. The successful candidate will independently deliver assigned functional areas and support requirement gathering, configuration, testing, deployment and post-go-live activities.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities
Deliver assigned Oracle Fusion Project Financials functional areas across implementations, rollouts, upgrades and support engagements.
Configure and support Project Foundation, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts and Project Control.
Analyse project accounting and financial management requirements and map them to standard Oracle Fusion Cloud processes and controls.
Configure project organizations, project units, templates, classifications, expenditure types, transaction sources, burden schedules, rate schedules, budgets, forecasts, billing plans, revenue methods and accounting options.
Support cost collection, cost allocation, burdening, capitalization, project asset creation, intercompany and interproject billing, customer invoicing, revenue recognition and project close processes.
Participate in fit-to-standard workshops, requirement gathering, process design, solution walkthroughs and finance stakeholder discussions.
Prepare functional design documents, configuration workbooks, process flows, test scripts, reconciliation templates, training materials and operating procedures.
Support integrations with General Ledger, Receivables, Payables, Fixed Assets, Procurement, Expenses, Time and Labor, HCM, EPM and external applications.
Execute CRP, SIT, UAT, data migration, cutover, go-live and hypercare activities, including project cost, revenue, invoice and accounting reconciliation and defect resolution.
Validate subledger accounting, accounting distributions, period close, project-to-ledger reconciliation and project performance reporting.
Collaborate with finance, functional, technical, integration, data and reporting teams and support junior consultants as required.
Experience
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Oracle Projects, Project Accounting or Project Financial Management, including hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Financials.
Chartered Accountant qualification and relevant post-qualification experience in project accounting, financial control, audit, revenue, costing or management accounting are mandatory.
Strong implementation or support experience in Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts, Project Control and Project Foundation.
Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, cost collection, allocations, burdening, capitalization, project assets, invoicing, revenue recognition, accounting and reconciliation.
Experience in at least two full lifecycle Oracle Projects or Project Financials implementations, including at least one Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation.
Hands-on experience in requirement analysis, configuration, testing, data migration, cutover, period close, reconciliation and post-go-live support.
Experience with integrations across General Ledger, Receivables, Payables, Fixed Assets, Procurement, Expenses, Time and Labor, HCM or EPM is preferred.
Experience in project-centric sectors such as engineering and construction, professional services, energy, real estate, oil and gas, government, or power and utilities is preferred.
Competencies / Skills
Strong Oracle Fusion Project Financials functional, project accounting and financial control skills.
Ability to independently manage assigned Project Financials work areas, work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Sound understanding of accounting standards, project costing, revenue recognition, capitalization, subledger accounting, period close and financial reconciliation.
Effective communication skills and ability to translate finance and business requirements into functional documentation.
Strong organizational, analytical, reconciliation, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to assess financial process and control implications and apply sound professional judgement.
Ability to follow defined delivery, governance and release management processes and remain focused on priorities.
Must have a valid passport for business travel involving work at client sites and be willing to work MENA shift timings (Sunday to Thursday).
Education
Mandatory qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountant from a recognised professional accounting body, with relevant post-qualification experience.
Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Management or Project Financial Management certification is preferred.

Description:
Oracle Human Capital Management - Functional - Senior (Payroll, Absence and Time & Labor)
Job Summary
We are seeking an initiative-taking and experienced Oracle Fusion Payroll - Functional Senior Consultant to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of Oracle Fusion Payroll, payroll processing, payroll elements, balances, costing, fast formulas, legislative/localization requirements and related Oracle HCM modules, extensive functional expertise, and a proven ability to deliver successful implementations and support in a consulting environment.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities
Manage and support internal KPI s, Oracle Fusion Payroll implementation projects, including requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment.
Should be able to interpret functional requirements and able to deliver and design it from onsite and offshore. If required, ready to travel to onsite
Provide functional expertise in Oracle Fusion Payroll and related Oracle HCM modules like Absence and time & labor, payroll elements, balances, payroll flows, costing, retro pay, Core HR
Collaborate with clients to understand their payroll, and related HCM processes and requirements and provide recommendations for improvements and optimizations. Conduct fit-gap analysis, configuration, functional design documentation, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
Identify and mitigate system risks by evaluating functional and cross-functional dependencies, proactively recommend process improvements based on best practices.
Develop and maintain project documentation using AIM / OUM / TCM / Agile or other prescribed methodologies, including functional specifications, payroll configuration workbooks, test plans, and user guides.
Drive and assist business users during Prototype/CRPs/SITs/UATs/KUTs and prepare payroll test scripts, payroll cycle test cases, costing validation scenarios and conduct trainings.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Oracle Fusion Payroll and Human Resources, providing timely and effective support to clients.
Ensure project timelines, milestones, and deliverables are met and function as the primary functional consultant for stakeholder alignment.
Stay updated with the latest Oracle Fusion Payroll and Oracle Fusion HCM features, functionalities, and industry best practices to provide innovative solutions to clients.
Participate in proposal development and client presentations.
Guide junior consultants, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented work environment.
Experience
Core experience in Payroll and Human Resource with localization knowhow and having HR/payroll domain/process knowledge is preferred.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience working in ERP HR modules (EBS /Fusion) in Oracle Fusion Payroll, Absence, Time and labor with implementation and support experience with a focus on functional consulting.
Should have worked in at least 2-3 full life cycle implementations in Oracle Fusion Payroll, Oracle HCM Cloud, Oracle EBS, and emerging ERP platforms.
In-depth knowledge of Oracle Fusion Payroll, Oracle HCM suite and its integration with other Oracle applications suits.
Lead the team either from the onsite and offshore, manage delivery independently.
Experience in payroll costing and integration with Manpower planning, Attendance, Time and Labour or downstream finance systems.
Familiarity with Oracle Reporting Tools (OTBI, BI Publisher), payroll reports, payroll flows and integrations using HCM Extracts.
Demonstrated expertise in Oracle Fusion Payroll, payroll elements, balances, fast formulas, payroll costing, retro pay, Core HR, and Time and Labour
Knowledge of configuration workbooks, Fast Formulas, Payroll Rules, payroll elements, balances, costing, payment methods, payroll processes and payroll reporting is desirable.
Prior consulting experience in a Big Four or similar environment is an asset.
Experience in any of the major industry sectors like Retail, Government, Energy, Real Estate, Oil & Gas, Power & Utilities and Finance & Banking
Competencies / Skills
Strong customer handling skills and ability to lead & mentor team-members
Ability to drive projects along with the team and independently
Strong communication skills and ability to translate requirements into design documents.
Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines
Excellent organizational and time management skills, strong analytical & problem-solving skills
Ability to acquire, absorb, and apply complex business knowledge to problems quickly
Ability to work as part of a team
Ability to follow well defined release management processes
Ability to multitask and still stay focused on release priorities
Education
Should be a graduate with an MBA in HRMS/HCM and preferably with Oracle Payroll/Fusion HCM certification and having professional certification (e.g., SHRM, HRCI) is a plus

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking an initiative-taking and experienced Oracle Fusion Human Capital Management, Talent, Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC) and Benefits, Functional Senior Consultant to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of Oracle Core HCM, Talent, ORC and Benefits modules, extensive functional expertise, and a proven ability to deliver successful implementations and support in a consulting environment.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities
Manage and support internal KPI s, Oracle Fusion HCM Talent, ORC and Benefits implementation projects, including requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment, while continuing to support Oracle Core HR implementation priorities.
Should be able to interpret functional requirements and able to deliver and design it from onsite and offshore. If required, ready to travel to onsite
Provide functional expertise in Oracle Fusion HCM modules, with primary focus on Talent Management, Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC) and Benefits, including Core HR, Global Human Resources and know-how in Talent Management
Collaborate with clients to understand their business processes and requirements and provide recommendations for improvements and optimizations. Conduct fit-gap analysis, configuration, functional design documentation, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
Identify and mitigate system risks by evaluating functional and cross-functional dependencies, proactively recommend process improvements based on best practices.
Develop and maintain project documentation using AIM / OUM / TCM / Agile or other prescribed methodologies, including functional specifications, test plans, and user guides.
Drive and assist business users during Prototype/CRPs/SITs/UATs/KUTs and Prepare test scripts and test cases & conduct trainings.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Oracle Core HCM, Talent, ORC, Benefits providing timely and effective support to clients.
Ensure project timelines, milestones, and deliverables are met and function as the primary functional consultant for stakeholder alignment.
Stay updated with the latest Oracle HRMS features, functionalities, and industry best practices to provide innovative solutions to clients.
Participate in proposal development and client presentations.
Guide junior consultants, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented work environment.
Experience
Core experience in Human Resource with localization knowhow in any of the middle east countries and having HR domain/process knowledge is preferred.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience working in ERP HR modules (Fusion) in Oracle Core Human Resource, Talent, ORC and Benefits in implementation and support, with focus on functional consulting.
Should have worked in at least 2-3 full life cycle implementations in Oracle HCM Cloud and emerging ERP platforms.
In-depth knowledge of Oracle Fusion HCM suite, and its integration with other Oracle applications suits.
Ready to work either from the onsite and offshore, manage delivery independently.
Experience in costing and integration with Manpower planning or Attendance systems is nice to have
Familiarity with Oracle Reporting Tools (OTBI, BI Publisher) and integrations using HCM Extracts
Having knowhow or exposure in Absence, Talent Management, Compensation, Payroll, Performance, Time and Labour is an added advantage
Prior consulting experience in a Big Four or similar environment is an asset.
Experience in any of the major industry sectors like Retail, Government, Energy, Real Estate, Oil & Gas, Power & Utilities and Finance & Banking
Competencies / Skills
customer handling
lead & mentor team-members
drive projects along with the team and independently
translate requirements into design documents
work under pressure and meet deadlines
organizational and time management skills
analytical & problem-solving skills
teamwork
release management processes
Education
Should be a graduate with an MBA in HRMS/HCM and preferably with Oracle certification and having professional certification (e.g., SHRM, HRCI) is a plus

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation (ARCS) Senior Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in Reconciliation Compliance, high-volume Transaction Matching, reconciliation governance, reporting, integrations and automation. The role will support solution design and independently deliver application configuration, data loads, matching rules, workflow, testing, deployment, documentation and production support under the guidance of project leadership.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities
Participate in end-to-end Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation implementations, rollouts, enhancements and support engagements.
Configure Reconciliation Compliance, including periods, calendars, currencies, organisational units, attributes, formats, profiles, reconciliation methods, risk ratings and workflow.
Configure preparer and reviewer assignments, tolerances, variance analysis, auto-reconciliation, ageing, alerts, notifications, attachments, comments, electronic sign-offs and audit evidence.
Design Transaction Matching solutions using multiple data sources, match types, transaction types, one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-one and many-to-many rules, tolerance logic and date or amount adjustments.
Configure and tune auto-match rules, suggested matches, manual matching, adjustments, unmatched-item ageing, exception handling and reconciliation integration.
Develop balance-sheet, intercompany, bank, cash, subledger-to-ledger, system-to-system and operational reconciliation use cases.
Create and support operational and compliance dashboards, predefined and custom reports, reconciliation-status reporting, ageing analysis, match-rate monitoring and exception reporting.
Develop and support integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, E-Business Suite, SAP, FCCS, banks, subledgers, data warehouses and external systems using Data Integration, EPM Automate, REST APIs and file-based interfaces.
Automate profile imports, balance and transaction loads, currency rates, reconciliation creation, auto-match execution, period-status changes, journal exports, reporting and job monitoring.
Execute CRP, SIT, UAT, data migration, reconciliation-cycle validation, volume and performance testing, cutover, go-live and hypercare; investigate defects and support root-cause resolution.
Prepare configuration workbooks, functional and technical specifications, match-rule designs, test scripts, training materials, operating procedures and deployment documentation.
Support security, segregation of duties, reconciliation policies, audit trails, evidence retention, data lineage, controls and production-support procedures.
Collaborate with finance, controllership, audit and technical teams; guide junior consultants, participate in peer reviews and support demonstrations and estimations.
Experience
Minimum 5+ years of Oracle EPM, finance transformation or account-reconciliation experience, including strong hands-on Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation experience.
At least two full-lifecycle Oracle EPM implementations, including one ARCS implementation covering Reconciliation Compliance and Transaction Matching.
Strong knowledge of balance-sheet reconciliation, account substantiation, reconciliation governance, risk-based workflow, variance analysis and financial-close controls.
Hands-on experience with periods, formats, profiles, rules, currencies, organisational units, workflow, auto-reconciliation, ageing and dashboards.
Hands-on Transaction Matching experience with data sources, match types, matching rules, adjustments, exceptions, auto-match optimisation and high-volume data sets.
Experience integrating ARCS with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP or other source systems and automating processes through Data Integration, EPM Automate and REST APIs.
Experience supporting workshops, configuration, testing, migration, reconciliation-cycle validation, cutover, go-live and post-production support.
Industry experience in government, retail, energy, real estate, oil and gas, financial services, or power and utilities is preferred.
Competencies / Skills
Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation configuration, administration and connected financial-close processes
Reconciliation Compliance, periods, formats, profiles, workflow, risk ratings, ageing, auto-reconciliation and audit evidence
Transaction Matching data sources, match types, rules, tolerances, adjustments, exceptions and match-performance optimisation
Balance-sheet, intercompany, bank, cash, subledger-to-ledger, system-to-system and operational reconciliations
Operational and compliance dashboards, predefined and custom reports, ageing, variance, status and exception analysis
Data Integration, EPM Automate, REST APIs, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, FCCS and third-party ERP, bank and subledger integrations
Security, segregation of duties, controls, audit trails, evidence retention, data lineage and compliance reporting
Awareness of Predictive AI, Reconciliation Assignment Assistance, Transaction Matching Assistance, confidence scores, anomaly detection and governed human review is desirable
Strong accounting, analytical, problem-solving, requirement analysis, documentation and stakeholder communication skills
Strong teamwork, mentoring and delivery capabilities; willingness to travel and work MENA business timings
Education
CA, CMA, ACCA, MBA Finance or an equivalent finance/business qualification is preferred.
Relevant Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation certification is preferred; accounting, audit, controls, integration or reporting credentials are advantageous.

Description:
Job Summary
Position: Graphics Designer - Senior Associate
Education: Any Graduate
Experience: 5 - 8 years of relevant experience
The Opportunity
This position will support the design and development of engaging visual content for eLearning modules and other digital learning materials. The Graphics Designer will work to agreed design quality standards and processes, using approved templates and tools, and will collaborate with other designers and learning professionals to enhance the quality and effectiveness of visual learning solutions. Additionally, the designer will develop and maintain strong relationships with content owners, Subject Matter Reviewers (SMRs), and other stakeholders.
Your Key Responsibilities
Proficiently create and customize eLearning modules using development tools, implementing interactive elements and assessments.
Independently produce high-quality graphic designs and layouts, mentoring junior designers in the process.
Manage LMS content areas, troubleshooting issues and providing user support while mentoring others in LMS usage.
Design and implement interactive elements for eLearning modules, creating complex interactive experiences.
Produce animations and videos, including storyboarding, editing, and post-production, contributing to creative brainstorming sessions.
Create a wide range of visual assets, including complex graphics and illustrations, guiding junior designers in asset production.
Design sophisticated typographic and layout solutions, setting benchmarks for quality and brand compliance.
Ensure all designs meet accessibility standards, advocating for inclusive design practices and mentoring others in best practices.
Design and implement gamification strategies within eLearning modules to enhance engagement and learning retention.
Craft compelling visual narratives that align with project messages and goals, developing storyboards and providing creative direction.
Apply design principles to enhance project outcomes, mentoring junior designers in effective design practices.
Communicate design ideas clearly, gathering feedback effectively and engaging in collaborative discussions.
Translate complex storyboards into detailed visual designs that enhance learning, providing guidance to junior designers.
Conduct thorough quality assurance reviews, ensuring visual consistency and functionality of eLearning materials.
Audit design work for brand compliance, mentoring junior designers on adherence to brand standards.
Facilitate effective teamwork by coordinating tasks and supporting team members, taking a proactive role in projects.
Adapt designs in response to feedback and evolving project requirements, proactively seeking solutions to design challenges.
Build strong relationships with SMRs and project teams, effectively gathering requirements and incorporating feedback.
Provide mentorship to junior designers, leading by example in design projects and supporting their professional development.
Foresee and proactively deal with challenges in projects
Skills and Attributes for Success
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with content owners, SMRs, and other stakeholders.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate design concepts and engage in collaborative feedback.
Ability to adapt to a constantly changing and growing business environment.
Good problem-solving skills and a customer service-focused mindset.
Proactive in mentoring junior team members and facilitating effective teamwork.
To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have
5 to 8 years of experience in graphic design and eLearning development.
Advanced proficiency with graphic design software and eLearning development tools which must include:
Articulate Rise & Storyline 360
MS Word, PowerPoint, and whiteboarding applications (ie Miro/Mural/MS Whiteboard)
Videos
Adobe (iPDFs/Flipbooks)
A foundational understanding of LMS platforms and content management.
Experience building and maintaining strong relationships with business customers/clients.
Ability to work in fast-paced, stressful environments to deliver required results.
What We Look For
An experienced graphics designer who can support multiple projects concurrently.
A professional who can quickly problem-solve and offer perspective on solutions.
A professional who demonstrates resilience and is energized by working in a global environment, proactively seeking different opinions and valuing diverse perspectives.
