Description:
Role & responsibilities
Ensure uninterrupted, safe and efficient operation of plant utilities, including boilers, chillers, cooling towers, compressors, nitrogen systems, HVAC and water systems.
Plan and execute preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance to minimize equipment downtime.
Ensure timely availability of steam, chilled water, cooling water, compressed air, nitrogen and other utilities as per production requirements.
Monitor utility consumption, optimize energy efficiency and implement cost-reduction initiatives.
Ensure compliance with cGMP, SOPs, statutory requirements and EHS standards.
Monitor critical operating parameters and equipment performance to ensure system reliability.
Coordinate qualification, calibration, validation and documentation of utility systems.
Manage utility installation, commissioning, capacity enhancement and improvement projects.
Ensure statutory inspections, safety compliance and risk mitigation for utility equipment.
Supervise utility personnel and contractors, ensuring effective deployment and technical competency.
Manage maintenance budgets, spare parts inventory, AMCs and utility-related expenditures.
Coordinate with Production, QA, QC, Engineering and EHS for uninterrupted plant operations.

Preferred candidate profile
B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical or Chemical Engineering with 10 12 years of relevant experience in utilities operations and maintenance, preferably in API/pharmaceutical manufacturing.
Strong technical knowledge of boilers, chillers, cooling towers, compressors, HVAC, nitrogen and water systems, with exposure to cGMP, EHS and statutory compliance.
Proven ability in team management, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, energy optimization and ensuring uninterrupted utility availability.

VLCC is widely recognized for its scientific weight loss solutions and its therapeutic approach to beauty treatments. With a staff strength of nearly 6000, over two-third of whom are experienced specialists including medical doctors, nutritionists, psychologists, cosmetologists and physiotherapists and having served over 10 million customers since its inception, VLCC is the largest and most-preferred brand in the Wellness domain in the countries it operates in.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Description:
Join the Team of voco Amritsar, located with excellent road connectivity to the city s commercial and residential hubs, voco Amritsar caters to a dynamic mix of corporate, SME, and MICE clientele in a substantially competitive market. The voco Amritsar is located approximately 11.6 kilometers (7.2 miles) from the Golden Temple and 02 kilometers from Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee International Airport.
With 139 well-appointed rooms, the hotel offers full-service F&B outlets including an All-Day Dining restaurant (90 covers), Lobby Lounge (30 covers), and Bar (40 covers), along with 24-hour Room Service. Our meetings and events space accommodates up to 500 guests, supported by additional leisure and wellness facilities such as a Health Club, Swimming Pool, and a boutique Spa.
Job Overview
Under the general guidance of the Director of Finance within the limits of InterContinental hotels Group policy and procedure is responsible for translating the business plan into the material and service requirements of the hotel and plans and executes their acquisition storage, and issuance.
At Voco we want people who are friendly, welcoming, and full of life; people who are always finding ways to make every guest s experience an enjoyable one.
Duties and Responsibilities
Financial returns:
Assist in the creation of and work within the established Purchase department budget and control expenses.
Participates in negotiations for service contracts.
Obtains competitive quotations and bids.
Ensure all FF&E purchase in line with budgeted CAPEX.
People:
Supports others in getting their jobs done, generally in a way that makes them smile and feel appreciated.
Regularly offers help and guidance, contributing to the feeling that this is a great place to work.
Helps to co-ordinate projects and comes up with ideas for making us more efficient or guest friendly.
Shares information with others readily to help everyone work together better for the guests.
Communicates goals and objectives and makes links with organizational goals.
Guest Experience:
Translates operating forecasts into material requirements plans and thereby determines standard stock and re-order levels with Department Heads and Management.
Maintain and update market list for daily ordering.
Ensure prompt ordering for food and beverage supplies for kitchens.
Maintain and update contract log and a proper filing system.
Identifies and develops reliable sources of supply.
Identifies and organizes adequate storage for all perpetual inventory items and implements corporate policy, products, and initiatives in order to maximize cost effectiveness.
Establishes adequate record keeping and issuance procedures.
Maintain and update capital purchase listing (CAPEX/FF&E)
Maintain and update CAPEX log.
Ensure all locations of FF&E are properly recorded in the system.
Ensure all FF&E are properly tagged.
Protects inventories from waste, spoilage, and theft.
Keeps abreast of the marketplace as to innovation and value.
Processes purchase requests from departments
Ensure physical stock take is conducted as scheduled.
Posts orders to inventory module and produces purchase order for receiver to match against goods received.
Place approved orders.
Establishes standard purchasing specifications.
Ensures products and resources are assigned to the appropriate department and billed accordingly.
Supervises the hotels print shop to ensure timely and economical production of printed material.
Ensures that market surveys are completed in coordination with the Executive Chef, F&B Manager and Director Finance & Business Support
Responsible business:
Demonstrate understanding and awareness of all policies and procedures relating to Health, Hygiene and Fire Life Safety
Familiarize yourself with emergency and evacuation procedures.
Assists in providing safekeeping, including proper storage and access, for all contracts, leases and other financial records.
Qualifications and Requirements
High school diploma / secondary education / equivalent plus 3-6 years of related experience in Stores and Purchase or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Some college courses in Purchasing, Employment Law or related field preferred.

Description:
Axis Max Life Insurance is seeking a dynamic and experienced Manager - Training to join our team. The primary responsibility of this role is to design, implement, and oversee training programs that enhance the skills and knowledge of our employees, ensuring adherence to company standards and industry regulations. The Manager - Training will collaborate with various departments to identify training needs, develop effective training materials, and evaluate the success of training initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

- Assess training needs through surveys, interviews, and performance reviews to identify skill gaps and training requirements.
- Develop and deliver training programs, workshops, and seminars that align with organizational goals and enhance employee performance.
- Create comprehensive training materials, including presentations, manuals, and e-learning modules.
- Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of training programs through feedback, assessments, and performance metrics.
- Collaborate with department heads to tailor training solutions that meet specific team needs.
- Maintain training records and documentation to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
- Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in training and development.
- Mentor and support trainers and instructional staff to foster a culture of continuous learning.

Skills and Tools Required:

- Strong knowledge of adult learning principles and training methodologies.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, both verbal and written.
- Proficiency in designing and delivering engaging training content using various tools and mediums.
- Familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and e-learning platforms.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to assess training needs and measure training effectiveness.
- Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment while being self-motivated.
- Experience with performance management systems and employee development strategies.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel) and other relevant software.
- Previous experience in the insurance industry or financial services sector is a plus.

Qualifications:

- Bachelors degree in Human Resources, Education, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Minimum of 5 years of experience in training and development, with at least 2 years in a managerial role.
- Certification in training methodologies or instructional design is preferred.

Role & responsibilities

Book Design & Layout: Design and format school textbooks, workbooks, activity books, practice books, worksheets, and supplementary learning materials for Classes K8.

Educational Visuals: Develop creative learning aids, chapter openers, educational posters, concept illustrations, tables, charts, and instructional graphics.

Experience designing school textbooks, children's books, workbooks, or educational materials will be a strong advantage.

A portfolio demonstrating book layouts, print publications, illustrations, and page design is essential.


Perks and benefits

INR 35.000 to INR 40,000 Per month plus 1 month Bonus after successful completion of Deliverable projects.

Description:
Join the Team of voco Amritsar, located with excellent road connectivity to the city s commercial and residential hubs, voco Amritsar caters to a dynamic mix of corporate, SME, and MICE clientele in a substantially competitive market. The voco Amritsar is located approximately 11.6 kilometers (7.2 miles) from the Golden Temple and 02 kilometers from Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee International Airport.
With 139 well-appointed rooms, the hotel offers full-service F&B outlets including an All-Day Dining restaurant (90 covers), Lobby Lounge (30 covers), and Bar (40 covers), along with 24-hour Room Service. Our meetings and events space accommodates up to 500 guests, supported by additional leisure and wellness facilities such as a Health Club, Swimming Pool, and a boutique Spa
Job overview
Assists the Director of Sales or Director of Sales and Marketing in management of all sales activities and events including direct sales, sales solicitation, sales administration, public relations and management of the sale team.
Also to manage sales activities and events in line with the annual sales and marketing plan and to achieve/exceed budget and sales strategy for your hotel
At voco we look for people who are dynamic, confident and ambitious; people who excel in their role and help our guests succeed too.
Duties and responsibilities
Financial returns:
Maintain files, records and reports as it pertains to: budgets, contacts, planning activities, time lines, contracts, purchase orders and post meeting notes. Complete forecasts, plans, and productivity reports for management.
Participate in the preparation of the annual departmental operating budget and financial plans. Monitor budget and upsell products and services while minimising waste to increase revenue.
Negotiate room prices, sell USPs and hotel services within approved departmental booking guidelines .
Monitors local competitors and compare their operation with his/her operation
Solicits business and follow up on referrals and potential sales leads
Keeps aware of trends, systems, practices and equipment in audio visual through trade literature, hotel show and site visits
Provides direction on and conducts market research
Maintain regular contact with IHG regional hotels and reservation networks
Attends trade shows and sells conference space when directed
People:
Works with DOS on manpower planning and management needs
Works with DOS in the preparation and management of the Department s budget
Manage day to day sales activities and build relationship with team members
Personally build clear and open lines of communication with intra departments
Build a team with different opinions, skills, experiences, and backgrounds; leverage personal, cultural, and functional differences to optimize team performance
Create an environment that trains, develops, coaches and mentor s team members
Guest experience:
Monitors competitors activities and assists in marketing intelligence
Refers sales leads to appropriate personnel within the InterContinental Hotels Group
Sells to new, existing and prospective customers considering goals set forth in the sales strategy, negotiating optimum rate for the benefit of the business
Services existing business through management of account bases
Sell all facets of the hotel
Manage the corporate head office and the preferred hotel history for that company
Develop and maintain a regular pattern of sales calls, meeting with principals of target market
Provides direction on, and conducts market research and analysis
Develops and maintains contact with business generators, meeting and convention planners, visitors/convention bureau, travel agents, tour operators, airlines, corporate accounts, Government Departments and other producers closely allied to Hotel business
Builds profile within local market place through attendance at various events and local market place
Conduct client interviews
Entertain clients
Plan and conduct familiarization tours and site inspections
Travel when required to promote the hotel and develop potential business
Maintain regular contact with the IHG hotels in your region and the regional reservation office
Responsible business:
Develop awareness and reputation of the hotel and the brand in the local community.
Coordinate safety and security initiatives to ensure meetings flow smoothly with minimal interruptions or problems. Coach and advise clients on meeting options and alternatives that potentially reduce waste, save energy and have a minimal impact on the environment.
Perform other duties as assigned. May also serve as manager on duty .
Accountability
Meeting Rooms Sales target as per the allocated segment along with the desired guest experience scores .
Qualifications and requirements
Minimum of 3 year Sales experience in 4 or 5 Hotel property
Hospitality degree or equivalent
Excellent customer relations, problem solving and time management skills
Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office and Opera Sales
Proven ability to creating new business opportunities
Assertive, professional and positive with a proven ability to develop in a team environment
Must be able to work independently and maintain a positive attitude within a very busy environment
With valid drivers license is preferred
The statements in this job description are intended to represent the key duties and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be ALL responsibilities or qualifications of the job.

Description:
Position Overview:
Leasing Manager to lead leasing initiatives for retail and commercial assets. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in retail leasing, brand acquisition, and commercial negotiations, along with established relationships across retail, F&B, fashion, lifestyle, entertainment, and service sectors.
This role requires a proactive professional who can identify leasing opportunities, engage prospective tenants, negotiate commercial terms, and successfully close lease transactions while maximizing occupancy and revenue generation.

Key Responsibilities:
Identify, approach, and onboard suitable retail brands, F&B outlets, entertainment operators, and service providers for commercial and retail projects.
Generate new leasing leads through market outreach, networking, referrals, and industry contacts.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with national, regional, and emerging retail brands.
Drive brand acquisition initiatives to enhance the tenant mix and project positioning.
Conduct market research to identify leasing trends, brand expansion plans, consumer preferences, and competitor activities.
Analyze market data and provide recommendations to optimize leasing strategies and occupancy levels.
Track competing retail and commercial developments to identify opportunities and market gaps.
Coordinate Mall presentations and units visits for prospective tenants.
Lead commercial discussions and negotiate lease terms, rentals, revenue-sharing models, and other commercial conditions.
Manage the complete leasing lifecycle from lead generation and brand engagement to documentation and lease execution.
Ensure timely closure of leasing transactions while maintaining profitability objectives.
Collaborate closely with developers, property owners, consultants, architects, and project teams.
Build and maintain strong relationships with brand representatives, leasing consultants, and industry

Experience:
5-15 years of experience in: Retail Leasing, Mall Leasing, Commercial Leasing, Office Leasing, Brand Acquisition.Experience in leasing for shopping malls, high-street retail, mixed-use developments, or commercial business parks.
Prior experience with reputed developers, shopping malls, commercial real estate firms, or leasing consultancies is preferred.
Demonstrated track record of successful lease closures and tenant acquisition.

Description:
The Marketing Assistant Manager is part of an important team that creates and executes property-level communications to our customers.
Under the leadership of the Manager of Marketing and Communication, this role promotes on-brand messaging to customers through traditional, digital, and social media channels all with the goal of enhancing the image of the hotel.
This role helps build direct marketing plans, targeted campaigns, and activated channels to the end of driving consumer awareness and preference, increasing market share, and building broader portfolio and brand awareness.
This role assists with building deep partnerships with their regional eCommerce and Marketing teams to verify all local, social, and digital marketing efforts are effectively integrated with the selling efforts for the organization.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
Required:
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Marketing, Public Relations, Business Administration or related major and 2 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising experience preferred
OR
4-year bachelors degree in Marketing, Public Relations, Business, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Hotel Marketing and Advertising
- Assists with the execution of the annual marketing plan to budget .
- Provides support to Operations, Food Beverage and Sales teams to execute promotions and campaigns to target in-house guests with promotions that drive incremental revenue to the hotel.
- Works with advertising agency on the tactical advertising campaigns creative and media plans, particularly for food and beverage promotions.
- Assists with the management of FB media schedules email marketing and display advertising.
;
- Stays informed about the status, performance evaluation, opportunities, and issues related to online programs and initiatives.
- Helps verify that all advertising for the hotel in digital channels is in alignment with brand voice.
Social Media Content Management
- Supports facilitation ofsocial media engagement and updating content in local digital channels (eg, hotel website, travel sites).
- Assists with promotions campaign in FB, weddings, spa, rooms and conferences through relevant digital and social media channels.
- Engages in proactive online reputation management by surfacing relevant guest comments (positive or negative) in social media channels and responds accordingly.
Public Relations and Visual Asset Management
- Participates in the development of comprehensive PR plan per quarter along with agency;
- Maintains a comprehensive list of local media contracts, with particular emphasis on food critics and bloggers.
- Manages assigned accounts as per the media account management system.
- Assists with writing and distribution of all press releases for property events, promotions, and outlets.
- Supports execution of hotel sponsored events, community/government relations activities, and press promotional activities.
- Helps manage external vendors and media agencies; Assists with review of PR leads from the continent PR Leader regarding which are the best media to promote the hotel.
- Supports the co-ordination of photography for FB advertising, collateral and public relations purposes between the hotel, advertising agency and the regional field marketing teams.
- Assists with photo shoots for seasonal or festive promotions in partnership with the cluster or area marketing team.
May serve as a point of contact for regionally approved local photographers for food, amenity, and property imagery.
Direct Marketing and Collateral Development
- Assists with coordination and execution of Hotel and FB printed materials.
- Controls quantity and inventory of all Hotel marketing collateral and verifies copies are filed in a comprehensive manner.
- Supports the production of all property, FB display, and temporary signage in hotel public areas.
- Assists with the execution of FB direct marketing activities.
- Verifies all collateral is as per brand standard guidelines and in compliance with Brand Standard Audit (BSA).
General
- Assists in the development, co-ordination and execution of all communications activities.
- Helps with the publication of hotel s newsletter(s).
- Supports communications duties and functions as deemed necessary.
- Assists in the liaison and execution of joint FB promotions.
- Works with the Manager of Marketing and Communication to verify the Hotel s website and related websites are updated on a regular basis.
-
- Provides marketing assistance and act as a marketing subject matter expert for GMs, Sales Leaders and Managers, and Revenue leaders.
- Keeps abreast of competition and its collateral, advertising, and marketing efforts and constantly evolving digital and marketing trends.
- Performs other reasonable job duties as assigned by manager.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Approvals

Description:
Job Summary
An Operations Manager in an education or EdTech company oversees daily campus or digital workflows, faculty scheduling, student onboarding, and compliance.
In Chandigarh and India, local openings range from schools and study consultancies like Silver Fern Education Consultants to growing EdTech platforms.
Core Responsibilities
Academic Coordination: Manage class timetables, faculty assignments, and exam workflows.
Student & Parent Support: Oversee student onboarding, fee tracking, and inquiry handling.
Facility & Resource Management: Monitor campus upkeep, safety, and infrastructure (if on-site) or LMS tools (if online).
Cross-Functional Link: Connect sales, marketing, and academic teams to hit growth and retention goals.
Compliance & Reporting: Maintain student records and ensure adherence to institutional or local rules.
Key Qualifications
Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Education Management, or Human Resources (Master's is a plus).
Experience: 5 years of background in Education administration, coaching centers, or EdTech operations.
Tech Skills: Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Workspace, CRM platforms, and Learning Management Systems (LMS).
Soft Skills: Strong time management, team leadership, and parent/student communication.

Dear Candidate,
We have an urgent opening at HDFC Sales Pvt Ltd.

If interested please share your resume on anmolptomar@hdfcsales.com

NOTE: This is a field sales role and requires two wheeler & DL.

Purpose: Will be responsible for meeting targets, identify new sources from assigned geography,
and maintain good relationship with sources, achieving efficiency of assigned geography and
sources there by achieving the desired productivity expected by the company.
Job description:
1. Area/ Geography Mapping.
Responsible for lane to lane/ Area mapping of Area/ Geography at regular intervals with the
help of supervisor. Identify new sources in the allocated Area/ Geography and inform the
progress to reporting manager during team huddle.
Knowledge, Skills & Functional Competency
Knowledge of the entire geography.
Ability to plan and map the allocated geography into areas/lane to lane.
Ability to use tools and resources to identify potential sources.
2. Source Relationship Management.
Responsible for managing the relationship with all sources assigned and identified by him in
his geography/area.
Knowledge Skills & Functional Competency
Ability to understand the potential and ensure the expected LSR, SLR and MS of the
source.
Knowledge and ability to use various tools which can be utilized to improve relationship
and ratios.
3. Maintain Reports
Responsible for maintaining reports related to sales and all his activities in the prescribed
format. Should maintain diary on daily basis in the prescribed format of activities.
Knowledge, Skills & Functional Competency
Knowledge of various reports to be maintained
Ability to capture data in the prescribed format
Ability to understand and perform all functions of diary
4. Channel Partner Recruitment
Responsible for identification of channel partners
Knowledge, Skills & Functional Competency
Knowledge of BSA empanelment process.
Ability to identify the potential channel partner
Ability to identify whether the BSA falls within the norms and category defined.
5. Team Huddle
Responsible for attending team huddle on a daily basis as per the set process
Knowledge, Skills & Functional Competency
Knowledge of daily morning huddle process
Ability to provide data in the prescribed format based on business requirements.
6. Customer Relationship Management
Responsible for enhancing the customer experience by developing and maintaining
relationship with customers
Knowledge, Skills & Functional Competency
Knowledge of all products of HDFC and competition
Ability to sell products and provide required services to customers
Knowledge of KYC documentation
Knowledge of legal documentation and technical process
Knowledge and ability to use sales kit
Ability to analyse credit document and derive eligibility
Ability to handle objections
AboutCompany: HDFC Sales is a wholly owned subsidiary of HDFC Ltd. The company has been floated as a distribution arm of HDFC with an objective of offering quick and easy service to prospective clients of HDFC group. HDFC Sales offers financial management solutions to individuals encompassing among other products like Home Loans, Life Insurance, Mutual Funds, Fixed Deposits and property Solutions.

AboutCompany:
Havells India Limited (Havells), one of Indias largest FMEG (Fast-Moving Electrical Goods) Company & power distribution equipment manufacturer.
Havells is among the few organizations being recognized as a Great Place to Work Certified TM Organization for the fourth consecutive year. We have also been recognized among Indias Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All Top 50.

With the acquisition of Lloyd in 2017, Havells has made a foray into high-potential consumer durables segments with offerings of Air-conditioners, Televisions, Refrigerators and Washing Machines.
Our global network consists of 7000+ professionals across 35 branches and 15 plants. The company boasts of a strong manufacturing prowess with 15 state-of-the-art manufacturing plants in India located in Haridwar, Baddi, Sahibabad, Faridabad, Alwar, Neemrana, Ghiloth, Tumkur, and Sricity. Currently over 95% of the product offering is energy efficient and manufactured in-house which makes Havells a name synonymous with excellence and expertise in the electrical industry.
Havells, over the years, has embarked on the journey of social change through inclusive growth. Serving Mid-Day Meal to over 70,000 students across 700 schools daily in the Alwar district, building over 4000 eco-friendly bio-toilets in 400 government schools, distributing over 1,90,000 reusable sanitary napkins to girls, and planting over 17 Lakh tree saplings so far, are among few of our CSR initiatives.

Description:
About us :
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!
AboutCompany: Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
CompanyAddress: Floor No 8, Skymark One in Tower D, Plot No H 10B Sector98, Noida, Gautambuddha Nagar; Uttar Pradesh 201304, NOIDA, Uttar Pradesh, India

Description:
Job Description -
Job Title- Area Sales Head - CONSUMER LIGHTING
Level-Assistant Manager
Location-Ludhiana
Reporting To-Product head
Supervising-Individual Contributor
Job responsibilities

1. Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve company targets within the Consumer Lighting division.
2. Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, distributors, and their teams.
3. Identify new business opportunities and market trends to expand the company's market share.
4. Lead and motivate distributors and their teams to drive performance and meet sales objectives.
5. Analyze sales data and market insights to formulate effective sales strategies.
6. Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as marketing, product development, and customer service to ensure alignment and customer satisfaction.
7. Monitor and report on sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to senior management.
8. Provide regular training and coaching to distributor teams to enhance their skills and performance.
9. Represent the company at industry events, trade shows, and conferences to promote brand awareness and generate leads.
10. Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and ethical standards in all sales activities.
Candidates profile -
Education

Preferred MBA B.tech /B.E or any post Graduate with 60 %
Experience

3-6 Years
Salary

Best in industry
Personal Attributes

Excellent communication and people skills
Learning agility
Customer centricity
Strong influencing and stake holder management skills
Aptitude in problem-solving
Desire to work as a team with a result driven approach
Age

Maximum 32 Years
Brief Overview:
Havells India Limited, a Great Place to Work-Certified™ Organization with an overall FY 2022-23 net revenue of INR 17,500 Crore is a Fast Moving Electrical Goods (FMEG) company headquartered in Noida in existence since 1958.
The company has products ranging from home and kitchen appliances which includes water heaters, air coolers, water purifiers, fans, personal grooming, lighting for domestic, commercial and industrial applications, modular switches and wiring accessories, industries and domestic circuit protection switchgear, industrial and domestic cables and wires, induction motors and capacitors and consumer durable products like AC, washing machine, LED TV and Refrigerators. We own brands like Havells, Lloyd, Crabtree, Standard and Promptec.
We have philosophy of Make in India, extensive distribution network and world class quality. We have 40 branches/representative offices with over 6,000 professionals and 12 manufacturing plants located at Haridwar, Baddi, Sahibabad, Faridabad, Alwar, Neemrana and Ghiloth.
For more details, visit www.havells.com

- Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

- Having MBA or equivalent degree if its B.tech or B.Arch with MBA is preferred.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Proven track record in team management.
- Existing network and connections with B2G Customers , Architects Consultants , PMC’s , PSU’s  , CP’s Etc.

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Customer focus:
Driving Net Promoter Score Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving sales vs. Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff

Cash & Inventory Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stock takes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions management are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues
Supervision are resolved

standards

Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands

Store upkeep & maintenance equipment at the store

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Description:
Job Description - Agency Frontline Sales Role
Band- 1
CTC- Up to 3.5 lakh rupees
JOB SUMMARY: To create network of high performing agencies and promulgate initiatives within each agency to achieve sales productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners. Recruit, Coach, Mentor, Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity Renewal Targets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to onboarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.
Plan goals performance needs for Partners and Agents in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners
Identify partner/ agents development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical, product and skills training and coaching. Develop agents in line with career development / training requirements of the Company.
Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re-activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through company's sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors' offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE:
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills
Competency- Result Orientation Definition- Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)
Skillset required- Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation Definition- Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets
Skillset required- Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services
Skillset required- Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values
Skillset required- Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior
Competency - People and Team Leadership
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required- Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support
Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition- Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead the execution of a government building project under the EPC mode. The candidate will be responsible for site management, team leadership, government liaisoning, cost control, and timely project completion.

Key Responsibilities
Manage day-to-day site activities, construction planning, and project scheduling.
Lead site engineers, subcontractors, and vendors to achieve project targets.
Coordinate with government officials, clients, and consultants for approvals and inspections.
Monitor project costs, material consumption, and resource utilization to prevent cost overruns.
Resolve technical and execution challenges and suggest innovative, cost-effective construction methods.
Ensure quality, safety, and compliance with approved drawings and technical specifications.

Candidate Requirements
B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering with 7+ years of experience in building construction.
Experience in government projects and EPC execution preferred.
Strong knowledge of project planning, BOQs, billing, cost control, and subcontractor management.
Excellent leadership, problem-solving, and coordination skills.

The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also
includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks,
dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer
experience.
Responsibilities
Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Optometrist
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to
deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer hasFollowing the 12-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check-up
Eye check-up & Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive
dispensing lens while recommending the appropriate lens and/or frames

recommendation Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences

right time to pitch the recommended solutions Achieving sales
Vs. Plan & SOP
adherence Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due
communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the
reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment Store upkeep & regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
maintenance Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or
damage in the storePersonal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Diploma in Optometry Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
Job Summary
Role Overview The Field Officer is the frontline member of the KiDS project team, responsible for direct engagement with schools, teachers, students, parents, and communities in the assigned districts. The role reports to the District Coordinator or Programme Manager and requires consistent field presence and strong community engagement skills.
Location
Saharanpur, Chitrakoot, Jhansi, Lucknow, Kanpur
Organization
YR Gaitonde Medical Educational Research Foundation (YRGMERF)
Project
KiDS (Kids and Diabetes in Schools) - supported by Sanofi
Experience
Minimum 3 years of experience in development, health, education, or nutrition programmes at the district level.
Qualifications
Post-graduation in Home Science, Nutrition, Social Sciences, or a related discipline.
Working knowledge of the education department system in UP is required.
Key Responsibilities
Field Implementation Facilitate teacher training sessions using the KiDS manual in assigned schools.
Support trained teachers in conducting diabetes awareness sessions with students.
Organise and facilitate parent-teacher meetings in project schools.
Map the communities linked to each project school and conduct community awareness meetings.
Identify and support diabetes ambassadors within communities who can sustain awareness efforts beyond the project period.
Documentation and Reporting Document all field activities systematically and compile data for submission to the District Coordinator / Programme Manager.
Provide field data and inputs for programme reports in coordination with the ME Officer.
Maintain complete records of referrals to health facilities, forms, and related documentation.
Travel The role requires approximately 20 days of field travel per month. Travel and logistics support will be provided under the project.
Skills
Proficiency in MS Excel for data entry and reporting.
Strong written and oral communication skills in Hindi and English.
Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently in field settings with minimal supervision.

Description:
Job Summary
Technical Expert, Organisation YR Gaitonde Medical Educational & Research Foundation (YRGMERF) - Project Disha. Experience required: 5 years.
Responsibilities
The Technical Experts will provide mentoring and supportive supervision to DISHA cluster units, ensuring the effective implementation of the National AIDS Control Program (NACP) V.
Mentoring and Supervision: Based at the cluster level, provide mentoring support to 4 to 5 DISHA cluster units or DISHA single units.
Conduct monthly visits to all assigned DISHA units to provide on-site mentoring and supportive supervision.
Provide evidence-based technical guidance on all components of NACP V to the DISHA units.
Coordination and Collaboration: Strengthen coordination with allied health departments at the district level (NHM, NTEP, NVHCP) for enhanced referral linkages.
Make field visits to NACP facilities along with DISHA staff for supportive supervision and capacity building.
Reporting and Data Quality: Ensure the timely and quality submission of monthly reports for DISHA.
Verify data reported by at least 3 facilities per district each month and provide inputs to ensure data quality.
Guidance and Capacity Building: Guide the DISHA team on advocacy, stakeholder coordination, and coordination with other departments in the district.
Assist DISHA in developing district profiles, integrated action plans, and DISHA-specific IEC materials.
Orient and ensure optimal implementation of all component activities as per NACP V in the district/DISHA cluster.
Implementation of Strategies: Guide DISHA units on implementing new strategies of NACP V, such as CSS, SSS, SOA, use of virtual media, APN, index case, etc.
Provide component-wise inputs and guidance to enhance the overall performance of DISHA units.
Performance Improvement: Responsible for periodical improvement in the 95-95-95 performance targets of the DISHA cluster.
Field Visits: Conduct field visits for a minimum of 20 days per month to provide on-site support and supervision.
Requirements
Desirable Attributes: Master's Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Public Health, Humanities, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in public health projects, particularly in HIV/AIDS programs.
Strong understanding of NACP V and public health systems.
Excellent mentoring, supervisory, and capacity-building skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in data analysis and reporting.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Flexibility to travel extensively within the assigned region.

Continuously seek feedback from clients to improve service delivery and enhance the overall customer experience.
Demonstrate empathy and understanding in addressing client concerns and objections.
Stay updated on product knowledge and sales techniques to enhance performance and productivity.

Description:
Project Name: Project for Establishment of Mizoram State Super-Specialty Cancer and Research Centre, Aizawl - Mizoram, India.
Functional Area: Equipment Management and Support (Specialized in Laboratory, Physiology, and Rehabilitation Equipment)
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu/ Aizawl, Mizoram, India
Duration: 6 months (Intermittent Input)
Qualification:
-Bachelor s degree in Medical Electronic or Electronic or Biomedical Engineering.
-Certifications or training in laboratory or rehabilitation equipment preferred.
Overall Professional Experience:
-Minimum 15 years of professional experience in managing laboratory, physiology, or rehabilitation-related equipment, with at least 5 completed projects.
-Experience in medical equipment planning and/or procurement, having contributed to at least 3 projects.
-Hands-on experience in the installation, calibration, and basic maintenance of laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
-Work experience as a Clinical Engineer in healthcare or medical care facilities.
Role Responsibilities:
Equipment Installation Calibration:
-Lead the installation, setup, and calibration of laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment at MSSSCRC.
-Ensure that equipment is installed according to specifications and regulatory standards, meeting safety and performance requirements.
-Conduct initial testing to verify the functionality of newly installed equipment, making adjustments as necessary to optimize performance.
Compliance and Quality Assurance:
-Perform routine checks and inspections to ensure that equipment continues to meet operational standards and regulatory requirements.
-Monitor equipment performance, ensuring it adheres to safety and operational regulations in line with national and international standards.
-Assist in compliance audits and support the creation of reports to document adherence to health regulations.
Troubleshooting Technical Support:
-Provide technical troubleshooting support for any malfunctioning laboratory, physiology, or rehabilitation equipment.
-Offer quick resolutions for minor issues and escalate complex technical problems to senior specialists or vendors for further investigation and resolution.
-Diagnose equipment faults and recommend corrective actions to maintain optimal functionality.
Training MSSSCRC Staff on Equipment Use Maintenance:
-Develop and deliver training programs for MSSSCRC staff (clinical, technical, and administrative) on the correct use, handling, and safety protocols for laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
-Conduct hands-on training sessions to ensure staff are proficient in operating the equipment, including detailed instructions on how to maintain and troubleshoot the equipment.
-Create training materials and user manuals tailored to the equipment, ensuring that staff have clear, accessible guides for reference.
-Assess staff competency in operating the equipment and provide additional guidance or refresher courses as necessary to ensure staff confidence and safety in equipment handling.
-Provide specialized training in equipment calibration, regular maintenance tasks, and how to perform troubleshooting for common issues.
Record Maintenance Reporting:
-Maintain accurate and detailed records of equipment installation, servicing, and performance, ensuring that all equipment data is properly documented and accessible.
-Track service histories, calibration schedules, and any repairs or modifications made to the equipment.
-Assist in preparing periodic reports on equipment status, including any issues identified, actions taken, and overall performance evaluation.
-Coordination with Senior Specialists Vendors:
-Collaborate with senior specialists and vendors to manage upgrades, repairs, and replacements of equipment.
-Coordinate with vendors to procure spare parts and ensure that all equipment remains functional throughout the project duration.
-Ensure timely maintenance schedules are followed to minimize equipment downtime and avoid disruptions in medical services.
Project Support Management:
-Assist in the management of project timelines, ensuring that equipment-related tasks such as installation, calibration, and maintenance are completed on schedule.
-Support project teams in planning and procuring equipment, ensuring that equipment specifications meet the project s healthcare requirements.
-Provide guidance and technical input in the planning phase for procurement of new laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
Safety Operational Efficiency:
-Conduct regular safety checks to ensure that all equipment complies with health and safety regulations and operates efficiently.
-Evaluate the operational efficiency of equipment and recommend improvements or upgrades when necessary.
-Ensure that all equipment is safely decommissioned or disposed of at the end of its useful life.
Preferred Age: Below 50 years
Employment Type: Project Specific

Description:
Project Name: Project for Establishment of Mizoram State Super-Specialty Cancer and Research Centre, Aizawl - Mizoram, India.
Functional Area: Equipment Cost Expert
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu/ Aizawl, Mizoram, India
Duration: 4 months (Intermittent Input)
Qualification:
-Bachelor s degree in Biomedical Engineering/Medical electronics or Electronic.
-Certifications in cost analysis or financial planning preferred.
Overall Professional Experience:
-Minimum of 15 years of experience in cost analysis of medical equipment or related fields.
-At least 7 years of experience in the medical or healthcare sector.
-Experience in medical equipment planning and/or procurement, having contributed to at least 2 projects.
-Experience working on Japanese ODA Loan Projects in any sector.
-At least 1 year of experience in SAARC or ASEAN regions (preferable).
-Work experience as a Clinical Engineer in healthcare or medical care facilities.
-Strong knowledge of procurement processes and cost optimization techniques.

Role Responsibilities:
Cost Estimation Budgeting:
-Lead the estimation of preliminary project equipment costs during the basic design phase, ensuring accurate forecasting of all associated costs.
-Develop cost models and prepare detailed cost estimates for medical equipment procurement and installation.
-Identify and quantify the costs related to equipment, components, consumables, transportation, and installation work, ensuring that the budget is comprehensive and aligned with project objectives.
Survey Data Collection:
-Conduct surveys of existing or similar healthcare facilities to gather information on operational and maintenance costs of medical equipment.
-Assess the existing equipment in operational facilities to understand their functionality, lifespan, and associated costs to make informed decisions.
-Collect data on the cost of spare parts, consumables, and other supplies necessary for the proper functioning of medical equipment.
Evaluation of Local Distributors Service Providers:
-Survey local distributors for warranty services, maintenance contract availability, and pricing.
-Evaluate the reliability and service offerings of local vendors, ensuring they meet the operational needs of the project and provide cost-effective maintenance solutions.
Cost Breakdown Analysis:
-Collect and analyze detailed data on equipment-related costs, including main components, consumables, transportation costs, turnkey work, maintenance contracts, and other related services.
-Ensure a thorough understanding of all cost components and provide a comprehensive cost breakdown for each equipment item.
-Collaborate with procurement teams to optimize cost-efficiency and select the best value options for the project.
Tender Evaluation Compliance:
-Assist the Project Management Unit (PMU) in evaluating financial documents related to equipment tenders, ensuring that the costs are in line with the project s financial goals.
-Review tender submissions for compliance with project specifications, budget constraints, and cost-effectiveness.
-Provide recommendations on cost optimization and value for money, ensuring that all financial aspects of the tender align with project needs.
Cost Reporting Documentation:
-Prepare and maintain detailed reports on cost estimations, budgets, and financial evaluations related to medical equipment.
-Ensure that all cost reports are accurately documented and available for review by the project team and stakeholders.
-Track and report any changes in cost projections, identifying areas where cost savings or adjustments can be made.
Collaboration with Project Stakeholders:
-Work closely with the project team, including procurement specialists and clinical engineers, to align equipment cost management with overall project goals.
-Provide regular updates on cost estimations, procurement strategies, and cost optimization efforts to senior management and stakeholders.
Preferred Age: Below 50 years
Employment Type: Project Specific

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Junior Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Position: Cluster Human Resource

Eligibility Parameters:
3-4 years of experience in Human Resource generalist role.

Education Qualification
Minimum : MBA/ PGBDA (HR) (regular course)

Position Reports to : AHR /Zonal HR
Reportees : HR Intern (Wherever applicable)

Required Competencies
Technical Expertise
Communication & Presentation skills
Planning & Organising
Counselling & Coaching
Teamwork & networking
Problem Solving

Key Accountabilities/Responsibilities
The most important end-results for which an incumbent would be held responsible at the end of the year.

Manpower Budgeting
Involved in proposing the manpower budgets after taking into account various projections & projected manpower numbers for the coming year.
Allocates the staff in various sub-departments considering various factors like Strengths & weaknesses of each member, GMROL, level of intervention required with the customer (A/B/C), MPA along with DMs & UM
Ensures availability of that manpower as per budgets and checks that budgets are not exceeded beyond permissible limits.
Does availability study periodically, gives feedback to DMs & Supervisors and arrives at solutions for problem areas.

Recruitment, Selection & Induction
Ties up with consultants to meet manpower requirements. Negotiate with them for least possible service fees.
Follows up with consultants for filling up vacancy as soon as possible
Maintains database of applications, rejects
Liases with institutes and colleges for CCA applications
Prepares for and conducts assessment centre for selection
Conducts interviews with UH for selection for all store level positions upto Department Managers.
Evaluates need for placing of advertisements & gets required approvals
Ensures induction schedule is prepared for new joinees, induction goes as per plan, adequate inputs are given and employees are equipped enough before they are on the job.

Training & Development
Prepares training calendar after collating data from PA forms & discussions with concerned Supervisors & DMs.
Does module development on certain training areas
Ensures all infrastructure is in place for internal training programs
Liases with external consultants for specific training needs which cannot be catered to internally & negotiates for best quality at best rate and gets necessary approvals for external trainings.
Ensures smooth execution of trainings.
Ensures training evaluation is done for each program conducted
Liases with Brands/ SO for product/ brand training
Delivers training programs

Payroll Activities
Ensure error-free & timely updation of employee data on system.
Ensures all payroll inputs to be closed as per given timelines with the central payroll team.

Employee Communication & Policy implementation
Communicates employee related policies and ensures adherence to the same
Clarifies queries related to policies and gives feedback on the same to the SO

Welfare Activities
Handles employee grievances at all levels by coaching & counselling
Ensures tie-ups for employees with other institutions like computer institutes, libraries etc.
Ensures execution of employee engagement activities as per annual calaneder.
Activates unit led awards to keep motivation levels high

Statutory Compliances
Liases with consultants to ensure statutory compliances & timely filing of returns.
Ensures statutory compliances are met wrt brand staff, concessionaires etc.

Performance Appraisal
Communicates to the staff the appraisal schedules & process to be followed which are sent be SO
Conducts PA workshops for assessors to throw light on process & common appraisal errors
Ensures regular follow ups to ensure appraisals are done as per time lines
Goes through appraisal forms to oversee the quality of the feedback & comments & evaluate objectivity
Does the normalisation for each supervisor team and communicate ratings as per normal curve back to the supervisors. Make changes, discuss with concerned HODs and arrive at final ratings
Sends collated data to SO
Counsels employees if dissatisfaction arises post increments showing them the organization perspective & the way ahead

Description:
Soft Skills Trainer
Designation- Trainer

Operations No of Openings- 3

The objective of the position Grow is a flagship program of Dr.Reddy's Foundation designed to skill the youth of India. This position aims to develop employability skills among the unemployed youth who are graduates so that they can be employed in private sector jobs. Core employability skills include Communicative English, Digital literacy, Soft Skills, Communication Skills, Digital Problem Solving, Sector & Work Readiness, and interview skills.
Major Deliverables
1. Following the predefined session plan while delivering training to the identified youth
2. Develop skills and knowledge on the identified subjects based on the curriculum that is designed
3. Prepare learners to face interviews confidently
4. Conduct concurrent assessments as per the plan to continue to measure the progress of the students
5. Maintain data with respect to training and related activities.
6. Participate in center activities (such as organizing Parents meet, doing retention followup, collecting training feedback etc.) along with the other staff members to make the center successful.

Description:
Job Title: SAP BTP & Cloud Administrator
Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore / Indore
Total Experience: 1012 years
Notice Period: Immediate joiner
Job Summary
We are looking for a senior SAP BTP Administrator to own the administration of SAP Business Technology Platform across our customer landscapes. The primary focus is BTP: global accounts, subaccounts, entitlements, identity and access, connectivity and cloud-native runtimes. The role also carries SAP Basis and database administration responsibilities for the on-premise and hybrid systems that BTP connects to. The ideal candidate combines deep BTP operations experience with a solid Basis background and can work across cloud and on-premise SAP.
Responsibilities
SAP BTP Administration (primary focus)
Set up and govern the BTP global account structure: directories, subaccounts, and naming and tagging standards across development, test and production.
Manage entitlements, quotas and cost tracking, and raise capacity requests in line with project demand.
Administer Cloud Foundry orgs and spaces and Kyma environments, including deployments, service instances and runtime health.
Manage identity and access: trust configuration with SAP Cloud Identity Services and corporate identity providers, role collections, role templates and least-privilege access reviews.
Configure and maintain connectivity: Destinations, Cloud Connector setup and high availability, and private connectivity to on-premise systems.
Administer SAP HANA Cloud instances, SAP Integration Suite, and SAP Build and Work Zone as required by the customer landscape.
Manage BTP transports and content movement through Cloud Transport Management.
Monitor services, audit logs and alerts; set up and maintain BTP audit log retention.
Maintain the BTP CLI and automation scripts for repeatable provisioning and housekeeping.
SAP Basis Administration (secondary)
Perform day-to-day Basis administration across development, test and production systems.
Handle system monitoring, performance tuning and optimization for ABAP and HANA systems.
Manage user administration, security, authorizations and transport management between systems.
Plan and execute OSS note implementation, BDLS, system copies, client copies and refreshes.
Support SAP HANA upgrades and perform post-upgrade checks.
Provide Basis expertise during project cutovers and ensure stability through critical transition periods.
Database Administration (secondary)
Administer database instances supporting SAP systems, including backup and recovery, space management and housekeeping.
Monitor database performance, identify and resolve bottlenecks, and tune configurations.
Plan and execute database patching, version upgrades and migrations with minimal downtime.
Maintain database security, access controls and disaster recovery procedures, and test them periodically.
Communication and Documentation
Maintain clear documentation of configurations, changes, runbooks and procedures.
Communicate with project teams, stakeholders and end users, and provide regular status and health reports.
Work with customers to define BTP governance, onboarding and operating models.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
10–12 years of experience in SAP technical administration, with at least 4 years in SAP BTP administration.
Hands-on experience with BTP global accounts, subaccounts, entitlements, Cloud Foundry and role-based access control.
Experience with Cloud Connector, Destinations and connectivity to on-premise SAP systems (ECC, S/4HANA, BW, CRM, SCM).
Strong working knowledge of SAP NetWeaver and SAP HANA, including HANA Cloud.
Solid SAP Basis experience: monitoring, transports, user administration, OSS notes, BDLS, system copies and HANA upgrades.
Working knowledge of database administration for SAP-supported databases (backup, recovery, performance and patching).
Familiarity with cutover processes and Basis support during critical project phases.
Strong problem-solving skills and clear written and verbal communication.
Ability to work independently and lead a team.
Preferred Qualifications
SAP BTP certification (for example, SAP Certified Technology Associate, SAP BTP) or SAP Basis certification.
Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Services and SAP Integration Suite.
Experience with Kyma, Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tooling for BTP.
Scripting skills in Shell, Python or the BTP CLI.
Familiarity with ITIL service management frameworks.
Experience with hyperscaler landscapes (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud) under BTP.
Working at HGS
At HGS our employees get an open and collaborative environment and gain experience working for customers in various industries while solving complex business problems. They get support to learn new technologies as well as to enhance existing skills to further their career growth.
AboutCompany: Hinduja Global Solutions Ltd., (HGSL) is an Indian listed company and part of Hinduja Group serving fortune 500 companies for the last 40 years. It is a Digital Technology BPM company specialising into Consumer Engagement Services in the field of Technology, Telecom, banking, retail operations, Data Analytics and Digital Technology services. The Parent Co holds entities in the USA, Philippines, UK, Canada, South Africa, Colombia and Jamaica through subsidiaries and step-subsidiaries. With more than 18,000 employees spread across 9 countries, our mission is to make our clients more competitive by providing exceptional experience. Powered by peoples first philosophy and experience serving over 1100 of the world’s leading brands, HGS is the perfect place to build your future!
