Description:
Hiring: Digital Integration Site Lead | 15+ Years | WFH

Position: Digital Integration Site Lead
Experience: 15+ Years
Job Type: Permanent
Location: Bangalore, Pune, Indore, Aurangabad
Work Mode: Work From Home (WFH)
Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Preferred
Interview Mode: Virtual (2 Rounds)
Laptop: Mandatory for Interview

Key Responsibilities
Lead site-level digital integration and enterprise system deployment projects.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams, site leadership, IT teams, and global stakeholders.
Drive deployment activities including testing, training, cutover, go-live, and hypercare support.
Ensure successful adoption of digital solutions while maintaining GMP compliance and operational continuity.
Manage stakeholder communication, issue escalation, and project execution across manufacturing sites.

Required Skills
15+ years of experience in the Pharmaceutical Industry.
Minimum 5 years of experience leading site-level digital/IT/manufacturing projects.
Strong understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing operations and GMP-regulated environments.
Experience with enterprise system deployments (SAP ERP, MES, Planning, Quality Systems).
Knowledge of testing, training, cutover, go-live, and post-go-live support.
Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
Experience working in matrix organizations and global/multi-site deployment programs.
Familiarity with change management, deployment methodologies, and Lean/Operational Excellence is an advantage.

Education
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Information Systems, or a related field.

Interested candidates with relevant experience and immediate availability can apply now.

Thanks,
HR

Honeybee Tech Solutions is a global talent solutions provider specializing in IT, engineering, and sales staffingpartnering with clients across sectors like BFSI, healthcare, automotive, and technology

Description:
Project Role : Custom Software Engineer

Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.

Must have skills :Microsoft Power Business Intelligence (PBI)

Good to have skills:NA
Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification:15 years full time education

Senior Smartsheet & Power BI Developer
The Senior Smartsheet & Power BI Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing enterprise-wide Smartsheet solutions and Power BI analytics platforms to automate workflows, improve collaboration, enhance project/program management, and deliver actionable business insights. This role focuses on building executive-grade dashboards and reports, integrating Smartsheet with Power BI, and enabling data-driven decision-making through advanced reporting, automation, and system integrations.
Key

Roles & Responsibilities
Smartsheet Solution Development & Automation
Design, develop, and maintain scalable Smartsheet solutions utilizing Sheets, Workspaces, Reports, Forms, Dashboards, Dynamic Views, WorkApps, Pivot App, Functions, and Advanced Formulas.
Create automated workflows for approvals, notifications, reminders, status updates, and data validations using Smartsheet Automation.
Develop cross-sheet references and rollup solutions to consolidate project, program, and portfolio data into centralized views.
Build and optimize enterprise-wide project tracking, resource management, governance, and operational reporting solutions.
Configure Dynamic Views and WorkApps to deliver role-based access and personalized user experiences.
Design and implement governance standards, templates, and best practices for Smartsheet adoption.
Power BI Development & Analytics
Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and reports for executive leadership and business stakeholders.
Develop complex data models, DAX measures, KPIs, scorecards, and drill-through analytics using Power BI.
Create executive-level visualizations for project health, resource utilization, financial metrics, operational performance, and program governance.
Develop and optimize Power BI datasets, semantic models, and reporting frameworks for enterprise-scale analytics.
Implement Row-Level Security (RLS), workspace governance, and data refresh strategies.
Smartsheet - Power BI Integration
Integrate Smartsheet data with Power BI using native connectors, APIs, dataflows, and ETL pipelines.
Design automated data ingestion processes to combine Smartsheet data with enterprise systems such as SharePoint, SQL Server, Azure, Salesforce, and other business applications.
Build consolidated reporting solutions that provide a single source of truth across multiple business functions.
Develop data transformation and cleansing processes using Power Query, Power BI Dataflows, and ETL tools.
Integrations & Technical Enablement
Develop integrations using Smartsheet REST APIs, webhooks, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, and middleware platforms.
Connect Smartsheet with Microsoft ecosystem tools including SharePoint, Teams, Power Platform, Outlook, and Excel.
Support implementation of third-party connectors and integrations with enterprise applications such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Jira, and other operational systems.
Troubleshoot and optimize dashboard performance, data refreshes, data models, and workflow automations.

Maintain technical documentation, governance standards, and solution architecture artifacts

Purpose of the Role
The position will be responsible to increase the new car retails through exchange , improvise the re sale value of TML products & drive pre owned cars business in order to ensure profitability of channel partners , generate revenue for TML & build strong brand value in pre-owned car market Within overall strategic framework of TML PVBU.

Job Description: SAP S/4HANA Fiori Developer with ABAP CDS Experience
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated SAP S/4HANA Fiori UI5 Developer (About 4 to 7 years of experience) with expertise in ABAP and CDS. As a member of our dynamic team, you will be responsible for developing and enhancing SAP Fiori applications using Fiori Elements \ UI5 framework, ensuring a seamless user experience and efficient utilization of SAP S/4HANA capabilities.
Responsibilities:
Develop and customize SAP Fiori/UI5 applications using SAP UI5 framework, adhering to Fiori design principles and guidelines.
Design, develop, and implement custom Fiori/UI5 applications based on business requirements, ensuring high performance, responsiveness, and scalability.
Collaborate with functional consultants, business analysts, and end-users to understand business requirements and translate them into technical designs and solutions.
Enhance existing SAP Fiori/UI5 applications by adding new features, optimizing performance, and improving user experience.
Work closely with the ABAP team to develop backend logic and integrate UI5 applications with SAP S/4HANA backend systems using ABAP programming and CDS views.
Develop and maintain SAP Gateway services (OData services) to expose backend data for consumption by Fiori/UI5 applications.
Perform unit testing, troubleshooting, and bug fixing of Fiori/UI5 applications to ensure high-quality deliverables.
Follow best practices and coding standards for SAP Fiori/UI5 development, ensuring compliance with security and data privacy guidelines.
Stay updated with the latest SAP technologies, tools, and frameworks related to Fiori/UI5 development, and proactively apply them to improve application development processes.
Required Skills:
Solid understanding of the Fiori framework and capability to develop custom apps
Experience with SAP Gateway for service creation and OData for data provisioning
Proficiency in integrating SAP back-end systems using OData services
Familiarity with Business Application Studio (BAS) for deploying and managing Fiori applications

Description:
Job Summary
Role Summary - The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Ways of Working
Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).


Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers. Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants, Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO), Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV). Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate. Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts, denial rates, supply metrics vs competition.


Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Roles and Responsibilities
Manage collections through field visits, phone calls, and emails.
Identify and prioritize delinquent accounts for recovery.
Develop and implement effective collection strategies to minimize write-offs.
Collaborate with internal teams to resolve customer queries and issues.
Maintain accurate records of all interactions with customers.
Desired Candidate Profile
1-5 years of experience in banking collection, loan collection, or related fields.
Strong knowledge of collections process, including legal procedures for loan recoveries.
Excellent communication skills for effective negotiation with customers over phone calls.
Interested candidates can share your resume to aniket.mandloi5579@jana.bank.in
AboutCompany:
Jana Small Finance Bank, erstwhile Janalakshmi Financial Services, is headquartered in Bengaluru. It is one of the 10 financial institutions which had received in-principle approval from RBI, in 2015, to set up a Small Finance Bank.
Established in Bengaluru in 2008, it went on to become the largest Micro Finance Institution (MFI) in India, and was recognised globally as one of the world€™s innovative financial institutions working on the problem of financial inclusion.
Jana Bank received the final banking license in April 2017 and started banking operations on March 28, 2018. Under the leadership of its MD & CEO, Ajay Kanwal, Jana Small Finance Bank€™s vision is to become the leading inclusive digitised bank serving all customer segments and communities of an aspirational India.
Currently, post the transition phase, the bank is enabling its existing 45 lakh customers across 19 states in India to access banking services. It has Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of about 35 percent and a loan book of INR 76 billion as on March 31, 2018. By 2020, the bank aspires to add four million customers.
The bank has deep domain expertise in banking and financial services, with the senior management team having 25+ years of average experience in banking sector. Its current employee strength is of 15,000. By end of 2019, Jana Bank€™s 500 branches will be operational across 19 states, post conversion of majority of its micro finance storefronts into bank branches.
Bengaluru-headquartered Jana Small Finance Bank is regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

AboutCompany:

The bank has deep domain expertise in banking and financial services, with the senior management team having 25+ years of average experience in banking sector. Its current employee strength is of 15,000. By end of 2019, Jana Bank€™s 500 branches will be operational across 19 states, post conversion of majority of its micro finance storefronts into bank branches.
Bengaluru-headquartered Jana Small Finance Bank is regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

Description:
About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving B2B customer acquisition for PTL vertical. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.

Key Responsibilities:
Drive Revenue Growth: Lead and deliver aggressive revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis through new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion in the logistics and supply chain domain.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-impact BD team; establish scalable processes for lead generation, funnel management, and account growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.

Preferred Background & Skills:
5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Description:
Experience
7–8 years of relevant Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) experience, preferably with significant exposure to HSE Management Systems.
Experience in implementing, maintaining, auditing, and improving HSE management systems.
Experience leading activities related to ISO management system standards, particularly ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and/or ISO 50001.
Lead Auditor knowledge and/or experience.
Experience driving site HSE Management Systems (HSEMS) and maintaining applicable HSE-related ISO certifications, including internal/external audits, compliance, and continuous improvement.
Strong experience in incident and case management, including reporting, investigation, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and organizational learning from incidents, near hits, and occupational health cases.
Experience leading site-level HSE strategic initiatives, including Road to Resilience, machine safety, ergonomics, industrial hygiene, and environmental sustainability.
Ability to lead major risk assessment activities, including machine guarding, ergonomics, material handling, contractor safety, and process safety.
Experience driving proactive near-hit, hazard identification, and safety observation reporting across functions.
Ability to facilitate cross-functional reviews of incidents, near hits, and audit findings to ensure effective corrective actions and sustainable risk reduction.
Experience partnering with Engineering, Operations, Materials, Maintenance, and Quality teams to integrate HSE requirements into process design, equipment procurement, facility modifications, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Experience with CTO/CTE and other Pollution Control Board applications and documentation.
Experience establishing and maintaining site HSE governance processes, including steering committees, management reviews, compliance audits, risk reviews, and leadership safety engagement.
Experience leading emergency preparedness and crisis management programs, including emergency response planning, drills, business continuity support, and coordination with local regulatory agencies and emergency responders.
Ability to represent the site during regulatory inspections, corporate audits, customer assessments, and environmental agency interactions.
Experience managing the site HSE project and risk-reduction portfolio, ensuring resources are prioritized toward initiatives that deliver meaningful employee risk reduction while supporting operational, quality, and business objectives.

7+ years of Product / Sales experience in Gold loan or other Asset products,Post Graduate Degree in MBA or Equivalent

Description:
Responsibilities
Responsible for overall branch operations, performance & profitability of the branch.
Drive & participate in field marketing activities with the team to improve branch visibility.
Plan, conduct & monitor the branch & field level marketing activities to ensure healthy pipeline of leads resulting in business conversion & branch growth.
Focus on customer engagement & appraisal of gold ornaments being pledged in branch with correct weight & purity assessment as per company policy and auditory compliance.
Joint custodian of the Vault with responsibility of safekeeping of pledge ornaments as per company policy.
Verify customer KYC documents, application requests and initiate loan disbursals.
Process foreclosure, part release, closure, interest payment transactions based on customer requests.
Authorize transactions for disbursal, foreclosure, release and accept customer payments.
Responsible for keeping NPAs in control through strong follow-ups from customers for interest collections.

Hiring, coaching, mentoring and training employees and providing them with timely feedback on their performance.
Maintaining quality & performance of the business, preparing various reports of the same and take necessary actions for growth of business in branch.
Increase gold loan business plus various other third-party products.
Responsible for correct valuation & maintenance of 100% process compliance at branch.
Manage error-free valuation & appraisal of gold ornaments being pledged in branch with correct weight & purity assessment as per company policy and auditory compliance.
Qualifications & Experience
7+ years of Product / Sales experience in Gold loan or other Asset products
Post Graduate Degree in MBA or Equivalent

Description:
Human Resources Coordinator
Create and maintain filing systems.
Create and type office correspondence using a computer.
Distribute and route mail.
Order and track Human Resources office supplies and forms.
Answer phone calls and record messages.
Create new employee personnel file.
Assist walk-in candidates with application procedures.
Maintain space designated for completing applications and ensure it is clean, well maintained, and accessible to individuals with disabilities.
Respond to questions, requests, and concerns from employees and management regarding company and Human Resources programs, policies and guidelines.
Inform Human Resources management of issues related to employee relations within the division or property.
Maintain confidentiality and security of employee and property records, files, and information.
Ensure accurate maintece of all employee records and files (eg, interview documents, I-9s).
Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets.
Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager.
Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards.
Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette.
Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees.
Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.
Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
- Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
- Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
- Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
- Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
- Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
- Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
- Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

Description:
Job Summary
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, we're the world's leading premium drinks company. From global icons like Johnnie Walker, Guinness and Tanqueray to Smirnoff and Don Julio, we create brands consumers love. Bring your passion and use your curiosity as you explore, collaborate and innovate. Together with passionate people from all over the world, you'll test new ideas, learn and grow, and unlock a brighter, more exciting future.
Join us to create a career worth celebrating.


About the Function
Supply Chain Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world. With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships. It s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers hands, you ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.


About the Role
The Senior Executive - Unit Supply Chain will be responsible for managing procurement coordination, material receipts, inventory control, internal material movement, logistics cost optimization, and supply chain reporting to ensure smooth and efficient manufacturing operations.


Key Responsibilities
Review and validate purchase order requests.
Monitor and control daily Purchase Receipts and Production Receipts, ensuring accurate documentation and SAP entries.
Maintain material receipt records and supporting documents until invoice receipt and reconciliation.
Coordinate timely movement of materials within the unit to support uninterrupted operations.
Monitor logistics costs, achieve cost targets, and identify opportunities to optimize logistics operations.
Coordinate with Planning and Packing teams to ensure proper accounting and reconciliation of packing materials.
Follow up with suppliers and transporters to ensure timely deliveries and adherence to schedules.
Prepare accurate and timely reports on material availability and resource requirements.
Monitor expenditure and resource utilization to support cost control and operational efficiency.
Develop and implement contingency plans to manage fluctuations in demand and material availability.
Assist the Unit Supply Chain Manager in preparing daily and monthly MIS reports.
Maintain updated databases of vendors, pricing, and manufacturer information.


Educational Qualification
Masters/bachelors degree in business administration, Commerce, or a related field.


Experience Required
2-5 years of relevant experience in supply chain operations, procurement, materials management, inventory control, or warehousing.
Experience in a manufacturing environment.
Hands-on experience with SAP or other ERP systems.


Knowledge and Skills
Strong understanding of procurement, materials management, inventory control, and warehousing practices.
Good planning, organizational, and coordination skills.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
High flexibility and adaptability in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
Proficiency in SAP and data-driven reporting.

Description:
Project Role : Custom Software Engineering Lead

Project Role Description : Own the technical direction and architecture of custom software solutions, leading teams through design and delivery. Set development standards and ensure code quality, scalability, and performance aligned to business objectives.

Must have skills :SAP for Utilities Billing

Good to have skills:NA
Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required

Summary:
As a Custom Software Engineering Lead, a typical day involves overseeing the technical direction and architectural design of custom software solutions. This role requires guiding teams through the entire development lifecycle, from initial design concepts to final delivery. The position focuses on establishing development standards and ensuring that the software produced meets expectations for quality, scalability, and performance. Collaboration with various stakeholders to align technical efforts with business goals is a key aspect of daily activities, fostering an environment of innovation and continuous improvement.

Roles & Responsibilities:

- Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
- Responsible for team decisions.
- Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
- Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
- Lead the development and implementation of best practices to enhance software quality and efficiency.
- Mentor and support team members to foster professional growth and skill development.
- Coordinate cross-functional efforts to ensure seamless integration of software components.
- Monitor project progress and adjust plans to meet deadlines and business requirements.

Professional & Technical Skills:
Must To Have Skills:
Proficiency in SAP for Utilities Billing.
- Strong knowledge of software architecture principles and design patterns relevant to custom software development.
- Experience in managing and leading software development teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
- Ability to analyze complex technical problems and provide effective, scalable solutions.
- Familiarity with performance optimization and code quality assurance techniques.
- Excellent communication skills to facilitate collaboration across diverse teams and stakeholders.

Additional Information:

- The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in SAP for Utilities Billing.
- This position is based at our Indore office.
- A 15 years full time education is required.

15 years full time education

Description:
About Us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the Role:
Paytm is looking for an experienced sales professional & people manager to be a part of the QR & Sound Box vertical.

Expectations/ Requirements:
1.Growth of distribution and market share in the assigned area of operations.
2.Visibility & accountability through extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product .
3.Identify and recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4.Plan the market size, span and geographies for ASMs .
5.Devise best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
6.Monitor the quality parameters as suggested by the management.
7.Validate and conduct audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
8. People manage a large team of 5-10 ASMs & 200+ indirect employees.

Must Have:
Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application the new learnt ideas and concepts.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. Self-starters, who can take ownership and are comfortable navigating ambiguity, will be an ideal fit. 8-12 years experience in sales - business development, B2C markets
2. Passionate about working in a fast growing firms and large team handling.
3. Articulate complex solutions to novice customers.
4. Good sales and negotiation skills. Experience in quota driven sales is a must.
5. Experience in payments and finance is a plus - though not mandatory

Why join us:
A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology
Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities
A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals.
Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you with enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. Indias largest digital lending story is brewing here. Its your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Corporate/ Center

JOB TITLE:Beauty HeadJOB BAND: AREA/DEPARTMENT:Beauty/ CenterGRADE: REPORTS TO:Center Head/ Cluster HeadPOSITIONS SUPERVISED:Beauty Therapist/Hair stylist/Pedicurist/Dermatologist
JOB SCOPE:Under the general guidance of the Center Head and in association with other experts and within the limits of established Company policies drives the sales of the Beauty Department, takes care of the relevant manpower to ensure productivity in the department, manages customer relationship, the value of VLCC brand and services, and ensures compliance of operational standardsKey Responsibilities:
To be responsible for grooming, training, discipline and welfare of beauty staff (including self).
To be responsible for work allocation and manage weekly off days for beauty staff.
To ensure and be responsible for the maintenance of adequate stock pertaining to Beauty stationary, consumables, retail and linen. Consumables to be monitored on daily basis and correlated with session executions to ensure that the quantities of consumables being used are as per SOP. Forecast of the same to be given to the Accountant for final compilation of the total stocks and order placement after approval from the Centre Head.
To study beauty cards of booked in clients for planning the appointments a day prior and accordingly give necessary instructions to therapists. To conduct / get conducted the First Skin Analysis, check the Beauty Cards regularly and make appropriate entries in the soft ware.
To ensure cleanliness of the beauty section, therapy rooms and mens salon.
To check attendance of the Beauty staff and make necessary arrangements for any absenteeism.
To supervise and handle all beauty bookings.
To ensure equal distribution of work by rotation to Beauty staff.
To ensure safe handling and maintenance of all electrical / electronic gadgets of beauty section.
To inform the CH / ABH/ AH and Corporate about Beauty machines requiring repair.
To personally supervise maintenance of all Beauty machines.
To send all required information listed below to the corporate office as per findings,
No. of clients booked in the current month.
No. of completed packages in a month.
Beauty efficacy report.
Figure diagnosis sheet.
Beauty assessment formats.
No. of beauty regular walkins in the month.
Transfer of slimming packages into Beauty or vice versa.
List of VIP clients

To ensure that in zero session beauty parameter sheets are filled properly.
To be responsible for Beauty Efficacy Report.
This must be authenticated with client feedback / remarks, before and after photograph & validated by Center
Head and Cluster Head & to be timely sent to Beauty department for incentive calculations.
To ensure regular follow up of clients.
To ensure execution of packages within validity.
To be responsible for achieving the sales & execution targets of Beauty Services.
To be responsible for improving sales of Beauty Packages and RBS / Cross-selling of Slimming Packages
To ensure consumption of products as per SOPs.
To be responsible for beauty stock maintenance at the center and to follow policy of FIFO for product consumption (first in first out) ( ALONG WITH ACCOUNTANT)
To ensure beauty cards are duly & correctly filled with emphasis on below mentioned details,
i) Client signature & comments after each session.
ii) Diet Counseling.
iii) Photograph before session and Maintenance photo and end of session photo
To constantly upgrade oneself and multitask so as to achieve the progression level as per the multitasking / up gradation planner


Additional Responsibilities:
To conduct formal presentations of products and services, attend promotional markets and organize product displays
To generate desired records from beauty Cards / Software from time to time
To perform outdoor duties from time to time
To perform any other job assigned by the Corporate from time to time.
KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES: Well groomed, good communication skills, superior customer handling skills, analytical skills, good organizational & team skills, well versed with all the programmes of VLCC. Be able to manage people and their rosters. , flair for sales & persuasiveness
DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:Doctor/ Dermatologist/ Cosmetologist with additional qualifications in hair and skin
DESIRED EXPERIENCE:
Min of 4 - 7 years of experience in related fieldSPECIAL REQUIREMENTS:


Willing to work in shifts, accept additional responsibilities, comfortable with transfers

Description:
Position: Manager Design (Solar & BESS)
Department: Renewable Green Energy
Location: Head Office Bhopal
Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Electrical / Mechanical / Civil Engineering

Experience:
10 years total experience
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Solar PV project design
Experience in utility-scale solar projects (50 MWac) preferred

Role Objective
To independently design, review, and deliver complete DC & AC engineering for large-scale solar PV projects, ensuring technical compliance, constructability, safety, and cost optimization across the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities:
Responsible for the design and engineering of large-scale solar PV projects (utility-scale).
Prepare detailed designs, single line diagrams (SLDs), general arrangement drawings, cable sizing, equipment foundation Design & drawings, and layouts etc.
Preparation of complete bill of quantities (BOQ) for utility scale solar projects
Work on optimization of system design and BOQ for cost-effectiveness and efficiency.

DC Design Engineering
DC system design including: String sizing, module configuration, inverter loading
DC cable sizing, voltage drop & loss calculations
PV array layout optimization considering terrain, shading & wind loads
Coordination of MMS (fixed/trackers) with civil & structural teams

AC Design Engineering
AC system design including: Inverter output, LT/HT panels, transformers
AC cable sizing, protection schemes
Interface engineering with pooling substations & grid connectivity
Support AC side integration with SCADA & monitoring systems

Design calculations:
DC/AC losses, short circuit, protection coordination
Ensure compliance with CEA, IEC, IS codes, DISCOM/STU/CTU requirements

Key Skills & Tools
PVsyst/Helios, AutoCAD (mandatory)
ETAP / SKM / Excel (preferred)
Strong understanding of solar EPC execution

Description:
1. Customer Complaint Management
- Receive, analyze, and respond to customer complaints within the agreed timeline.
- Coordinate containment, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions.
- Prepare and submit 8D reports, 5-Why analysis, and other customer-required reports.
- Ensure effectiveness verification and obtain customer closure approval.
2. Customer Quality Assurance
- Ensure products meet customer drawings, specifications, standards, and quality requirements.
- Monitor PPM, rejection rates, warranty claims, and field failure trends.
- Establish containment and corrective actions to prevent defective parts reaching customers.
- Ensure compliance with customer-specific requirements and quality agreements.
3. Customer Audits and Visits
- Plan and coordinate customer audits, assessments, and plant visits.
- Ensure audit readiness, documentation availability, and closure of audit findings.
- Present quality performance, improvement activities, and corrective action status.
- Coordinate cross-functional teams to address customer observations.
4. New Product Development (NPD) and Launch Quality
- Review customer quality requirements during new product development.
- Coordinate APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plan, MSA, SPC, and validation activities, as applicable.
- Ensure process readiness, product validation, traceability, and error-proofing before launch.
- Coordinate safe launch and enhanced inspection until the required approval and stability criteria are met.
5. Cross-Functional and Supplier Coordination
- Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Materials, Supplier Quality, RD, and Marketing.
- Drive supplier corrective actions for customer-related component issues.
- Ensure defective material segregation, replacement, traceability, and disposition.
- Monitor action owners and timelines until effective closure.
6. Quality Performance and Continuous Improvement
- Track customer PPM, complaints, rejection costs, warranty, and repeat failures.
- Prepare monthly quality performance reports and management reviews.
- Identify recurring issues and implement horizontal deployment across similar products and processes.
- Drive lessons learned, defect prevention, and continual improvement initiatives.
India Nippon Electricals is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in the design, development, and implementation of innovative electrical solutions for automotive applications. The Senior Engineer will be responsible for leading projects from concept through to completion, ensuring that all engineering deliverables meet quality, reliability, and performance standards.

Description:
Job Summary
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.


Responsibilities
Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the companys business
Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan
Coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
Maintain credit quality
Onboard new channel partners
Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications.


Educational Qualifications
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage


Required Qualifications and Skills
1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred
Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities
Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills

Description:
Internship Trainee

Location: Chennai, Pondicherry, Erode
Role Purpose
The Customer Service Officer (Internship Trainee) will be responsible for managing customer service operations for unsecured lending products while undergoing structured rotational training across service desk, complaint management, regulatory grievance handling, and quality functions.
The role is designed to build a strong compliance-oriented, customer-centric operations leader for future managerial responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities
1. Service Desk Operations
Handle inbound customer interactions related to loan applications, disbursement, EMI servicing, foreclosure, and account queries
Ensure high First Call Resolution (FCR) and adherence to defined Turnaround Time (TAT)
Maintain accurate call documentation in CRM/system
Deliver consistent customer experience aligned with company standards
Register and track customer complaints in the system
Maintain proper documentation for audit and inspection purposes
2. Regulatory & Compliance Adherence
Strict adherence to RBI guidelines and internal policies
Ensure zero tolerance toward mis-leading information or incorrect commitments
Maintain audit-ready documentation of customer communication
Escalate sensitive cases to Nodal / Grievance Officer as per defined escalation matrix
3. Customer Experience & Process Improvement
Identify recurring service gaps and suggest corrective actions
Support implementation of process improvement initiatives
Contribute to service quality enhancement programs

Training & Rotational Exposure (1218 Months)
The InternshipTrainee will undergo structured exposure to:
Service Desk Operations
Welcome Calling
Complaint Desk & Escalation Handling
Regulatory Grievance Management
Quality & Training Function
MIS & Process Governance
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
First Call Resolution (FCR)
Average Handling Time (AHT)
Complaint TAT Compliance
Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
Audit & Compliance Score
Zero Regulatory Deviations
Qualification
Graduate (MBA in Finance / Operations / Marketing preferred)
02 years of relevant experience (Fresh MBA candidates may apply)
Skills & Competencies
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Analytical and problem-solving ability
Customer-centric approach
Compliance-driven mindset
Ability to handle pressure and escalations professionally
Working knowledge of CRM systems

Job Description
Job Title: RA- Credit Life Reporting To- Manager - Credit Life
Location :
Will be responsible for managing a leading bank Loan Verticals and branches. Purpose of the Job (overall high level summary of the job)
Managing the Group credit life business, across locations and to achieve business volume (premium) and desired penetration. Regularly engage and provide market update, training & drive the ASCs (Loan Centre) to implement the set processes and ensuring seamless functioning of Grp Cr Life product within ASCs. He/she will be closely working with the Retail Asset Teams of the Bank to sell Group credit life Scheme along with the bank s primary product. He/she would plan, monitor, coach, communicate and execute sales strategies and gain mind share of the bank officials (at all levels) and then provide feedback. He/she will also in turn work with the Group Operations to follow up on issuance and clearing of pendency, if any.
Principal Accountabilities How they are achieved/measured
Manage the Group business with the Bank employees
Liaison with different departments for closure of the cases
Champion product and process to drive top line sales through business sales team and maintaining penetration levels of group insurance products with channel partner.
Coordinate and train key officials (ASSL, DSA, other bank officials) to enhance their understanding of the business to increase seller activisation
Provide market feedback on competition and other products in the market.
Manage and strengthen relationship through engagement with Partner s Zonal Leadership team, Ops & Credit Team, DSAs, SMs, Field Sales Staff at all levels and across functions. Values add in key initiatives to enhance attachment ration & business volume through training and service.
Tracking penetration performance and publishing dashboards, along with Group Operations.
To measure & monitor the various metrics (Files and sum assured Penetration rates, seller activation, Claim denial rates/ pending rates, rejection ratios , medical TATs etc), to minimize the same and adhere to TATs and contribute to product improvement.
Monitoring and control process of Post Sales.
Managing complete claims operation & end to end process.

Overview
MRF Tyres (Madras Rubber Factory) is India’s largest tyre manufacturer, established in 1946 and headquartered in Chennai. From its humble beginnings as a small toy balloon unit, the company has grown into a global leader in the tyre industry, with products exported to over 90 countries worldwide. Over the decades, MRF has built a strong presence across India with multiple manufacturing facilities and an extensive dealer network, while steadily expanding its footprint in international markets. The company’s registered office is located at 114, Greams Road, Chennai – 600006, and it operates under the name MRF Limited. Innovation is central to MRF’s success, with a dedicated Research and Design division that serves as a pioneering technology hub, focusing on safety, performance, and advanced tyre design. This emphasis on R&D has enabled the company to consistently deliver high-quality products that meet the diverse demands of passenger vehicles, two-wheelers, commercial trucks, farm machinery, and off-the-road applications. With a strong reputation for reliability, global reach, and technological leadership, MRF continues to stand as a symbol of Indian manufacturing excellence in the international tyre market.

Description:
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent - Reduce attrition

Organizational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Description:
What you ll do:
Lead and manage the research, design, and development of critical components for Medium Voltage (MV) Switchgear. Drive innovation, compliance, and industrialization to strengthen the competitiveness of both MV Switchgear portfolios.
"- - Define and execute R&D strategies for component development across MV Switchgear aligned with business objectives and product technology roadmaps.
- Manage resources, budgets, and timelines, ensuring effective prioritization and delivery of component projects across both product lines.
- Supervise VCB design activities for MV Switchgear, including interrupters, linkages, and insulation systems for AIS and GIS environments.
- Define and approve type and prototype test plans covering MV Switchgear components (mechanical endurance, TRV, dielectric, internal arc, environmental cycling, etc.).
- Coordinate type testing with accredited labs (KEMA, CESI, GCC Lab) and oversee in-house prototype validation.
- Lead root cause analysis of failures and ensure effective corrective measures across both product families.
- Guarantee compliance with IEC / 100 / 102 / 103 / 200 standards as well as customer-specific and utility requirements.
- Maintain technical documentation supporting certifications, approvals, and type testing for both MV Switchgear projects.
- Utilize DFMEA and reliability engineering methods to strengthen robustness and long-term quality of Switchgear components.
- Coordinate with manufacturing, supply chain, electrical, and quality teams to ensure industrialization of components for both MV Switchgear.
- Collaborate with suppliers and R&D institutions to localize and qualify components, reducing costs and lead times across both product lines.
- Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary team, fostering expertise in both MV Switchgear component engineering and building succession pipelines.
- Ability to recruit, recognize and cultivate high performers and expose them in order to create a robust second line of management.
- Assessment criteria of subordinates is performance that leads to planned results.
- Able to anticipate problems and make the necessary proactive steps to prevent them
- Ability to take necessary and proper timely decisions.
- Deliver the required results in timely manner with required quality and cost.
- Must make a tangible difference to his area of operation. and exceed business expectations.
- Responsible for monitoring and controlling budgets and expenses to achieve the optimum cost efficiency.
- Develop, coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automations opportunities as much as possible."

Description:
Change the world. Love your job.
Texas Instruments (TI) is out front and ready for the next big challenge. Our innovations are at the core of nearly every electronics product in use today. And it doesnt stop there. Were developing breakthrough technology to power the worlds future innovations as well. TI is committed to building a better future from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities. Put your talent to work with us.

Application specific MCU industrial (ASM-IND) product line offers a broad range of high performance, innovative and cost-effective specialized MCUs for a wide range of applications across Motor control and Digital power. We enable powering next generation AI datacenters, provide motor control solutions for Humanoids, robotics, etc., build AI solutions for predictive diagnostics, improve performance, control and optimize energy efficiency.
We are looking for an application engineer who has the passion and excitement to continuously learn, innovate, take an active role in solving real time control. It is a fast paced, results driven environment requiring Microcontroller knowledge, system level understanding, software development, Motor control algorithms and system hardware skillsets. You will collaborate with worldwide accounts to solve their system challenges, enable them to go to market faster, work with marketing and business leadership to develop strategic technical solutions to enable TI business growth and impact the next generation of products.
Key responsibilities include:
Develop sensored and sensor less motor control algorithms to enable faster response, Smoother speed, less acoustic noise
Own specific IP s write technical reference manual, resolve customer issues through E2E platform and field engagement
Participate in customer calls to understand system requirements and help select the right devices and reference designs
Support customer design-in activities by:
Adapting our system reference solutions to their custom hardware design.
Meet customer across the globe to promote our technical benefits and resolve technical issues / Debug
Schematic and layout review of customer solutions for our device
Help with software porting, optimize software to improve performance.
Resolve production stop issues for customers
Design EVM and internal evaluation boards to support evaluation activities of new products.
Train Field Applications Engineers and customers on ASM Microcontrollers and reference designs
Write application notes and training collateral that explain features, implementation of motor control on ASM Microcontrollers.
Qualifications
Minimum requirements:
Master s degree in Electrical Engineering or related degree
3 years of application/system engineering experience
Motor control algorithm development
Strong knowledge of Microcontrollers
Experience in embedded C software development
Solid hardware and software debugging skills

Preferred qualifications:
PHD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Electrical Drive Systems
Hands-on experience working in motor control algorithm development
Knowledge on Matlab, Simulink and Plexim for simulation and model-based code generation
Digital control system design
Familiarity with field bus communication
Power electronic system design
Knowledge on functional safety, security and artificial intelligence
Ability to review schematics and PCB layout using CAD tools
Demonstrated strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships
Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery
Self-driven and ability to take initiative and drive for results
Continuous learning mindset
Ability to produce high quality technical documentation
Good communication skillset to interface with customers and Field Applications Engineers

Description:
Role Summary
We are looking for an experienced Warehouse Manager who can take full ownership of the warehouse: racking and storage, stock accuracy, dispatch, and the supervisors and workforce. The person who joins must be able to run the operation independently and report to the owner with clear, accurate information.

Key Responsibilities

Racking & Storage
Manage a G+5 pallet racking system with defined bin locations (row, column, level)
Ensure every pallet is put away in the correct bin and the location is recorded accurately
Plan space usage, put-away, and picking to keep the warehouse organized and avoid congestion
Enforce FIFO by batch, production date, and MRP
Ensure safe forklift / reach truck movement and racking load safety

Inventory & Stock Control
Maintain 100% stock accuracy between physical stock and records
Conduct regular cycle counts and month-end physical stock audits
Track good vs. damaged stock and handle damage segregation and reporting
Reconcile stock with client records and resolve differences quickly

Inward & Dispatch
Plan and supervise daily receipts from the factory and dispatches to depots
Coordinate vehicle placement, loading, and documentation without delays
Ensure dispatch accuracy (right SKU, batch, quantity)

People Management
Lead supervisors, forklift operators, and loading/unloading labour
Allocate shifts and daily work, and hold supervisors accountable for targets
Maintain discipline, attendance, and productivity on the floor
Resolve worker issues firmly and fairly, without escalating everything to the owner
Train new staff on racking, stock procedures, and safety

Compliance, Safety & Reporting
Prepare daily/weekly MIS on stock, inward, dispatch, damages, and manpower
Ensure housekeeping, fire safety, and PPE compliance
Be ready for client audits and inspections at any time

Requirements
5+ years of warehouse experience, with at least 2 years as Warehouse Manager / In-charge
Mandatory: hands-on experience managing a pallet racking warehouse with bin locations
Experience in FMCG, 3PL, or manufacturing warehouses preferred
Proven experience leading a team of 20+ workers and supervisors
Strong knowledge of FIFO, batch tracking, stock audits, and damage handling
Working knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets (WMS or SAP exposure is a plus)
Good communication in Tamil; English and Hindi preferred
Graduate in any discipline; diploma/degree in logistics or supply chain is a plus

Analytical skills
Customer oriented

Role & responsibilities

Job Title: Accounting / Taxation Professional
Location: Karaikkal (100% Onsite)
Job Type: Full-time
Salary: 3,00,000 to 6,00,000 per annum
Experience Required: 3+ years

Work Hours: 10:00am to 6:30pm IST, Monday to Saturday (6 days, 45 hours a week)

BGS & Co., Chartered Accountants, Karaikal, is seeking experienced accounting and taxation professionals who can independently manage accounting, tax filings, statutory compliance and regular client assignments.
The role requires strong practical knowledge, ownership of work and the ability to communicate professionally with clients.

Key Responsibilities
Handle day-to-day accounting, ledger scrutiny, reconciliations and finalisation of accounts.
Prepare and file Income-tax and GST returns, ensuring accuracy and timely compliance.
Prepare supporting workings, schedules and documentation for accounting and tax assignments.
Coordinate with clients to collect information, resolve queries and complete assignments within agreed timelines.
Draft routine correspondence and maintain proper records, documentation and follow-ups.
Use Tally and relevant accounting and tax software effectively.
Use AI tools, where appropriate, to support office productivity, drafting and documentation, while maintaining confidentiality and verifying accuracy.
Take ownership of assigned work and keep clients and internal stakeholders informed of progress.

Candidate Profile
Relevant hands-on experience in an accounting practice, CA firm or a similar accounting and taxation role.
Practical experience in accounting and finalisation of accounts.
Experience in Income-tax and GST return preparation and filing.
Working knowledge of Tally and other accounting or tax software.
Good computer skills and familiarity with AI tools for practical office use.
Good written and spoken communication skills.
Confidence in interacting professionally with clients.
Strong drafting, documentation, organisation and follow-up skills.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to learn, adapt and take responsibility.

Candidates with relevant practical experience and the ability to independently handle assignments will be preferred.

Key Skills: Accounting, Finalisation of Accounts, Income Tax, ITR Filing, GST Compliance, GST Return Filing, Tally, Ledger Scrutiny, Reconciliation, Statutory Compliance, Client Coordination, Documentation, AI Tools.

Description
We are looking for high-performing Managers to help us meet our customer acquisition and revenue growth targets by keeping our company competitive and innovative. The candidate should be able to drive independently and lead/Develop a team to meet the company expectations.
Responsibilities

Design and implement a strategic business plan that expands company s customer base and ensure it s strong presence
Build and promote strong, long-lasting customer relationships by partnering with them and understanding their needs
Identify emerging markets and market shifts while being fully aware of products and competition status
Requirements
8 to 15 yrs experience in Sales and Managing a Team in last few years.
Degree - Any Degree, Engineers would have an advantage.
Proven Track record of delivering high growth targets and revenues.
Strong Business acumen and relevant industry experience can be an advantage.

Open for Discussion and not a constraint for the right candidate.

Title: Senior Engineer RDE
Skills: AutoCADProduct designSwitchgearPrototypeGISTechnical documentationSupply chainRoot cause analysisReliability engineeringCompliance, About the company, Eaton Technologies, 3.9, 1.5K employee reviews, PowerInternetB2BB2CForbes Global 2000, Follow, 129.6k followers, Overview
Description:
What you ll do:
Manage the product design, and development of critical components for Medium Voltage (MV) Switchgear. Drive innovation, compliance, and industrialization to strengthen the competitiveness of MV Switchgear portfolio.
-Active partcipation for product design and development of VCB, RMU, AIS and GIS design activities for MV Switchgear ranage . Drive innovation, compliance, and industrialization to strengthen the competitiveness of MV Switchgear portfolio.
- Product verifications of VCB, RMU, AIS and GIS design activities for MV Switchgear
-Define and approve type and prototype test plans covering MV Switchgear components
-Coordinate type testing with accredited labs (KEMA, CESI, GCC Lab) and oversee in-house prototype validation.
-Lead root cause analysis of failures and ensure effective corrective measures across both product families.
-Guarantee compliance with IEC / 100 / 102 / 103 / 200 standards as well as customer-specific and utility requirements.
-Maintain technical documentation supporting certifications, approvals, and type testing for both MV Switchgear projects.
-Utilize DFMEA and reliability engineering methods to strengthen robustness and long-term quality of Switchgear components.
-Coordinate with manufacturing, supply chain, electrical, and quality teams to ensure industrialization of components for both MV Switchgear.
-Collaborate with suppliers and RD institutions to localize and qualify components, reducing costs and lead times across both product lines.
-Able to anticipate problems and make the necessary proactive steps to prevent them
-Ability to take necessary and proper timely decisions.
-Deliver the required results in timely manner with required quality and cost.
-Must make a tangible difference to his area of operation. and exceed business expectations.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled T24 Developer with 3 to 5 years of experience in Temenos T24/Transact local development, customisation, and integration framework. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in developing and customising T24 applications, implementing business requirements, and integrating T24 with internal and external systems.
The candidate will work closely with functional consultants, business analysts, and technical teams to deliver high-quality banking solutions.

Role & responsibilities
Develop, customise, and maintain Temenos T24/Transact applications based on business requirements.
Work on T24 local development, including routines, versions, enquiries, and application customisations.
Develop and maintain integrations using the T24 Integration Framework and related integration technologies.
Support system integration between T24 and third-party applications, APIs, and other banking systems.
Analyse technical requirements and translate them into effective development solutions.
Perform unit testing, debugging, troubleshooting, and defect resolution.
Support SIT, UAT, deployment, and post-production activities.
Prepare technical documentation and ensure adherence to development standards.
Collaborate with functional, testing, infrastructure, and business teams to ensure timely delivery.
Provide technical support for existing T24 applications and integration interfaces.

Required Skills & Qualifications
3 to 5 years of hands-on experience in Temenos T24/Transact development.
Strong experience in T24 local development and customisation.
Practical experience with the T24 Integration Framework and system integration.
Knowledge of T24 development components such as routines, versions, enquiries, and application programming.
Experience with jBASE/jBC and related T24 development tools.
Understanding of integration concepts, APIs, web services, and interface development.
Good knowledge of banking processes and the Temenos T24 application architecture.
Experience in debugging, testing, and resolving technical issues.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Preferred candidate profile
Experience working on T24 implementation, enhancement, or support projects.
Exposure to OFS, SOAP/REST APIs, middleware, and interface monitoring.
Familiarity with source control, release management, and development lifecycle practices.
What We Offer
Competitive salary as per market standards.
Opportunity to work on banking technology and integration projects.
A collaborative and professional work environment.
Opportunities for technical learning and career growth.
AboutCompany: Zurcher IT is a subsidiary Service Partner to a European Private Wealth Bank (TURICUM). This opportunity is to be a key part of a forward-thinking team, dedicated to driving innovation and efficiency. We are looking for a skilled Techno Functional Consultant for T24 Production Support with strong experience in TAFJ Architecture and JBoss application Server.

Description:
Job Title: US IT Recruiter Fresher to Senior Level
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu, Pondicherry
Experience: 0–5+ Years
Shift: Night Shift – US Staffing
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for US IT Recruiters at different experience levels — Freshers, Junior, Mid-Level, and Senior Recruiters — to join our recruitment team in Salem and Pondicherry.
The role will be assigned based on the candidate's experience, skills, and knowledge of the US IT Staffing process.
Freshers with good communication skills and a strong willingness to learn are welcome to apply. Experienced candidates should have hands-on experience in US IT Recruitment and candidate sourcing.
Key Responsibilities
Source IT professionals using Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Monster, CareerBuilder, job boards, referrals, and other sourcing platforms.
Understand job descriptions and identify suitable candidates based on client requirements.
Search and identify candidates using Boolean search, keyword search, resume databases, and other sourcing techniques.
Review resumes and shortlist qualified candidates based on technical skills and experience.
Conduct initial candidate screening to assess skills, experience, communication, availability, location, work authorization, and interest.
Communicate job opportunities and requirements clearly to candidates.
Maintain regular communication and follow-up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
Coordinate interviews and follow up on interview feedback.
Negotiate candidate salary/rate expectations within approved guidelines.
Collect required candidate information and documentation.
Submit qualified candidates to clients/account managers within the required timelines.
Maintain accurate candidate records, submissions, interview status, and recruitment activities in the ATS.
Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified IT professionals.
Meet daily, weekly, and monthly recruitment targets.
Maintain quality submissions and ensure timely completion of recruitment activities.
Experience-Level Expectations
Fresher / Junior (0–2 Years):
Good communication skills and willingness to learn US IT Recruitment.
Learn and perform candidate sourcing, resume screening, candidate calling, and interview coordination.
Previous recruitment experience or internship is an advantage but not mandatory for freshers.
Mid-Level (2–5 Years):
Independently manage assigned US IT recruitment requirements.
Strong experience in sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, submissions, and interview coordination.
Ability to manage multiple requirements and consistently achieve recruitment targets.
Senior Level (5+ Years):
Handle complex, niche, and high-priority US IT requirements independently.
Strong expertise in advanced sourcing, candidate screening, rate negotiation, and candidate management.
Ability to mentor junior recruiters and contribute to team performance and recruitment strategies.
Required Skills
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Strong interpersonal and candidate engagement skills.
Good analytical and organizational skills.
Ability to work in a target-driven and fast-paced environment.
Basic understanding of IT technologies and technical terminology.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Willingness to work during US business hours / night shift.
Preferred Skills – Experienced Candidates
Hands-on experience in US IT Staffing / US IT Recruitment.
Experience with Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Monster, CareerBuilder, or similar sourcing platforms.
Knowledge of Boolean search and candidate sourcing techniques.
Understanding of W2, C2C, and 1099 hiring models.
Knowledge of US work authorization and visa categories such as H-1B, OPT, CPT, GC, and USC.
Experience with ATS platforms.
Knowledge of different IT skill sets and technical job requirements.
Experience working with VMS or client/vendor requirements is an advantage.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
MBA HR, B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc., BCA, or other relevant qualifications are preferred.
Freshers are welcome to apply.
Candidate Profile
We are looking for candidates who are:
Interested in building or advancing their career in US IT Staffing.
Good at communication and relationship building.
Willing to work in a night-shift environment aligned with US business hours.
Target-oriented and committed to achieving recruitment goals.
Willing to learn and continuously improve recruitment skills.
Candidates will be considered for the appropriate level based on their experience, skills, and demonstrated recruitment capabilities.
