Experience architecting large-scale enterprise applications.
Strong understanding of omnichannel and customer experience design.
Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1/2.2).

Description:
Role & responsibilities
SAP controls design, integration and assurance
Lead pre- and post-implementation control design assessments, fit-gap reviews, configuration testing, and operating effectiveness support across R2R, O2C, P2P, P2M and related cross-functional processes.
Oversee development and review of control activity narratives (CANs), manual control procedures (MCPs), control test scripts (CTSs), risk and control matrices (RCMs), process flows and control ownership/RACI documentation.
Assess automated application controls, configurable controls, interfaces, key reports, data dependencies, exception handling, and manual controls reliant on SAP-generated information.
Challenge design deviations, identify control gaps, evaluate business and financial reporting impact, and recommend remediation or compensating controls with clear ownership and deadlines.
Oversee RICEFW/WRICEF reviews, functional specifications, custom enhancements, defect and change assessments, testing evidence, and control impacts throughout project releases and hypercare.
Technology risk, security and regulatory compliance
Direct SAP ITGC reviews covering user access, privileged access, authentication, change management, operations, logging, and configuration governance, aligned to relevant SOX and audit requirements.
Guide SAP GRC and Pathlock-related reviews, including access request approvals, periodic access reviews, segregation of duties (SoD), sensitive access, ruleset governance and mitigating controls.
Provide implementation assurance through design checkpoints, go-live readiness reviews, risk escalation, remediation validation, and coordination with internal and external assurance teams.
Engagement and people leadership
Own engagement planning, budgets, resourcing, work allocation, milestones, quality review, issue resolution and senior stakeholder reporting across concurrent projects.
Coach and review multidisciplinary teams; set clear expectations for documentation, evidence sufficiency, technical accuracy, productivity, and timely delivery.
Build trusted relationships with overseas engagement teams, client process owners, SAP functional and technical leads, compliance teams, and program management offices.
Contribute to proposals, solution development, methodology improvement, knowledge assets, reusable testing accelerators and practice growth.

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Specialist to join our platinum team of entrepreneurial, enthusiastic, and caring people. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and delivering digital marketing programs to kickstart the sale of our products and drive the rapid expansion and growth in the market. You will identify new and exciting opportunities and establish brand awareness. If you are the person who can execute the ambitious goals at one-third resources than the normal, we would like to meet you. To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset and be a creative, self-starter, top-notch communicator, and passionate marketer.
Responsibilities
Comprehend categories, products, customers and business goals
Know the persona of customers and understand their needs
Research products and competitors to identify opportunities
Establish a digital marketing strategy across various engagement channels both online and offline and develop a marketing calendar
Identify syndication schedules for editorial calendars for blogs, content, and social media posts
Develop effective paid search strategies to gain market share
Plan, design, launch and optimize various PPC campaigns
Perform keyword research and audience targeting in support with management
Work with web developers and designers to manage integrations and tooling for PPC, social media, etc.
Monitor advertisement budgets and oversee search platform accounts
Track KPIs, analyze web traffic metrics, and provide recommendations and useful reports for management
Maintain partnerships with PPC ad platforms and vendors
Identify click frauds and eliminate it
Ensure the highest possible ROI on ad-spend
Perform ongoing keyword discovery, expansion, and optimization
Research and implement search engine optimization recommendations
Research and analyze competitor advertising links
Develop and implement link building strategy
Recommend changes to website architecture, content, linking, and other factors to improve SEO positions for target keywords
Build a social media strategy through the audience identification, competitive research, benchmarking and messaging including platform strategy
Setup, Review, and Optimize company pages on social media platforms
Establish metrics and goals on customer engagement and intimacy on social media to boost website traffic and gain revenue
Engage with the customer on behalf of the brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Proven SEM experience with PPC campaign management across multiple web and social channels
In-depth experience with website analytics tools such as Google Analytics
Solid understanding of performance marketing, conversion, and online customer acquisition
Expertise in keyword research, data analysis and reporting
Knowledge of ranking factors and search engine algorithms
Up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in SEO and SEM
Strong business acumen and expert communicator
Experience with A/B and multivariate experiments
Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, XML, JavaScript, and web development and industry-leading commerce tools
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Marketing, Quantitative, Media or a related field
Google Adwords Certification
Google Analytics and other SEO training are welcome

Description:
As an EDMCS -- Techno / Functional - Associate, you will specialize in providing consulting services for enterprise performance management solutions using Oracle technologies. You will collaborate with clients to assess their performance management needs, design and implement Oracle-based solutions for budgeting, forecasting, financial consolidation, and reporting. As an Associate, you will focus on learning and contributing to client engagement and projects while developing your skills and knowledge to deliver quality work. You will be exposed to clients to learn how to build meaningful client connections, manage and inspire others, and grow your personal brand by deepening your technical knowledge of firm services and technology resources.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will be part of a dynamic team that helps clients optimize operational efficiency. You will be expected to adapt to working with a variety of clients and team members, each presenting varying challenges and scope, using these experiences as opportunities to learn and grow.
Responsibilities
- Collaborating with clients to assess and address their performance management needs using Oracle technologies
- Designing and implementing Oracle-based solutions for budgeting, forecasting, financial consolidation, and reporting
- Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of Oracle enterprise performance management tools
- Analyzing client needs to optimize operational efficiency through business application consulting
- Developing and applying business process analysis and financial planning skills to enhance client outcomes
- Engaging in strategic data analysis to inform financial planning and performance management
- Utilizing Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition (OBIEE) for advanced data insights and reporting
- Conducting process root cause analysis to identify and resolve operational challenges
- Supporting the development of key performance indicators (KPIs) to track and improve client performance
- Participating in the creation and management of budgets to align with client strategic objectives
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 1 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Accounting & Finance, Finance, Management Information Systems, Economics, Business Administration/Management
- At least one of the following: Oracle Cloud certification in Enterprise Performance Management or related Oracle EPM Cloud applications
- Demonstrating proficiency in Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition (OBIEE)
- Utilizing strategic data analysis for informed decision-making
- Applying business process analysis to optimize operations
- Developing financial forecasting models to enhance profitability
- Excelling in communication and teamwork within diverse environments

Description:
As a GenAI Full Stack Senior Associate you will support the design and development of full stack GenAI solutions, turning business needs into practical data and technology deliverables within our Data & Analytics Engineering practice. As a Senior Associate you will analyze complex problems, manage assigned workstreams, build client relationships, and guide junior team members while navigating changing priorities and using critical thinking to shape solution delivery. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will apply data science methods, use modern development tools and techniques, interpret data for insights, and contribute to AI-driven automation and cognitive solutions that support client needs.
Responsibilities
- Design and develop responsive, performant user interfaces using modern frontend frameworks (React, Angular, Vue.js), implementing reusable component libraries and ensuring design consistency.
- Optimize frontend performance through techniques like lazy loading, code splitting, caching, and efficient rendering strategies for scalable web applications.
- Build, secure, and maintain scalable REST and GraphQL APIs and backend services using Node.js, Java Spring Boot, or Python, handling business logic, data validation, and error handling.
- Develop and manage microservices architectures and design relational and NoSQL database schemas with optimized queries and migrations for production environments.
- Deploy applications on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) leveraging Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins) for continuous integration and delivery.
- Collaborate closely with product managers to translate UX designs and user stories into pixel-perfect, accessible, and consistent user interfaces across devices and browsers.
What You Must Have
- Bachelor's & Master's Degree
- 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Experience working with AI or Generative AI tools-based applications.
- Strong backend development skills using Node.js, Nest.js, Java Spring Boot, or Python frameworks, with solid understanding of RESTful APIs and GraphQL.
- Proficient in front-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks like React, Vue.js, or Next.js.
- Familiarity with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB, along with authentication and authorization mechanisms.
- Knowledgeable in version control systems, preferably Git, to manage code and collaborate effectively.

Description:
Job Title: Oracle Cloud HCM Functional Consultant (Senior Associate)

Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Kolkata,Pune, Chennai, Gurugram (PwC Acceleration Center India)

About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced Oracle Cloud HCM Functional Consultant with strong expertise in multiple HCM modules and proven experience in end-to-end implementations. You will work closely with clients and internal teams to design, configure, and implement Oracle Cloud HCM solutions, driving HR transformation and process optimization.

Key Responsibilities:
Lead requirements gathering workshops and collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into Oracle Cloud HCM functional specifications
Design and configure Oracle Cloud HCM modules (Core HR, Payroll, Benefits, Absence, T&L, Compensation, Talent Management, Recruitment & Onboarding, Learning, Workforce Modelling) aligned with best practices
Manage multiple end-to-end Oracle Cloud HCM implementations ensuring quality delivery within budget and timelines
Develop and execute test scripts; lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate system functionality
Provide post-implementation support and training to users for smooth adoption of Oracle Cloud HCM solutions
Prepare detailed functional design documents, configuration guides, and user manuals
Integrate Oracle Fusion HCM with third-party systems using Oracle Integration Cloud, FBDI, APIs, etc.
Use Oracle HCM Cloud tools and analytics to provide insights and contribute to HR strategy and workforce planning
Manage stakeholder relations, collaborating across project managers, technical teams, and business users to ensure success

What You Must Have:

Description:
VMware Engineer with HCX
Hybrid
Hyderabad/Bangalore

Job Details:
The Sr. Infrastructure Engineer will play a critical role in managing and optimizing our infrastructure systems. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in VMWare technologies and will be responsible for ensuring the stability, performance, and security of our infrastructure. This position requires a proactive approach to problem-solving and a commitment to delivering high-quality infrastructure solutions that meet the needs of our organization.

Responsibilities:
Design, implement, and manage VMWare environments to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
Monitor and maintain infrastructure systems, including servers, storage, and network components.
Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure-related issues in a timely manner.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support application deployments and infrastructure upgrades.
Develop and maintain documentation for infrastructure processes, configurations, and procedures.
Implement and manage backup and disaster recovery solutions to ensure data integrity and availability.
Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies to recommend improvements to infrastructure systems.
Participate in capacity planning and performance tuning of infrastructure resources.
Provide technical support and guidance to junior team members.

Mandatory Skills:
Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with VMWare technologies, including vSphere, vCenter, and ESXi.
Proficiency in managing virtualized environments and understanding of virtualization best practices.
Experience with infrastructure monitoring tools and performance tuning.
Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols.
Familiarity with backup and disaster recovery solutions.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure.

Preferred Skills:
Knowledge of cloud technologies and hybrid cloud environments.
Experience with automation tools and scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell, Python).
Familiarity with ITIL processes and best practices.
Experience with storage solutions and SAN technologies.
Certifications related to VMWare or infrastructure management (e.g., VCP, VCAP).

Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Relevant certifications in VMWare or infrastructure management are highly desirable.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously

Location-Bangalore/Hyderabad/Gurgaon/Kolkata/Chennai/Pune.

Core module expertise: Hands-on functional knowledge in at least two modules, such as FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, EWM, or QM, including the ability to read and validate configuration rather than only execute scripts.

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an Tech Lead (Backend Developer) - Manager, you will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth. Within our Advisory practice, you will leverage advanced analytics and statistical techniques to extract insights from large datasets, helping solve complex business problems and inform strategic decisions. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion.
Responsibilities
- Leading data science initiatives to transform raw data into actionable insights for informed decision-making
- Guiding teams in the application of advanced analytics and statistical techniques to solve complex business problems
- Developing and implementing machine learning models to enhance data-driven decision-making processes
- Collaborating with client support teams to design and develop robust data solutions that drive business growth
- Utilizing data science algorithms and troubleshooting techniques to optimize data analysis and visualization
- Mentoring team members to leverage their unique strengths and improve performance on client engagements
- Analyzing system components to identify linkages and interactions for comprehensive data solutions
- Taking ownership of projects, including planning, budgeting, execution, and completion, to meet client expectations
- Encouraging innovation and the use of technology to enhance delivery and inspire team development
- Addressing conflicts and engaging in challenging conversations with clients and stakeholders to maintain project alignment
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree from Tier 1
- At least 7 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Computer and Data Engineering, Computer Science, Human Computer Interaction, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems/Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering
- Strong proficiency in Python for production-grade application or service development.
- Experience designing, implementing, and integrating REST APIs.
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerised service deployment.
Strong working knowledge of PostgreSQL, including schema design, querying, and performance tuning.
- Proficiency with Git-based collaborative development workflows.
- Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including clean code, automated testing, design patterns, and maintainability.
- Working knowledge of Docker and CI/CD pipelines.

Description:
Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Description:
As a SAP - CS - Senior Associate, you will engage with clients to analyze their needs, implement SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will help clients optimize their customer relationship management processes, enhance customer satisfaction, and achieve strategic objectives. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate complex situations, grow your personal brand, and deepen your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, and deliver quality work. Embracing increased ambiguity, you will be comfortable when the path forward isnt clear, using these moments as opportunities to grow.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems. You will develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is changing, using critical thinking to break down complex concepts. Your role will involve interpreting data to inform insights and recommendations, while upholding professional and technical standards.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client requirements to implement SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software solutions
- Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of SAP CRM applications
- Collaborating with clients to optimize customer relationship management processes and enhance customer satisfaction
- Utilizing analytical thinking to break down complex concepts and develop actionable insights
- Engaging in business process consulting to identify opportunities for improvement and transformation
- Managing deployment and design implementation of CRM solutions to meet client objectives
- Facilitating customer needs analysis to tailor CRM solutions effectively
- Building and maintaining meaningful client connections to foster long-term relationships
- Leveraging business technology skills to support CRM software deployment and integration
- Interpreting data to inform insights and recommendations for client engagements
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 2 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- At least one of the following: One or more SAP certifications in SAP Customer or S/4HANA customer-facing solutions, including Sales, Service, Commerce, or Customer Data platforms
- Demonstrating proficiency in SAP Cloud for Customer and SAP CRM
- Utilizing analytical thinking for business process improvement
- Excelling in customer relationship management and engagement
- Implementing technology solutions to enhance customer satisfaction
- Navigating complex client environments with ease
- Building meaningful client connections through effective communication

Job Description
 Position: Marketing Specialist Builder Partnerships (MBA Fresher)
Location: Hyderabad, Mumbai, Bangalore
Department: Alliances & Partnerships
Company:Livspace
About the Role
Livspace is looking for energetic and customer-focused MBA graduates to join our Alliances & Partnerships team.
As a **Marketing Specialist*, you will be stationed at assigned premium builder projects and will act as the face of Livspace at the property. You will own the complete customer journey—from the first interaction at the builder site to the final home interior booking.
This is a high-ownership role where you will collaborate with builder sales teams, engage prospective homeowners, drive Experience Centre visits, coordinate with Livspace designers, and ensure an exceptional customer experience throughout the buying journey.
---
Key Responsibilities
 Project Ownership
* Own one or more assigned builder projects end-to-end.
* Build strong working relationships with builder sales, CRM, and project teams.

Description:
At PwC, our people in software and product innovation focus on developing cutting-edge software solutions and driving product innovation to meet the evolving needs of clients. These individuals combine technical experience with creative thinking to deliver innovative software products and solutions.
Those in software engineering at PwC will focus on developing innovative software solutions to drive digital transformation and enhance business performance. In this field, you will use your knowledge to design, code, and test cutting-edge applications that revolutionise industries and deliver exceptional user experiences.
Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:
Analyse and identify the linkages and interactions between the component parts of an entire system.
Take ownership of projects, ensuring their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion.
Partner with team leadership to ensure collective ownership of quality, timelines, and deliverables.
Develop skills outside your comfort zone, and encourage others to do the same.
Effectively mentor others.
Use the review of work as an opportunity to deepen the expertise of team members.
Address conflicts or issues, engaging in difficult conversations with clients, team members and other stakeholders, escalating where appropriate.
Uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements.
The Opportunity
As part of the Software and Product Innovation team you will drive the technical direction and architecture for a whole-stack engineering team, securing delivery quality and performance. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff while fostering a collaborative culture that emphasizes learning and innovation. This role allows you to shape the technical landscape and guide your team toward excellence in delivery.
Responsibilities
Direct the technical architecture for a versatile engineering team
Secure exceptional delivery and peak performance standards
Lead and mentor junior staff while fostering a collaborative culture
Shape the technical landscape to drive team excellence
Focus on strategic planning to meet client needs effectively
Encourage a culture of learning and innovation within the team
Manage client accounts and maintain enduring relationships
Oversee project execution to secure alignment with goals
What You Must Have
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
8 years of professional software engineering experience
Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering preferred
Proven experience in technical leadership roles
Skilled in JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
Demonstrated ability in mentoring engineers
Experience with MongoDB or NoSQL databases
Proven skills in designing scalable, distributed systems
Excelling in problem-solving and debugging
Experience collaborating in agile, cross-functional teams

Responsibilities:
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and identify opportunities to apply Agentic AI and Generative AI (GenAI) solutions to solve complex enterprise problems.
Design, develop, and implement advanced GenAI and Agentic AI systems, including ReAct agents (Reasoning + Acting frameworks), multi-agent architectures, and autonomous AI workflows.
Build and deploy intelligent AI-powered chatbots and conversational agents using LLMs, tool-calling frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), memory modules, and agent orchestration patterns.
Ensure consistency, reliability, and alignment in AI-generated outputs through prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and monitoring mechanisms.
Develop and implement machine learning models and algorithms to support GenAI applications, including fine-tuning, embeddings, and hybrid AI architectures.
Perform data cleaning, preprocessing, and feature engineering to prepare structured and unstructured data for machine learning and GenAI pipelines.
Collaborate with data engineers to design efficient data pipelines and integrate ML/LLM systems into scalable production environments.
Validate and evaluate model and agent performance using appropriate metrics (accuracy, latency, hallucination rate, consistency scoring, human evaluation frameworks).
Develop and deploy production-ready AI applications using object-oriented programming principles, ensuring modularity, scalability, maintainability, and robustness.
Implement containerized AI solutions using Docker and Kubernetes for orchestration, scaling, and cloud-native deployments.
Design and implement tool-augmented agents, API-integrated workflows, and autonomous decision-making systems using modern AI agent frameworks.
Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate AI insights and business impact clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Continuously stay updated with advancements in GenAI, Agentic AI, multi-agent systems, LLM orchestration, and emerging AI frameworks, recommending innovative approaches to enhance enterprise AI capabilities.
Requirements:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.
7+ years of relevant technical/technology experience, with a focus on GenAI projects.
Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, R, or Scala.
Proficiency in machine learning libraries and frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.
Experience with data preprocessing, feature engineering, and data wrangling techniques.
Solid understanding of statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, and experimental design.
Familiarity with cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Knowledge of data visualization tools and techniques.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Experience with object-oriented programming languages such as Java, C++, or C#.
Experience developing and deploying machine learning applications in production environments.
Understanding data privacy and compliance regulations.
Relevant certifications in data science or GenAI technologies.
Development experience in system designing, proven track record of software delivery through all phases of development, critical thinking, ability to clearly communicate, present and lead.
Nice to Have Skills:
Experience with Azure AI Search, Azure Doc Intelligence, Azure OpenAI, AWS Textract, AWS Open Search, AWS Bedrock.
Familiarity with LLM backed agent frameworks such as Autogen, Langchain, Langgraph Semantic Kernel, etc.
Experience in chatbot design, frontend and development.
Certification of cloud or Genai
Designed and implemented enterprise-grade GenAI solutions using Databricks Mosaic AI, enabling scalable LLM deployment and governance.
Built Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using Mosaic AI Vector Search and Foundation Models for domain-specific knowledge querying.
Fine-tuned and deployed LLMs using Mosaic AI Model Serving, optimizing inference latency and cost.
Implemented secure LLM workflows with Unity Catalog governance and model tracking via MLflow.
Strong background in the Healthcare domain, with deep understanding of Payer operations and working knowledge of Provider ecosystems.
Experience in consulting engagements, including direct interaction with client stakeholders and managing client relationships.
Demonstrated leadership experience managing and mentoring teams of 510 members.
If you are passionate about GenAI technologies and have a proven track record in data science, join PwC US - Acceleration Center and be part of a dynamic team that is shaping the future of GenAI solutions. We offer a collaborative and innovative work environment where you can make a significant impact.

BE / B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc / M.E / M.Tech /Master’s Degree /MBA from reputed institute

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Run third-party risk assessments end-to-end from intake through approval and ongoing monitoring across client vendor portfolios.
Manage numerous engagements, primarily focused on helping organisations identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with their third-party relationships.
Negotiate security requirements with vendors and track remediation deliverables to ensure timely closure of identified gaps.
Maintain third-party risk registers, contract renewals cadence, and produce executive reporting for leadership visibility.
Conduct TPRM programme maturity assessments against industry-leading frameworks (such as NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001, SIG, etc.) to identify gaps and recommend improvements.
Collaborate with clients to understand their vendor landscape and risk appetite, ensuring all engagements are delivered to the highest quality and professional standards.
Stay informed about emerging supply chain threats, regulatory expectations, and TPRM technologies, and incorporate this knowledge into client recommendations.
Provide Subject Matter Expertise on third-party risk management best practices and regulatory requirements to clients across various sectors.


Preferred candidate profile

Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Risk Management, Business Administration, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
Minimum of 3 years of experience delivering third-party risk management projects, including vendor assessments, programme design, and risk reporting.
Proven track record of successfully executing complex projects within consulting or professional services environments.
In-depth understanding of TPRM principles and domains (such as vendor due diligence, contractual security requirements, ongoing monitoring, and fourth-party risk).
Strong knowledge of TPRM frameworks and standards (such as NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001, SIG, CAIQ) is advantageous.
Familiarity with TPRM platforms and tools (such as OneTrust, ServiceNow VRM, Archer, or BitSight) is beneficial.
Professional certifications such as CRISC, CTPRP, or CISA are a plus.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic and diverse team environment.
Demonstrated capability to manage multiple projects concurrently and adhere to deadlines.

Description:
We are looking for a skilled Frontend Developer with expertise in React and Typescript to join our team in Chennai or Bangalore, India. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in frontend development and excellent problem-solving skills.
Roles and Responsibility
Design and develop high-quality, responsive, and scalable web applications using React and Typescript.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize project requirements.
Develop and maintain well-organized, efficient, and readable code.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues efficiently.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving overall code quality.
Stay updated with the latest trends and technologies in frontend development.
Job Requirements
Strong proficiency in React, Typescript, and related frameworks.
Excellent understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals.
Experience with state management libraries such as Redux or MobX.
Familiarity with modern frontend build tools like Webpack or Rollup.
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
About Company
Photon Infotech P Ltd is a leading company in the industry, committed to delivering high-quality solutions and services to its clients. We value innovation, teamwork, and continuous learning.

Description:
Role: Workday Accounting Prism
Experience: 4 to 10 years
Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certification: Workday certification (Mandatory)

Required Skills:
Active Workday Financials certification.
At least 1 year or full implementation of Workday Financials along with end to end support on Accounting Center/Prism.
At least 3 years of relevant Workday experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Subject Matter Expertise on Accounting Center Processes and reports while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Functional experience in several Workday Finance modules like Financial Accounting, Common Financial Management, Customers, Customer Accounts, Banking and Settlement, Business Assets, Projects.
Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various Finance modules and hands on experience configuring FDM structure and business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.
Hands-on experience creating and troubleshooting EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Preferred Skills:
Good to have Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Reporting, FDM and other certifications related to Workday Finance functional areas.
Knowledge on using Customer Central for configuration and migration.
Demonstrates thorough abilities and/or a proven record of success working in a collaborative environment to collect and refine business requirements along with the associated development activities to deliver the appropriate reporting solutions within Workday Accounting Center;
Demonstrates competencies in verbal and written communication skills via experience in leading business requirements gathering and design sessions;
Demonstrates thorough abilities in data profiling and governance principles to ensure data integrity and quality throughout the development life cycle, and utilizes data modeling, design, and visualization tools and principles;
Demonstrates thorough knowledge of SQL, including database queries;
Serves as a subject matter expert regarding Workday Accounting Center; and
Demonstrates critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

Location - Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Kolkata, Chennai

If you are interested and know someone looking out, kindly share CV at PG00832018@techmahindra.com

Skills & Job Description
Lead end to end solution architecture design for SAP S/4HANA implementations, transformations, and migrations across diverse business landscapes.
Define high level business capabilities, validate requirements, and create comprehensive technical blueprints that align IT strategies with business objectives
Collaborate with cross functional teams including SAP process experts, development architects, and project management offices to ensure seamless solution delivery


Core Skills---

SAP S/4HANA Expertise
Deep knowledge of SAP S/4HANA modules including Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing
Proficiency in SAP Activate methodology for structured implementation approach
Experience with S/4HANA migration strategies, system conversion, selective data migration and greenfield implementations
Understanding of SAP S/4HANA Cloud editions (Public, Private) and deployment options
Architecture & Design
Enterprise architecture framework expertise with ability to design scalable, integrated solution landscapes
Solution component definition using SAP Transformation Navigator and architectural modelling tools
Integration architecture design covering A2A, B2B, and hybrid connectivity patterns
Cloud and Clean Core strategy implementation with focus on standardization and extensibility
Database administration knowledge, particularly SAP HANA platform optimization
Understanding of middleware technologies and integration patterns
Soft Skills & Competencies
Excellent communication and presentation skills for senior management and technical audiences
Problem solving expertise with ability to navigate complex technical and business challenges
Negotiation and influencing skills for driving consensus across diverse stakeholder groups
Experience Requirement
Certification Requirements
SAP Certified Professional Enterprise Architect (P_SAPEA_2023) or equivalent
SAP S/4HANA implementation and migration certifications SAP BTP Solution Architect certification preferred
TOGAF or similar enterprise architecture framework certification recommended


Key Responsibilities

Solution Design
Create comprehensive technical blueprints covering processes, integration, extensibility, and data management strategies
Validate IT scope and approve/reject requirements based on architectural feasibility and business value
Stakeholder Engagement
Conduct solution architecture workshops and present recommendations to executive leadership
Gather and validate business requirements while identifying gaps in current system landscape
Provide architectural advisory services and best practice guidance to implementation teams
Success Metrics
Successful delivery of S/4HANA implementations within scope, timeline, and budget parameters
Client satisfaction scores reflecting solution quality and architectural guidance effectiveness
Team development indicators including knowledge transfer and skill enhancement
Technical excellence benchmarks including system performance, scalability

Description:
About The Role


Job Title -

Instructional Design - Associate

- T&O- (S&C GN)

Management Level:12 - Associate

Location:Gurugram, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Chennai

Must have skills:

Instructional Design OR Storyboarding OR Articulate Storyline


Good to have skills:Whatfix, walk me, ADDIE model

Experience:Minimum 0-3 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification:Any Bachelors Fulltime

Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles & Responsibilities:



Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Analyst in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:
Support team/ project through various phases of learning design and development based on the identified business problem, audience profile, and evaluation methodology.
Help develop standards and templates for the proposed learning solution.
Create effective training materials mapping the clients needs using learning modalities such as Instructor-led training, Web-based training, virtual Instructor-led training, simulations, videos, interactive learning nuggets, and performance support materials.
Collaborate with stakeholders such as Subject Matter Experts, team leads, media and technology teams to support iterations to the learning material for improved business outcomes.
Creatively visualize the content and work with the visual design team to convey the course content/key messages impactfully.
Write impactful storyboards by understanding the raw content and repurposing it based on audience, content, modality, and other considerations.
Perform quality checks on the training deliverables to meet the standard quality benchmarks.
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Proficiency in content development and instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.
Understanding of industry standard design/rapid authoring tools such as Articulate/Captivate/ Lectora/ Camtasia/ SAP Enable Now/WalkMe and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools. An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.
Possess excellent interpersonal and writing skills with a strong business acumen.


Qualification

Professional & Technical

Skills:

Graduate/Post Graduate in any specialization, preferably Journalism / Mass Communication / English Literature /Advertising / Public Relations
Desired work experience:-0-3 years in instructional design and content development with an understanding of training and design strategy
Adept at gathering and understanding source content to create engaging courses based on the target audience
Experience in applying proven learning methodologies and emerging technologies for adult learning



Additional Information:
A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression
A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Gurgaon, Chennai
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Building the machine learning production System(or MLOps) is the biggest challenge most large companies currently have in making the transition to becoming an AI-driven organization. This position is an opportunity for an experienced, server-side developer to build expertise in this exciting new frontier. You will be part of a team deploying state-of-the-art AI solutions for Fractal clients.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
As MLOps Engineer, you will work collaboratively with Data Scientists and Data engineers to deploy and operate advanced analytics machine learning models. You ll help automate and streamline Model development and Model operations. You ll build and maintain tools for deployment, monitoring, and operations. You ll also troubleshoot and resolve issues in development, testing, and production environments.
Enable Model tracking, model experimentation, Model automation Develop scalable ML pipelines
Develop MLOps components in Machine learning development life cycle using Model Repository (either of): MLFlow, Kubeflow Model Registry
Machine Learning Services (either of): Kubeflow, DataRobot, HopsWorks, Dataiku or any relevant ML E2E PaaS/SaaS
Work across all phases of Model development life cycle to build MLOPS components
Build the knowledge base required to deliver increasingly complex MLOPS projects on the Cloud(AWS, Azure, GCP)/On Prem Be an integral part of client business development and delivery engagements across multiple domains.
QUALIFICATIONS: REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
3-12 years experience building production-quality software
Strong experience in System Integration, Application Development or DataWarehouse projects across technologies used in the enterprise space
Basic Knowledge of MLOps, machine learning and docker
Object-oriented languages (e.g. Python, PySpark, Java, C#, C++ )
Experience developing CI/CD components for production ready ML pipeline.
Database programming using any flavors of SQL
Knowledge of Git for Source code management
Ability to collaborate effectively with highly technical resources in a fast-paced environment
Ability to solve complex challenges/problems and rapidly deliver innovative solutions
Team handling, problem solving, project management and communication skills & creative thinking
Foundational Knowledge of Cloud Computing either one AWS, Azure or GCP
Hunger and passion for learning new skills
Recommended (not mandatory): completion of Fractal Data Science Professional Certificate" with this - https: / / www.coursera.org / professional-certificates / fractal-data-science

B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or related technical degree OR Equivalent.

Level:Manager | Location:Bangalore/Gurgaon/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Hyderabad/Kolkata | Years of Exp:10 to 15 years
Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe in creating an impact? Are you a problem solver who enjoys working on transformative strategies for global clients? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities in Accenture Technology Strategy & Advisory.
The Practice- A Brief Sketch:
The Technology Strategy & Advisory Practice is a part of and focuses on the clients most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models using agile methodologies.
We provide you with a great learning ground, deep-rooted in , where you will get an opportunity to advice and work with our key global clients, driving end-to-end transformative strategic value and business growth. As a part of this high performing team, these are some of the initiatives you will drive:
Transaction Advisory and Strategy (Tech): Lead and support M&A transactions (Carve Outs / Separation / Mergers/ Integrations) with a focus on the technology sector, including IT infrastructure, software, cybersecurity, cloud computing, SaaS, AI, and emerging tech trends. IT Due Diligence and Financial and Financial Analysis: Manage and lead IT due diligence processes, evaluating financial, operational, technological, and legal aspects of technology companies / organizations being considered for acquisition. Industry & Technology Infrastructure Assessment:Understanding of client technology operations to grasp the context of global, industry, economic, technology, and social trends Draw Roadmaps for IT implementations: Pinpoint the right data-driven Digital, IT or Cloud technology strategy solutions for practical implementation road maps Monitor Digital, IT & Cloud Strategy: Managing change, monitoring, and gauging processes, and taking remedial steps
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Leverage your deep experience across technology strategy areas such as tech M&A Advisory, IT Separation / Integration Planning / Execution, Digital & Technology Strategy, Operating Model Design, Agile Operating Model Design, Workforce Transformation, Sourcing Strategy, IT Shared Services Strategy, Process Transformation, Value case/ business case formulation, Enterprise Architecture and Application Portfolio Strategy Excel as a long-term trusted advisor and partner by providing thought leadership and profound knowledge of market trends. Understand and deploy the key value drivers of a business, how they impact the scope and approach of the engagement Create expert content and use advanced presentation, public speaking, content creation and communication skills for C-Level discussions. Demonstrate strong understanding of a specific industry, client or technology and function as an expert to advise senior leadership. Manage budgeting and forecasting activities and build financial proposals

Your experience counts!
MBA from a tier 1 institute
Your prior experience-
5-8 years of M&A Advisory, Strategy Consulting or Investment banking experience
Experience in the example offerings:M&A advisory (tech), Separation planning & execution, Integration Planning & Execution, IT Due Diligence,
Experience in at least 2 of the example offerings:Tech Strategy, Tech Operating Models, IT Shared Services Strategy, Cloud Transformation, Industry & New Technology, Technology ROI/Cost Take Out, Modern Architecture, Data-Driven Enterprise
3+ years of experience in financial modeling, valuation analysis, scenario testing and writing business cases (quantitative and qualitative) to support strategic business initiatives, process improvement initiatives, or IT transformation
2+ years of experience leading or managing large teams effectively including planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating team workshops, and developing technology strategy recommendations
Good knowledge of technology and enterprise architecture concepts through practical experience and knowledge of technology trends e.g. Mobility, Cloud, Digital, Collaboration
A strong understanding in any of the following industries is preferred:Financial Services, Retail, Consumer Goods, Telecommunications, Life Sciences, Transportation, Hospitality, Automotive/Industrial, Mining and Resources or equivalent domains
Exposure to industry frameworks e.g. TOGAF, DODAF desirable but not essential.

About Accenture Strategy & Consulting:Accenture Strategy & Consulting enables our clients to embrace the change and shape their future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers, and communities. This is our unique differentiator. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture S&Cs services include those provided by our Capability Network a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Our Capability Network teams complement our in-country teams to deliver cutting-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world. Be part of a highly specialized team including top notch professionals from leading business schools coupled with experience in working with global industry leaders. Grow your career and experience a stimulating, fast-paced environment working with prestigious clients on diverse projects to solve significant business challenges. You will deliver lasting impact as you work alongside the extremely skilled team, combining overseas client-site work with opportunities based locally, and contribute to high performance through continuous collaboration and knowledge sharing. Practice Overview:Capability Network CFO & Enterprise Value (CFO & EV) team supports CFOs / Finance organizations to craft and implement strategies anchored on digital disruption, new age operating models, best in class practices to drive market differentiation and creating value. We take pride in performing End to End Transformations, delivering tangible results and outcomes for our client on back of path breaking thought leadership, deep CXO relationships, digital investments & assets and collaborating with our other Accenture businesses like Technology and Operations. CFO&EV includes the below domains: CFO Value Strategies - Defining strategies to uncover, assess, architect and capture value across the enterprise including M&A, investment decisions, operating model considerations and strategic cost reduction initiatives. Digital Finance Transformation Transform the core finance function from strategic vision through value realization, into a more efficient and effective capability and operating model, enabled by intelligent automation (RPA through AI), data and analytics strategies, and new ways of working. o Tax Transformation includes tax function assessment and process transformation, tax operating model transformation, automation of tax systems and end to end tax transformation. o Treasury & Working Capital Management includes treasury management and operating model, total working capital assessment, treasury and working capital technology solutions and digital innovation. Enterprise Planning & Analysis Developed integrated, cloud enabled, planning and enterprise performance analysis capabilities that will enhance strategic insights and accelerate business decisions. Digital Risk and Compliance - Actively engage with clients to prepare and protect their enterprise in an increasingly volatile world, enabling business outcomes over the short, medium, and long term. The differentiating Capabilities of CFO&EV Practice combines the broad focus of CFO Strategy with agile planning, sustainable growth, data driven thinking and automation to drive value creation. Accenture CFO&EV Practice has expertise in delivering Shared Services Transformations, Target operating model definition, Zero Based Organization/Zero Based Spend Full Cycle, Intelligent Enterprise Platforms Transformation/Automation, Enterprise Performance Management Strategy implementation, F&PA Process Design and Blueprints, AI-Powered Planning & Forecasting, Digital Reporting & Analytics, Enabling Technologies, Tax Process Automation, Treasury Strategy, Working Capital Optimization, Risk Strategy and Assessment, Cyber Resilience and Security, Financial Crime & Regulatory Compliance, Data Driven Consulting, Client Value Analysis, SAP BPC and S/4 HANA green field and brown field transformations with 150+ projects per year. Instructional Design Specialist

- T&O- (S&C GN)

Instructional Design OR Storyboarding OR Articulate Storyline

Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles & Responsibilities:



Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Consultant in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:
Collaborate with the client team to understand the business problem, identify the solution approach and work through the design, development, and delivery phases.
Conduct Training Needs Analysis to develop the training curriculum.
Develop high-quality and detailed content outlines as per the curriculum.
Design standards, guidelines, templates, and checklists for the proposed learning solution.
Collaborate with internal and client stakeholders to design and develop relevant and effective training deliverables.
Review training deliverables to ensure that the deliverable quality is as per the project quality parameters and industry standards.
Identify and share the risks with the Project Leads/Functional Manager to discuss possible solutions/mitigations/alternatives.
Coach instructional designers and content developers to prepare materials for instructor development workshops.

Description:
You will deliver lasting impact as you work alongside the extremely skilled team, combining overseas client-site work with opportunities based locally, and contribute to high performance through continuous collaboration and knowledge sharing. Practice Overview:Capability Network CFO & Enterprise Value (CFO & EV) team supports CFOs / Finance organizations to craft and implement strategies anchored on digital disruption, new age operating models, best in class practices to drive market differentiation and creating value. We take pride in performing
End to End Transformations, delivering tangible results and outcomes for our client on back of path breaking thought leadership, deep CXO relationships, digital investments & assets and collaborating with our other Accenture businesses like Technology and Operations. CFO&EV includes the below domains: CFO Value Strategies - Defining strategies to uncover, assess, architect and capture value across the enterprise including M&A, investment decisions, operating model considerations and strategic cost reduction initiatives. Digital Finance Transformation Transform the core finance function from strategic vision through value realization, into a more efficient and effective capability and operating model, enabled by intelligent automation (RPA through AI), data and analytics strategies, and new ways of working.
Tax Transformation includes tax function assessment and process transformation, tax operating model transformation, automation of tax systems and end to end tax transformation. o Treasury & Working Capital Management includes treasury management and operating model, total working capital assessment, treasury and working capital technology solutions and digital innovation. Enterprise Planning & Analysis Developed integrated, cloud enabled, planning and enterprise performance analysis capabilities that will enhance strategic insights and accelerate business decisions. Digital Risk and Compliance - Actively engage with clients to prepare and protect their enterprise in an increasingly volatile world, enabling business outcomes over the short, medium, and long term. The differentiating Capabilities of CFO&EV Practice combines the broad focus of CFO Strategy with agile planning, sustainable growth, data driven thinking and automation to drive value creation.
Accenture CFO&EV Practice has expertise in delivering Shared Services Transformations, Target operating model definition, Zero Based Organization/Zero Based Spend Full Cycle, Intelligent Enterprise Platforms Transformation/Automation, Enterprise Performance Management Strategy implementation, F&PA Process Design and Blueprints, AI-Powered Planning & Forecasting, Digital Reporting & Analytics, Enabling Technologies, Tax Process Automation, Treasury Strategy, Working Capital Optimization, Risk Strategy and Assessment, Cyber Resilience and Security, Financial Crime & Regulatory Compliance, Data Driven Consulting, Client Value Analysis, SAP BPC and S/4 HANA green field and brown field transformations with 150+ projects per year.
Location Gurgaon/Mumbai/Bangalore Travel Percentage Expected Travel could be anywhere between 0-100%
Principal Roles And Responsibilities -
Seeking for candidates with strong and deep finance knowledge, process, and operational acumen in various aspects of finance coupled with strong consulting skills around problem identification, creative thinking, problem solving, strong and clear communication and presentation skills, stakeholder management, etc. Candidate will be operating in one of the above domains with opportunities to move across domains over the years. Working closely with our clients, consulting professionals and help in building and implementing strategies that can enhance business performance.
Opportunities to make a difference within exciting client initiatives coupled with Accentures leading assets, are limitless in this ever-changing business landscape. Few day-to-day responsibilities include: Identifying, assessing, and solving complex business problems for area of responsibility, where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.
Demonstrating strong finance process knowledge and understanding to work with client process owners across accounting, management and reporting, taxation, etc. Assisting clients in developing and building the required capabilities for growth and innovation to sustain high performance. Developing detailed and actionable business cases and plans which reflect our practices deep industry, functional and business process acumen to leverage our assets and capabilities for greatest strategic impact. Working in multi-disciplinary teams to shape, sell, communicate and implement programs. Assisting leadership teams in developing offerings and assets

Qualifications - Chartered Accountant, only rank holders or first attempters in both group for both CA Final and PE II levels. Experience Minimum 3 years of experience in a reputed CA firm with strong experience around taxation, maintaining books of accounts, consolidation and close process, audits and internal controls, audits of financial institutions including risk analysis, client relationship management, etc. Key Competencies and Skills Must Have Strong analytical skills, with ability to analyze data, interpret the trends and produce results in presentable manner. Should possess advanced excel skills and PPT skills with minimum 2+ years of working experience. Ability to convert complex data into effective displays that are consumable by clients/end-users.
Well-versed in Finance processes with 2 to 3 years of basic experience. Required Soft Skills: Demonstrate analytical, critical thinking, problem-solving, and creativity to solve non-standard analytics problems. Ability to collaborate with geographically dispersed teams. Strong communication and presentation skills. Attention to detail and accuracy. Self-starter with strong organizational, time management and multi-tasking skills. Description:
Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, Gurgaon, Pune

Brief about the Team & Fractal
Fractal partners with Fortune 500 organizations to unlock business value through AI, Data, Cloud, and Digital Transformation. We combine deep domain expertise, advanced analytics, generative AI, and cloud technologies to help clients accelerate innovation, optimize operations, and drive measurable business outcomes. As organizations increasingly adopt cloud-first strategies, AWS plays a critical role in enabling scalable, secure, and data-driven transformation journeys.

Role Summary:
The Client Partner - Head of AWS is responsible for driving AWS-led business growth, expanding strategic client relationships, owning practice P&L, and delivering large-scale cloud transformation programs. This leader will serve as the executive sponsor for key client engagements, strengthen Fractals partnership with AWS, and help clients leverage AWS services to accelerate AI, Analytics, Data, and Digital modernization initiatives.
The role requires a blend of executive client engagement, cloud consulting expertise, sales leadership, alliance management, and business operations to scale the AWS practice.
Roles & Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership
Define and execute the growth strategy for Fractals AWS Practice, aligned with the organizations overall business objectives.
Own the AWS Practice P&L, including revenue growth, margins, utilization, and overall business performance.
Develop offerings, accelerators, solution assets, and industry-specific cloud transformation propositions.
Collaborate with leadership teams to identify emerging market opportunities and expand AWS-led services.
Client Partnership & Business Growth
Build and manage executive relationships with C-level stakeholders across strategic accounts.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients on cloud transformation, modernization, AI/ML, data platform, and generative AI initiatives.
Drive account mining, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities across existing and new clients.
Lead strategic pursuits and large transformation deals from opportunity identification through closure.
Develop account growth plans and oversee pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue realization.

AWS Alliance & Ecosystem Management
Serve as the primary leadership interface between Fractal and AWS.
Strengthen relationships with AWS sales, solution architecture, and partner teams.
Drive joint go-to-market initiatives, co-selling opportunities, AWS-funded programs, and marketplace engagements.
Ensure alignment with AWS partner competencies, specializations, and certifications.
Represent Fractal in AWS industry events, leadership forums, and customer engagements.
Practice & Talent Leadership
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of AWS architects, consultants, engineers, and client partners.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Drive capability development across Cloud, Data, AI/ML, Security, Modernization, and GenAI on AWS.
Establish career development frameworks and succession plans within the AWS practice.
Service Delivery Excellence
Oversee successful delivery of AWS transformation programs across clients and industries.
Ensure projects meet quality, timeline, security, compliance, and business outcome expectations.
Collaborate with delivery leaders to improve delivery methodologies, governance, and customer satisfaction.
Act as an executive escalation point for strategic accounts and critical programs.
Innovation & Thought Leadership
Stay current with AWS technologies, industry trends, and emerging cloud capabilities.
Lead development of cloud-native AI and data modernization solutions leveraging AWS services.
Contribute to thought leadership through client workshops, industry forums, conferences, and publications.
Promote innovation through reusable frameworks, automation accelerators, and solution assets.
Financial Leadership
Develop and manage annual business plans and growth targets for the AWS practice.
Drive profitable growth through effective resource planning and portfolio management.
Monitor key business metrics including revenue, margins, utilization, pipeline, and customer satisfaction.
Identify opportunities for operational efficiency and cost optimization.
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. MBA preferred.
18+ years of experience in technology consulting, cloud services, digital transformation, or managed services.
Proven experience leading large AWS practices, cloud consulting organizations, or strategic cloud businesses.
Demonstrated track record of managing multi-million-dollar revenue portfolios and driving profitable growth.
Strong understanding of AWS Cloud services, Data Platforms, AI/ML, GenAI, Security, DevOps, Modernization, and Migration services.
Experience managing executive client relationships across Fortune 500 organizations.
Strong commercial acumen with expertise in deal shaping, negotiations, and contract management.
Proven ability to build and lead geographically distributed teams.

Key Responsibilities
Lead and coordinate Workday Financials delivery across R2R and P2P workstreams, ensuring alignment on scope, priorities, timelines and dependencies.

Approximately 810 years of relevant experience, including strong hands-on experience with Workday Financial Management and experience leading delivery or functional workstreams.
Strong functional knowledge of R2R and/or P2P, with good understanding of end-to-end financial business processes.
Experience across key Workday Financials capabilities such as Accounting, Supplier Accounts, Procurement, Expenses, Banking, Settlement and related business processes.
Experience leading or coordinating multiple functional and technical workstreams within Workday implementations, optimization programs or managed-services engagements.
Strong understanding of the Workday delivery lifecycle, including requirements, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment and production support.
Ability to review functional solutions, identify cross-workstream impacts and guide teams toward scalable solutions.
Experience managing client stakeholders, priorities, escalations and competing delivery demands.
Ability to independently manage delivery planning, risks, dependencies and team execution.

Experience across both R2R and P2P is preferred; deep expertise in one with good working knowledge of the other is acceptable.

Role overview: Strategy Consulting - Corporate Deals Technology
The Corporate Deals Technology (CDT) team partners with global corporate clients to shape technology strategy that enables business value and deal success in complex M&A transactions. Our thought leadership and extensive expertise in various industries allow us to serve corporate clients with consulting services with a focus on technology components of the value chain to create scalable and profitable businesses.
Corporate Deals Technology (CDT), a key practice of the Strategy platform, works with corporate clients across industries supporting engagements:
Developing M&A Technology Strategies for integrations, separations, carve-outs, and divestitures by collaborating with C-suite executives
Conducting Technology Due Diligence to assess IT landscapes, identify risks, and evaluate value creation opportunities
Advising on Integration and Divestiture Planning to align technology strategy with business and operational priorities
Designing Future-State Technology Models and Architectures Core responsibilities as a Manager would entail (but not limited to)
As a Manager, you will work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive consulting and industry experience, helping our clients solve their complex business issues from strategy to execution. Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to
Proactively assist the team across deal spectrum (IT DD, IT integration / separation)
Lead team on project delivery and manage leadership & client conversations
Lead solution design and implementation aspects of the engagement by ensuring high quality within time and budget constraints
Plan and develop integration and separation deliverables, including Day One readiness and execution, business process and systems integration and separation
Develop financial models for IT, including synergy savings, one-time costs, standalone costs and stranded costs
Recommend enterprise architecture, solutions, and systems based on industry leading practices and past experiences
