Description:
About the Role:
Grade Level (for internal use): 11
Role Summary
The Application Cloud Security Lead will serve as a key security leader within the SP Global Energy Division BISO team, responsible for coordinating security initiatives across application, cloud, and AI-enabled environments. This role directly supports the protection of applications, data, systems, and reputation by proactively managing cyber risk, strengthening resilience and embedding security into everything we do.
The successful candidate will partner with technology, product, engineering, cloud, risk, compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure security is integrated into architecture, delivery, operations, and innovation. The role will focus on security architecture reviews, application security governance, cloud security enforcement, AI security oversight, risk remediation, and alignment with enterprise cybersecurity standards.
This position requires a hands-on security leader who can translate cybersecurity requirements into practical controls, influence engineering teams, guide secure design decisions, and drive measurable improvements in cyber resilience across the Energy Division.
Key Responsibilities
Lead and coordinate application, cloud, and AI security initiatives across the SP Global Energy Division in alignment with SP Global's cyber risk management objectives.
Conduct security architecture reviews for applications, APIs, cloud platforms, data flows, integrations, and AI-enabled solutions to identify risks and recommend secure design improvements.
Partner with engineering, product, architecture, cloud, and business teams to embed security requirements into solution design, development, deployment, and operations.
Enforce application security controls, including secure coding practices, vulnerability remediation, authentication, authorization, secrets management, dependency security, and software supply chain risk management.
Oversee cloud security control implementation across public cloud environments, including identity and access management, network security, encryption, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration.
Review and assess AI and machine learning use cases for security risks, including data leakage, prompt injection, model exposure, access control, third-party AI risk, and misuse scenarios.
Track, prioritize, and drive remediation of application, cloud, and AI security findings, exceptions, and risk acceptances in partnership with accountable technology owners.
Support cyber risk assessments, compliance reviews, audit requests, and security reporting related to Energy Division applications, cloud services, and AI-enabled platforms.
Develop and maintain metrics, dashboards, and executive-level reporting to communicate security posture, risk trends, remediation progress, and key security initiatives.
Serve as a trusted security advisor and liaison between the Energy Division and Enterprise cybersecurity teams, promoting secure-by-design practices and consistent adoption of security standards.
Required Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
5-8+ years experience in cybersecurity, with a strong focus on application security, cloud security, security architecture, and/or technology risk management.
Experience conducting security architecture reviews for applications, APIs, cloud platforms, data platforms, and enterprise technology solutions.
Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD security, container security, Kubernetes security, infrastructure-as-code scanning, secrets management, and software supply chain security.
Experience with cloud security tools such as CSPM, CWPP, CNAPP, SIEM, vulnerability management platforms, container scanners, and identity governance tools.
Familiar with AI security concepts such as prompt injection, model access control, sensitive data exposure, model monitoring, adversarial testing, AI red teaming, and third-party AI risk.
Experience working with public cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders including technology, product, risk, compliance, privacy, legal, and business teams.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical security risks to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to prioritise risks, influence remediation, and drive outcomes in a complex enterprise environment.
Relevant certifications such as CISSP, SABSA, CCSK, Cloud Vendor Certifications (e.g. AWS Certified Security Specialty, AWS Certified Solution Architect, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer) or equivalent credentials.

Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Job purpose
The job role is in the Private Markets division at Acuity, one of the fastest growing segments within the firm. This opportunity is ideal for a private equity /investment banking / strategy consulting professional who is interested in working with leading global private equity funds and corporations.
Key responsibilities
Support the preparation of periodic financial statements, including the Balance Sheet, Statement of Operations, Statement of Changes in Equity, Cash Flow Statement, and related disclosures in accordance with applicable accounting standards.
Assist in preparing financial statements supporting schedules, lead schedules, reconciliations, and audit-ready working papers to ensure completeness and accuracy.
Perform General Ledger (GL) reviews, account reconciliations, and variance analysis to identify and resolve accounting exceptions.
Assist in the calculation and review of management fees, incentive/carried interest allocations, and related supporting schedules in accordance with fund governing documents.
Support regulatory and statutory reporting requirements by preparing schedules, data packs, and supporting documentation.
Perform analytical reviews and tie-outs between financial statements, supporting schedules, trial balance, and underlying accounting records.
Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities, including journal preparation, balance sheet reconciliations, and reporting deliverables.
Coordinate with internal stakeholders, auditors, and onshore teams to address queries and provide supporting documentation during financial reporting and audit cycles.
Maintain high standards of accuracy, documentation, and internal controls while supporting process improvement initiatives and undertaking ad-hoc accounting and reporting assignments as required
Key competencies
MBA (Finance), CFA (Level I/II), CA (Inter), or an equivalent qualification with a strong academic background in Accounting and Finance.
Strong conceptual understanding of financial accounting, financial statement preparation, and accounting principles.
Familiarity with Private Equity, Private Credit, or Alternative Investment Fund structures will be an added advantage.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups, and data analysis. Exposure to accounting or ERP systems will be an advantage.

Description:
Experience Management Supervising Associate
About Global Delivery Services:
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
The Opportunity:
As a part of a team, you will act as a Resource Management Hub Deputy Manager who provides consistent, high quality services to key individual stakeholders.
Your Key Responsibilities:
Service Delivery Leadership:
Manage end-to-end resource fulfilment, ensuring alignment with delivery timelines and business priorities.
Oversee billing and finance operations related to resource deployment, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
Own headcount planning to support growth and efficiency.
Champion and lead Strategic Experience Management initiatives, aligning resource strategy with long-term business objectives.
Monitor and improve service levels, turnaround times, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Planning & Optimization:
Forecast demand and plan capacity across skill sets.
Maximize bench utilization and redeployment efficiency.
Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and HR to align hiring plans with pipeline and delivery needs.
Performance Management:
Establish and track KPIs for resource performance, utilization, and productivity.
Conduct regular reviews with delivery leads to assess individual and team performance.
Stakeholder Management:
Act as a strategic partner to delivery, business leaders.
Facilitate governance forums to review resource allocation, pipeline, and performance metrics.
Resolve escalations related to staffing conflicts, skill mismatches, or delivery risks.
Data & Analytics:
Maintain accurate dashboards and reports on resource availability, utilization, and forecasting.
Use data-driven insights to inform decision-making and identify improvement opportunities.
Skills and attributes for success:
Hands on knowledge on End to End Resource management
Be proficient in MS Project/Word/PowerPoint/Excel - working knowledge of MS office
Knowledge in Data Visualisation tools would be an added advantage
Exceptional communication skills - both written and oral
Demonstrate strong organizational skills and structured thinking abilities
Demonstrate strong interpersonal and analytical skills
Demonstrate an eye for detail
Be flexible and willing to adjust responsibilities to align with developing business needs
Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity and rapid change
To qualify for the role, you must have:
Graduate / MBA (HR) with 12-14 years of overall experience with 8+ years of relevant experience in E2E resource management, deployment, forecasting and scheduling concepts.
Exposure of short term and long-term resource planning would be an added advantage.
What we look for:
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we offer you:
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy

Description:
Key responsibilities are assigned based on an evaluation of the candidates professional qualification, relevant SPA and Disputes experience, analytical skills, and a demonstrated working knowledge of transaction value drivers and post-deal issues. As a Senior Associate in the SPA & Disputes team, you will work on EV to Equity bridge analysis, post-deal mechanisms and disputes matters, while collaborating with PwC UK teams on project deliverables. Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Work in a team performing analytical procedures on accounting and financial data to support transaction value assessments, and visualising insights using Excel and AI tools (training will be provided on these tools); Interpret and critically review transaction legal documentation and evaluate completion accounts and locked box mechanisms, identifying areas of value leakage or risk; Identify areas which may warrant further investigation / give rise to potential adjustments to price; Proactively work with team leaders and team members to manage a workload of multiple projects with competing priorities based on relative importance and urgency; Communicating confidently with engagement teams to understand scope and expectations, and present project deliverables once they have been completed; Supporting engagement setup from initiation through to completion, understanding workflow management tools, relevant application of AI tools, and ensuring accurate documentation of work performed; Participate in a wide range of projects and collaborate across multiple workstreams or teams; consistently demonstrating creative thinking, individual initiative and timely completion of assigned work; and Consistently demonstrate teamwork dynamics by working as a team member: understand personal and team roles; contribute to a positive working environment by building solid relationships with team members; and proactively seek guidance, clarification and feedback.
Preferred Qualifications Strong interest in mergers and acquisitions, with the ability to understand key value drivers in transactions; Good knowledge of accounting fundamentals, price adjustment mechanics (e.g. net debt, working capital), and valuation principles; Familiarity with valuation methods and transaction mechanisms such as completion accounts and locked box structures; Demonstrated ability to analyse complex financial data and legal documents with precision; Proven track record of independently managing deliverables and maintaining high quality under tight deadlines; Effective written and verbal communication skills in English; Self-motivated, with a strong commitment to personal growth and continuous learning; and Adaptable and eager to develop new skills in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Basic Qualifications Working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint; Strong written and verbal communication skills; Certifications requirement: CA/MBA; Good accounting and financial concepts; High level of attention to detail; 2-5 years experience in analysing financial accounting information (for example in audit or FDD); and Awareness of business valuations concepts (Enterprise Value vs. Equity Value) and transaction mechanisms (completion accounts vs. locked box).

Description:
Responsibilities
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and translate them into backend functionalities for GenAI and Agentic AI projects.
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend solutions, including event-driven architectures and integration with external systems/APIs.
- Manage data storage solutions using relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB) databases to support AI applications in production.
- Utilize containerization (Kubernetes) and implement DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions), for efficient deployment and scalability.
- Build and integrate APIs using Python frameworks (Flask, FastAPI) and collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and DevOps teams for seamless AI model deployment.
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's & Master's degree
- At least 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Proficient with LLM interaction frameworks like LangChain, Semantic Kernel, and LlamaIndex, and experienced in integrating, scaling, and deploying GenAI and agentic applications in production.
- Skilled in setting up data pipelines for both model training and real-time inference to support AI workloads efficiently.
- Advanced Python expertise including OOP, asynchronous programming (asyncio), concurrency (multithreading, multiprocessing), design patterns, memory management, and performance optimization for scalable GenAI systems.
- Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, software design principles (SOLID, clean architecture), and hands-on experience with cloud-native development on Azure/AWS, including serverless, microservices, and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).
- Experience with additional OOP languages (Java, C++, C#) and familiarity with WebSocket implementations for real-time application functionality.

Description:
Role: Workday Accounting Prism
Experience: 4 to 10 years
Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certification: Workday certification (Mandatory)

Required Skills:
Active Workday Financials certification.
At least 1 year or full implementation of Workday Financials along with end to end support on Accounting Center/Prism.
At least 3 years of relevant Workday experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Subject Matter Expertise on Accounting Center Processes and reports while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Functional experience in several Workday Finance modules like Financial Accounting, Common Financial Management, Customers, Customer Accounts, Banking and Settlement, Business Assets, Projects.
Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various Finance modules and hands on experience configuring FDM structure and business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.
Hands-on experience creating and troubleshooting EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Preferred Skills:
Good to have Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Reporting, FDM and other certifications related to Workday Finance functional areas.
Knowledge on using Customer Central for configuration and migration.
Demonstrates thorough abilities and/or a proven record of success working in a collaborative environment to collect and refine business requirements along with the associated development activities to deliver the appropriate reporting solutions within Workday Accounting Center;
Demonstrates competencies in verbal and written communication skills via experience in leading business requirements gathering and design sessions;
Demonstrates thorough abilities in data profiling and governance principles to ensure data integrity and quality throughout the development life cycle, and utilizes data modeling, design, and visualization tools and principles;
Demonstrates thorough knowledge of SQL, including database queries;
Serves as a subject matter expert regarding Workday Accounting Center; and
Demonstrates critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

Description:
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and translate them into backend functionalities for GenAI and Agentic AI projects.
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend solutions, including event-driven architectures and integration with external systems/APIs.
- Manage data storage solutions using relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB) databases to support AI applications in production.
- Utilize containerization (Kubernetes) and implement DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions), for efficient deployment and scalability.
- Build and integrate APIs using Python frameworks (Flask, FastAPI) and collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and DevOps teams for seamless AI model deployment.
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's & Master's degree
- At least 4+ years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Proficient with LLM interaction frameworks like LangChain, Semantic Kernel, and LlamaIndex, and experienced in integrating, scaling, and deploying GenAI and agentic applications in production.
- Skilled in setting up data pipelines for both model training and real-time inference to support AI workloads efficiently.
- Advanced Python expertise including OOP, asynchronous programming (asyncio), concurrency (multithreading, multiprocessing), design patterns, memory management, and performance optimization for scalable GenAI systems.
- Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, software design principles (SOLID, clean architecture), and hands-on experience with cloud-native development on Azure/AWS, including serverless, microservices, and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).
- Experience with additional OOP languages (Java, C++, C#) and familiarity with WebSocket implementations for real-time application functionality.

Description:
Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

The opportunity: Analyst-National-Forensics-ASU - Forensics - Investigations & Compliance - Gurgaon
National :
National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience.
ASU - Forensics - Investigations & Compliance :
Successful organizations depend on their reputation for keeping promises, respecting laws and behaving ethically to maintain stakeholder trust. EY Forensic & Integrity Services professionals help organizations protect and restore enterprise and financial reputation. We assist companies and their legal counsel to investigate facts, resolve disputes and manage regulatory challenges. We put integrity at the heart of compliance programs to help better manage ethical and reputational risks.
Our integrated approach ranges from enhancements in areas of perceived weakness or issues - including governance, controls, culture and data insights - to full organizational design and structural implementation. We want to help companies safeguard and restore financial and brand reputations. The insights and quality services we deliver help build trust and confidence in the capital markets and in economies the world over.

Your key responsibilities

Technical Excellence
Examine financial documents to identify fraudulent activities
Investigate complex financial transactions and create reports of findings
Perform audits of financial transactions and account details to ensure compliance with laws and regulations
Prepare detailed reports on audit findings and propose solutions to management or relevant authorities
Interview individuals to gather information and understand the context of specific transactions
Collaborate with legal teams to prepare for court proceedings and provide expert testimony
Develop and implement forensic audit programs and control systems
Stay updated with the latest auditing techniques and methods, and relevant legal changes
Ensure ethical conduct and protect sensitive and confidential information
Maintaining all the records in system & excel depending upon the task
Validation of information & documents
Ascertain verification from sources as per client guidelines
Good written and verbal communication skills (English Language)
Analytical bent of mind
Focused Target Oriented

Skills and attributes


To qualify for the role you must have
Graduate / Post Graduate
Experience
0-1 Years

What we look for

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

The practice is aligned to the Global Network Song Practice of Accenture and works with clients across their marketing, sales and services functions. As part of the team, you will provide transformation services driven by key offerings like Marketing, Sales and Service, Commerce. These services help our clients become living businesses by optimizing their marketing, sales and customer service strategy, thereby driving cost reduction, revenue enhancement, customer satisfaction and impacting business metrics in a positive manner.
The Customer Data Platform Manager is a mid-level position within the Marketing transformation vertical of Accenture GN Song.

The key responsibilities as Customer Data Platform Manager will include
the following:
Conduct assessment of clients current data management and Customer Data Platform (CDP) capabilities. Provide recommendations on optimizing the current stack and develop use cases to improve utilization.
Gather business requirement and strategize and build clients digital marketing data management program that delivers high performance profiles for segmentation, personalization & activation across Digital channels.
Identify different data sources, approaches to enrich customer profiles/segments in CDP (customer data platforms) and define use cases across multiple channels/destinations. Design Data cleaning, transformation, and integration approach from various data sources into CDP.
Evaluate and recommend new ways of data management through CDP and how it connects into the broader marketing technology landscape (campaign management and insight generation).
Identify, scope and partner with technology solution providers, clients IT, BU teams, compliance, and marketing agencies to deliver the best solution meeting the needs of our clients.
Plan, design, implement & integrate CDP solutions such as Adobe Experience Platform RT CDP and work with partners to leverage various data management capabilities offered these solutions.
Understand and convey the impact of regulations like CCPA, GDPR and clients own internal or industry regulation on data gathering and management. Should be able to guide towards privacy by design, consent management for customer profile activation across digital marketing channels.
Understand and design integrations (including API based/ file-based integrations) b/w tools/platforms of different vendors/ MarTech/AdTech components/ data sources.
Stay abreast of MarTech landscape & engage ecosystem players/vendors to ensure best in class digital audience management capabilities for clients. Propose and conduct pilots as needed.
Develop and manage a team of CDP specialists by managing key tasks such as work allocation, time management, project SME support, hiring, training etc.
Aside from client delivery, the selected candidate will also drive business development efforts and thought leadership in the Martech, CDP and other digital marketing platform space.

Excellent oral and written communication skills
Creating and maintaining client relationships
Strong understanding of Marketing processes, data management, data strategy, data integration, marketing & Advertising technologies and their integrations with other technologies
Partner with technology solution providers and marketing agencies to deliver the best solution meeting the needs of our clients.
Strong project management skills: ability to mobilize and organize across multiple stakeholders (client and internal) and projects.

In addition , to excel at the role , you will also need to have :
An ability to work with the leadership to support business development and thought leadership.
Data-driven mindset within proven utilization of information to drive decisions, calibrate and results.
Strong communication and presentation skills to share the perfect pitch with key stakeholders.
Strong client handling skills to develop, manage and deepen relationships with key stakeholders.
Team building skills to collaborate, work and motivate teams with diverse skills and experience to achieve goals.
Ability to work effectively in a remote, virtual, global environment.
Ability to work in a fast paced and unstructured environment.
Ability to learn new and understand new tools/solutions.
Identify new opportunities, develop solutions and own proposals end to end.
Contribute to offering development skills to identify areas of growth related to specific skills, platforms, assets etc. that contribute to enhancing the offering.

#ACN Song GN Reinvention Services Customer Service Retail Service Reinvention Manager
Job Title Retail Service Reinvention Manager
Management Level: L07 Manager
Location: Bangalore, Gurgaon, Mumbai (India; global remit)
Experience: 10+ Years (L07)
Must have skills: Retail Service Reinvention / Customer Service Strategy Transformation; a blend of industry and consulting experience with deep understanding of the end-to-end retail value chain and how it drives service demand, volume and exceptions; experience shaping AI-native / agentic service operating models.
The Practice A Brief Sketch
The practice works with clients across their marketing, commerce, sales and service functions to reinvent how they engage customers. As part of the Reinvention Services Customer Service team, you will help the worlds leading retailers transform service from a reactive, cost-driven function into an intelligence-led, AI-native capability that senses signals in real time, resolves issues before they escalate, and continuously improves from every interaction across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystem driving customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience.
Job summary
As a Retail Service Reinvention Senior Manager / Associate Director, you will advise C-suite executives, shape AI-native service operating models, and lead end-to-end transformation for the worlds leading retailers. Reporting to the Customer Service Managing Director, you will build and lead a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts and carry accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M. The role requires a strong blend of retail domain expertise, consulting leadership, end-to-end value chain understanding, executive stakeholder management, and business development capability to shape and deliver scalable, future-ready retail service solutions.
Roles and responsibilities
Service Strategy Advisory
Define enterprise and omnichannel service strategy across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystems.
Shape AI-native service vision, target operating models and multi-year transformation roadmaps.
Develop business cases, prioritize investment and establish value-realization frameworks.
Advise boards and C-suite on where to sequence quick wins against enterprise-scale change.
Experience Design
Map end-to-end journeys for shoppers (order, delivery, returns, loyalty, complaints), associates (store, picker, contact centre) and suppliers (onboarding, purchase orders, invoicing, disputes).
Blueprint services across people, process, data and technology layers.
Identify moments of truth and design service recovery for stock-outs, failed deliveries, substitutions and disputed refunds.
Define channel strategy spanning mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social, store desk and associate/picker devices.
Operating Model Process Transformation
Design target operating models spanning shopper services, supplier services, store workforce services, and fulfilment/ecosystem services.
Design the workforce across shoppers, store associates, pickers and inventory teams, contact-centre specialists and leads, supplier account teams, and delivery partners/dispatchers.
Establish governance frameworks policy and business rules, approval/escalation thresholds, SLAs and entitlements, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
Build KPI and performance frameworks tied to customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience outcomes.
Technology AI Transformation
Set CRM and CCaaS platform strategy (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect).
Shape knowledge and case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk).
Design conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow) intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs and decisioning/policy engines.
Integrate across order, store and supply-chain systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, supplier/EDI portals) and IoT/GPS-enabled field and delivery tracking.
Build service analytics, predictive/prescriptive models and root-cause analysis capability.
Human + Agentic Operations
Design hybrid workforce models blending advisors, associates, AI copilots and autonomous agents across the shopper, supplier, store and fulfilment domains.
Design agents for high-volume service capabilities order status, substitutions, returns, refunds, delivery orchestration, supplier collaboration and dispute resolution.
Lead change management, upskilling and adoption programmes for frontline and support teams.
Establish AI governance, ethics and bias controls, and ongoing model/agent performance oversight.
Enterprise Transformation Delivery
Lead end-to-end programmes from strategy through implementation, adoption and value realisation.
Orchestrate multi-workstream delivery across business, experience, operations, technology and data/AI teams.
Manage executive steering committees and track value against committed business cases.
Practice Building
Develop market-leading thought leadership and intellectual property.
Build reusable methods, accelerators, assets and AI workflows for retail reinvention services.
Coach and mentor consulting teams.
Support business development and strategic pursuits collaborating with Song leadership to identify new opportunities and with Songs Consulting, Technology and Data AI teams for delivery.
Professional Technical Skills
Deep expertise in grocery, apparel or large omnichannel retail, with working knowledge of the end-to-end value chain merchandising and assortment planning, inventory and price management, promotions execution, digital commerce, in-store operations, supplier and partner operations, and last-mile fulfilment and how each stage drives customer demand, service volume and service exceptions.
First-hand practitioner experience inside leading grocery, apparel or omnichannel retailers (not advisory-only) having lived these operations, partnered with frontline teams, and redesigned them at enterprise scale.
Proven track record across service strategy advisory, experience design, operating model transformation, technology AI transformation, and enterprise delivery; consulting background is valuable but strong industry leadership experience counts equally.
Hands-on shopper/customer service experience across the lifecycle: order status and delivery-exception handling; substitutions, out-of-stock and refund/credit resolution; returns and reverse-logistics servicing; loyalty, rewards and membership servicing; complaint, feedback and social/review response; and multi-channel delivery (mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social) with consistent resolution regardless of entry channel.
Supplier and partner service experience: onboarding, compliance and account management; forecast, purchase-order and inventory collaboration; quality issues, disputes and score-carding; invoice, payment and reconciliation servicing; and supplier/partner portals, EDI exchanges and account-management workflows.
Store and workforce service experience: inventory accuracy, price integrity and promotion execution at store level; pick, pack and in-store fulfilment; store-to-contact-centre escalation and case hand-off; associate empowerment tools (store apps, picker/associate devices, knowledge assistants); and workforce scheduling, service standards and frontline performance management.
Fulfilment and ecosystem service experience: delivery orchestration, routing and ETA/live tracking; failed-delivery, missed-slot and delivery-recovery workflows; reverse logistics and returns-to-warehouse operations; driver, dispatcher and 3PL partner management; and last-mile SLAs, on-time performance and partner score-carding.
Working knowledge of core retail service processes order-to-delivery, returns refunds, complaint case management, store-to-contact-centre escalation, substitution/refund workflows and supplier dispute resolution with the SLAs and benchmarks that define operational excellence, and fluency in how cases move end-to-end (detect, triage/categorise, route/assign, investigate/enrich, decide/approve, orchestrate, execute/communicate, confirm/close).
Exposure to the retail service technology and AI stack: CRM CCaaS (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect); knowledge case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk); conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow); systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, PIM/MDM, pricing and promotions engines); supplier/EDI portals and IoT/GPS-enabled tracking; and the underlying AI/ML stack (intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs, policy/rules engines, predictive/prescriptive models, decisioning/optimisation and root-cause analytics).
Experience designing target operating models that combine human and AI/agentic capacity reusable service capability design, hybrid workforce design, and governance/guardrail frameworks (policy business rules, approvals escalation, human-in-the-loop controls, SLAs entitlements, privacy consent, security access, compliance audit, model/agent performance governance, ethics bias controls, and data quality traceability).
Demonstrated track record of driving measurable outcomes customer value (NPS/CSAT, trust, advocacy); growth (repeat purchase rate, average order value, attach rate, customer lifetime value); service quality productivity (first-contact and overall resolution, reduced cost-to-serve and contact volume, higher associate productivity); and availability resilience (in-stock rate, on-time delivery/payment, margin protection, and supply/compliance resilience).
Executive stakeholder management, communication and storytelling; ability to build and defend a business case at board level; fluency across business, experience, operations, technology and AI/data teams; and comfort translating complex operating models into a clear enterprise narrative.
Additional information
Experience in retail, customer service or enterprise service transformation, including large-scale programmes delivered end-to-end from strategy through implementation; the ideal candidate blends industry and consulting experience.
Reports to the Customer Service Managing Director; builds and leads a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts, with accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M.
Employment type: Permanent. Work arrangement: remote / hybrid / onsite, flexed to client and project needs; travel expectation varies by client engagement.
MBA or postgraduate qualification in retail preferred. Relevant certifications a plus CCXP, Six Sigma/Lean, ITIL, PMP, CSCP/APICS, Agile or Design Thinking, or platform certifications (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce).



Qualification
Experience in Retail industry (physical + digital) - Grocery, Apparel or large omnichannel retail sector experience
Good to have skills: relevant certifications (CCXP, Six Sigma/Lean, ITIL, PMP, CSCP/APICS, Agile or Design Thinking) and platform certifications (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce).
Educational Qualification: MBA or postgraduate qualification in retail preferred; MBA or equivalent degree in Business, Strategy, Sales Marketing.

About Practice
Accenture's Transaction Advisory team sits at the heart of strategic value creation across the deal lifecycle. We support both Private Equity (PE) and Corporate clients, partnering on initiatives from target screening and due diligence to integration, separation, and portfolio value enhancement.
This team works in close collaboration with Capability Network Industry/Functional teams, Client Account Teams, and Global M&A/PE Leadership across geographies - offering unmatched opportunities to lead and shape high-impact consulting engagements.
What You'll Do -
Key Responsibilities
Deliver strategic engagements across the full M&A lifecycle:
Pre-Deal:Target screening, sector/company research, commercial/operational/technology due diligence, synergy assessment

Functional M&A:Must have hands-on experience in post-deal execution, including integration/separation of functions
Engagement Support:Prepare client decks, support RFPs and thought capital development
Industry Focus (Preferred)
Experience working with clients in one or more of the following sectors is preferred:
CMT, Financial Services, Resources, Healthcare/Life Sciences, Consumer Goods & Services, Retail
Must-Have Skills
Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities with issue-based thinking
Experience in direct client interactions, including presenting findings and driving stakeholder discussions.
Experience with value creation strategies, growth and cost levers, and digital or tech transformation in deals
Business acumen and knowledge of M&A trends, investment models, and PE-backed transformation mandates

Functional M&A
Tech M&A

Tech DD, Cyber DD, Digital DD (for digital product-based companies)

Day 1 Planning, IMO

Functional Integration & Separation - Planning & Execution (Finance, HR, Supply Chain/Procurement functional exposure as good to have)
IT Integration & Separation - Planning & Execution
Why Join Us?
Work on some of the most strategic deals in the market with global clients and PE firms
Develop deep expertise across industries, technologies, and the full M&A lifecycle
Be part of a rapidly growing and entrepreneurial practice, with leadership exposure and growth opportunities
Access world-class learning and global collaboration in a high-performing, supportive culture

Job

Summary:

This role involves driving strategic initiatives, managing business transformations, and leveraging industry expertise to create value-driven solutions.





Roles & Responsibilities:
Deliver strategic advice to clients by providing data-driven recommendations that enhance business outcomes.
Independently manage communications with clients, ensuring clear understanding of project objectives and progress updates.
Design and implement GenAI, RAG, Agentic AI, or traditional AI/ML algorithms tailored to address specific business challenges within the healthcare and life sciences sector.
Demonstrate knowledge of life sciences datasets and maintain strong domain expertise to drive the development of robust analytics solutions.
Support the delivery of consulting projects for global clients, working as part of a small to medium-sized team or as an individual contributor as required.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, leveraging skills in data engineering, data science, and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Apply design thinking principles and business process optimization to recommend and implement innovative, value-driven solutions.
Engage in ongoing learning to develop consulting acumen, industry knowledge, and technical capabilities.





WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?
An opportunity to work on high-visibility projects with top Pharma clients around the globe.
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners, and business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge, and capabilities.
Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.





What you would do in this role
Support delivery of small to medium-sized teams to deliver consulting projects for global clients.
Responsibilities may include strategy, implementation, process design, and change management for specific modules.
Work with the team or as an Individual contributor on the project assigned which includes a variety of skills to be utilized from Data Engineering to Data Science
Provide Subject matter expertise in various sub-segments of the LS industry.
Develop assets and methodologies, point-of-view, research, or white papers for use by the team and the larger community.
Acquire new skills that have utility across industry groups.
Support strategies and operating models focused on some business units and assess likely competitive responses. Also, assess implementation readiness and points of greatest impact.
Co-lead proposals, and business development efforts and coordinate with other colleagues to create consensus-driven deliverables.
Execute a transformational change plan aligned with the client’s business strategy and context for change. Engage stakeholders in the change journey and build commitment to change.
Make presentations wherever required to a known audience or client on functional aspects of his or her domain.



Who are we looking for?
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or other Quantitative field.
Extensive GenAI expertise with a track record of creating and deploying GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.
Proven experience (4+ years) in working on Life Sciences/Pharma/Healthcare projects and delivering successful outcomes.
Excellent understanding of Pharma data sets – commercial, clinical, RWE (Real World Evidence) & EMR (Electronic medical records)

Hands-on experience with handling Datasets like Komodo, RAVE, IQVIA, Truven, Optum etc.
Hands-on experience in building and deployment of Statistical Models/Machine Learning including Segmentation & predictive modeling, hypothesis testing, multivariate statistical analysis, time series techniques, and optimization.

Experience with any of the cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for deploying and scaling language models.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset.
Proficient in Excel, MS Word, PowerPoint, etc.
Ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.
Strong writing skills to build points of view on current industry trends.
Good communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills

Tech Transformation delivery leader- Associate Director
Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to drive large-scale complex AI led Technology Transformation programmes for our most strategic clients across the globe. You will lead the execution of enterprise-wide transformation initiatives that drive strategic business outcomes, operational excellence, and sustainable value creation across Technology Modernization, AI Enterprise Transformation, M&A and Enterprise Agility pillars.
Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Tech Transformation delivery leader
Level: Associate Director
Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad
Years of Exp: 17+ years
Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you thrive on leading complex transformations, improving SDLC using AI, Mainframe Modernisation, Data & AI, building domain driven Architecture and high-stakes transformation programmes? Are you a delivery leader who is passionate about complex Technology Delivery and helping CIOs, CTOs and business executives drive technology change that delivers real commercial outcomes? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and lead and deliver complex, high-value transformation portfolios for global clients. Working at C-suite level, you will take Revenue (P&L) accountability for accounts and portfolios, managing budgets from $5M to $30M, scaling delivery organisations, and ensuring transformation investments generate lasting revenue and business value. You will govern multi-programme portfolios, drive commercial growth, and serve as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation at the highest levels of client organisations.
The Practice - A Brief Sketch
Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Digital Core Reinvention Partner and focuses on our clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through technology transformation initiatives, aimed at modernising delivery, improving operational performance and generating measurable enterprise value.
We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, large-scale programme delivery and business transformation, where you will work with key global clients to drive the next evolution of enterprise technology change. As part of this high-performing team, you will lead organisations through complex transformation journeys - from translating transformation vision into measurable business outcomes through disciplined execution across global teams, functions, and delivery partners. This is a delivery leadership role with direct accountability for transformation outcomes These are some of the initiatives you will support:
Enterprise Transformation Portfolio Leadership:Own and lead a portfolio of strategic transformation initiatives aligned to enterprise priorities and growth objectives, ensure transformation programs deliver measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, customer impact, and financial value. End-to-End Delivery Accountability:Assume full accountability for transformation execution from mobilization through implementation, stabilization, and value realization - including complex systems implementation, Mainframe Modernisation, and cloud-native migration programmes, lead multiple concurrent, large-scale transformation programs with significant organizational, operational, and technology complexity.Revenue Management and Financial Governance:Carry P&L accountability for accounts and portfolios with budgets of $5M-$30M; manage actuals, forecasts, margin protection, revenue recognition and commercial change control; identify and drive revenue growth opportunities and account expansions AI & Intelligent Transformation Leadership:Lead and manage scaled deployment of Agentic AI, Generative AI, automation, and digital workforce solutions as part of enterprise transformation programs, establish governance, risk management, and adoption frameworks for responsible deployment of AI-enabled transformation initiatives. Integration and Dependency Management:Govern complex multi-programme integration across internal teams, client stakeholders and third-party vendors; manage interdependencies, interface points, data migration streams and system integration programmes to ensure coherent, risk-managed portfolio delivery; lead cloud-native and API-led architecture transitions within delivery programmes Value Realisation and Benefits Framework:Track measurable transformation outcomes across the portfolio - cost reduction, revenue growth, operational efficiency, risk reduction and speed-to-market; report on value delivered at board level Global Delivery Leadership:Act as a trusted partner to C-suite executives and senior business leaders, lead executive governance forums and transformation steering committees, communicate complex delivery and business challenges clearly, providing actionable recommendations and mitigation strategies. Executive Stakeholder Leadership:Shape CxO narratives, transformation roadmaps and investment choices at portfolio level; advise on vendor strategy and scale-up plans; lead deal-shaping and account growth, representing Accenture externally and contributing to practice development and market offerings


Role Summary
As Delivery Lead Associate Director, you are accountable for the overall delivery performance of an account or portfolio of transformation programmes with budgets of $5M-$30M. You will lead high-impact delivery for programs on a scale, carry P&L accountability, and align outcomes to strategic client objectives. You will engage at C-suite level, govern Senior Manager delivery leads, drive revenue management and commercial growth, embed continuous improvement, and make decisions that carry major, lasting impact across the organisation.



Key Responsibilities

Own delivery accountability across an account or portfolio of programmes;


Define and enforce portfolio-level delivery standards, governance frameworks, and quality controls; lead the introduction and embedment of Agile delivery models, CICD practices and modern ways of working within client organisations.


Lead executive-level governance forums and Steering Committees; act as executive delivery sponsor with the client.


Manage relationships at C-suite and board level; act as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation.


Drive Agentic AI-powered transformation; articulate and demonstrate prior experience using Agentic AI in transformation contexts to clients and internal stakeholders, building confidence and adoption.


Accountability for the account P&L manage budgets of $5M-$30M, protect margin, drive revenue recognition and pursue revenue growth opportunities.


Shape and negotiate commercial terms; manage material changes to contract scope and commercial structure.


Manage and facilitate the governance of large programs comprising 50-150+ FTEs including mentoring and coaching people in the programs.


Manage risk, escalation decisions, and demand/supply balance across the portfolio.


Lead identification and scaling of continuous improvement and delivery innovation initiatives across the portfolio.


Lead deal-shaping and proposal strategy for significant account expansions and new pursuits.


Represent Accenture externally; contribute to practice development, capability strategy, and market offerings.


Qualification

What We're Looking For

17-20 years' total experience; 3-5 years proven experience managing and delivering complex portfolio of transformation programmes with budgets of $5M-$30M.


Proven ability to govern complex, multi-programme transformation portfolios in a large global services environment, with direct accountability for delivery, revenue and commercial outcomes.


Demonstrated track record of C-suite stakeholder engagement, influence, and relationship management.


Experience leading organisational change and embedding operational performance improvements at scale.


Track record of account growth, deal-shaping, and business development alongside delivery execution.


Strong executive presence:communicates with clarity and gravitas; builds trust with senior audiences rapidly.


Must have experience of working across at least one of the following areas; Technology Modernization, Mainframe Modernisation, AI Enterprise Transformation, Complex Delivery, Enterprise Agility

Set yourself apart:
Mastery of managing complex deliveries coordinating with more than one supplier with multiple dependencies and work plans
Experience delivering cloud-native transformation programmes leveraging Cloud Technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), microservices architectures, API-led integration, or SaaS platforms
Experience of delivering transformation at scale within a highly regulated or complex industry sector
Cloud/Industry and Programme Management certifications and credentials
Demonstrate a strong Technical and Emotional Quotient





Qualifications & Certifications

Bachelor's degree (relevant discipline); Master's / MBA strongly preferred.


PMP, MSP, or equivalent programme management certification.


SAFe, or equivalent Agile certification.


Cloud/enterprise platform certifications (AWS, Azure, Guidewire, SAP, ServiceNow etc.) - advantageous.

What's in it for you?
An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Job Title: Python Developer _Data Test Engineer/Backoffice (Associate/Sr Associate/ Delivery Lead/ Manager)
Location: Gurgaon/Bangalore/Pune
Work hours: 10am to 7pm IST
Department: Data Technology Services
Experience Level : 4-10 years
Job Purpose
Were hiring a hands-on engineer to design and build a reusable Pythonframeworks that spans front-end integrations, backend/middle-tier services, andcloud execution. Youll translate complex, post-trade data flows into robustdata models, stored procedures, and regression automation, and ownCI/CDincluding scripts to run AutoSys/batch jobs and stored procs acrossenvironments. The ideal candidate brings pragmatic engineering discipline,capital-markets data intuition, and a builders mindset.
Key Responsibilities
Collaborate with BAs, QEs, and traders/ops to clarify requirements and codesign testable acceptance criteria; maintain living technicaldocumentation and run-books.
Champion reusability: templates, golden pipelines, sample datasets, and coding standards that scale across engagements
Key Competencies
410 years of hands-on softwareengineering with Python (incl. packaging, virtual envs, unit/integrationtesting); strong use of libraries such as pandas, SQL Alchemy/ pyodbc, andasyncio /celery for pipelines and services
Expert SQL skills and stored-proc development (SQL Server/Oracle/Postgres), query tuning, and execution-plan analysis for largedatasets.
Proven experience designing CI/CD pipelines and automating promotion (code + data + DB objects) with Azure DevOps/Jenkins/GitLab; strongGit practices and code-review hygiene.
Comfort with schedulers (AutoSys/Control-M/Airflow) and shell/Python scripting for batch or chestration; familiarity with secretsmanagement and environment configuration.
Domain understanding of post-trade data flows and how to encode the m into repeatable regression checks.

Description:
Role Summary
Support fund accounting, financial reporting, investor reporting, and operational activities across private equity funds, co-investment vehicles, SPVs, GP entities, and management companies.
Perform accounting, reconciliations, capital activity processing, and quarter-end close within a complex alternative investment environment.
Partner with finance, fund administration, audit, tax, compliance, and investor relations teams to ensure accurate reporting and operational excellence.
Key Responsibilities
Prepare and post journal entries independently using supporting schedules, transaction documentation, and bank statements.
Perform bank reconciliations and investigate outstanding reconciling items.
Review and process fund and management company invoices and validate expense allocations.
Record accruals, prepaid amortization, management fees, and other period-end accounting adjustments.
Track and record capital calls, distributions, commitments, and investor transactions.
Support Investran reconciliations and maintain integrity between accounting and reporting systems.
Perform end-to-end quarter-end and year-end close activities.
Prepare financial statements and supporting schedules in accordance with reporting requirements.
Review financial statements for accuracy, tie-outs, cross-references, and presentation consistency.
Support preparation of investor reporting packages, capital account statements, and quarterly reporting deliverables.
Assist with regulatory, compliance, tax, and audit reporting requirements including standard reporting packages.
Manage investor queries, maintain reporting trackers, and support ad hoc accounting and operational projects.
Required Experience
5+ years of experience in Private Equity Fund Accounting, Fund Administration, Fund Operations, or Alternative Investments.
Strong understanding of private equity fund structures, partnership accounting, capital activity, and investor allocations.
Proven experience preparing journal entries independently using supporting documentation and bank statements.
Strong understanding of end-to-end quarter-end close and financial statement preparation.
Experience with reconciliations, expense allocations, accruals, and general ledger accounting.
Exposure to investor reporting, fund reporting, and audit support activities.
Advanced Excel and strong analytical skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
Preferred Experience
Experience with Investran.
Exposure to flagship buyout funds, co-investment structures, SPVs, and management company accounting.
Experience supporting investor reporting and regulatory reporting requirements.
Experience working with fund administrators, auditors, tax advisors, and investor relations teams.
Exposure to process improvement and automation initiatives.
Basic Information
Position Title - Senior Associate
Experience Level - 5+
Department - Private Markets
Location - Gurgaon/Bangalore
Position reports to - Delivery Manager

Description:
Position Title-Delivery Lead- Salesforce Business Partner
Department-Sales operations
Location-Gurgaon/ Bangalore/ Colombo
Position reports to-Associate Director - Sales Operations / Global Sales Operations
Job Summary
To provide hands-on ownership of Acuity's enterprise Salesforce ecosystem across user support, platform administration, data management, integration, enhancements and user enablement. The role will translate business needs into secure, scalable CRM solutions; strengthen data quality; support responsible AI adoption; and turn Salesforce data into actionable commercial insight.
Another important angle will be to improve forecasting accuracy by developing repeatable, data-led approaches that use opening pipeline position, conversion, win rates, sales cycle dynamics and deal level signals to better anticipate quarterly and year-end sales outcomes.
Responsibilities
Business-facing support and ownership: Act as the primary contact for Salesforce incidents, service requests, enhancements and user queries; manage intake, prioritization, communication, resolution and escalation; provide training, release updates and clear documentation.
Salesforce administration: Manage users, licenses, profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing settings and access reviews; configure Flows, approvals, validation and assignment rules, record types, page layouts, Dynamic Forms and Lightning pages; maintain reports, dashboards, queues and notifications.
Platform development and continuous improvement: Apply configuration-first thinking while using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL and APIs where appropriate; troubleshoot defects, address root causes, reduce technical debt and coordinate environments, deployments and post-release validation.
Integrations and data management: Support Salesforce integrations with ERP, billing, CPQ, e-signature, marketing and other enterprise platforms; oversee APIs, authentication, middleware, monitoring and error handling; lead migration, cleansing, deduplication, reconciliation, backup and validation activities.
AI, analytics and forecasting: Build operational and executive dashboards covering pipeline, conversion, sales, forecasting, revenue, customers, adoption and service performance; establish repeatable predictive methods to forecast quarterly and year-end landing positions using opening pipeline, stage conversion, win rates, sales-cycle velocity, slippage and deal-level risk; identify and deliver high-value use cases using Agent force, Einstein and related capabilities.
Governance, risk and documentation: Maintain effective release, change, backup, testing and deployment controls; support audits and ITGC requirements; maintain solution designs, SOPs, configuration inventories, deployment records and user guidance; coordinate vendors while retaining clear internal accountability.
Stakeholder partnership: Work closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Billing, Delivery, IT and external partners to support connected Lead-to-Order and Order-to-Cash processes, including merger and acquisition initiatives.
Key Competencies
Customer and support orientation: Approachable and accountable front line for Salesforce users.
Technical depth: Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, APIs, testing and deployment, balancing configuration-first thinking with development and integration capability.
Commercial forecasting and analytical judgement: Converts CRM data into reliable forecasts, early-warning indicators and practical actions for Sales Leadership; challenges assumptions and explains variance clearly.
AI and automation mindset: Identifies AI and automation opportunities that simplify day to day business processes
Ownership and delivery: Takes responsibility from problem definition through design, delivery, validation, adoption and support.
Communication and stakeholder management: Make complex principles easy to understand and explain technical and analytical topics clearly to users, technical teams and senior leadership.
Continuous improvement: Identifies opportunities for automation, simplification, innovation and improved user experience.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in computer science preferred but Information Systems, Engineering, Analytics or a related discipline considered too, Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification required, with Sales Cloud Consultant, Platform Developer, Omni studio, CPQ, platform data architect or Agent force certification advantageous.
