With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.

About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.

Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store.

Description:
Shyam Sundar Co Jewellers is looking for a Social Media Live Anchor to host engaging Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube Live sessions. The role involves wearing and showcasing jewellery collections, demonstrating their features, and interacting with online audiences in real-time. The ideal candidate should be confident, well-spoken, and have a passion for fashion, jewellery, and customer engagement.
  Primary Responsibilities
  Live Anchoring & Jewellery Demonstration:
Host Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube Live sessions, presenting and explaining jewellery collections.
Wear and model various jewellery pieces to enhance their appeal.
Provide detailed descriptions of gold, diamond, and silver jewellery, including design, craftsmanship, weight, pricing, and customization options.
Answer real-time customer queries related to jewellery products and offers.
Engage with viewers, encouraging them to interact, comment, and share.
Maintain high energy levels and professional on-screen presence.
Customer Engagement & Query Handling:
Respond to customer queries, comments, and messages during and after live sessions.
Share updates on ongoing offers, collections, and new arrivals.
Maintain a friendly and persuasive tone to encourage sales and brand loyalty.
Content Creation & Social Media Growth:
Plan and coordinate live session schedules to maximize reach and engagement.
Collaborate with the social media team to strategize content and themes for Live sessions.
Assist in short video content creation (Reels & YouTube Shorts) for additional promotions.
Ensure content aligns with brand tone, aesthetics, and audience expectations.
Event Coverage & Brand Representation:
Host store events, jewellery exhibitions, and festive launches through live sessions.
Be the digital face of Shyam Sundar Co Jewellers, building brand recognition and trust.
Key Skills & Requirements: Educational Qualification Graduation in Mass Communication, Marketing, Fashion, or any relevant field. Experience 1-3 years in anchoring, live streaming, or social media hosting (jewellery or fashion industry preferred). Skills Required
Strong communication & presentation skills in Bengali, Kokborok and Hindi.
Confident and charismatic on-camera presence.
Ability to engage with online audiences and answer queries professionally.
Basic knowledge of social media trends, audience interaction, and marketing strategies.
Familiarity with Meta Business Suite and YouTube Live management.
Location Agartala, Tripura
Join Us & Be the Digital Face of Shyam Sundar Co Jewellers!

Description:
Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores

Required Personality Traits
a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves
b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior
c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings
d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.
e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern
f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Key Responsibilities

Plan, execute, and monitor solar EPC projects, including rooftop and ground-mounted solar installations, from project initiation to commissioning and handover.
Prepare project schedules, execution plans, resource allocation plans, and deployment strategies to ensure timely project completion.
Supervise site execution activities, including civil, structural, electrical, module mounting, inverter installation, cabling, and earthing works.
Coordinate with engineering, procurement, vendors, contractors, and site teams to ensure the timely availability of materials and resources.
Monitor project progress against approved timelines, budgets, technical specifications, and quality standards.
Manage project costs, control expenses, and ensure optimum utilization of manpower, materials, machinery, and other resources.
Ensure compliance with applicable electrical safety standards, statutory requirements, quality procedures, and project specifications.
Coordinate with clients, consultants, government authorities, DISCOMs, and other stakeholders for approvals, inspections, grid connectivity, and project-related clearances.
Monitor installation, testing, commissioning, and performance verification of solar PV systems.
Identify project risks, resolve site-level technical and operational issues, and implement corrective actions to avoid delays and cost overruns.
Conduct regular site visits and review contractor performance, work progress, safety practices, and quality of execution.
Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly project progress reports, MIS, budget updates, and management review reports.
Ensure proper documentation of drawings, material records, inspection reports, commissioning certificates, and project handover documents.
Coordinate with the operations and maintenance team for smooth project handover and resolution of pending issues.
Lead and manage project engineers, supervisors, technicians, and subcontractors to achieve project delivery targets.

Required Skills

Strong knowledge of solar PV systems, solar EPC execution, and project management.
Experience in project planning, site execution, commissioning, and contractor management.
Knowledge of electrical systems, solar modules, inverters, mounting structures, DC/AC cabling, and grid connectivity.
Proficiency in MS Excel, project scheduling, cost estimation, and project reporting.
Strong leadership, client coordination, problem-solving, and team management skills.
AboutCompany:
Company Profile:
Surya International Enterprise Pvt Ltd, the CRISIL BBB rated flagship company of Surya Group, is a multifaceted conglomerate operating in diverse fields such as Solar Energy, Manufacturing, Water Industry, Plastic Recycling, and Fintech. Our core mission is to provide sustainable and affordable green energy and water solutions through cutting-edge technology.
Surya Group has been on an exceptional growth trajectory for over a decade, achieving remarkable operational and financial milestones. With a net worth exceeding 125 Crores and an annual turnover of 325 Crores in the last financial year, our growth story is a testament to our unwavering commitment to excellence.
Over the past 10 years, we have successfully installed more than 100MW of on-grid, off-grid, and hybrid solar power plants, solidifying our position as a leader in the renewable energy sector. Furthermore, we have established a Mega Factory in the heart of Infovalley-2 EMC Park in Bhubaneswar, dedicated to the production of high-quality solar modules. Additionally, we have another mega factory in the Ghiloth Industrial Area, Rajasthan, further expanding our manufacturing capabilities.
At Surya Group, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment that encourages innovation and growth. As an equal opportunity employer, we value the diverse perspectives and experiences of our skilled workforce, which spans around 500 employees across India, with 170 employees based at our Head Office in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. Our geographical presence extends to various states, including Odisha, Delhi, Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, Assam, Tripura, Mizoram, Kolkata, and Kerala, among others.
We invite talented individuals to join our dynamic and purpose-driven team, where they can contribute to our mission of creating a sustainable future while advancing their careers in a supportive and inclusive environment.

Description:
About The/Nudge
The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime."
What are we solving for
We are solving for households in poverty who are also nancially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.
At The/Nudge Institute, we are in the process of catalyzing the propagation of the same. Our purpose is to contribute to making the most excluded individuals contributing member to the economy:
Enable govt to adopt by providing research,design, and implementation support
Continue to implement on its own to iteratethe design for impact at scale
Enable more NGOs to adopt technical and capacity-building support
Continue to generate data on poverty and evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
Build technology solutions for NGOs and governments to adopt and implement at scale & with quality.
Position Overview:
The/Nudge Institute is partnering with the Tripura Rural Livelihood Mission (TRLM), Rural Development Department, Government of Tripura, to promote the adoption of the Graduation Approach (Economic Inclusion Program) for supporting extremely vulnerable households in achieving sustainable and dignified livelihoods. As part of this partnership, a State Project Management Unit (SPMU) has been established at TRLM, Agartala, to support the Government of Tripura in designing and implementing the Tripura - Samaveshi Aajeevika Yojana (TR-SAY) & Chief Ministers Nabadisha Abhijan (CM-NDA). This position will be based at the concerned blocks of Tripura, work closely with block officials of TRLM and will report to the Program Lead.

What will you do
Understand and practice the values and spirit of The/Nudge Institute and the State Rural Livelihood Mission (SRLM).
Identify and select vulnerable women in the designated project geographies across the state.
Mobilize vulnerable women into hamlet-level groups and Self-Help Groups (SHGs).
Support the selection, placement, and capacity building of community cadres from local villages/Gram Panchayats to provide intensive handholding and facilitation support to targeted vulnerable women and their households.
Facilitate vulnerable households access to eligible government entitlements and social security schemes by leveraging convergence platforms, including community cadres, community institutions, social capital, block-level line departments, and internal convergence mechanisms within the SRLM.
Facilitate livelihood planning for targeted households and support them in accessing formal credit and loans through community institutions to establish and strengthen livelihood activities.
Strengthen the capacities of community institutions and community cadres to ensure the long-term well-being of vulnerable women by fostering community ownership through the communitization process.

Description:
About the Role
DScholar Research Consultancy Analytics (OPC) Private Limited is looking for a professional, responsible, and student-focused Academic Consultant Admission Guidance to join our Career Guidance Department in Agartala.
The Academic Consultant will be responsible for counselling students and prospective applicants regarding higher-education opportunities and assisting them in understanding courses, institutions, eligibility requirements, admission procedures, documentation, and application processes.
The role requires excellent communication skills, an interest in higher education, strong information-research abilities, and the ability to guide students and parents in a professional and transparent manner.


Key Responsibilities
Counsel students and prospective applicants regarding higher-education and admission opportunities.
Understand each student s academic background, qualifications, interests, preferences, and educational objectives.
Provide information about suitable courses, programmes, colleges, universities, and other educational institutions based on the student s stated requirements.
Explain course eligibility criteria, admission requirements, application procedures, required documents, fees, important dates, and other relevant information.
Guide students regarding educational opportunities after Class 10, Class 12, graduation, post-graduation, and other relevant stages of education .
Assist students in identifying appropriate undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, certificate, professional, and other academic programmes.
Research colleges, universities, courses, entrance examinations, admission requirements, scholarships, and other educational opportunities from reliable sources.
Assist applicants in completing admission applications and organizing required documents within the scope of the company s admission consultancy services.
Review applications and supporting documents for completeness before submission where such assistance forms part of the assigned service.
Keep applicants informed about application requirements, important dates, pending documents, and other relevant admission-related updates.
Conduct counselling sessions with students and parents through face-to-face meetings, telephone, email, WhatsApp, and online communication platforms.
Respond professionally to admission-related enquiries received through the company s website, telephone, email, social media, and walk-in visits.
Explain the company s admission guidance and consultancy services clearly to prospective students and parents.
Follow up with prospective applicants regarding counselling sessions, applications, documentation, and other pending requirements.
Maintain accurate records of enquiries, counselling sessions, prospective applicants, applications, admissions, and follow-ups.
Update CRM systems, spreadsheets, online forms, and other internal record-management systems.
Communicate with colleges, universities, and other educational institutions when required and appropriately authorized.
Verify important admission information through official or reliable sources before communicating it to applicants.
Maintain current knowledge of courses, admission procedures, eligibility requirements, entrance examinations, and developments in higher education.
Participate in admission campaigns, educational events, student counselling programmes, seminars, workshops, and other company activities when required.
Maintain the confidentiality of students personal, academic, and application-related information.
Prepare periodic reports on enquiries, counselling sessions, applications, admissions, and follow-up activities.
Perform other reasonable admission-guidance and student-support duties assigned by the company.


Educational Qualification
Bachelor s Degree in any discipline from a recognized university.
Candidates should also possess:
Good understanding of the Indian education and higher-education system.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Strong interpersonal and counselling abilities.
Ability to communicate professionally with students and parents.
Basic computer proficiency.
Working knowledge of MS Word, Excel, email, online forms, and internet research.
Ability to independently search for and verify admission-related information.
Good organizational and documentation skills.


Preferred Qualification
Preference may be given to candidates possessing one or more of the following:
Master s Degree in any discipline.
Degree or postgraduate qualification in Education, Psychology, Management, Social Sciences, Humanities, Commerce, or a related discipline.
Certification or training in Academic Counselling, Admission Counselling, Career Counselling, Guidance Counselling, or Student Counselling.
Previous experience in admission consultancy or academic counselling.
Previous experience working with a college, university, educational institution, coaching centre, or education consultancy.
Familiarity with university admission processes, entrance examinations, and higher-education programmes.
Freshers with excellent communication, counselling, and interpersonal skills are also encouraged to apply.


Required Skills
Academic Counselling
Admission Guidance
Admission Counselling
Student Counselling
Higher Education
College Admissions
University Admissions
Student Support
Educational Consultancy
Client Handling
Communication Skills
Interpersonal Skills
Documentation
Application Processing
Online Research
MS Office
Email Communication
CRM
Follow-Up Management
Record Keeping


Language Skills
Good communication skills in English are required.
Ability to communicate effectively in Bengali and/or Hindi will be an advantage for counselling students and parents.


Experience
Freshers and experienced candidates may apply.
Candidates with previous experience in admission counselling, academic counselling, educational consultancy, student services, or a related field may be given preference.


Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate should:
Be genuinely interested in higher education and student counselling.
Enjoy interacting with students and parents.
Have patience and good listening skills.
Be able to understand individual student requirements.
Be able to explain admission procedures clearly and accurately.
Be comfortable conducting one-to-one counselling sessions.
Have good internet research and information-verification skills.
Be organized and capable of managing multiple applicants and follow-ups.
Maintain professional conduct and confidentiality.
Be willing to continuously learn about courses, universities, admission requirements, and changes in the higher-education sector.


Professional Ethical Requirements
The Academic Consultant must provide admission information accurately, responsibly, and transparently .
The consultant must not make false or misleading representations regarding any college, university, educational institution, regulatory authority, accreditation, affiliation, or the company s relationship with an institution.
The consultant must not guarantee admission, scholarships, examination results, placements, employment, visas, or any other outcome unless such an outcome is expressly guaranteed in writing by the relevant authorized institution or organization.
Students should be supported in making their own informed educational decisions based on accurate information about available options.
Agartala
This is a Full-Time, Office-Based position .

Website: https://www.bajajcapitalinsurance.com/
About

Bajaj Capital Insurance Broking Limited (BCIBL) is an IRDAI-licensed insurance broker and part of the Bajaj Capital Group. Established in insurance broking since 2004, the company offers a wide range of life and general insurance solutions, including health, term life, motor, travel, pet, and commercial insurance. BCIBL focuses on helping customers compare insurance options, make informed choices, and access advisory and claims support through its digital platform and nationwide presence.

Position title: Sales Executive
Salary: 15k to 22K+ Huge Performance Incentive
Type of Job: Inhouse Sales

Job purpose
To achieve assigned sales targets by identifying potential customers, building strong relationships, and providing multiple financial products. The role involves ensuring customer satisfaction, driving persistency,
client meetings,need analysis,plan preparation,solution providing, collaborating with other teams and adhering to sales process guidelines to contribute to the overall profitability of the venue.

Key responsibilities

Sales & Business Development
Identify and approach prospective clients through direct sales, referrals and leads generated through market survey.
Analyze customer needs and recommend suitable financial products to achieve their financial goals.
Pitch & promote various financial products such as Life Insurance, Health Insurance, Mutual Funds.
Meets or exceed monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.

Customer Relationship Management
Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers to encourage repeat and referral business.
Provide ongoing support and after sales services to ensure customer satisfaction.
Handle customer queries, concerns and complaints promptly and professionally.

Driving Persistency
Ensure timely premium payments and policy renewals by engaging with customers and providing reminders or support.
Proactively address customer queries or concerns to reduce policy lapses.
Coordinate with customers to collect the relevant documents for policy renewals.

Market Intelligence & Product Knowledge
Stay updated on market trends in the insurance and mutual funds industry.
Maintain in depth knowledge of product features, benefits and compliance requirements.
Attend regular training sessions to enhance product knowledge, selling skills and compliance understanding.

Compliance & Documentation
Ensure adherence to regulatory and organizational guidelines during the sales process.
Maintain accurate and timely documentation of customer interactions, sales transactions and financial advice provided.
Get Certified for required profile

Job Requirements

Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in any discipline

Experience: 0-3 years of experience

Functional and Behavioral requirements
Strong communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills.
Ability to understand financial products and explain them effectively to clients.
Self-motivated with a result-oriented approach.
AboutCompany:
Xquizit is an AI-powered talent acquisition and evaluation platform that helps organizations streamline the complete hiring journey, from candidate sourcing and outreach to screening, assessment, interviewing, and final evaluation.
The platform enables companies to build relevant candidate pipelines, automate telephonic and WhatsApp outreach, screen resumes against role-specific requirements, conduct skill assessments with AI-based proctoring, and run conversational AI interviews with adaptive follow-up questions. Xquizit also provides detailed, evidence-backed candidate reports and consolidated evaluation insights to support faster and more consistent hiring decisions.
Designed as a modular platform, Xquizit can be used across individual stages of the hiring process or as an integrated sourcing-to-evaluation workflow, helping organizations reduce manual effort, improve hiring speed, and evaluate candidates more effectively at scale.

Provide individual and group counseling sessions to help students develop coping strategies and techniques.
Conduct workshops and seminars on topics such as time management, study skills, and career development.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work effectively with diverse groups of students.
Strong knowledge of counseling theories and practices.
Experience working in an educational setting is preferred.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.
A graduate degree is required for this position.

Description:
We are looking for an Associate Business Head to lead our ed-tech firm's growth and profitability. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of the business, including sales, marketing, product development, and operations, and driving the P&L of the designated branch.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop and implement strategies to drive revenue growth and profitability for the business.
Build and lead a high-performing team to execute the company's goals and objectives.
Identify new market opportunities and develop plans to expand the company's customer base.
Develop and execute marketing campaigns to promote the company's products and services.
Manage product development initiatives, including ideation, design, and launch.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless delivery of products and services to customers.
Develop and manage the P&L for the organization, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
Identify and manage key business risks, including competitive threats, regulatory changes, and market fluctuations.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including investors, partners, and customers.
Represent the company at industry events and conferences.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field. MBA preferred.
At least 3+ years of experience in a senior leadership role, with a track record of driving business growth and profitability.
Experience in the ed-tech industry is highly preferred.
Strong business acumen and financial management skills, with experience managing P&L for a business unit.
Excellent leadership and management skills, with the ability to build and lead high-performing teams.
Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to develop and execute complex business plans.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with key stakeholders.
Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
Entrepreneurial mindset, with a bias towards action and a willingness to take risks.

Description:
URGENT HIRING - CONSULTANT ANAESTHESIOLOGIST
Location: Kailashahar, Unakoti District, Tripura
Hospital Type: Multi-Speciality Hospital
Contact 639865 2832
POSITION
Consultant Anaesthesiologist - OT ICU
QUALIFICATION
- MD Anaesthesiology
- DNB Anaesthesiology
- DA (Diploma in Anaesthesia)
- Valid NMC / Tripura State Medical Council Registration
EXPERIENCE
- Experienced candidates preferred
- Candidates with hands-on OT and ICU experience will be given preference
SALARY
3 Lakhs - 3.5 Lakhs per Month
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Conduct pre-operative anaesthesia assessment and evaluate surgical fitness
- Administer general, regional and other appropriate anaesthesia techniques
- Provide anaesthesia support for elective and emergency surgeries
- Monitor patients throughout surgical procedures and ensure safe peri-operative care
- Manage airway and intubation, including emergency airway situations
- Provide post-operative pain management and recovery care
- Support ICU management of critically ill patients in coordination with the treating team
- Assist with ventilator management and hemodynamic stabilization as required
- Respond to OT, ICU and hospital emergencies
- Coordinate with surgeons, physicians, intensivists, OT staff and nursing teams
- Maintain accurate anaesthesia records and clinical documentation
- Follow infection-control, patient-safety and hospital protocols
SKILLS REQUIRED
- Strong clinical knowledge of Anaesthesia and peri-operative care
- Good airway management and emergency response skills
- OT and ICU experience preferred
- Knowledge of ventilator and critical care management
- Good clinical decision-making and teamwork skills
- Professional and patient-centric approach
JOB TYPE
- Full-Time Consultant
- OT ICU Responsibilities
BENEFITS
- Attractive compensation package
- Good OT and ICU clinical exposure
- Supportive multidisciplinary team
- Long-term professional growth opportunity
Interested candidates may share their updated CV along with current salary, expected salary, notice period and relevant OT/ICU experience.
Immediate joiners will be preferred.

Description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a versatile Web Developer to build, deploy, and maintain custom client websites. In this role, you will take full ownership of client digital assets from initial design and layout conceptualization to ongoing technical maintenance, CMS integration, and performance optimization.
Key Responsibilities
Web Design & Development: Conceptualize, build, and maintain responsive, high-performance websites and digital portals for our clients.
Maintenance & Security: Perform regular website maintenance, updates, security audits, and performance optimization.
Project Procurement & Business Growth: Identify and acquire new web development projects/clients for DSCHOLAR WEB (attractive performance incentives paid per procured project).
Training & Mentorship: Conduct training sessions and workshops for internal team members and interested candidates looking to upgrade their web development skills.
Technical Operations: Manage web hosting, domains, SSL, CMS platforms, and client delivery workflows.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Education: B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
Experience: 1 5 years of web development experience building and maintaining client-facing websites or web applications.
Core Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP/Node.js, and popular frameworks (React.js, Next.js, or Vue.js).
CMS & Database Management: Experience with WordPress/Elementor, headless CMS tools, and relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL).
Web Operations: Solid understanding of domain configuration, cloud hosting (AWS, Vercel, cPanel), SSL certificates, and web security best practices.
Work From Home (WFH) Setup Requirements
As a fully remote position, the candidate must have a functional and dedicated home workstation equipped with:
Hardware: High-performance laptop/desktop (Intel i5/i7 or AMD Ryzen 5/7, minimum 16GB RAM, 256GB+ SSD).
Display & Peripherals: External monitor setup recommended for multi-tasking, along with a working webcam, noise-canceling headset, and microphone for video meetings.
Internet Connectivity: High-speed broadband connection (minimum 50 Mbps) with a secondary backup power connection (e.g., router UPS or mobile hotspot) to ensure uninterrupted service during power outages.
Workspace: A quiet, professional home office space conducive to video calls with clients and trainees.
Compensation & Perks
Negotiable based on experience, portfolio, and technical assessment.
Work Environment: e-Workspace, Collaborative, fast-paced environment with exposure to international clients and cutting-edge web technologies.
Mode of Selection
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and called for an interview.
Candidates with good networking skills will be preferred.
Job Features

Location: Remote
Work setup: Work from Home, Set-up required
Mode of Selection: Online Video Interview

Full-Time Web Developer Job in Agartala, Tripura | DSCHOLAR WEB
Full-Time Desk Job | Agartala, Tripura
Unit: DSCHOLAR WEB | DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics
Job Type: Full-Time, Desk-Based Position
Job Location: Agartala, Tripura, India
Employment Type: Full-Time
About Us
DSCHOLAR WEB is a specialized service unit of DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics, providing end-to-end website design, development, hosting, management, maintenance, and digital solutions.
We design, develop, deploy, host, maintain, and manage websites and digital platforms for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled and versatile Full-Time Web Developer based in Agartala, Tripura.
This is a full-time, desk-based professional position in Agartala. The selected candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, maintaining, securing, and optimizing client websites and digital platforms.
The employee will handle the complete lifecycle of assigned web projects-from understanding client requirements and designing the website to development, deployment, hosting, maintenance, troubleshooting, updates, and ongoing technical management.
The position also involves client and project coordination, technical operations, business-development support, project procurement, and training activities when required.
Key Responsibilities 1. Website Design & Development
Design and develop modern, responsive, professional, and high-performance websites.
Develop websites for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Convert client requirements and concepts into functional digital solutions.
Develop corporate websites, professional/profile websites, institutional websites, e-commerce websites, landing pages, portals, and custom web solutions.
Ensure websites are fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Develop and customize websites using appropriate programming languages, frameworks, CMS platforms, themes, and plugins.
Customize WordPress, Elementor, and other CMS-based websites according to project requirements.

Description:
Associate, Program Implementation [Tripura]
Tripura, Fluency in Hindi, English and Bengali
Supports the on-ground implementation and monitoring of Labhyas Social-Emotional Learning (SEL) program in partnership with the state government. Ensures high-quality delivery through effective coordination, capacity building, data management, and stakeholder engagement.
Role Expectations
All the tasks mentioned below would be key to your role. The following requirements are not mentioned in order of priority.
Manage a dedicated team of Field Supervisors in the state with respect to reporting, coordination, training, data completion, and any need-based support.
Conduct regular field visits to monitor program implementation and ensure adherence to guidelines and timelines.
Regularly review field team performance, provide feedback, and build their capacity through ongoing coaching and mentoring.
Troubleshoot challenges in real-time, escalate issues when necessary, and ensure timely resolution.
Oversee program implementation across assigned districts, ensuring that program milestones, quality benchmarks, and timelines are consistently met.
Work closely with the Monitoring Evaluation (ME) team to ensure effective implementation of program activities and high-quality data collection from the field.
Contribute to the creation of performance dashboards and reports for internal reviews and decision-making.
Develop teaching and learning materials focused on Social-Emotional Learning (SEL) for different grades or contexts.
Design and facilitate online and in-person training and capacity-building sessions for enumerators, teachers, and other stakeholders.
Conduct refresher training and follow-up learning circles to reinforce capacity building and improve delivery quality.
Educational Qualification
Bachelors or Masters degree in Education, Social Science, or a related field.
Experience
1-2 years of proven experience in teacher training, facilitation, or program implementation.
Prior experience in on-ground or field-based roles is preferred.
Exposure to training facilitation, monitoring, or stakeholder coordination will be an advantage.
Understanding of Social Emotional Learning (SEL), mental health, or child psychology is preferred.
Characteristics
Proficiency in speaking, reading, and writing Bengali (non-negotiable).
Knowledge of other regional dialects in Tripura will be preferred.
Strong relationship-building, communication, and coordination skills.
Excellent organisational and time management abilities.
Proficient in Google Tools (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and comfortable with digital reporting systems.
Highly motivated, empathetic, and driven by childrens wellbeing.
A self-starter who acts with urgency, takes initiative, and learns quickly.
Comfortable with regular travel across districts for field visits, training, and coordination.
Open to experimentation, collaboration, and feedback in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment.
Deeply committed to integrity, transparency, and trust in both process and relationships.
If youre someone who is driven by purpose, excited to build, and energized by working closely with communities in service of childrens wellbeing, wed love to hear from you. We care more about your drive, alignment, and willingness to learn than ticking every box.

1. Drive sales growth of solar products through distributor training and customer engagement.

Self-driven, target-oriented, and passionate about renewable energy.

Strong knowledge of solar panels, inverters, batteries, and rooftop solar solutions.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Description:
Job Purpose
The responsibility of this role is to plan, implement and achieve the sales targets for the branch by developing channels like Banking, National Distributors and IFAs for central & harbor suburbs through distributor engagement & expansion.
Job Context & Major Challenges
Job Context/Job Challenges:Organisation ContextEstablished in 1994, Aditya Birla Sun Life Asset Management Company, (ABSLAMC) is a joint venture between Aditya Birla Group &Sunlife Ficial Inc. , a leading international ficial services company in Canada. ABSLAMC is a fund manager for Birla Sunlife Mutual Funds ¤tly ranks as the fourth largest fund Management houses in India with a total Average AUM base of over INR 2 Lakh 45 Thousand crores(as on Nov 2017). Out of the 42 fund houses in the country, ABSLAMC ranked 1st in Fixed Income AUM &5th in Equity AUM category respectively. As of November 2017, the Average AUM market Share of the organisation was approx 10. 73%. The company grew its investor client base by 44% to about 5. 2 Mn from 3. 6 Mn from the previous year, thereby bagging a second position in this category. Distribution Network: ABSLAMC has a footprint in more than 200 locations across the country with approx 65, 000 IFAs, 210 National Distributors & 85 banking partnership. ABSLAMC also has its offshore presence through its rep offices in Singapore, Dubai & Mauritius. Its offerings also include Portfolio advisory services for High Net worth individuals as well as offshore funds for Non Resident Indians. The Company follows a longterm, fundamental research based approach to investment &thrives to provide a transparent ðical services to its investors. One of the key challenges for ABSLAMC has been to maintain a balance between moving with dynamic &constantly changing regulatory norms of the country &maintaining growth &profitability in the extremely competitive market. &some of key strengths of the organization that have helped it to sustain &grow are:
Focus on TechnologyThe organization has been in the forefront in implementing technological innovation to foster innovation &also to improve efficiency for its stakeholders, whether it is employees, clients or distributors
Product InnovationABSLAMC has been known to be a pioneer in terms of products &has a history of launching innovative, category defining products like Birla Cash plus, etc. Research based approachABSLAMC has one of the largest team of research analyst dedicated to tracking down the best companies to invest in. Strong Distributor Delivery MechanismThe Company has developed a 4pronged sales/delivery mechanism to ensure maximum reach &penetration to the end customers. This mechanism includes Company s direct Channels (branches/online), Independent Ficial Advisors (IFAs), National Distributors (ND) &Banks.
Regulator InterfaceABSLAMC plays a key role in the Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI) with quite a few members of the top management being a part of the AMFI Board. It has hence ensured that it can discuss any new Industry development from a regulatory perspective at the initial stages with the Regulator as well as the Industry Association
People Management ABSLAMC believes in continuously measuring the perception of its people using a 4S approach, namely Satisfaction, Say, Stay &Strive, which has enabled it to garner a workforce committed &aligned to the overall business success. In context to the organization, the Banking Distribution, IFA &ND channels are a very integral &critical part of the Retail Distribution setup.
Plan, organize & manage all activities to drive Retail Sales through all the channels in the region to increase AUM, market share, quality &profit potential of assets. The Banking Distribution compromises of the Retail &Private Banks. As these retail channels cater to very different class &set of clients &client requirements, it gives us a platform to promote our diversified set of products based on these requirements.
Key Challenges for the role are as follows:
a)To ensure an increase in visibility activities.
b)Lack of a measurement tool for performance, thus the branch manager has to manually maintain &update performance data.
c)Difficulty of coordination with different channels of distribution
Key Result Areas KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters) Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters) KRA1 Retail Sales Execution Drives ongoing sales from the defined relationships and contribute towards regions achievements
Obtains and analyzes information from market to identify new clients, makes direct pitches, liaises with channel partners to increase sales
Profiles distributors and caters to their requirements to ensure ongoing business from them
Ensures targeted number of folios are added and achieves targeted amount of new SIPs KRA2 Retail Sales Execution
Distributor Empanelment & Engagement Conducts regular meetings and contact with the distributors
Undertakes empanelment and activation of distributors
Disseminates updates and other product related information in timely manner
Organizes and executes trainings and engagements for partners KRA3 Reporting and compliance Ensures 100% compliance with internal reporting & audit systems
Provides weekly reports to Regional Heads
Updates sales portal with requisite information to facilitate information collation and analysis
Undertakes installation of advertising and publicity materials for brand visibility KRA4 Branch Administration Ensure branch administration in order to help maintain and grow sales in the region.
Ensure good rating for the branch and get well equipped for internal audit.
Ensure compliance and SEBI code of conduct issues are adhered to KRA5 Overseeing Branch administration and monitoring branch issues to ensure a smooth delivery of service to clients Facilitate smooth operations of the branch including branch imprest, administration, operations and client servicing standards KRA6 Providing relevant reports to management for assigned territory. Furnishing relevant sales reports of the branch to Cluster & Zonal Head KRA7 Managing and monitoring team members for better productivity 1. Facilitating regular training, guidance and development of team members
2. Ensuring AMFI Certification of team members
3. Monitoring performance of RM s on monthly basis and take corrective measures if achievement deviates from the required achievements.

Description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Renewable Energy Engineer to support the Department of Energy, Government of Chhattisgarh/Tripura in monitoring and implementing key renewable energy programs, including PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (PMSGMBY) and PM-KUSUM.

Location: Raipur, Chhattisgarh/Agartala, Tripura (Full-time deployment with Department of Energy, Government of Chhattisgarh)

Assignment Duration: 12 Months(Contingent upon Winning the bid)

Engagement Type: Consultant / Fixed-Term Project Assignment
Key Responsibilities
Support monitoring and implementation of renewable energy projects and government schemes.
Work closely with the Department of Energy, CSPDCL, and CREDA.
Assist in project tracking, reporting, stakeholder coordination, and data analysis.
Support training and capacity-building initiatives for government officials.
Prepare presentations, reports, and project updates.

Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
Master's degree in Engineering, MBA, or related field preferred.

Experience
Minimum 2 years of experience in the renewable energy sector in India.
Experience supporting at least one renewable energy project with a state utility, government department, or renewable energy agency.
Exposure to project monitoring, implementation, or advisory assignments.

Skills
Good understanding of renewable energy projects and government programs.
Strong analytical, coordination, and communication skills.
Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Excellent written and spoken English.

Description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Renewable Energy Expert / Team Leader to support the Government of Chhattisgarh/Tripura in strengthening renewable energy program monitoring, project management, and capacity-building initiatives. The selected expert will work closely with the State Energy Department, Renewable Energy Development Agency (REDA), and DISCOMs to drive effective implementation and oversight of renewable energy projects.

Location
Raipur, Chhattisgarh/ Agartala, Tripura (Full-time deployment with State Energy Department)

Assignment Duration- 1 year

Key Responsibilities
Team Leadership & Project Management
Lead and manage the overall delivery of the assignment.

Serve as the primary point of contact for the State Energy Department and associated agencies.
Monitor project progress and ensure timely delivery of outputs and milestones.
Conduct impact assessments and provide strategic recommendations.
Prepare and submit project completion reports.

Renewable Energy Advisory
Lead program monitoring and management activities for renewable energy projects in Chhattisgarh/Tripura

Education
Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
Master's Degree in Engineering, Management, MBA, or related field preferred.

Experience
Proven experience managing projects of similar scale and complexity.
Familiarity with ADB or other Multilateral Development Bank (MDB) funded projects.
Experience supporting state-owned power utilities, renewable energy agencies, or government energy departments.
Demonstrated involvement in monitoring or managing at least two renewable energy projects.
Minimum 4 years of experience working with renewable energy companies in India.

Skills
Strong stakeholder engagement and project management capabilities.
Understanding of renewable energy policies, utility operations, and sector programs.
Excellent communication and reporting skills.
Proficiency in MS Office Suite.

Language
Fluency in written and spoken English.

Please note that this is fixed term role, contingent upon winning the bid.

1. Position Details
Designation: Sales Officer
Location: South Tripura
Department: Trade Sales
Reporting To: ASM/TSM
Salary Range: As per market standards
Experience: 23 years in Sales / Channel Management
Qualification: Graduation (MBA / Marketing preferred)
2. Role Purpose
The Executive – Sales is responsible for driving business growth in the territory by managing dealer and sub-dealer networks, achieving sales and collection targets, strengthening market presence, and ensuring effective execution of company strategies.
3. Key Deliverables / Responsibilities
Manage and expand channel distribution
Appoint, develop, and monitor dealers and authorized sub-dealers
Achieve assigned primary and secondary sales targets
Ensure availability of products and correct market pricing
Execute brand-building and promotional activities at local level
Conduct mason/contractor meets and provide technical support
Ensure timely collection and healthy fund flow from dealers
Track competitor activity and provide market intelligence
Maintain accurate sales reports, MIS, and forecasts
4. Key Result Areas (KRA) & Key Performance Indicators (KPI)
KRA 1: Sales Target Achievement
Monthly, quarterly, and annual volume & value target achievement
Growth in secondary sales and repeat business
KRA 2: Channel Development
Appointment of new dealers and sub-dealers
Improvement in dealer productivity and coverage
KRA 3: Market Development & Visibility
Increased market share in Sivasagar region
Execution of branding, visibility, and promotional activities
KRA 4: Collection & Credit Control
Timely collection as per credit norms
Reduction of overdue and outstanding balances
KRA 5: Compliance & Reporting
Adherence to company pricing, schemes, and SOPs
Timely reporting of sales, collections, and market feedback
5. Roadmap of Success
0–3 Months
Understand company products, pricing, and sales processes
Map Sivasagar market, dealer base, and competitor landscape
Build strong relationships with dealers and influencers
3–6 Months
Achieve minimum 85–90% of assigned sales targets
Expand sub-dealer network in uncovered areas
Improve product visibility and secondary sales
6–12 Months
Consistently achieve or exceed targets
Strengthen dealer loyalty and market share
Become a key contributor to regional business growth

Job Title: Relationship Manager (Field Sales Executive)
Company: Policybazaar
Location- Guwahati , Agartala
Industry: Insurance

Eligibility Criteria:
Must own a Bike and have a valid Driving License
Proficient in the regional language
Minimum 1 year of experience in field sales
Strong communication and networking skills

Roles and Responsibilities:
Achieve Sales Targets: Meet business goals based on Annualized Premium (ANP) and case count.
Customer Acquisition: Generate new leads via natural market, referrals, and the orphan base.
Client Meetings: Conduct regular meetings to understand client needs and offer suitable insurance solutions.
Need-Based Selling: Ensure appropriate solutions through a structured selling model.
Upselling & Cross-Selling: Maximize revenue through existing customer base.
Post-Sales Service: Resolve queries and ensure timely policy issuance.
Customer Engagement: Maintain regular touchpoints and strong relationships with clients
Collaboration: Coordinate with supervisors to plan and execute business strategies.
Sales Forecasting: Design and evaluate innovative sales strategies.
Database Management: Maintain and grow your customer database in your designated territory.
ISMS Compliance: Follow security protocols to safeguard customer and company data.

Peaks & Benefits:
Unlimited incentives
Travel Allowances
Medical I Insurance
Attractive Salary Package

Description:
Job Description:
Central Medical Services Society (CMSS), (An autonomous body under Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Govt. of India), is seeking a skilled and dedicated Junior Pharmacist on the payroll of LRS Services Pvt. Ltd. The ideal candidate will have experience in pharmaceutical storage, distribution, and regulatory compliance.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage pharmaceutical store/warehouse/distribution functions efficiently.
Ensure adherence to Good Storage and Distribution Practices (GSDP) in line with GMP regulations.
Support regulatory audits related to store/warehouse and distribution operations.
Maintain and update inventory records in the ERP system.
Assist in maintaining compliance with all pharmaceutical storage and distribution guidelines.
Eligibility Criteria:
Age: Below 40 years as of the date of deployment (relaxation may be considered in exceptional cases).
Educational Qualification:
Diploma in Pharmacy (D. Pharma) or
Bachelor s Degree in Pharmacy (B. Pharma) from a recognized university/institute approved by the Pharmacy Council of India.
Experience:
Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience for D. Pharma holders.
Minimum 1 year of post-qualification experience for B. Pharma holders.
Skills and Knowledge:
Familiarity with Good Storage & Distribution Practices (GSDP) as per GMP regulations.
Experience in handling regulatory audits.
Proficiency in ERP systems.
Strong command of English (both written and verbal).
Knowledge of the local language is desirable.
Additional Information:
Candidates with exceptional qualifications or experience may receive age and experience relaxation. This is a dynamic role requiring attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and a commitment to maintaining high pharmaceutical standards.
AboutCompany:
LRS services is an integrated and innovative technology firm providing managed IT services, maintenance services, staffing services and hardware support globally. Offering customized service solutions and hardware that help customers to reduce overall costs and minimize risk in all phases of their IT life cycle.

Description:
Director / Manager Business Development and Customer Success
Tripura Multinational was started to tap into the vast unaddressed opportunities in Leadership Capability Transformation within businesses operating in Asia Pacific, Japan, India and the Middle East. With the business environment changing at a rapid pace, and customer expectations rising significantly, it is incumbent on every organization to build the next generation of skills and capabilities within their teams, and to empower their managers to amplify the impact of those skills through the power of coaching.
We are looking for an individual with a passion for Selling, Sales Management and Customer Success. If you have experience selling People and Capability Transformation solutions to Global Business and Human Resource Leaders, then this job is for you.
Responsibilities
Lead by example on the quality of your customer engagement that our Sales and Leadership Programs seek to exemplify.
You would ideally be proactive with an internal drive for excellence and an external orientation for customer centricity and success.
You would play a strategic role in expanding the client/customer base. You would actively prospect, position, qualify leads, close the deal and sell the gamut of our program offerings.
You would independently build a territory plan segmenting your markets and focusing your execution.
Manage and build the CRM for your territory with discipline, consistency and commitment. Daily updates are encouraged.
Develop and deliver a yearly/quarterly plan linked to sales performance management with measurable KPIs for pipeline progression and conversion.
Possess the gravitas to drive 2-3 CXO meetings every week.
Draft proposals with measurable and monetizable business value that will aid acceleration in your sales cycle.
Maintain good relationships with all existing and prospective clients and collaborate internally with teams like Marketing, Finance and Operations.
Identify market trends and customer requirements that brings insights and foresights back into the business.
Qualifications
You ideally possess 10-15 years of experience in Business Development with comprehensive knowledge and experience working in B2B businesses, preferably selling professional services.
You have engaged in end-to-end sales cycle progression as an independent contributor performing both hunting roles for new customer acquisition and farming roles for cross-selling/up-selling to an existing customer.
You are familiar with CRM systems and can showcase field discipline by gleaning insights from the CRM.
You have excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to differentiate yourself through the quality of your articulation and engagement.
You are driven by Innovation and champion bold ideas and new ways of doing things for your customer. You ask challenging and stretching questions which are themselves value for the customer.
Any exposure to training, education, skill development, assessment, human capability development and coaching within organizations would be your additional asset in this role.
This role will report to the Director for Sales Effectiveness and Execution Excellence and will be based in India / Singapore. In Singapore, Singaporeans and Permanent Residents of Singapore will be accorded priority for hire. Others can apply too.
AboutCompany:
Tripura Multinational Pte Ltd is a consulting and leadership development firm specializing in sales transformation, organizational growth, and executive coaching. It partners with global enterprises to enhance leadership capabilities, drive business performance, and foster sustainable growth through tailored consulting and training programs. The company emphasizes innovation, cross-cultural expertise, and measurable impact in its client engagements. Career opportunities highlight its focus on nurturing professionals in consulting, leadership development, and business transformation services.

Experience: 6+ Years
Job Locations: Pune, Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad

Job Summary:

We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Engineer with 6+ years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications. Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality web applications.

Collaborate with product managers, business analysts, and cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features.
Create and consume RESTful APIs and microservices.
Work with relational and NoSQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis.
Ensure application performance, security, scalability, and reliability.
Participate in code reviews and follow best coding practices.
Implement automated testing and CI/CD pipelines.
Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolutions.
Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends.

Required Skills:
6+ years of experience in Full Stack Development.
Strong proficiency in front-end technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript.
Hands-on experience with React, Angular, or Vue.js.
Strong experience in server-side development using Java, Node.js, or Python.
Experience with RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.
Good knowledge of database technologies including MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis.
Experience with Git and version control systems.
Knowledge of CI/CD tools and automated testing frameworks.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

Preferred Skills:
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized deployments.
Exposure to DevOps practices and monitoring tools.
Understanding of security best practices and performance optimization.

Description:
Job Description: AEO / SEO / GEO Specialist, Trivitron Digital.ai

Location: Chennai / Mumbai / Bangalore (Onsite only)

Type: Full-time

Experience: 4-8 years

Reports to: Head of Growth / Digital Transformation

About Trivitron Digital.ai (TDAI):
Trivitron Digital.ai is an AI-powered health technology platform. It is a joint venture between Trivitron Healthcare and
ResoHealth. Our products include LIS, RIS, HIS, CRM, LIMS, Claims IQ, peri-operative AI and an AI Health Companion.
Hospitals, diagnostic labs and wellness providers across India, the GCC and emerging markets use them.

The Role:
People now look for information in two places: traditional search engines and AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Gemini,
Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. We want TDAI and our customers to be the trusted answer in both. In this role youll
own organic visibility for TDAIs brand and products. Youll also help our hospital, diagnostics and wellness customers grow
their own search and AI visibility.

Key Responsibilities:

1. SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
Own technical, on-page and off-page SEO for TDAI’s websites and product pages
Do keyword research for B2B healthtech terms (e.g., “LIS software India”, “hospital management system UAE”)
and for patient-facing searches made to our customers
Build high-quality backlinks from healthcare, health IT and industry publications in India and the GCC
Run local SEO (Google Business Profile, directories, citations) for multi-location hospital and diagnostic chains
2. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)
Structure content so it gets picked up for featured snippets, People Also Ask, voice search and AI Overviews
Implement schema markup (MedicalOrganization, Hospital, MedicalTest, FAQ, Product, Organization)
Build FAQ and Q&A content hubs that answer real buyer and patient questions
3. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)
Track and improve how TDAI and our customers are cited in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and Claude
Build entity authority through Wikipedia/Wikidata, knowledge panels, authoritative mentions, PR and citationworthy
content (research, benchmarks, reports)
Set up prompt-level tracking for brand share-of-voice in AI answers and report on it
4. Customer Growth Services
Audit and improve search and AI visibility for hospital, diagnostics and wellness clients
Create playbooks for doctor profiles, test/package pages, location pages and review management
Connect visibility to business outcomes: appointments, test bookings, leads and footfall
5. Content, Compliance and Collaboration
Work with content, product, clinical and sales teams on content that is accurate and meets E-E-A-T standards
Follow healthcare content norms: medical review, no misleading claims, and data privacy (DPDP Act, UAE regulations)
Track and report on rankings, organic traffic, AI citations, DA/DR, leads and conversions

What You Bring:
4–8 years in SEO, with hands-on exposure to AEO/GEO or AI search visibility
Experience in healthcare, healthtech, diagnostics, hospitals or B2B SaaS (strongly preferred)
Strong command of Ahrefs/SEMrush, Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog and schema tools
Familiarity with AI visibility tools (e.g., Profound, Otterly, Peec AI, or your own tracking methods)
Working knowledge of HTML, structured data, site architecture and CMS platforms (WordPress, headless CMS)
Excellent written English; regional languages or Arabic are a plus
A proven track record of moving rankings, traffic and leads, with case studies to show

KPIs:
Organic traffic and qualified leads from search
Rankings for priority keywords (India and GCC)
Brand mentions and citations in AI answer engines
Featured snippets and AI Overview inclusions
DA/DR and growth in high-quality backlinks
Measurable visibility gains for customer accounts

Track GA SCM TTL initiatives in close alignment with the TTLCoE, ensuring progress, risks and dependencies are clearly visible.
Drive standardization, processharmonizationand supplier consolidation across GA Hubs and GPGs.

Act as a change agent by building awareness, supporting stakeholder engagement and enabling the successful rollout of new TTL projects,toolsand processes.
Provide regular and ad hoc updates on TTL topics, regulatorychangesand compliance requirements;identify,addressor escalate gaps to ensure GAremainscompliant.
Collaborate with counterparts across other Business Units to exchange knowledge, benchmark performance and implement relevant best practices.
Represent GA in relevant workshops and provide input on GA forecasts,performanceand annual TTL budget planning.
Support best-in-class delivery against Hitachi Energy KPIs, includingmaintainingaccuratepurchasing information records (PIRs), such as material weights and country of origin data.
Undertakeadditionalresponsibilities asrequiredto support the team and evolving business priorities.

Experience working in cross-functional,matrixedor global organizations, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business units,functionsand geographies.

Fluent English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong commercial awareness, with an understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements or a willingness to develop thisexpertise.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management,negotiationand influencing skills.
Proactive and accountable, witha strong senseof ownership and the ability to drive topics forward independently.
Structured,collaborative,and results-oriented, with the ability to manage priorities and deliver outcomes in a dynamic environment.
Analytical and solutions-focused, with strong problem-solving capability and attention to detail.
Comfortable working across cultures and countries, with a mindset that supports collaboration, continuousimprovementand change adoption.

- JL3: Up to 5.5 LPA

Job Description

We are looking for candidates for Customer Support (CS) and Service Desk (SD) roles who can provide excellent customer service, handle customer queries, and resolve technical and service-related issues. Candidates will act as the first point of contact for customers and service users, assisting them through voice calls, chat, email, and other support channels.

Key Responsibilities

- Handle customer queries and resolve issues through calls, chat, and email.
- Act as the first point of contact for customer and service-related requests.
- Understand customer concerns, analyse problems, and provide timely and effective resolutions.
- Provide technical support for laptop/desktop troubleshooting and VPN installation.
- Assist with Microsoft Outlook 365, BitLocker, and Active Directory-related issues.
- Handle requests related to information, system access, and other services.
- Demonstrate excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
- Resolve customer issues independently, efficiently, and professionally.
- Maintain good time management and ensure a positive customer experience.
- Be proactive and demonstrate respect for customers' time.

Eligibility Criteria

- Qualification: Any full-time graduate with 15 years of formal education.
- Experience: 15 years, depending on the job level and profile.
- Candidates with prior technical support experience must have at least 1 year of Service Desk Technical Support experience.
- Knowledge of Microsoft Outlook 365, BitLocker, and Active Directory is required for the technical Service Desk profile.
- Experience in laptop/desktop troubleshooting and VPN installation is required for the technical Service Desk profile.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Willingness to work in a voice support process and 247 rotational shifts.
- Rotational weekly offs and work from office are mandatory.
- Candidates must have completed double vaccination, as specified in the JD.

Note: Candidates will be screened according to the relevant CS or SD profile, experience, technical skills, and applicable salary budget.

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way youd like, where youll be supported and inspired bya collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where youll be able to reimagine whats possible. Join us and help the worlds leading organizationsunlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.


Your Role
Assist in requirements gathering and documentation for ARCS implementations.
Support configuration of reconciliation profiles, formats, and workflows.
Collaborate with senior consultants on integration and automation using EPM Automate and related tools.
Perform testing and validation of ARCS functionalities.
Provide end-user training and support during deployment.
Maintain project documentation and contribute to process improvements.


Your Profile
Lead end-to-end implementation of ARCS, including requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment.
Configure reconciliation formats, profiles, matching rules, and workflows.
Strong expertise in Oracle ARCS and related EPM solutions.
49+ years of experience in Oracle EPM Cloud (ARCS).


What youll love about working here
You can shape your career with us. We offer a range of career paths and internal opportunities within Capgemini group. You will also get personalized career guidance from our leaders.
You will get comprehensive wellness benefits including health checks, telemedicine, insurance with top-ups, elder care, partner coverage or new parent support via flexible work.
You will have the opportunity to learn on one of the industry''s largest digital learning platforms, with access to 250,000+ courses and numerous certifications.


About Capgemini
Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

Job Description: API Automation Test Engineer
Position: API Automation Test Engineer
Experience: 2 to 13 Years
Location: Bangalore / Pune / Chennai
Employment Type: Full-Time

Required Skills
2-13 years of experience in software testing with strong expertise in API Automation Testing.
Hands-on experience in API automation using Rest Assured, Postman, and Swagger/OpenAPI.
Strong programming skills in Java, Python, or JavaScript.
Experience in testing and automating RESTful APIs, Web Services, JSON, and XML payloads.
Good understanding of TestNG, JUnit, Maven, Gradle, and Git.
Experience working with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI.

Experience in integration testing, regression testing, and microservices testing.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

Description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way youd like, where youll be supported and inspired bya collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where youll be able to reimagine whats possible. Join us and help the worlds leading organizationsunlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.


Your Role
Design, develop, and execute performance, load, and stress tests using LoadRunner and JMeter.
Analyze system behavior under peak load, concurrent usage, and endurance conditions.
Create performance test scripts, scenarios, and execution plans for web, API, and backend applications.
Identify performance bottlenecks by analyzing metrics such as response time, throughput, CPU, memory, and database utilization.
Collaborate with developers, architects, and DevOps teams to tune application performance.
Conduct performance baseline tests and generate detailed performance reports.


Your Profile
5+ years of experience in Performance Testing using LoadRunner and JMeter.
Strong handson expertise in test scripting, scenario creation, and workload modeling.
Solid understanding of performance testing types: Load, Stress, Spike, Endurance, Scalability.
Experience analyzing logs, system metrics, and APM dashboards.
Strong understanding of HTTP, APIs, web technologies, databases, and system architecture.
Working knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Git, and automationfriendly ecosystems.


What You Will Love Working at Capgemini
Opportunity to work on cuttingedge digital banking transformation initiatives with global clients.
A culture that encourages learning, certifications, and career growth in banking and QA domains.
Collaborative, inclusive, and peoplecentric work environment.
Access to worldclass resources, tools, and frameworks to deliver topquality solutions.
Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of 22.1 billion.
Capgemini in India comprises nearly 235,000 team members working across 13 locations: Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Coimbatore, Gandhinagar, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Salem, and Tiruchirappalli.
