Role: Workday Compensation Consultant
Exp: 2 to 5 years
Locations: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certifications: Workday Certified (Mandatory)

Certification(s) Preferred:
Active Workday certification (HCM/Compensation)

Required Skills:
Active Workday Core HCM and Advanced Compensation certification.
At least 4 years of relevant Workday HCM experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Hand on experience on setting up compensation elements like grades, grade profiles, sticks plans, bonus plans, merit plans etc.
Subject Matter Expertise in configuring compensation grid, managing new and existing plans while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Expertise on stock grants and updates, Processing Bonus Events, One-time payments, Future payments, consolidated Merits.
Functional experience in multiple HR processes like Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Recruiting, Talent.
Perform HRIS operational duties for Workday HCM and Compensation modules.
Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various HCM/Compensation areas and hands-on experience in business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.
Understanding of HR programs and policies along with a commitment to HR principles of confidentiality required data analysis and report building skills is essential.
Hands-on experience creating and troubleshooting EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Ability to maintain the highest regulatory and compliance standards in handling employee records.
Ensure effective engagement and collaboration with cross functional teams (HRIS & Digital, P&C, People Analytics).
Preferred Skills:
Good to have additional certifications like: Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Talent, Recruiting, Reporting.
Knowledge on using object transporter, Customer Central for configuration and migration.

Job Description: Java Selenium Automation Engineer
Position: Java Selenium Automation Engineer
Experience: 2 to 3 Years
Location: Bangalore / Pune / Chennai/Pan India
Employment Type: Full-Time

Required Skills
2-3 years of experience in software testing with strong expertise in Web Automation Testing.
Hands-on experience with Selenium WebDriver for web application automation.
Strong programming skills in Java and experience in developing automation frameworks.
Experience with automation frameworks and design patterns such as Selenium, TestNG, JUnit, and Page Object Model (POM).
Good understanding of TestNG, JUnit, Maven, Gradle, and Git.
Experience working with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI.
Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies and SDLC/STLC processes.
Experience in API testing using Postman, Rest Assured, or Swagger.
Knowledge of defect tracking tools such as JIRA, Azure Boards, etc.
Experience in functional, regression, integration, and cross-browser testing.
Experience in creating, maintaining, and executing automated test suites.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

Our always-on learning agenda drives their continuous improvement through building and transferring digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem.

Role & responsibilities
SABER Registration: Register products on the Saudi SABER platform, coordinate with conformity assessment bodies, arrange the required compliance documents, and obtain shipment certificates.
2. Vendor Coordination: Communicate with suppliers regarding SABER documents and import/shipping documentation for Dubai (DXB) and Saudi Arabia (KSA).
3. Warson Orders: Track upcoming orders for Warson and ensure the orders are processed and coordinated on time.
4. Supervise Logistics Coordinator: Monitor the logistics coordinator's work related to RFQs (Requests for Quotations), POs (Purchase Orders), and intercompany stock transfers between company entities.
5. Landed Cost in NetSuite: Enter landed costs in NetSuite, including applicable freight, customs duties, insurance, and other import expenses, to calculate the actual cost of imported goods.
6. New Item Registration: Supervise the registration of new products in the system for retail and corporate sales.
7. Warehouse and Shipment Supervision: Coordinate with the warehouse supervisor to manage import and export shipments and ensure proper documentation and dispatch.
8. AWB for Sales Team: Prepare Air Waybills (AWBs), which are shipping documents used for air freight shipments arranged for the sales team.
9. AWB for Development Samples: Create shipping documents for product samples sent for testing, evaluation, or development purposes.
10. Government Payments: Follow up with the finance team to ensure timely payment of government-related logistics charges, duties, and fees.
11. Logistics and Government Bills: Prepare bills and payment documents related to logistics services and government charges.
12. KSADXB Shipments: Prepare the necessary shipping, customs, and transfer documents for goods moving between Saudi Arabia and Dubai, in both directions.

India's leading brokerage-free real estate
SELLER BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT ASSOCIATE (BDA)
Job Description | Field Sales
CompanyNoBroker Technologies Pvt. Ltd.LocationBangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, PuneExperienceMinimum 1 year and smart freshersWork ModeFull-time | Field-basedLanguagesEnglish / Kannada English / Telugu English / Tamil English / Hindi ¢ English / MarathiCore Focus: Field Sales
ROLE SUMMARY
The Seller Business Development Associate (BDA) is responsible for acquiring and engaging property owners, conducting field visits, showcasing properties, assisting buyers, and driving successful property transactions. The company provides qualified leads.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Meet property owners and customers to facilitate property sales, rentals, and leases.
Conduct property visits and accompany buyers during site visits.
Explain property features, pricing, and NoBroker services.
Coordinate property photoshoots and ensure accurate property information.
Negotiate pricing between buyers and sellers to close deals.
Onboard property owners and encourage premium service subscriptions where applicable.
Visit commercial properties to collect owner details and explain NoBroker services.
Upload property details through the NoBroker App or Google Forms.
Maintain customer interactions and sales updates in CRM.
Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets while ensuring excellent customer experience.
ELIGIBILITY
Diploma or Graduation is mandatory
Smart freshers / Experience up to 2 years in field sales.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS
Bike and valid Driving License.
Smartphone.
Candidates should be comfortable communicating in at least one of the required language combinations: English/Kannada, English/Telugu, English/Tamil, or English/Hindi.
PREFERRED SKILLS
Field Sales ¢ Business Development ¢ Lead Generation ¢ Customer Relationship Management (CRM) ¢ Negotiation ¢ Client Acquisition ¢ Relationship Building ¢ Sales Closing ¢ Site Visits ¢ Communication Skills ¢ Target Achievement ¢ Time Management
READY TO BUILD YOUR CAREER IN REAL ESTATE SALES?
Join a field-driven role where you will engage property owners and customers, conduct site visits, and contribute directly to successful property transactions.

Role: - Enterprise Architect (Java + Banking)
Location: - Navi Mumbai l' Chennai
Employment Type: - Full time

Experience Required:- 15+ years

9 hours (Relaxation to minimum 7 hours everyday with balance hours getting covered other days within the same week)

Work from office (Monday to Friday plus 1st, 3rd & 5th Saturday every month)

This account requires 5 days + alternate Saturday working however employees are entitled to avail bank holidays which roughly balances out the additional working days
Responsibility
1. Collaborate and consult with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into architectural solutions by assuring business, application, infrastructure and data decisions are aligned with enterprise architecture strategy.

7. Drive the adoption of DevOps practices, automation, and CICD pipelines to streamline software delivery processes Requirements.
Education: BE or ME in Computer Science, IT or equivalent.
1. Proven experience more than 15+ years and working as an enterprise architect or similar role in a large-scale enterprise environment.
2. Technologies exposure Java Angular, Spring Boot, Oracle, API gateway, API design, OpenShift, WAS, Golden Gate, mobile technologies, DevOps, Security Certification in TOGAF, Zachman Framework or other EA framework would have added advantage
3. Strong hands on experience on designing high volume service in banking domain; corporate banking exposure preferred Expertise in SDLC and project management methodologies focusing on Agile and Scrum.
4. Proven problem solving, analytical, adaptability and time management skills
5. Service Delivery experience from IT Service Industry

Description:
Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform
Experience: 48 years
Role Overview
We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.
Key Responsibilities
Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.
Required Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps);
Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.
Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls.
Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
Qualification and Certifications
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+).
Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

Locations- Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Kolkata, Noida, Kochi, Coimbatore

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.

Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.

Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.

Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.

Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.

Job Description: iOS Developer
Job Title: iOS Developer
Experience: 5to 8 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled iOS Developer to design, develop, and maintain high-quality iOS applications. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in Swift, iOS SDK, and mobile application development with a focus on performance, scalability, and user experience.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain iOS applications using Swift and UIKit/SwiftUI.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and backend developers to deliver high-quality mobile solutions.
Integrate RESTful APIs and third-party libraries/services.
Optimize application performance, responsiveness, and security.
Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code following coding standards.
Participate in code reviews, debugging, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
Ensure applications comply with Apple's App Store guidelines.
Work in Agile/Scrum teams and contribute to sprint planning and delivery.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Swift.
Expertise in iOS SDK, UIKit, and/or SwiftUI.
, Interface Builder, and iOS development tools.
Good understanding of MVC, MVVM, VIPER architecture patterns.
Experience integrating REST APIs, JSON parsing, and networking frameworks.
Knowledge of Core Data, SQLite, UserDefaults, and data persistence.
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and version control systems.
Understanding of mobile security, memory management, and performance optimization.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Firebase services (Analytics, Crashlytics, Push Notifications).
Knowledge of XCTest, Unit Testing, and UI Testing.
Experience with CocoaPods, Swift Package Manager, or Carthage.
Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
Published applications on the Apple App Store.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Nice to Have
Experience working in Agile environments.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Keywords: Swift, Objective-C, iOS SDK, SwiftUI, UIKit, Xcode, REST API, Core Data, Firebase, MVVM, Mobile App Development, Git, XCTest, App Store Deployment.

EY's GDS Assurance Digital teams mission is to develop, implement and integrate technology solutions that better serve our audit clients and engagement teams. Description:
As a SAP CPI - PIPO Manager, you will play a pivotal role in our Advisory Service Delivery Centre, extending PwC's global delivery capabilities. You will be responsible for providing premium, cost-effective services that enhance process quality and delivery capability, supporting client engagements within our Digital Core Modernisation network. As a Manager, you will lead teams to solve complex business issues, from strategy to execution, while fostering an environment of continuous learning and development.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage your leadership skills to mentor junior staff and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and execution. You will be accountable for delivering projects successfully, maintaining standards, and inspiring your team to achieve quality outcomes. By embracing technology and innovation, you will contribute to the firm's success and uphold its values and purpose. This position offers a unique opportunity to develop your business acumen and build trusted relationships with clients, all while navigating the dynamic landscape of SAP technology.
Responsibilities
- Leading SAP technology consulting projects, focusing on SAP CPI and PIPO solutions
- Managing client engagements to deliver process quality and support business transformation initiatives
- Guiding teams in the strategic planning and execution of SAP-based solutions
- Utilizing SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori to enhance data-driven decision-making processes
- Overseeing the integration of SAP HANA and SAP NetWeaver to optimize system performance
- Developing and maintaining relationships with clients to identify and address business challenges
- Promoting the adoption of innovative SAP technologies and practices across client projects
- Confirming data integrity and compliance within SAP frameworks
- Coaching team members to foster professional growth and development
- Analyzing complex business issues to provide meaningful recommendations and solutions
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 9 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- At least one of the following: One or more SAP certifications aligned to SAP Technology and platform solutions, including SAP S/4HANA System Administration, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP Integration Suite, SAP Security, or related technical architecture credentials
- Demonstrating proficiency in SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori
- Utilizing Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP) for business transformation
- Excelling in strategic technology planning and process optimization
- Embracing change and fostering innovation in client engagements
- Building trusted relationships through effective communication and teamwork

SAP BASIS Manager Job Description
Position: SAP BASIS Manager
Experience: 12+ Years
IMMEDIATE JOINERS ONLY
Role Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP BASIS Manager to lead SAP BASIS service delivery for big engagements, customer engagement, and technical operations across enterprise SAP landscapes.
The role requires strong leadership capabilities to manage large teams, drive operational excellence, ensure customer satisfaction, and oversee complex SAP transformation initiatives.
The ideal candidate should possess a blend of technical expertise, people management, stakeholder management, and service delivery experience in a customer-facing environment.
Key Responsibilities
Service Delivery & Operations
Own end-to-end SAP BASIS service delivery across SAP ECC, S/4HANA, BW, PI/PO, Solution Manager, and SAP HANA environments.
Ensure adherence to SLAs, KPIs, availability, performance, and operational commitments.
Drive proactive monitoring, incident prevention, capacity planning, and continuous service improvements.
Lead major incident management, problem management, root cause analysis, and escalation handling.
Customer & Stakeholder Management
Act as the primary point of contact for customer leadership and key stakeholders.
Conduct governance reviews, service review meetings, executive updates, and operational discussions.
Manage customer expectations, risks, escalations, and service improvement initiatives.
Build strong relationships with customer teams and ensure high customer satisfaction.
Team Leadership & People Management
Lead and manage a team of SAP BASIS consultants, leads, and SMEs.
Drive resource planning, workforce management, hiring, onboarding, and competency development.
Mentor team members and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Ensure effective succession planning and skill readiness for future business needs.
Technical & Project Leadership
Oversee SAP installations, upgrades, cloud transformations, and SAP HANA initiatives.
Provide technical guidance on architecture, performance optimization, high availability, and disaster recovery.
Drive automation and process optimization initiatives to improve efficiency and service quality.
Support transition, transformation, and large-scale SAP projects.
Required Skills
12+ years of SAP BASIS experience with strong expertise in SAP HANA and S/4HANA landscapes.
Proven experience managing SAP BASIS delivery teams in managed services or AMS environments.
Strong customer-facing experience with excellent stakeholder and relationship management skills.
Experience in service delivery governance, resource management, and operational leadership.
Strong understanding of ITIL processes, incident management, change management, and service operations.
Excellent communication, presentation, leadership, and decision-making skills.
Preferred Qualifications
SAP Certified Technology Associate
SAP HANA Administration Certification
ITIL Certification
Key Competencies
Customer Relationship Management
Executive Stakeholder Management
Team Leadership & People Development
Service Delivery Management
Strategic Planning & Execution
Risk & Escalation Management
Operational Excellence
Continuous Improvement & Automation

Key Responsibilities

Manage day-to-day SAP BASIS administration activities across SAP landscapes.
Perform system monitoring, performance tuning, health checks, and preventive maintenance.

Execute client administration, transport management, user administration, and system housekeeping activities.

Handle and resolve critical P1/P2 incidents within SLA timelines.
Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and implement preventive measures.
Troubleshoot performance bottlenecks, work processes, dumps, job failures, memory issues, and connectivity problems.
Coordinate with SAP, infrastructure, database, and application teams for complex issue resolution.

3. SAP Technical Project Execution

Perform system refreshes, client copies, system builds, and landscape maintenance activities.

Support SAP systems hosted on cloud platforms.
Assist in managing hybrid landscapes and cloud connectivity solutions.

6. Technical Collaboration & Continuous Improvement
Collaborate with SAP, customer, infrastructure, and development teams to deliver technical solutions.
Identify automation opportunities and process improvement initiatives.
Create and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks.
Mentor junior consultants and contribute to knowledge-sharing activities.
Required Skills & Experience
5–8 years of hands-on experience in SAP BASIS administration and support.
Strong experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP HANA Database, and SAP Fiori.
Experience supporting business-critical production SAP landscapes.
Expertise in SAP upgrades, system refreshes, client copies, transport management, and system maintenance.
Strong troubleshooting skills covering performance issues, dumps, job failures, RFC issues, memory utilization, and system availability.
Good understanding of SAP architecture, including ABAP and Java-based systems.
Experience with SAP HANA monitoring, performance tuning, and administration.
Exposure to SAP Cloud environments including.
Experience managing STMS and transport strategies in complex SAP landscapes.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Proactive attitude with the ability to work independently and within global support teams.
Preferred Qualifications
SAP BASIS, SAP HANA, or SAP S/4HANA certifications.
Experience with RISE with SAP environments.
Knowledge of SAP BTP, Solution Manager, and cloud operations.

Java Full Stack Developer - Job Description (JD)

Job Title: Java Full Stack Developer

Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled Java Full Stack Developer with expertise in both backend and frontend development to build scalable, high-performance enterprise applications. The ideal candidate should possess strong experience in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, and modern frontend technologies such as Angular or React, along with cloud and DevOps knowledge.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain end-to-end web applications.
Build scalable backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and Microservices.
Develop responsive and interactive user interfaces using Angular or React.
Design and consume RESTful APIs and integrate third-party services.
Work with relational and NoSQL databases for application development.
Collaborate with architects, business analysts, QA teams, and product owners.
Implement security, authentication, and authorization mechanisms.

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Data Science Manager, you will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth. Within our Advisory practice, you will focus on leveraging advanced analytics and statistical techniques to extract insights from large datasets and drive data-driven decision-making. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will work on exploratory and descriptive analysis, statistical modeling, and creating data visualizations to help solve complex business problems and inform strategic decisions.
Responsibilities
- Leading data science initiatives to transform raw data into actionable insights for informed decision-making
- Guiding teams in the application of advanced analytics and statistical techniques to solve complex business problems
- Developing and implementing data-driven strategies using machine learning, predictive modeling, and artificial intelligence
- Overseeing the creation and maintenance of data pipelines and data lakes to support large-scale data processing
- Collaborating with stakeholders to identify opportunities for leveraging data science to drive business growth
- Utilizing programming languages such as R and MATLAB to develop and refine data models and algorithms
- Promoting the use of innovative technologies and methodologies within data science teams
- Confirming data quality and integrity through rigorous data validation and troubleshooting processes
- Mentoring junior staff and fostering a culture of continuous learning and development within the team
- Engaging in strategic planning and execution to align data science projects with organizational goals
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 7 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Business Analytics, Computer and Information Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Programming, Data Processing/Analytics/Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, Systems Engineering
- Demonstrating proficiency in data science algorithms and workflows
- Utilizing machine learning and deep learning techniques effectively
- Excelling in data-driven decision making and predictive modeling
- Managing data pipelines and confirming data quality
- Leveraging programming languages such as R and MATLAB
- Applying natural language processing and neural network methodologies

Description:
We are looking for a dynamic, result-oriented Govt Sales professional to join our institutional sales division and expand our footprint across government accounts and public sector undertakings (PSUs).

Key Responsibilities:

1. Strategic Business Development & Approvals
Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with Government departments, PSUs, smart city boards, and government-empanelled architects/PMCs.
Brand Approvals: Actively pitch Fenesta products to secure official brand and product specifications in Government Bill of Quantities (BOQs) and tenders.
Competitor Intelligence: Keep track of public sector market trends, upcoming infrastructure projects, and competitor movements to adapt sales strategies effectively.
2. Commercial & Operational Execution
Deal Closure: Take complete ownership of the government project life-cyclefrom mapping initial leads and delivering technical presentations to final commercial negotiations and sales conversion.
Pricing Strategy: Evaluate project and firm financials to prepare competitive pricing frameworks that balance business profitability with tender viability.
Database Management: Maintain a highly accurate database of active tenders, ongoing prospective pipelines, and key influencers across public sector bodies.
3. Cross-Functional Collaboration
Internal Alignment: Collaborate closely with internal design, engineering, estimation, and installation teams to ensure seamless execution of government project mandates.
Sales Support: Act as the primary bridge between institutional leads and the internal retail/project sales divisions for localized project conversions.
Technical & Behavioral Skills:
Domain Knowledge: A fundamental technical understanding of building materials, specifically uPVC & Aluminium doors/windows or Faades.
Government Liaisoning: Proven track record of interacting with government contractors, public sector officials, and navigating institutional tender procedures.
Negotiation & Persuasion: High proficiency in navigating complex price negotiations and contract clauses with sub-contractors and government vendors.
Problem-Solving & Leadership: Ability to autonomously lead a project pipeline, resolve execution-level bottlenecks, and remain client-centric under tight project timelines.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Revenue Generation: Total revenue achieved through government accounts against assigned annual targets (including new acquisitions, upsells, and cross-sells).
Pipeline & Conversion Growth: Growth volume of the government sales pipeline (number of active leads, BOQs secured, and successful tender conversions).
Client & Stakeholder Satisfaction: Post-execution feedback from government accounts, contractors, and partner PMCs.
AboutCompany:
Fenesta is Indias largest windows and doors brand, and a part of DCM Shriram Group established in 1889 with a turnover of Rs 12,080 crore acknowledged for its transparent work culture and diversity.

Fenesta has successfully installed more than 4 Million windows and doors till date. The Brand today boasts of sales and service presence in more than 350 cities through 20 sales offices, 7 factories, 300+ channel partner showrooms,
9 Signature studios and a strong sales and service force of more than 1500 professionals with60+ service centres
across India.

Fenesta also has an International presence in Maldives, Kenya, Nepal and Bhutan.
Fenesta product portfolio consists of uPVC Windows & Doors, Aluminum Windows & Doors, Solid Panel Doors and Faade. Empowered with knowledge of India's extreme conditions, Fenestas uPVC and Aluminium Windows and Doors systems
are able to withstand India's extreme climate conditions. Our high performance products add an architectural dimension to the home and keeps out all external elements like noise, dust, pollution, rain and storms. The products are specifically designed to require negligible maintenance and outlast buildings.

Fenesta Solid Panel Door Category is a one-stop solution for all your door needs. These doors are made of hybrid
polymer, offers strength, stability and are water and termite resistant. They also require almost no maintenance.

Description:
Years of Experience
5-9 Years

Position Requirements
Extensive SAP S/4HANA Finance & Controlling expert with hands-on solution design, configuration, testing and deployment experience; preferably with an accounts/finance and cost/management accounting background.
Strong, demonstrable expertise in CO sub-modules: CO-CCA (Cost Center Accounting), CO-PCA (Profit Center Accounting), CO-PC (Product Costing) product cost planning, standard cost estimates, cost estimate with/without quantity structure, mixed costing, variance analysis, WIP calculation, and settlement — Material Ledger (ML) and Actual Costing — multi-level actual costing run, periodic unit price, alternative valuation runs, parallel currencies/valuations — along with Profitability Analysis (CO-PA — costing-based and/or account-based), Internal Orders, and Overhead Cost Controlling, alongside FI-GL, FI-AR, FI-AP, Asset Accounting and ICMR.
Proven, hands-on experience configuring Controlling building blocks end-to-end: cost element/cost center hierarchies, activity types and planning, allocation cycles (assessment/distribution), costing sheets, cost component structures, Material Ledger activation and actual costing configuration, and profitability reporting structures.
Full lifecycle exposure to Product Costing and Material Ledger solutions — from requirement gathering and design (blueprinting/fit-gap), through configuration, unit/integration/UAT testing, cutover, and post-go-live deployment support.
Ability to mentor and manage multiple teams and projects, with CO, Product Costing, and Material Ledger design ownership across workstreams.
Participate in design discussions, providing deep expertise on SAP S/4HANA Finance and Controlling capabilities (e.g., universal journal-based CO-FI real-time integration, margin analysis, Material Ledger as the valuation backbone in S/4HANA).
Work with business/controlling users to understand requirements and propose alternative design solutions for cost allocation, product costing, inventory valuation, and profitability reporting.
Develop a collaborative, cohesive team culture with a “One Team” mindset.
Hands-on experience in Finance, Controlling and management accounting processes, with the ability to translate accounting requirements into system configuration.
Hands-on experience across S/4HANA Finance features with ability to design, develop, configure and test integrations between CO/Product Costing/Material Ledger and other modules — MM/SD/PS/PP/PM/IM — particularly cost flows from procurement, production, and project systems into Controlling and inventory valuation objects.
Knowledge of CFIN, and understanding of the elimination of ETL tools to enable real-time transactional-level matching.
Understanding of AIF, field value mapping, centralized transaction processing, payments, intercompany reconciliation, and group consolidation using S/4HANA Group Reporting.
Hands-on experience in S/4HANA Intercompany Matching and Reconciliation (ICMR), backed by a solid accounting, finance, and controlling background.
Demonstrated functional experience in Intercompany Reconciliation processes in SAP.
Knowledge and experience implementing SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting is an added advantage.

Preferred Knowledge
Hands-on, configuration-level knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Finance and Controlling, including Product Costing and Material Ledger, other integration workstreams, CFIN, and ICMR, with the ability to drive projects through full design-configure-test-deploy cycles.
Understanding of different project delivery methodologies, especially Agile and Scrum frameworks, applied to CO, Product Costing, and Material Ledger design and testing cycles.

Preferred Skill
Hands-on configuration and design experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance, with demonstrable depth in Controlling (CO), Product Costing, and Material Ledger design, configuration and testing.
Familiarity with onsite/offshore delivery models and hands-on experience across system landscape environments (e.g., Dev/QA/Prod, transport management for CO/Product Costing/ML configuration).
Familiarity with Implementation, Support, Rollout, and Training delivery models — including testing phases specific to Product Costing and Material Ledger (cost estimate testing, actual costing run validation, integration testing across MM/SD/PP, UAT, and cutover/deployment support).
Familiarity with role matrix/role testing and ability to assist technical team members on CO/Product Costing/ML-related developments (reports, BAdIs, enhancements).
Familiarity with both Waterfall and Agile approaches to software/configuration delivery.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
Ownership and commitment, flexible timings.
Expertise in JIRA and Agile delivery model.

Professional and Educational Background
Senior Associate — 5-9 years of experience.
5+ years of experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance with a strong Controlling, Product Costing and Material Ledger component, with a minimum of 2 end-to-end implementations involving CO/PC/ML design, configuration, testing and deployment.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Responsibilities
PL Growth Metrics: Own the marketing budget and key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Retention, and Brand Health metrics.
Digital Storefront Merchandising: Own the "homepage" and category pages of the app. You will decide CTR and AOV
Funnel Optimization CRO: Monitor the user journey from "App Install" to "Order Placed." You will be responsible for identifying drop-off points and implementing A/B tests on checkout flows, search results, and product display pages (PDPs) to increase conversion.
Pricing Promotion Engine: Execute the pricing strategy for the target segment. You will manage the backend configuration of coupons, "slash-pricing," and bundle deals, ensuring they are psychologically appealing and technically seamless.

Inventory Catalog Sync: Work with the supply chain team to ensure the app reflects real-time stock availability

Result oriented, data forward and a problem solving approach towards business with a key eye on Customer, Consumer and Category Insight.
Tech Marketing Hybrid: You must be comfortable with "No-Code" dashboarding, CMS tools, and marketing automation platforms.
Analytical Prowess: Expert-level skills in Excel/SQL and data visualization tools (Tableau/PowerBI). You should be able to find the "why" behind the numbers.
Data-Driven Decision Making: Proficiency in marketing analytics tools to derive insights from complex data sets and iterate on strategies in real-time.
Strong communicator: Excellent written and verbal communication skills to craft and deliver the right message, to the right people, at the right time.
Ability to manage short term needs with long term strategic bets
Tenacity to develop ideas independently and thrive in a fast-paced start-up environment

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an AI Engineer – Manager, you will play a pivotal role in driving software and product innovation within our Technology Consulting practice. You will focus on developing innovative software solutions that enhance business performance and drive digital transformation for our clients. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards, motivating and inspiring others to deliver quality. You will leverage your growing business knowledge to identify opportunities that contribute to the success of our firm, leading with integrity and authenticity.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion. You will embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same. Your responsibilities will include analyzing and identifying the linkages and interactions between the component parts of an entire system, effectively mentoring others, and addressing conflicts or issues with clients and team members. You will uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards, contributing to the firm's purpose and values in a meaningful way.
Responsibilities
- Leading software engineering projects to drive digital transformation and enhance business performance
- Designing, coding, and testing applications using Python, React Native, and Flutter to deliver exceptional user experiences
- Managing application development and lifecycle management to optimize software solutions
- Implementing microservices architecture to improve system scalability and reliability
- Developing solution architecture and system software to support innovative product development
- Overseeing software project management to confirm successful planning, budgeting, and execution
- Mentoring team members to leverage their strengths and improve performance
- Addressing conflicts and engaging in difficult conversations with stakeholders to resolve issues
- Validating professional and technical standards, including adherence to the firm's code of conduct
- Encouraging the use of innovative technologies and methodologies to enhance delivery and inspire teams
-Proven delivery of production full-stack systems (React + Python) and AI/ML or GenAI solutions
-Strong architectural judgment across front-end, back-end, and LLM/agent orchestration
-Deep familiarity with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, ReAct) and LLM orchestration
-Experience with enterprise integrations, distributed systems, cloud (Azure / AWS / GCP), containers/Kubernetes, and security best practices
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 8 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Computer and Data Engineering, Computer Science, Human Computer Interaction, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems/Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering
- Excelling in application development and software design
- Utilizing Python and scripting languages for innovative solutions
- Managing software project lifecycles with Agile methodologies
- Leading teams in microservices architecture and system development
- Developing solutions with React Native and Flutter frameworks
- Troubleshooting complex issues in software engineering environments

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
- Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
- Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
- Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
- Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
- Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
- Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
- Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

The DTC ( Direct-to-Customer) business aims to leverage 50 million homes opportunity in India by providing simplified services and great and consistent customer experience. ¢ Drive discipline in store and cash compliance
¢ Simplify communication for the field executives to understand
¢ Keep team motivated through team connects, rituals and R&R
¢ Building strong relationships with internal as well as external stakeholders and resourcefulness
¢ Partner Management (in LCO towns)


¢ Broadband and network knowledge
¢ Inventory management
¢ Analytical Mindset & basic MS office
¢ Drive for results and Execution Excellence
¢ Ownership
¢ Influencing
¢ Build and maintain relationships

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
- Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
- Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
- Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
- Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
- Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
- Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
- Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Role Summary - The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management.
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page (RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high.
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc., to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants.
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation and Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner.
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc., amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies.
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants, Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO), Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV).
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS, PowerBi, Compass, Salesmate.
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise / Month Wise / Day Wise.
Transactions across accounts, denial rates, supply metrics vs competition.


Qualifications
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English.
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels.
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality.
Effective communication skills.
Attitude Aptitude for Sales.
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules.
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change and implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity and originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Job description

Job Specification:-
Position:-Sales Officer
Location :-Baramula
Experience :- 1 years +
Industry:- Nutraceutical
Channel:- General Trade/Modern Trade

Job Description:- General Trade.
1. Sales Target Achievement: Daily market visit and cover 20-25 retailers daily basis as per monthly travel plan. Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets in General Trade by expanding the distributor and retailer base.
2. Distributor Management: Build strong relationships with distributors, ensuring product availability and maintaining optimum stock levels.
3. Retailer Engagement: Conduct regular market visits to assess retailer performance, manage relationships, and ensure visibility of the brand in outlets.
4. Route Planning: Plan and execute the sales route for daily market visits to maximize coverage and improve product penetration.
5. Market Feedback: Gather feedback from retailers and distributors on pricing, promotions, competitor activity, and product acceptance.

Modern Trade (MT):
Store Management: Work closely with key accounts, supermarkets, and hypermarkets to drive sales and ensure product visibility.
Planogram Compliance: Ensure the brands products are displayed according to planogram guidelines and that promotional displays are set up correctly.
Stock Management: Monitor stock levels in stores, coordinating with supply chain and merchandising teams to avoid out-of-stock situations.
Relationship Building: Build and maintain strong relationships with store managers, buyers, and category managers to ensure smooth operations.
Promotions & Activations: Implement promotional campaigns, in-store activations, and other initiatives to boost sales and brand awareness.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets.
Growth in the number of active retailers and stores.
Improvement in product visibility and brand presence in both GT and MT.
Effective distributor and store relationship management.
Read in out-of-stock issues and improvement in stock rotation.

Description:
About us :
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Job responsibilities

AboutCompany:
Havells India Limited (Havells), one of Indias largest FMEG (Fast-Moving Electrical Goods) Company & power distribution equipment manufacturer.
Havells is among the few organizations being recognized as a Great Place to Work Certified TM Organization for the fourth consecutive year. We have also been recognized among Indias Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All Top 50.
Havells owns some of the most prestigious brands like Havells, Crabtree, Lloyd, Standard, & Reo offering a wide spectrum of products, including Industrial & Domestic Circuit Protection Devices, Cables & Wires, Motors, Fans, Modular Switches, Home Appliances, Water Heaters & Air Cooler, Grooming Products, Luminaires for Domestic, Commercial and Industrial Applications. Currently over 95% of the product offering is energy efficient and manufactured in-house which makes Havells a name synonymous with excellence and expertise in the electrical industry.
Havells, over the years, has embarked on the journey of social change through inclusive growth. Serving Mid-Day Meal to over 70,000 students across 700 schools daily in the Alwar district, building over 4000 eco-friendly bio-toilets in 400 government schools, distributing over 1,90,000 reusable sanitary napkins to girls, and planting over 17 Lakh tree saplings so far, are among few of our CSR initiatives.

Job Introduction:
Job Introduction / Roles Responsibilities
As a professionally trained Security Guard for G4S, you could be a member of the security team responsible for securing premises, such as building sites, courts, shops, warehouses, banks and factories. You would be conducting foot or vehicle patrols, controlling access at points of entry, securing equipment and people, responding to emergencies, monitoring CCTV, surveillance operative and helping to identify and prevent criminal activity.
Protect premises, property, and information
Reporting daily to the supervisor with all daily reports as per procedures
Ensuring all Policies and Procedures are adhered to at all times
All Health, Safety, and Environment instructions are to be adhered to at all times
Operating and monitoring security systems
Control the entry and exit of individuals, materials, and vehicles
Patrol on foot searching for any situations or conditions hazardous to the property or safety of a person at a site
Patrol all outside parking areas as required to ensure vehicle safety and to detect an unauthorised person
Write appropriate reports as required
Benefits and Advantages of Joining G4S
Career growth
G4S standard uniform
Job training and consistent upskilling
Salary on the 7th of every month
27 annual leaves
Annual Bonus of max 1-month salary
Gratuity (after 5 years of service)
Accidental insurance up to INR 3 lakhs
EPF 12% from the employer and 12% from the employee
ESI Health Coverage for self family
Pension applicable after 10 years continues services (Retirement age 58 years)
In case of death during the services, pension applicable of nominee and 2 children till 25 years of age and INR 75k ex-gratia and INR 3,62000/- EDLI benefits
Ideal Candidate
Minimum Education qualifications is 10th Pass
Minimum Height 5 feet and 7 inches (5 7 ) for men and 5 ft for women
Age between 18 and 35 for a fresher and up to 40 for an experienced security guard
Physically and medically fit and look like a mature person

Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart SalesAssociate

Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills

Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About Lenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include
prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.

About the Role
The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also
includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks,
dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Optometrist
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the
free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to
deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score
Following the 12-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check-up
Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive
lens while recommending the appropriate lens and/or frames
Eye check-up &
dispensing
Performing a quality check of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences
Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Product
recommendation
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due
communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the
reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Achieving sales
Vs. Plan & SOP
adherence
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment
regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Store upkeep & maintenance

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Diploma/ Bachelors in Optometry
Freshers are eligible to apply- no minimum work experience required
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
.
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
