Description:
Position: Contracts Administrator / Commercial Engineer
Experience: Below 30 Years
Qualification: BE / B.Tech Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / relevant Engineering discipline
Location: Dholera, Gujarat – Semiconductor Project
Industry: Construction / EPC / Industrial Projects
Role Objective
We are looking for a Contracts Administration / Commercial professional with 3–5 years of experience in construction/EPC projects, preferably with exposure to large industrial, semiconductor, manufacturing, data centre, cleanroom or other technically complex projects.
The candidate will be responsible for day-to-day contract administration, commercial coordination, subcontract management, measurement, billing, variation management and documentation, ensuring contractual and commercial requirements are properly monitored and closed.
Key Responsibilities
Manage day-to-day contract administration and commercial activities for the project.
Review and understand contract conditions, scope of work, BOQ, specifications and commercial terms.
Maintain and monitor contractual correspondence, notices, approvals and records.
Coordinate with project, planning, engineering, procurement and execution teams for commercial matters.
Prepare and process RA Bills / subcontractor bills, including verification of measurements and supporting documents.
Monitor work orders, subcontract agreements, amendments and commercial commitments.
Assist in preparation and evaluation of variation / extra items / deviation claims.
Track approved, pending and potential variations and maintain appropriate documentation.
Assist in preparation of claims, counterclaims and contractual submissions.
Monitor subcontractor performance against scope, milestones and contractual obligations.
Support rate analysis, reconciliation and commercial evaluation of subcontractor proposals.
Maintain cost/value records, commitments, billing and recovery statements.
Coordinate with site teams for measurement certification, reconciliation and closure of commercial issues.
Ensure timely submission of contractual notices and maintain a proper contract correspondence register.
Support preparation of monthly commercial reports, MIS and management dashboards.
Assist senior commercial/contracts team in contract closure, final accounts and settlement of outstanding issues.
Ensure proper documentation and records are maintained for audit and contractual reference.
Preferred Project Exposure
Candidates with experience in any of the following projects will be preferred:
Semiconductor / Fab / Electronics Manufacturing
Industrial / Manufacturing Projects
Data Centres
Cleanroom Projects
High-tech / MEP-intensive Projects
Large EPC / Infrastructure Projects
Large-scale Building / Industrial Construction
Semiconductor project exposure is preferred, but not mandatory. Candidates from strong commercial/contracts backgrounds in large EPC or industrial projects who are keen to work on semiconductor projects may also be considered.
Desired Competencies
Good understanding of construction contracts and commercial processes.
Working knowledge of BOQ, measurements, billing and rate analysis.
Exposure to variations, claims and contractual correspondence.
Ability to read and interpret drawings, specifications and scope documents.
Strong coordination skills with multiple project functions and subcontractors.
Good analytical and numerical skills.
Strong documentation and follow-up capability.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced project environment with tight timelines.
Willingness to work at Dholera project site and closely coordinate with execution teams.
Qualification & Experience
BE / B.Tech from a recognised institution.
3–5 years of relevant experience in Contracts / Commercial / Quantity Surveying / Project Commercial functions.
Experience in construction / EPC / industrial projects is preferred.
Candidates should demonstrate stability in previous assignments and hands-on site-level commercial exposure.

Description:
About Us
Tata Consulting Engineers Limited (TCE) is the largest Indian private sector engineering and project consultancy and an emerging global leader in integrated engineering solutions. With more than 60 years of engineering excellence, TCE has a presence in over 64 countries and over 12000 completed projects, the company operates in 3 core Industry segments -Infrastructure (Water, Environment, Urban Development, Buildings, Manufacturing Facilities, Ports and Harbours, Transportation), Power (Thermal, Hydro, Nuclear, Renewable, Transmission and Distribution) and Resources - Hydrocarbons and Chemicals (Oil, Gas and Refineries, Chemicals, Petrochemicals, Fertilizers, Speciality Chemicals, Pulp and Paper, Cement, Food, Pharmaceuticals and Beverages, Tyre, Glass) as well as Mining and Metallurgy (Mining, Geology, Beneficiation, Steel, Non-ferrous). TCE serves domestic as well as international markets and is known for several first-of-its-kind projects offering Engineering Studies, Design Engineering Services, Project Management Consultancy Services, OPEX and IIOT across all three verticals. A part of Tata Group - India’s most respected group, TCE is a 100 percent subsidiary of Tata Sons Limited Design your Future with us At TCE, you will experience a supportive environment that empowers you to excel, whether you are based in our offices or at a client site. We embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, fostering a workplace where every individual can thrive by contributing their unique skills and perspectives to deliver exceptional results for our clients. Our comprehensive compensation and benefits packages are designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families, complemented by a robust global well-being program. As a leading global infrastructure firm, we are committed to your growth and success, offering access to cutting-edge technology and impactful projects that offer flexibility and significant professional opportunities. Join us and become part of a global company that values your potential and supports your career development.
Purpose & Scope of Position
Working Engineer (WE) will be part of an engineering team providing engineering services to large and small projects. WE is responsible for engineering in a 3D environment and production of 3D models and 2D drawings in accordance with project requirements under the supervision of the Project Engineer (PE). WE is required to apply specialized and/or advanced engineering principles at conceptual and detailed level. The WE participates in a wide range of projects and the activities include modeling and drafting for detailed engineering phase for multi-disciplinary projects.
Experience
• 1-4 years of experience in relevant design discipline • Experience in engineering packages
Qualification
• Postgraduate or graduate in an engineering discipline
Key Responsibilities
1. Assist the PE with the delivery of project requirements as they relate to scope, quantities, quality, cost and schedule 2. Responsible to work in an integrated 3D environment and produce design calculations, reports, specifications, evaluation reports, technical recommendations and, 3D models and 2D drawings as per project requirements 3. Produce and maintain technical and engineering deliverables using 2D and 3D engineering software as required 4. Facilitate the sharing of technical expertise across projects including archival of project documents. 5. Provide and/or participate in training for resources assigned to the project 6. Perform conceptual layout work 7. Develop design details, prepare / extract drawings and check the deliverables prior to release 8. Ensure coordination with engineers within the discipline and with other disciplines 9. Co-ordinate and review clash detection in an integrated model with other discipline engineers and resolve issues if any 10. Participate in formal engineering review processes 11. Review vendor drawings and documents including archival and inputs to other disciplines 12. Represents the discipline during site visit / client meetings as felt necessary by PE/PM. 13. Support technology team/ Project team for development and automation works as required.

Drives Results
Demonstrates Self-Awareness
Ensures Accountability
Instills Trust
Persuades
Resourcefulness
Decision Quality
Situational Adaptability
Manages Complexity
Being Resilient

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Network Engineer to manage, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure during the warranty and Operations & Maintenance (O&M) period. The candidate will be responsible for network availability, incident resolution, configuration management, preventive maintenance, and coordination with OEM support teams to ensure compliance with project SLAs.

Key Responsibilities
Install, configure, operate, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure, including switches, routers, wireless access points, and firewalls.
Monitor network device health, availability, performance, and connectivity.
Troubleshoot complex LAN/WAN, routing, switching, wireless, and network security issues.
Configure and manage VLANs, IP addressing, routing protocols, trunking, and access ports.
Support firewall operations, security policies, network segmentation, and connectivity troubleshooting.
Perform preventive maintenance, configuration backups, firmware upgrades, and security patch deployment.
Log, track, escalate, and resolve network incidents within the prescribed SLA timelines.
Coordinate with OEM Technical Assistance Centres (TACs) and backend support teams for advanced troubleshooting and incident resolution.
Support network monitoring and management platforms for performance analysis and fault detection.
Maintain network diagrams, configuration records, asset inventories, incident logs, and maintenance reports.
Perform physical verification of network equipment and support network expansion, upgrades, audits, and acceptance testing.
Prepare and submit periodic reports, preventive maintenance reports, and incident status updates as required under the RFP.
Provide technical support during emergencies, planned maintenance, and service restoration activities, including outside normal working hours when required.
Ensure compliance with customer policies, change management procedures, security standards, and project SLA requirements.

Technical Skills Required
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, routing, switching, and network troubleshooting.
Hands-on experience with VLANs, inter-VLAN routing, static routing, OSPF, and other relevant routing protocols.
Experience with enterprise switches, routers, and wireless networking solutions.
Knowledge of firewalls, network security policies, and network segmentation.
Familiarity with network monitoring and management systems.
Experience with configuration backup, firmware upgrades, and network documentation.
Good incident management, problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills.

Educational Qualification and Experience
BE/B.Tech in Information Technology (IT), Electronics & Communication (EC), or Computer Science (CS).
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in enterprise networking, implementation, operation, and maintenance.
Valid OEM certification relevant to the proposed network solution, as required by the RFP.
Experience in onsite technical support and enterprise network infrastructure management is preferred.

Performance Expectations
Maintain network availability and support timely incident resolution.
Meet prescribed SLA response and restoration timelines.
Complete preventive maintenance and reporting activities on schedule.
Maintain accurate network documentation and configuration records.
Ensure effective coordination with OEMs and backend teams.

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Network Technician specializing in passive networking infrastructure. The candidate will be responsible for structured cabling installation, fiber-optic cabling, cable termination, testing, rack installation, patch panel management, and troubleshooting of passive network infrastructure at customer sites.

Key Responsibilities
Install and maintain structured cabling infrastructure, including Cat6/Cat6A UTP and FTP cables.
Perform cable laying, routing, dressing, termination, and labeling as per project standards.
Install and terminate patch panels, information outlets, faceplates, keystone jacks, and network racks.
Perform fiber-optic cable laying, splicing coordination, termination, and testing.
Work with fiber-optic LIUs, ODFs, pigtails, patch cords, and fiber distribution panels.
Conduct cable testing and certification using LAN cable testers and fiber testing equipment such as OTDR and optical power meters, where applicable.
Perform rack installation, patch cord management, cable dressing, and equipment labeling.
Identify and rectify cable faults, connectivity issues, and termination defects.
Prepare cable routing records, port mapping, labeling schedules, and as-built documentation.
Assist with installation and connectivity testing of switches, routers, and wireless access points.
Perform physical verification and preventive maintenance of passive network infrastructure.
Coordinate with the Network Engineer, project team, and site supervisor for installation, testing, and commissioning activities.
Follow site safety procedures and maintain installation quality as per project specifications.
Support site inspections, testing, commissioning, and customer acceptance activities.

Technical Skills Required
Hands-on experience with Cat6/Cat6A structured cabling.
Knowledge of copper cable termination, patch panels, I/O outlets, and keystone jacks.
Experience in fiber-optic cabling, LIU/ODF installation, and fiber patching.
Basic knowledge of fiber splicing and testing using OTDR and optical power meters.
Experience in network rack installation, cable dressing, and labeling.
Ability to read cable layouts, floor plans, and network infrastructure drawings.
Basic understanding of LAN connectivity and network troubleshooting.
Knowledge of cable testing, documentation, and quality standards.

Educational Qualification and Experience
ITI/ Diploma in IT, Electronics, Computer Hardware, Telecommunications, or a related field.
Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in passive networking and structured cabling projects.
Experience in commercial buildings, data centers, campuses, or enterprise networking projects is preferred.
Relevant structured cabling or fiber-optic certification will be an added advantage.

Description:
Job Summary
As an Associate in the Financial Institutions Group Client Support team, you will provide consultative support for business intelligence tools and financial data products. You will manage complex client queries, troubleshoot data-related issues, and help clients maximize the value of our platforms.
You will act as a client advocate, working closely with Sales, Product, Technology, Content, and Industry Research teams to improve the client experience, support data quality initiatives, and contribute to product adoption and revenue growth.


The Team
The Financial Institutions Group team provides specialized support to clients across financial institutions, government organizations, universities, and other market participants. With team members across multiple global locations, the team operates in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
Associates develop strong subject matter expertise in financial institutions, banking regulations, mortgage data, demographic research, asset-level analytics, and market intelligence workflows.


The Impact
In this role, you will help strengthen client relationships by delivering timely, accurate, and consultative support. Your work will contribute to client retention, product usage, operational efficiency, and overall client satisfaction.
You will also help identify product enhancement opportunities, improve internal workflows, and support initiatives that enhance data quality and platform usability.


Responsibilities
Provide advanced client support via phone, email, and chat, resolving complex and data-intensive inquiries.
Conduct investigative client conversations to understand business needs, troubleshoot issues, and recommend effective solutions.
Act as a client advocate by identifying opportunities to improve product usability, data quality, and presentation.
Build customized Excel models, templates, and workflows using multiple datasets, including data not directly available on the platform.
Support clients in using mapping tools for mortgage, demographic, asset-level, and market analysis.
Partner with Product and Technology teams to test new features, enhancements, and platform updates with a focus on the end-user experience.
Lead proactive outreach campaigns related to product enhancements, new datasets, and workflow improvements.
Conduct client webcasts and product demonstrations, showcasing knowledge of FIG products, data, and industry trends.
Create Salesforce reports and analyze support trends to improve workflows, team procedures, and client outcomes.
Lead assigned projects from planning through execution and identify opportunities for process improvement.
Mentor new hires and junior team members through training, knowledge sharing, and best-practice development.
Collaborate with global teams across Sales, Product, Technology, Content, and Industry Research to resolve complex client issues.


What We're Looking For

Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Business, or a related field.
Strong understanding of finance, capital markets, banking, or the global economy.
Prior experience in client support, financial data, research, product support, or a related role preferred.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly and professionally.
Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.
Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across global, cross-functional teams.
Strong working knowledge of MS Excel and common business tools.
Ability to learn and apply tools such as SQL, Salesforce, mapping platforms, and financial data products.
Flexibility to work rotational shifts and weekends based on business requirements.
AboutCompany: S&P Capital IQ, a business line of The McGraw-Hill Companies (NYSE:MHP), is a leading provider of multi-asset class and real time data, research and analytics to institutional investors, investment and commercial banks, investment advisors and wealth managers, corporations and universities around the world. We provide a broad suite of capabilities designed to help track performance, generate alpha, and identify new trading and investment ideas, and perform risk analysis and mitigation strategies. Through leading desktop solutions such as the S&P Capital IQ, Global Credit Portal and MarketScope Advisor desktops; enterprise solutions such as S&P Capital IQ Valuations, and Compustat; and research offerings, including Leveraged Commentary & Data, Global Markets Intelligence, and company and funds research, S&P Capital IQ sharpens financial intelligence into the wisdom today's investors need.

Description:
The opportunity

Hitachi Energy is currently looking for dynamic personnel in Quality Assurance Team at Insulation Kit Center for the Transformers Business to join their team in Halol, India, where we have two state of the art insulation kit centers. These kit centers are supplying insulation kits for all major large power transformer manufacturers in India as well as Hitachi Factories in HUB APMEA. This team seeks a skilled and motivated individual.
Transformers BU team leverages innovative and diverse technology to transform energy, delivering social, environmental, and economic value and enabling a sustainable energy future for current and future generations. The business's comprehensive portfolio includes power transformers, traction transformers, insulation and components, digital sensors, and transformer services.The ideal candidate must enjoy working in a dynamic, fast-paced business environment. He or she must be flexible in accommodating business requirements and experience in working with diverse groups and cultures. The ability to multitask & deliver within timelines is essential. The candidate will have excellent communications skills. The job requires travelling to visit customers when needed.


How you'll make an impact
Develops and implements quality assurance strategies and plans to enhance production quality, efficiency, and effectiveness.
Lead QMS and ensure the system established is fulfilling the ISO requirements such as Functional requirements, Audit requirements, regular review of ISO processes and upgrade them for continuous improvement. Provides internal reporting on quality assurance activities, progress, and outcomes to relevant stakeholders.
Utilizes data-driven insights to drive/contribute decision-making and implement necessary process improvements.
Conducts training programs and workshops to promote quality awareness to develop the skills of manufacturing personnel.
Collaborates with manufacturing teams to address customer-specific quality requirements. Assist in analyzing customer feedback and identifying areas for improvement.
Participate in cross functional projects aimed at improving product quality through manufacturing/assembly process improvements.
Participates in development and implementation of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions to mitigate process risks. Conducts process audits and inspections to verify compliance with process risk mitigation measures.
Conducts comprehensive risk assessments for manufacturing/assembly processes to identify potential risks by performing activities like failure mode and effects analysis (PFMEA).
Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
Involves in PPAP and supplier development activities and lead with cross functional team till supplier onboarding in line with the global Hitachi guidelines.
Incoming quality inspections and maintaining relevant data and records, supporting suppliers for improving their QMS and rejection rates and processes.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your background
Diploma / B. E. / B. Tech in Electrical / Mechanical engineering
Relevant experience 6 to 8 years in quality assurance function at any large transformers manufacturing unit.
Experience in Transformer Insulation Kits manufacturing will be an added advantage
Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt Certified

Description:
Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytms B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytms PA PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. Indias largest digital lending story is brewing here. Its your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

Objective:

Principal Accountabilities / Key Responsibilities
F Develop, obtain approval and implement a strategic sales and marketing plan for domestic and export markets, with focus on PP Compounding and non-auto plastic applications.

F Non -Automotive Industry

F Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, distributors, and partners.
F Drive Metal-to-Plastic and polymer material replacement projects
F Manage key accounts to achieve sales targets and customer satisfaction
Customer, Key Account Management & Relationships:
F Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers and Non-Auto OEM accounts.
F Understand customer needs in terms of products, technologies, processing (injection moulding) and service expectations.
F Act as a senior interface between the Co. and key non-auto customers.
F Managing key client relationships and ensuring consistent sales performance across all regions.
F Coordinate customer requirements, forecasts, dispatches and inventory planning
F Participate in exhibitions, seminars, technical presentations and customer meetings

F Promote a culture of performance, accountability, knowledge sharing and ethical conduct.

1. BE with 12 to 20+ years of progressive commercial and sales leadership experience specifically within engineering plastics (PBT/ PA/ PP/ PC/ ABS/ ASA /PET/ PMMA/ Nylon/ Poly/ POM Blends) or chemical raw materials.
2. Proven experience in new project development
3. Strong technical understanding of polymer applications and material selection
4. Strong sales, business development and negotiation skills
5. Strong exposure to Plastic Injection Moulding processes and their linkage with material performance.
6. Hands-on experience handling Non- Auto Industry suppliers and OEM businesses.
7. Proven sales track record and experience in customer support (preferred).
8. Strong communication and negotiation skills.
9. Ability to build rapport quickly and maintain strong client relationships.
10. Effective time management and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
11. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
12. Willingness to travel PAN India

Description:
Job Summary
Meet the Team At Splunk and Cisco, we believe in turning data into answers. We are a team of passionate innovators in the Customer Success Experience organization, committed to our customers success, our product s evolution, and, most importantly, each other s growth. Together, we help clients navigate the complex landscape of modern cyber defense and redefine how the world interacts with machine data.
Your Impact
As a Professional Services Architect (Security), you will be the technical and strategic authority for our Security portfolio and a Trusted Advisor to our customers. You will architect solutions across our SIEM and SOAR ecosystems, including Splunk Enterprise Security, UEBA, and SOAR. You isn t just deploying software; you are architecting outcomes that protect organizations from the next generation of threats, with the opportunity to take ownership of your work, learn from industry leaders, and play a vital role in a team that celebrates collective success. This role requires regional travel of up to 30%.
Responsibilities
Architect Complex Solutions: Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of security deployments, from initial strategy and integration to ongoing optimization.
Drive Innovation: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to influence product roadmaps and develop new strategies that redefine how customers monitor their infrastructure.
Act as a Trusted Advisor: Engage at all levels, from C-suite stakeholders to technical engineers, to ensure operational success and strategic alignment.
Empower the Customer: Enable client teams to manage, scale, and solve complex security challenges independently.
Foster Growth: Champion a culture of continuous improvement, mentoring team members and contributing to a collaborative, high-performance environment.
Minimum Qualifications
5+ years of experience in a Security Operations Centre (SOC), security consulting, or security sales engineering.
Proven success implementing and architecting SIEM software.
Strong background in Cloud IaaS (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and 3+ years of experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes and Docker).
Proficiency in at least two of the following: Python, Java, .NET, PHP, Ruby, Node.JS, Objective-C; comfortable working across both Unix and Windows command lines.
Experience with automation/orchestration tools (Ansible, Puppet, Chef, or Terraform).
Preferred Qualifications
A high sense of urgency and the ability to manage competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical problems into business-value conversations.
A self-starter mindset with a passion for continuous learning and professional development.
Experience creating technical documentation (architecture diagrams, white papers, etc.).
Bonus: Knowledge of Splunk administration or statistical and analytical modeling.

Data Warehouse Testing Engineer - Job Description

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
Keywords for Resume Screening
Data Warehouse Testing, ETL Testing, SQL, Data Validation, Data Reconciliation, Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, Ab Initio, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact Tables, Dimension Tables, SCD, Data Migration Testing, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Redshift, BigQuery, Tableau, Power BI, JIRA, Agile.
Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience

PERFECT PLACER (www.perfectplacer.com), Promoted by a team of dedicated professionals with varied background, having comprehensive and extensive industry and consultancy exposure, is “One of the most preferred and referred consultants” today in Executive Search & Placement.

PERFECT PLACER in less than half a decade has grown to be a force to reckon with, having offices in Mumbai, Chennai, Bangalore, and New Delhi.

Perfect Placer along with its associate services has a long and prestigious list of leading Indian and Multinational Corporates in India and Outside across Managerial levels, functions, and Industries, covering both IT and Non-IT specialized in chief executive, board member and senior-level management search assignments.

General Manager Sales & Marketing (Engineering Polymers / Plastics)
You are responsible for leading the commercial, technical, and strategic growth for high-performance plastics and compounds.
Drive revenue, expand market share, manage P&L (Profit & Loss), and building B2B partnerships and oversee commodity polymer trends (PP, PE, PVC), negotiate high-volume contracts, manage strategic distributor relationships, and direct technical marketing for high-performance thermoplastics (e.g., Nylon, PEEK, Polycarbonates, customized polymer compounds) across target industrial segments.
Key Responsibilities:
Strategic & Financial Leadership
F P&L Management: Own revenue targets, gross contribution margins, pricing strategies, and annual budgeting for engineering polymer lines.
F Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy: Formulate and execute regional or global business development plans to scale market presence.
F Market & Competitor Analysis: Track raw material pricing volatility (petrochemical trends), freight costs, and competitor benchmarks.
Business Development & Key Accounts
F OEM & Processor Relationships: Build direct relationships with major OEMs, tier-1/tier-2 suppliers, and injection moulders/converters.
F Product Substitution: Drive metal-to-plastic or standard-to-engineering polymer conversion initiatives.
F Channel Management: Establish, evaluate, and manage distributor and channel partner networks.
Commodity Market Analysis
F Monitor petrochemical pricing fluctuations, global supply chain bottlenecks, global commodity trends (PP, PE, PVC, PET), currency fluctuations, and competitor pricing to manage risk and optimize trading margins.
B2B Brand Management
F Build brand equity and trust among suppliers (refineries/producers), logistics providers, and industrial buyers.
Commercial Strategy & Trading
F Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for trading commodity and engineering polymers.
Technical & Cross-Functional Coordination
F Technical Sales Support: Collaborate with R&D, production, and quality assurance teams to define technical specifications (MFI, density, impact, tensile strength, fillers) and manage customer trials.
F Product Development: Guide sample testing, custom grade development, and compliance validation for client applications.
Team Management
F Leadership & Mentoring: Direct, coach, and evaluate regional sales managers, technical application engineers, and account executives.
F Performance Tracking: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) including sales volume in metric tons, customer acquisition rates, and collection cycles.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Revenue Growth: Target achievement in sales volume and overall market share.
Profitability: Margin optimization against global commodity volatility.
Supplier & Client Acquisition: Diversity of supplier networks and conversion of B2B key accounts.
Risk-adjusted Return on Capital (RAROC): Management of credit cycles, inventory holding, and trade logistics.
Gross profit margins on plastic raw materials and compounding resins.
Sales volume (in Metric Tons) vs. quarterly/annual forecasts.
Customer acquisition rates and retention in key end-use verticals.
Inventory turnover and logistical cost optimization

Preferred candidate profile
1. Bachelor of Engineering in Polymer or Plastics Chemical or related Engineering Field is a must with MBA in Marketing is strongly preferred with 12 to 20+ years of progressive commercial and sales leadership experience specifically within engineering plastics, polymer compounding, or chemical raw materials.
2. Strong grasp of polymer rheology, resin properties, application engineering, and ERP/CRM tools (e.g., SAP, Salesforce).
3. B2B contract negotiation, high-volume account management, cross-functional leadership, and data-driven forecasting
4. Proficiency in data-driven decision-making, supply-demand forecasting, and CRM utilization.
5. Ability to communicate complex market intelligence to C-suite executives and board members.
6. Decisive leadership when navigating volatile commodity markets or supply chain crises.

Remuneration:
An outstanding remuneration package that rewards professionalism and diligence will be on offer for the successful applicant as well as a well-defined career path. An excellent package will be on offer for the right candidate, including an above-mentioned industry base salary for the right person as well as the most complete employee benefit scheme. Description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
A Day in the Life
The Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) business partners with healthcare professionals across India to expand access to therapies that help diagnose and treat cardiac rhythm disorders. This role is part of the downstream marketing function, responsible for developing and executing portfolio strategy, supporting product launches, driving therapy adoption, and enabling commercial success across a diverse healthcare landscape. The position works closely with regional sales teams and cross-functional partners to execute market development initiatives, strengthen customer engagement, and support business growth for the CRM portfolio.
This position can be based in Gurgaon or Mumbai and follows a Flex work model. Travel up to 10% is required to support customer engagement, field collaboration, industry events, and strategic business initiatives across India.
As a Senior Marketing Specialist, you will lead downstream marketing initiatives for the Cardiac Rhythm Management portfolio across India. The role combines strategic planning, commercial execution, market development, and stakeholder engagement to drive portfolio growth. You will collaborate with global and regional teams, translate market insights into actionable strategies, and partner with sales teams to improve customer engagement, therapy adoption, and business performance.
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.
Develop and execute portfolio marketing plans, including competitive positioning, pricing strategy, revenue forecasting, budget management, and brand initiatives.
Partner with global marketing teams to adapt regional strategies and implement market-specific growth plans.
Lead product launch activities, including clinical messaging, pricing recommendations, sales enablement, and customer engagement programs.
Manage inventory planning, demand forecasting, and portfolio performance to support business objectives and minimize obsolescence.
Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities, market trends, and customer needs.
Drive market development and patient awareness initiatives through physician engagement, digital campaigns, educational programs, and therapy adoption activities.
Build and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders, healthcare stakeholders, and industry partners to support therapy expansion and portfolio growth.
Collaborate with sales, regulatory, legal, clinical, public relations, and research and development teams to ensure aligned and effective execution of marketing strategies.
Required Qualifications
Requires a Baccalaureate degree (or for degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree which satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. • 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) and minimum of 4 years of relevant experience, or advanced degree with a minimum of 3 years relevant experience.
Experience developing and executing marketing strategies, product launches, and commercial growth initiatives.
Experience in market analysis, forecasting, pricing strategy, and business planning.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and managing multiple stakeholders.
Experience presenting business insights and recommendations to customers, sales teams, or leadership audiences.
 Preferred Qualifications
Master of Business Administration.
Experience in medical devices, cardiovascular therapies, cardiac rhythm management, or related healthcare markets.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint for business analysis and presentations.
Experience leading physician engagement, therapy awareness, or market development initiatives.
Experience working with global teams and supporting regional portfolio growth strategies.

Description:
Job Title: Associate Director Anchor Business (Supply Chain Finance)

Experience: 10 to 12 years

Location: Mumbai and Delhi

Role Overview

We are looking for a seasoned business leader to head the Anchor Business vertical within Retail Supply Chain Finance. The role focuses on onboarding and managing large anchor corporates, structuring SCF programs, and driving scale through dealer/vendor ecosystems across India. The ideal candidate will bring strong corporate relationship skills, structured finance understanding, and execution excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Anchor Origination & Relationship Management
Originate and onboard large anchor corporates across manufacturing, FMCG, auto, durables, building materials, and other retail-heavy sectors.
Build long-term strategic relationships with CFOs, Treasury, Procurement, and Supply Chain heads.
Structure end-to-end SCF programs aligned to anchor cash flow cycles and risk appetite.
Drive commercial negotiations including pricing, limits, documentation, and program terms.
Program Structuring & Scaling
Design scalable dealer/vendor financing programs linked to anchor supply chains.
Enable rapid onboarding of dealers/vendors in collaboration with counterparty and operations teams.
Ensure seamless coordination across credit, legal, operations, and technology for program rollout.
Drive volume growth, utilization, and stickiness across live anchor programs.
Portfolio & Risk Oversight
Own portfolio performance at the anchor level, including utilization, yield, and credit quality.
Monitor early warning signals, concentration risks, and program-level exposures.
Work closely with risk and collections teams to manage stress scenarios and resolution strategies.
Ensure compliance with internal credit policies and regulatory guidelines.
Internal & External Stakeholder Management
Act as the single-point owner for anchor relationships internally.
Collaborate with product, tech, risk, and operations teams to continuously improve SCF offerings.
Represent the organization in senior-level discussions with anchors and ecosystem partners.
Key Competencies
Strong understanding of Supply Chain Finance / Dealer & Vendor Financing structures.
Proven experience in managing large corporate (anchor) relationships.
Ability to structure and scale programs across Tier 1/2/3 geographies.
Strong commercial, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Sound understanding of credit, risk, and portfolio dynamics.

Ideal Candidate Profile

1012 years of experience in SCF / Corporate Banking / Transaction Banking / NBFC SCF businesses.
Prior experience handling anchor-led SCF programs is mandatory.
Entrepreneurial mindset with strong execution orientation.
Ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth NBFC environment.
Hands-on leader with strong ownership mindset.
AboutCompany:
About Vivriti Group
Vivriti Group is a trailblazer in the mid-market lending space, offering customized debt solutions to mid-sized enterprises. The group operates through two core businesses:
Vivriti Capital Limited: A systematically important Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC ND-SI) regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). Vivriti Capital has disbursed over USD 3 billion to 300+ enterprise borrowers and holds a CRISIL rating of A+.
Vivriti Asset Management: A fixed-income fund manager, managing multiple Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs). With over USD 550 million in commitments from 900+ institutional and private contributors, Vivriti AMC has invested more than USD 600 million across 90+ entities.

Job Title: Senior Associate / Project Leader Market Access
Job Location: -Gurgaon/Noida/Bangalore/Pune/Hyderabad
Job Summary: - This role will be responsible for market access/payer analytics, analyzing payer and patient-level data to deliver robust insights and solutions to client.
Job Responsibilities:-
Collaborate with cross-functional and cross-geographic teams to deliver high-impact Market Access, pricing, payer analytics, and contracting insights for global pharma clients
Work closely with project managers to define the analytical approach, break down complex access problems into structured execution steps, and ensure high-quality delivery
Contribute towards Axtria tools and capabilities as per the business requirements.
Build organization capabilities by participating in Hackathon, solution design, and process automation
Present analytical findings and strategic recommendations to onshore/client stakeholders through clear, compelling slide decks and discussions.

Job Requirements:-
34+ years of experience in the Pharmaceutical / Life Sciences Domain
We are looking for candidates with strong exposure to Market Access, Payer Analytics and commercial pharmaceutical analytics
Solid understanding of pharmaceutical contracting entities and landscape, including commercial, Medicaid, Medicare, formulary tiers, prior authorization, step edits, rebates, contracting and affordability programs
Hands-on experience working with payer-related datasets such as APLD, eLAAD, EMR, claims, formulary data, specialty data and prescription data.
Proven ability to structure ambiguous access-related problems, design analytical methodologies, and translate complex analyses into actionable Market Access insights
Ability to handle a variety of projects ranging from advanced analytics, ad-hoc analysis to reporting, collaborate effectively, and work in fast-paced, global client environments.
Technical requirements Excel, SQL, Python, PowerBI and knowledge of self-service analytics platforms like Dataiku will be an added advantage
Strong communication, project management, and storyboarding skills
Familiarity with advanced analytics, statistical modelling, or forecasting techniques is a plus.

Must-Have Skills:-
Strong expertise in Payer Analytics and hands-on work with patient and payer-level datasets
Proficiency in SQL, Python, Excel, and dashboarding using Power BI

Skills that give you an edge: -
Experience using Dataiku for data preparation, automation, and analytics workflows
Good to have work experience in building statistical modelling and/or AI/ML models using Python/R

We will provide: -
An inclusive environment that encourages diverse perspectives and ideas
A challenging and unique opportunity to contribute to the success of a transforming organization
Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
Vast opportunities for self-development: online Axtria Institute, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
Possibility to relocate to any Axtria office for short and long-term projects
Benefit package:
-Health Insurance benefits
-Retirement benefits
-Paid time off
-Flexible Benefits
-Hybrid working

About Axtria:

Axtria is a global provider of award-winning cloud software and data analytics to the life sciences industry. Axtria enables life sciences organizations to transform the product commercialization journey and deliver much-improved healthcare outcomes for patients worldwide. We are acutely aware that our work impacts millions of people and are incredibly passionate about the improvement we can bring to patients lives. Our focus is on delivering solutions that help pharmaceutical, medical device, and diagnostics companies complete the journey from data to insights to action and get superior returns from their investments. As a participant of the United Nations Global Compact, Axtria is committed to aligning strategies and operations with universal principles on human rights, labor, environment, and anti-corruption and taking actions that advance societal goals. Our people are our core strength, and they make us proud of our work; this has helped us grow exponentially and make tremendous strides toward developing great products. It is for the grit, thinking of an entrepreneur, and a family-like environment where each member is valued and treasured that we are growing rapidly. For more information.

Visit www.axtria.com

Description:
The Role
We are looking for a marketing intelligence leader who combines marketing and pipeline expertise with data science and AI to proactively monitor and optimize performance. This role will lead the development of predictive models that identify emerging risks and opportunities, diagnose performance drivers, and translate insights into actions that improve campaign, pipeline, and business outcomes.
 Location- Bangalore/Noida
Role- Individual Contributor
Shift- 2.00pm-11.00pm IST

Key Responsibilities
Marketing & Pipeline Performance Intelligence
Analyze performance across campaigns, funnel conversion, pipeline creation and progression, sales, revenue, and ROI.
Identify trends, performance gaps, risks, and opportunities across campaigns, channels, audiences, segments, and pipeline.
Diagnose what is driving performance and where intervention is needed.
Translate findings into actionable recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.
Data Science & Proactive Monitoring
Lead the design and deployment of predictive, forecasting, pacing, and anomaly-detection models to proactively monitor marketing and pipeline performance.
Build scalable early-warning capabilities that detect meaningful changes and emerging performance risks and opportunities.
Use advanced analytics to understand what changed, why it changed, and what is likely to happen next.
Campaign Optimization & Partnership
Partner closely with Marketing Operations, Product Marketing, Campaign Strategy, and Digital Experience to translate insights into action.
Recommend opportunities to optimize campaign strategy, audiences, channels, investment, execution, and activation.
Measure the impact of optimization actions and incorporate learnings into future analyses and models.
AI & Analytics Automation
Apply AI and automation to accelerate monitoring, forecasting, diagnostics, and insight generation.
Automate recurring analytical processes and build scalable performance intelligence solutions.
Partner with Marketing Operations and technology teams to operationalize models and analytics.
Executive Insights
Translate complex analytics into clear, decision-ready business insights and recommendations.
Communicate what is happening, why it matters, and what action should be taken.
Provide leadership with a proactive view of the marketing and pipeline risks and opportunities that require attention.
Qualifications
8+ years of experience in marketing analytics, data science, performance intelligence, or advanced analytics.
Hands-on data science experience designing, building, validating, and deploying predictive and proactive monitoring models, including forecasting and anomaly detection.
Deep understanding of B2B marketing and pipeline performance, including campaigns, funnel conversion, pipeline creation and progression, sales, revenue, attribution, and ROI.
Proven ability to diagnose performance drivers and translate model outputs and analytical insights into actionable marketing recommendations.
Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using AI, automation, and modern analytics platforms.
Strong business acumen, problem-solving, executive communication, and cross-functional partnership skills.
Success in This Role
Marketing identifies performance risks and opportunities earlier.
Teams understand where performance is changing, why, and what action to take.
Predictive monitoring reduces reliance on retrospective reporting.
Marketing gains greater visibility into campaign effectiveness and pipeline creation, progression, and conversion.
AI and automation enable faster, more scalable performance intelligence.
Leadership receives clear recommendations connecting marketing activity to pipeline and business outcomes.

Network Implementation Engineer
Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Pune, Noida
Immediate joiners preferred

Experience: 3+ Years

Skills:
Experience: 3+ years of hands-on deployment and migration experience specifically
within production networks.
Education Graduate from any stream (Engineering graduates preferred) or
equivalent practical field experience.
Certifications (Required or Strongly Preferred):
Cisco CCNA (minimum prerequisite if accompanied by deep field

Cisco CCNA Wireless is a strong plus.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Implement and configure Router and Switches in enterprise environment.
Replacement and migration of EOL router and Switches in enterprise setup.
Understating and experience on ACL and Qos configuration.
Bootstrap and apply golden configurations across Cisco Catalyst

Run post-cutover operational verification: ARP/MAC table validation, OSPF/BGP
neighbor adjacency checks, STP root bridge verification, and interface error
monitoring.
Implement and configure APs and WLC in enterprise environment.
Perform AP onboarding, provisioning and configuration on WLC.
Configure SSID, WLAN, Vlan Mapping and Wireless authentication policies.
Configure AP groups, RF profile, Power Settings, Mobility and roaming
parameters.
Perform WLC Software upgrade, SSL certificate installation.

Executive / Asst. Manager - Direct Tax
To support the Direct Tax function in managing tax compliance, litigation, assessments and tax advisory matters, while ensuring timely execution, effective risk management appropriate tax governance across the organization.
Key Responsibilities
1. Direct Tax Compliance
F Manage and review regular direct tax compliances including advance tax, incme-tax return, TDS/TCS and related filings.
F Coordinate with Finance/Accounts teams for accurate and timely tax data and reconciliations.
F Review tax positions arising from business transactions and ensure appropriate tax treatment.
F Monitor changes in the Income-tax Act, rules, circulars and judicial developments and assess their impact on the Company.
2. Tax Litigation & Assessments
F Handle ongoing income-tax assessments, appeals and other tax proceedings in coordination with external tax advisors.
F Prepare factual submissions, tax positions and supporting documentation for tax authorities.
F Maintain litigation trackers, monitor timelines and ensure timely responses to notices.
F Assist in developing litigation strategy and identifying key tax risks and opportunities.
3. Tax Advisory / Business Support
F Provide tax inputs on business transactions, contracts, investments, capital expenditure and other commercial matters.
F Analyse tax implications of proposed transactions and support business teams in making tax-efficient and compliant decisions.
F Assist in evaluating tax implications of new projects, expansion/capex and business restructuring.
F Coordinate with Legal, Secretarial, Finance, Commercial, Treasury and other stakeholders on tax matters.
4. Tax Accounting & Reporting
F Support computation and review of current tax and deferred tax in coordination with Finance/Accounts and auditors.
F Assist in preparation of tax provisions, tax reconciliations and tax-related disclosures.
F Support statutory and internal audit requirements relating to direct tax.
5. Tax Governance & Process Improvement
F Identify opportunities to strengthen tax processes, controls and documentation.
F Drive reconciliation and automation initiatives in direct tax compliance and reporting.
F Maintain appropriate documentation and audit trails for key tax positions.
F Assist in developing SOPs and tax governance frameworks.
6. Transfer Pricing / International Tax
F Support transfer pricing compliance, including documentation, benchmarking and filings.
F Assist in reviewing cross-border transactions and international tax implications.
F Coordinate with external advisors on transfer pricing and other international tax matters.

Preferred candidate profile
1. CA Inter or related discipline with 4-5 years of experience in a large manufacturing / listed company
2. Strong working knowledge of Income-tax Act, TDS/TCS and tax litigation.
3. Experience in handling assessments, notices and tax authority correspondence.
4. Good understanding of tax accounting, deferred tax and basic Ind AS 12 concepts.
5. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
6. Ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines.
7. Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.
8. Strong Excel and tax-research skills
9. Exposure to tax technology/automation.

Brief about the Team & Fractal
Fractal partners with Fortune 500 organizations to unlock business value through AI, Data, Cloud, and Digital Transformation. We combine deep domain expertise, advanced analytics, generative AI, and cloud technologies to help clients accelerate innovation, optimize operations, and drive measurable business outcomes. As organizations increasingly adopt cloud-first strategies, AWS plays a critical role in enabling scalable, secure, and data-driven transformation journeys.

Role Summary:
The Client Partner - Head of AWS is responsible for driving AWS-led business growth, expanding strategic client relationships, owning practice P&L, and delivering large-scale cloud transformation programs. This leader will serve as the executive sponsor for key client engagements, strengthen Fractals partnership with AWS, and help clients leverage AWS services to accelerate AI, Analytics, Data, and Digital modernization initiatives.
The role requires a blend of executive client engagement, cloud consulting expertise, sales leadership, alliance management, and business operations to scale the AWS practice.
Roles & Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership
Define and execute the growth strategy for Fractals AWS Practice, aligned with the organizations overall business objectives.
Own the AWS Practice P&L, including revenue growth, margins, utilization, and overall business performance.
Develop offerings, accelerators, solution assets, and industry-specific cloud transformation propositions.
Collaborate with leadership teams to identify emerging market opportunities and expand AWS-led services.
Client Partnership & Business Growth
Build and manage executive relationships with C-level stakeholders across strategic accounts.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients on cloud transformation, modernization, AI/ML, data platform, and generative AI initiatives.
Drive account mining, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities across existing and new clients.
Lead strategic pursuits and large transformation deals from opportunity identification through closure.
Develop account growth plans and oversee pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue realization.

AWS Alliance & Ecosystem Management
Serve as the primary leadership interface between Fractal and AWS.
Strengthen relationships with AWS sales, solution architecture, and partner teams.
Drive joint go-to-market initiatives, co-selling opportunities, AWS-funded programs, and marketplace engagements.
Ensure alignment with AWS partner competencies, specializations, and certifications.
Represent Fractal in AWS industry events, leadership forums, and customer engagements.
Practice & Talent Leadership
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of AWS architects, consultants, engineers, and client partners.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Drive capability development across Cloud, Data, AI/ML, Security, Modernization, and GenAI on AWS.
Establish career development frameworks and succession plans within the AWS practice.
Service Delivery Excellence
Oversee successful delivery of AWS transformation programs across clients and industries.
Ensure projects meet quality, timeline, security, compliance, and business outcome expectations.
Collaborate with delivery leaders to improve delivery methodologies, governance, and customer satisfaction.

Job Summary
We are seeking experienced Data Privacy professionals to join our expanding practice. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of global privacy regulations, hands-on experience with privacy operations, and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams. Candidates with strong communication, problem-solving skills, and stakeholder management capabilities are encouraged to apply.
The opportunity : Consultant/Senior Consultant - Tech Consulting - TMT - CNS - TC - Data Privacy - New Delhi
Data Privacy Professional Location Bangalore
Experience 2-8 years depending on role


About the Role

Responsibilities
Conduct privacy gap assessments for business processes/applications against global data protection regulations and standard including DPDPA, GDPR, CPRA and ISO 27701.
Draft data privacy policies, procedures, guidelines, and SOPs.
Determine and support execution of Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA).
Draft Records of Processing Activities (RoPA), develop Personal Data Inventories (PDI), and create Data Flow Diagrams (DFD).
Develop and deliver privacy training and awareness programs.
Privacy Engineering Architecture: Deep understanding of privacy concepts, Privacy by Design principles, and implementation in real-world processes.
Experience with Privacy Management Tools (PMT) and Privacy Enhancing Technologies (PET).
Expertise in tools such as OneTrust, BigID, and Securiti.ai.
Ability to drive overall privacy compliance architecture for clients.


Must-Have Skills
Strong understanding of global privacy regulations (GDPR, CPRA, DPDPA, etc.).
Experience in privacy risk assessments, RoPA, DFD, DPIA, and documentation.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and in cross-functional teams.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.


Good-to-Have (Preferred)
Certifications: CIPP/E, CIPM, ISO 27001, ISO 27701.
Experience with privacy tech platforms like OneTrust, BigID, and Securiti.ai.
Familiarity with ISO 27701 and NIST Privacy Framework.
Industry experience in Consumer Goods, Automotive, eCommerce, etc.

F Own the complete P&L, revenue, margin, and cost targets for the country's hot stamping foil operations.
F Formulate and execute long-term strategic plans to penetrate metallic, holographic, pigment, and security foil segments.
F Track local market trends, competitor positioning, and substrate developments.
Market Intelligence
F Track competitor pricing, new regulations (e.g., eco-friendly or recyclable foil mandates), and emerging packaging trends.
Sales, Business Development & Channel Management
F Drive B2B growth targeting large-scale converters, commercial printers, OEM partners, FMCG brands and pharmaceutical packaging manufacturers.
F Build, manage, and expand distributor networks, agent channels, and direct enterprise accounts.
F Oversee high-value negotiations and position the company as a technical application partner (solving issues like thermal stability, adhesion, and foil release).
Operations, Supply Chain & Technical Alignment
F Coordinate with production, quality control, and R&D to align foil structures with high-speed rotary and stamping equipment requirements and solve foil-transfer, die-temperature, or substrate-adhesion issues for clients.
F Oversee roll-slitting, layer coating quality standards, and inventory/supply chain workflows to minimize lead times.
Team Leadership & Governance
F Hire, mentor, and lead regional sales managers and technical service teams.
F Ensure local legal, regulatory, and statutory compliance.
F Report financial metrics, sales forecasts, and operational KPIs to regional headquarters or the board.

Preferred candidate profile
1. Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering, Polymer Science, Printing/Packaging Technology w or related discipline with MBA in International Business or Marketing preferred.
2. Experience of 10+ years in the printing, packaging, or specialty chemicals industry, with at least last 5 years specifically dedicated to the hot stamping foil sector is a must.
3. Proven track record in general management, P&L ownership, and country-level scaling.
4. Deep technical grasp of hot stamping machinery, dwell time, temperature, and foiling pressure variables.
5. Proven history of scaling market share, managing regional P&L, and closing high-value deals with industrial converters.
6. Strong commercial acumen, negotiation mastery, cross-cultural communication, and basic technical understanding of foil-stamping machinery and substrates.

Description:
Himalayan Institute of Alternatives, Ladakh (HIAL) is an upcoming Alternative Institute for Mountain Development which follows Contextual Learning and Experiential Pedagogy where students learn by doing and earn while they learn. It aims to develop Ladakh into a benchmark of sustainable living for the mountain world, where all children receive a meaningful education that prepares them for a life of dignity in harmony with nature. It believes in collaborative exercise between learners and facilitators. Instead of solving problems with the conventional 3Rs (Reading, writing, and arithmetic), the learners are encouraged to solve problems using the 3Hs: Bright Head, Kind Heart, and Skilled Hands. The institute is promoted by the renowned leaders in entrepreneurial education in India and attracts talent and grants from leading corporates and Government bodies in India.
For more details about us, please check:
Visit : HIAL Website or watch: About HIAl Job Description:
Looking for an experienced content creator who has proven ability to develop content and experience of writing good quality engaging articles. Has an ability to conduct extensive research on the assigned topic. A team player who has good coordination skills to collate the data at hand from different stake holders. The right candidate will be the one who is able to work from remote ethically and maintain timelines for deliverables and take ownership of the expected output without supervision.
About The Role:
As a content writer / you shall get to create content that shares HIAL's story, vision and brand to the world and make an impact across many different digital / social / media platforms.
Responsibilities:
1.Write, edit, publish content for websites, blogs, vlogs, videos, social media campaign (LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram etc).
2.Creating compelling headlines and body content that will capture the attention of the target audience.
3.Write content for Annual Report, Newsletter and other internal communication initiatives.
4.Design content marketing strategy.
5.Optimise content considering SEO.
6.Should have the ability to work independently and with cross functional teams.
7.Should be able to come up with fresh ideas and take ownership of projects.
8.Ensure that the content adheres to required branding and style guidelines and is relevant for our target audience.
9.Scripting for audio-visual, written and other media content.
10.Plan and Execute Events and Conferences that are integral to HIAL.
11.Monitor HIAL's Social Media and online presence and timely preparing high quality content for promoting HIAL brand value.
12.Prepare HIAL Annual Report (Annually), Newsletters (Quarterly), Monthly Updates (Monthly) collating data as required from all stakeholders.
13.While ensuring that they adhere to standards and goals of the HIAL, write and produce high-quality materials for effectively communicating to the key audience at appropriate platforms.
14.Create creative content for social media platforms including LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram to maintain an active online presence for HIAL.
15.Content for press releases, media briefings etc for HIAL's media relations across radio, print, digital, and television.
16.Assure uniformity in all content by serving as key brand guardian of HIAL.
17.Maintain the content of HIALs website by making sure it is correct, up to date, and persuasive.
18.Have an eye for detail and make sure all output is of a high quality.
19.Able to work from remote ethically and maintain timelines for deliverables.

KRA:
1.Written content for communication with HIAL's stakeholders.
2.Preparation and circulation of Annual Report (Annually), Newsletters (Quarterly), Monthly Updates (Monthly), brochures/ manuals, etc.
3.Branding and marketing related content.
4.Support in promoting the events organised time to time with valuable content for marketing and branding.
5.Social Media: Preparation of high quality and engaging content for all the social media handles as per tentative schedule mentioned below with SEO.
1. Instagram: Ensure daily effective posts.
2.Any Event: Instant Posting.
3.Facebook: Ensure daily effective posts.
4.Twitter
5.LinkedIn
6.Website
6.Content for the Events:
1.Annual Conferences & Festivals, promotion activities (Sun & Earth, Education, Entrepreneurship, Energy Studies).
2.Workshops.

7.I Live Simply (ILS).
1.Manage content related activities for ILS.


Preferred Educational Background:
1.Graduate or Master's in Mass Communication/ English literature or equivalent.
2.Good command over English.
3.Proven experience working under strict deadlines and the ability to work quickly.
4.Creative skills and usage of photographs, drawings, diagrams, animation, etc
The above is relaxed for the right candidate who can prove excellence in lines with the requirement with proven track record.
Preferred Work Experience:
1.Minimum of 2-5 years in similar roles.
2.Ability to work independently and reliably with minimal supervision.
3.Experience in SEO will be preferred.
4.Creative writing.

As per industry and region standards.

Job Description:
We are seeking a talented and creative Media Executive to join our team . The ideal candidate will have proven photography and videography skills, with a keen eye for capturing compelling visuals that tell a story. As a Media Executive, you will play a key role in documenting our projects, events, and initiatives through various forms of media, including photography, videography, and multimedia content creation. Responsibilities:
Capture high-quality photographs and videos that showcase the work and impact of HIAL's projects and initiatives.
Edit and enhance photos and videos using Adobe Creative Suite or similar software to ensure a polished and professional final product.
Collaborate with team members to develop creative concepts and visual storytelling strategies for various media projects.
Manage and maintain a library of multimedia assets, including photos, videos, and graphics.
Support social media and marketing efforts by providing engaging visual content for digital platforms.
Assist in the production of promotional materials, including brochures, presentations, and videos.
Travel with project teams to remote locations in Ladakh and other regions as needed to document fieldwork and events.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in photography, videography, media production, or related field preferred.
Proven experience in photography and videography, with a strong portfolio demonstrating technical proficiency and creative vision.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Lightroom, Premiere Pro, and/or After Effects.
Strong attention to detail and ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues from diverse backgrounds.
Willingness to travel and work in challenging environments, including remote Himalayan regions, and be flexible with assignments and schedules.
Benefits:
Opportunity to work with a dynamic team dedicated to making a positive impact in the Himalayan region.
Experience the rich cultural heritage and breathtaking landscapes of Ladakh.
Professional development opportunities and training in media production and storytelling techniques.
If you are passionate about using your media skills to make a difference and are excited about the opportunity to work in the beautiful Himalayan region of Ladakh, we encourage you to apply for the Media Executive position at HIAL. Join us in our mission to create a more sustainable and resilient future for Himalayan communities.
