Description:
style="margin-bottom: 0px;"> Commi I or II: Indian cuisine
F&B Production 2-4 Years Full-time Leh, Ladakh
Job Summary:
Job Summary

The Commis I Indian Kitchen is responsible for assisting in the preparation, cooking, and presentation of Indian cuisine while maintaining the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, and kitchen operations. The role requires sound knowledge of Indian cooking techniques, ingredients, and kitchen procedures, along with the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Prepare and cook Indian dishes according to established recipes and standards.
Assist senior chefs in mise en place and daily kitchen operations.
Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, and portion control.
Monitor the quality and freshness of ingredients before use.
Maintain cleanliness and organization of the assigned work station.
Follow all food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards.
Ensure proper storage, labeling, and rotation of food items (FIFO).
Support in receiving and storing kitchen supplies and ingredients.
Minimize food wastage and contribute to cost-control initiatives.
Assist during buffet service, la carte operations, banquets, and special events.
Report equipment malfunctions, stock shortages, and quality concerns to supervisors.
Work collaboratively with other kitchen team members to ensure smooth operations.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Hotel Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field preferred.
Minimum 2 4 years of experience in an Indian kitchen, preferably in a luxury hotel or fine-dining restaurant.
Knowledge of North Indian, Mughlai, Tandoor, and regional Indian cuisines is desirable.
Familiarity with food safety and hygiene standards.

Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of Indian cooking methods, spices, and ingredients.
Ability to work under pressure and meet service timelines.
Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good organizational and time-management skills.
Team-oriented attitude with a willingness to learn.
Ability to maintain a clean and disciplined work environment.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a luxury hospitality environment.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
A collaborative and supportive workplace culture.

Description:
The Marketing Manager at the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives Ladakh will be responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies to promote responsible tourism-related events, projects and activities, as well as promoting various courses, conferences, and workshops offered by the institute. The role will encompass a range of marketing activities, including digital marketing, content creation, event promotion, and brand management.

Key Responsibilities:

Promote Responsible Tourism Events:
Develop and implement marketing plans to promote responsible tourism-related events and activities curated by HIAL.
Collaborate with local and international partners to create awareness and attract participants.
Utilize digital marketing channels, social media, and content marketing to reach the target audience.
Promote Institute Courses:
Create marketing campaigns to promote the various courses offered by the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives Ladakh.
Develop course-specific marketing materials, including brochures, flyers, and digital content.
Implement strategies to increase course enrollment and participation.
Promote Conferences and Workshops:
Plan and execute marketing initiatives to promote conferences, workshops, and seminars held at the institute.
Coordinate with speakers, sponsors, and participants to ensure successful event promotion.
Manage event registration and attendee communication.
Digital Marketing:
Implement digital marketing strategies, including SEO, SEM, email marketing, and social media campaigns.
Create and curate content that highlights the institute's mission and values.
Monitor website traffic, engagement, and conversion rates to optimize digital marketing efforts.
Resource Management:
Oversee resource allocation and cash flow management to maintain financial stability and ensure that the organization can meet its financial obligations and strategic goals.
Content Creation:
Develop compelling and informative content, including blog posts, videos, and infographics, to engage the target audience.
Ensure that content aligns with the institute's values and promotes sustainable practices.
Collaboration:
Collaborate with the institute's teams, including academic, administrative, and event planning, to align marketing efforts with organizational goals.
Foster relationships with local and regional stakeholders to enhance the institute's presence.
Budget Management:
Create and manage marketing budgets, optimizing resource allocation for maximum impact.
Monitor spending and provide regular reports

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
Proven experience in marketing, preferably in the field of education, sustainable tourism, or related areas.
Strong knowledge of digital marketing techniques and tools.
Excellent communication and content creation skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a diverse team.
Passion for sustainable and responsible tourism practices.
Familiarity with Ladakh and the local community is a plus.
This Marketing Manager will play a crucial role in promoting the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives Ladakh's mission to promote responsible tourism and education in the region, while also fostering awareness and participation in its various courses, conferences, and workshops.

Description:
style="margin-bottom: 0px;"> Sous Chef-Indian Cuisine
F&B Production 7-8 Years Full-time Leh, Ladakh
Job Summary:
Job Summary

The Sous Chef - Indian Kitchen is responsible for assisting the Executive Chef in managing the preparation, cooking, and presentation of Indian cuisine while maintaining the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, and kitchen operations. The role requires strong knowledge of Indian cooking techniques, ingredients, menu execution, and kitchen procedures, along with proven leadership skills and the ability to manage a team effectively in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

Key Responsibilities

Assist the Executive Chef in managing the day-to-day operations of the Indian kitchen.
Supervise and coordinate the work of Chefs de Partie, Commis Chefs, and other kitchen team members.
Prepare and oversee the preparation and cooking of Indian dishes according to established recipes and standards.
Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, portion control, and overall food quality.
Conduct regular quality checks and ensure all dishes meet the required standards before service.
Plan and supervise mise en place and ensure adequate preparation for daily operations and service.
Assist in menu planning, development of new dishes, and implementation of seasonal and special menus.
Ensure proper handling, storage, labeling, and rotation of food items in accordance with FIFO practices.
Monitor ingredient quality, freshness, and availability and coordinate with the relevant departments for timely replenishment.
Control food wastage and assist in maintaining food-cost targets through effective production and portion control.
Ensure strict compliance with food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards.
Maintain cleanliness, organization, and discipline across the Indian kitchen and assigned work areas.
Assist in managing buffet service, la carte operations, banquets, special events, and other culinary requirements.
Train, guide, and develop junior kitchen team members in Indian cooking techniques, hygiene, and standard operating procedures.
Allocate daily duties and ensure efficient deployment of kitchen personnel during service.
Monitor kitchen equipment and report maintenance requirements, malfunctions, stock shortages, and quality concerns to the Executive Chef.
Take responsibility for the Indian kitchen in the absence of the Executive Chef, ensuring uninterrupted and efficient operations.
Work closely with other kitchen sections and service teams to ensure smooth coordination and timely food delivery.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Hotel Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field preferred.
Minimum 7-8 years of experience in a professional Indian kitchen, preferably in a luxury hotel or fine-dining restaurant.
Previous experience in a Sous Chef, Junior Sous Chef, or senior Chef de Partie position is preferred.
Strong knowledge of North Indian, Mughlai, Tandoor, and regional Indian cuisines.
Proven experience in supervising and leading a kitchen team.
Good knowledge of food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards.

Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of Indian cooking methods, spices, ingredients, and regional cuisines.
Strong leadership and team-management skills.
Ability to maintain consistency and quality during high-volume service.
Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet service timelines.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good understanding of food cost, portion control, and wastage management.
Ability to train, motivate, and develop junior kitchen team members.
Strong communication and coordination skills.
Ability to maintain a clean, disciplined, and professional kitchen environment.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a luxury hospitality environment.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
A collaborative and supportive workplace culture.

Job Description:
The Purchase Manager will be responsible for end-to-end management of the Sheshyon shop. This includes establishing and maintaining supplier relationships, negotiating favorable deals, overseeing inventory, ensuring timely purchases and sales, handling invoices, tracking budgets, and managing records. The role requires an individual who is highly organized, skilled in negotiation, and capable of fostering efficient and cost-effective operations.

Key Responsibilities:

1.Supply Chain Management:
Establish and maintain relationships with suppliers to ensure a reliable flow of quality goods.
Identify new suppliers and vendors when necessary, expanding options to meet the shop's diverse needs.
2.Negotiations and Vendor Relations:
Negotiate terms, pricing, and conditions with suppliers to achieve cost-effective procurement.
Report on supplier performance to ensure adherence to quality and service standards.
3.Procurement and Inventory Control:
Make timely purchases based on the needs of HIAL, public customers, and budget guidelines.
Manage stock levels, reorder points, and work with suppliers to prevent stockouts.
4.Billing, Budgeting, and Accounting:
Prepare and manage invoices, maintain bill records, and ensure accurate accounting for all purchases and sales.
Track and report on budget allocations, and provide regular updates to management.
5.Customer Service and Sales:
Serve as the main point of contact for both internal HIAL departments and external customers. Ensure a high standard of customer satisfaction and timely responses to inquiries.
6.Returns, Charges, and Price Adjustments:
Assist in the return of goods to suppliers when necessary and handle related documentation. Review carriage charges, price increases, and communicate changes to relevant departments.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's/ Master's or MBA in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or related field.
Proven experience in purchasing, vendor management, and inventory control.
Strong negotiation and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in accounting and budgeting.
Ability to multitask and work in a dynamic environment.

Job Summary:
About the Role

The Abduz Group is looking for a detail-oriented and dependable Finance Associate to support the day-to-day accounting and financial operations of the organization

The ideal candidate should possess a strong understanding of basic accounting principles, be proficient in Tally, and have the ability to maintain accurate financial records while ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures

Key Responsibilities

Record and maintain financial transactions accurately in Tally

Process invoices, receipts, payments, and journal entries

Assist in accounts payable and accounts receivable management

Reconcile bank statements, cash accounts, and vendor ledgers

Maintain organized financial records and supporting documentation

Assist in monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities

Verify bills, expense claims, and supporting documents for accuracy

Prepare basic financial reports and summaries as required

Coordinate with various departments to collect and verify financial information

Support statutory compliance and audit requirements by maintaining accurate records

Ensure confidentiality and security of financial information

Identify discrepancies and report them promptly to the Finance Manager

Requirements

Minimum 1 3 years of experience in accounting, finance, or a related role

Sound knowledge of accounting principles and bookkeeping practices

Proficiency in Tally ERP/Tally Prime is mandatory

Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy

Good analytical and numerical skills

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other MS Office applications

Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines

Strong organizational and record-keeping skills

Honest, reliable, and capable of handling confidential information

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor s degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Experience in the hospitality industry will be an added advantage

Familiarity with GST, TDS, and basic statutory compliance requirements is preferred

Description:
Position Overview:
HIAL is looking for a dynamic and people-centered HR Manager who can lead and manage the institute's human resource functions in a proactive, empathetic and organized manner. The ideal candidate should be passionate about creating an inclusive, growth-oriented and values-driven work culture while aligning HR practices with the institute's mission.

Key Responsibilities:

1. HR Strategy & Policy Development:
Design, review and implement HR policies and procedures that reflect the institute's ethos and ensure legal compliance.
Support long-term HR planning, including workforce planning, succession planning and talent development.
2. Recruitment & Onboarding:
Lead the end-to-end recruitment process for faculty, administrative and support staff.
Develop effective strategies for talent acquisition, including campus outreach and collaborations.
Ensure smooth onboarding and orientation of new employees.
3. Performance Management & Capacity Building:
Design and implement fair and constructive performance appraisal systems.
Identify training needs and coordinate internal and external capacity-building initiatives.
Support managers in developing individual growth plans for their teams.
4. Employee Engagement & Culture:
Foster a healthy, inclusive and collaborative work environment rooted in mutual respect and collective purpose.
Plan and execute employee engagement activities, feedback mechanisms and team-building initiatives.
Serve as a bridge between staff and leadership, ensuring two-way communication.
5. HR Operations & Compliance:
Maintain accurate and confidential employee records including attendance, leave and service history.
Manage HR-related documentation, including contracts, policies and compliance with labor laws.
Oversee payroll coordination, benefits and timely employee reimbursements in collaboration with the Finance team.
6. Conflict Resolution & Welfare:
Address staff grievances with empathy and fairness, ensuring timely resolution.
Promote mental health and staff well-being initiatives.

Qualifications & Experience:

Bachelor's/Master's degree in Human Resource Management, Organizational Development, or related field.
Minimum 5 years of progressive HR experience; prior experience in an academic or social sector organization is preferred.
Strong understanding of HR laws, best practices and systems.
Excellent interpersonal, communication and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work in a multicultural, high-altitude and mission-driven environment.
Desirable Attributes:
Sensitivity to local culture and a passion for sustainable development in the Himalayan region.
Adaptability and willingness to live and work in a remote, cold desert setting.
Experience with HR tech platforms and digital tools.
Ability to handle both strategic HR planning and hands-on operational tasks.

Role Summary:
We are seeking a passionate and experienced Senior Architect who is not only a practitioner of sustainable and context-responsive architecture but also an inspiring educator. The candidate will teach, mentor, and lead hands-on learning experiences that embody HIAL's philosophy of learning by doing. The role involves working closely with fellows, interns, and students to design and build passive solar-heated structures, lead community-based projects and organize flagship events such as the Sun and Earth Festival.

Key Responsibilities:

Academic & Teaching:
Design and deliver academic courses on sustainable architecture, passive solar design, earth architecture and responsible construction practices.
Facilitate experiential, hands-on and site-based learning that connect theory with real-world application.
Guide students, fellows, and interns in their individual projects, research and thesis work.
Evaluate learning outcomes and contribute to curriculum development.

Project Leadership & Mentorship:
Lead the design and construction of buildings at HIAL using eco-responsive methods (e.g., mud, stone, rammed earth, straw clay, solar).
Mentor architecture interns, fellows and visiting professionals on live projects.
Supervise and guide interdisciplinary teams on construction, prototyping and innovation in high-altitude building.

Events & Outreach:
Plan and lead events such as the Sun and Earth Festival, celebrating innovation in sustainable building and traditional knowledge.
Facilitate workshops and hands-on training programs for local communities, visiting institutions, and professionals.
Represent HIAL in national and international forums related to sustainable architecture and climate-responsive design.

Required Qualifications & Experience:
Master's degree in Architecture, Sustainable Architecture or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of professional experience, preference will be given to applicants having experience in high-altitude or climate-responsive architecture.
Proven track record in passive solar building design, use of local materials and responsible construction practices.
Prior experience in teaching, training, or community-based capacity building is highly desirable.
Strong design sensibility with the ability to translate concepts into actionable, buildable plans.

Key Skills & Attributes:
Passionate about sustainability and grounded in hands-on, practical problem-solving.
Comfortable working in remote, high-altitude environments and engaging with diverse stakeholders from villagers to international students.
Excellent communication, mentoring and facilitation skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and lead interdisciplinary teams.
Commitment to HIAL's values of innovation, inclusivity and ecological responsibility.

Preferred Qualities:
Familiarity with vernacular Ladakhi architecture and indigenous construction techniques.
Experience working with natural building materials such as adobe, cob, stone and wood.
Inclination towards experiential education and design/build pedagogy.

Description:
The Himalayan Institute of Alternatives, Ladakh, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Finance Head to lead our finance department. As the Finance Head, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the financial stability and success of our organization. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining financial forecasting models, supervising a team of accountants, and identifying cost-saving solutions. Additionally, you will collaborate with senior management to explore alternative funding options, manage resource allocation, and ensure compliance through audits.

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Forecasting:
Develop and maintain forecasting models for monthly, quarterly, and annual financial results to provide accurate and timely financial insights to the organization.
Team Leadership:
Provide strong leadership and supervision to a team of accountants, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in all financial transactions. Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and professional development within the team.
Cost Optimization:
Identify opportunities for cost-saving solutions to optimize financial performance, enhancing the financial sustainability of the organization.
Funding Exploration:
Collaborate with senior management to explore alternate funding options for projects and initiatives, including grants, partnerships, and investment opportunities.
Resource Management:
Oversee resource allocation and cash flow management to maintain financial stability and ensure that the organization can meet its financial obligations and strategic goals.
Budget Approval:
Review and approve budgets, ensuring they align with the organizational goals and financial constraints. Monitor budget performance and recommend adjustments when necessary.
Vendor Payments and Payroll:
Ensure timely payments to vendors and the punctual release of employee salaries, maintaining strong vendor and employee relationships.
Financial Integrity and Compliance:
Conduct regular audits to maintain financial integrity and compliance with relevant laws and regulations. Develop and implement corrective measures as needed.

Qualifications:
Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. MBA or a relevant advanced degree is preferred.
Proven experience in financial management, including forecasting, budgeting, and cost analysis.
Strong leadership and team management skills with a minimum of 5 years of supervisory experience.
Proficiency in financial modeling, accounting software, and Microsoft Office Suite.
Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of funding opportunities in the nonprofit sector is a plus.

Description:
Job Summary
The opportunity: Project Analyst-National-Forensics-ASU - Forensics - Discovery - Chandigarh
National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience.
ASU - Forensics - Discovery :
Successful organizations depend on their reputation for keeping promises, respecting laws and behaving ethically to maintain stakeholder trust. EY Forensic Integrity Services professionals help organizations protect and restore enterprise and financial reputation. We assist companies and their legal counsel to investigate facts, resolve disputes and manage regulatory challenges. We put integrity at the heart of compliance programs to help better manage ethical and reputational risks.
Our integrated approach ranges from enhancements in areas of perceived weakness or issues - including governance, controls, culture and data insights - to full organizational design and structural implementation. We want to help companies safeguard and restore financial and brand reputations. The insights and quality services we deliver help build trust and confidence in the capital markets and in economies the world over.
Your key responsibilities
Hands-on experience in cyber incident responses.
Proficiency in legal document review, applying coding protocols and relevance criteria consistently and accurately.
Working knowledge of digital forensic processes, including evidence collection, preservation, and chain-of-custody management.
Experience using e-discovery tools to process, filter, and review large volumes of electronic data.
Ability to apply structured consulting frameworks to organize investigations, analyze findings, and deliver clear project outputs.
Qualification
LLB
Experience
CIR and DR (6-12 months)
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements.
You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions.
We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
Job Title: Admission Counsellor / Business Development Executive / Senior Learning Consultant EdTech

Job Location: Mumbai / Pune /Chandigarh / Bangalore
Industry: EdTech / Education / Online Learning
Department: Sales, Admissions & Student Counselling
Experience: 1 to 3 Years (Freshers with Excellent Communication Skills are also Welcome)

Job Description

We are looking for enthusiastic and target-oriented professionals to join our growing EdTech team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for counselling prospective students, promoting educational programs, managing leads, and driving admissions and course enrolments.

Key Responsibilities:
- Connect with prospective students through inbound and outbound calls, emails, chats, and online platforms.
- Counsel students regarding online UG/PG programs, management courses, diplomas, certifications, and professional learning programs.
- Understand students' career goals and recommend suitable educational programs.
- Follow up with interested leads and convert enquiries into admissions and enrolments.
- Schedule video counselling sessions, online demos, and program discussions where required.
- Manage the complete sales funnel, from lead engagement to conversion.
- Achieve monthly admission and revenue targets.
- Maintain lead records, follow-ups, and sales reports using CRM tools and Excel.
- Build strong relationships with students and parents while ensuring a positive counselling experience.

Requirements
- Graduate in any discipline.
- Freshers with excellent communication and convincing skills can apply for eligible entry-level roles.
- Experienced candidates with backgrounds in EdTech Sales, B2C Sales, Admission Counselling, Academic Counselling, or Business Development are preferred for experienced positions.
- Strong communication, negotiation, persuasion, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work with sales targets and manage multiple leads.
- Basic knowledge of MS Excel, CRM tools, and dialer operations.
- A customer-focused attitude with a passion for education and career counselling.

Salary & Benefits
- Salary as per experience, skills, and company norms.
- Attractive performance-based incentives.
- Opportunity to work in the growing EdTech and online education sector.

Pricing
Sales Orders
Deliveries
Billing
Credit Management
Returns Process
Experience in Vistex modules such as:
Rebates
Chargebacks
Incentives
Claims Management
Pricing Programs

Description:
Position Title: Area HR Partner- Upper North (Third Party Contractual)

Reports to: Lead HR Retail (North and East)

Note: This role is on one year contract. Based on performance we can convert this role on-rolls, but if not then after one year the contract will terminate after one year

Location: Chandigarh (First two months in Gurgaon office)

Position Summary:
The Retail HR role partners closely with retail operations to support people-related initiatives across stores. The role focuses on driving hiring, employee engagement, capability development, and compliance while building a strong connect with store teams and supporting the overall employee experience in the region

Key Objectives:
Manage the end-to-end employee lifecycle for retail employees including recruitment, onboarding, engagement initiatives, training and development, and exit interviews.
Drive hiring across retail stores by identifying and leveraging both internal and external recruitment sources to ensure timely closure of open positions.
Partner with retail operations stakeholders and store managers to understand manpower requirements and support people-related decisions across stores.
Assess behavioral and capability development needs of store employees and coordinate relevant training programs with internal or external trainers.
Plan and manage the monthly employee engagement calendar across stores to strengthen employee connect and morale.
Coordinate and ensure timely and accurate submission of payroll inputs for retail employees.
Conduct regular store visits to interact with employees, gather feedback, understand on-ground challenges, and support resolution of employee concerns.
Track attrition trends and employee feedback across stores and work with business leaders to drive retention and employee experience initiatives.
Ensure effective implementation of company policies across stores and monitor compliance with statutory requirements, including maintenance of statutory registers and documentation.
Actively participate in various company forums and people initiatives within the organization.

Eligibility Criteria and Functional Competencies Required:
MBA / PGDM students specializing in HR or related fields.
2-4 years of HR experience, preferably in retail, hospitality, or other customer-facing industries.
Prior experience in managing store hiring, employee engagement, and HR operations will be an advantage.
Good communication and coordination skills.
Working knowledge of MS Excel and PowerPoint.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and work with multiple stakeholders.
AboutCompany: PUMA is a global sportswear and lifestyle brand headquartered in Herzogenaurach, Germany. Founded in 1948, PUMA designs and sells footwear, apparel, and accessories for sports and everyday fashion. The brand operates across categories such as running, football, training, basketball, and motorsport, and is known for combining performance, innovation, and street style.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
Who Will Do Well in This Role?
Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.
If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Description
What will you work on
Leading creative strategy for the platform which covers engaging FB content for Instagram to meet content metrics and revenue targets. Collaborate closely with the production team and post-production to ensure the written content aligns seamlessly with visual elements.

Someone who has excellent writing and communication skills, an instinctive design sensibility and an overall understanding of good quality, original content.
Someone familiar with Instagrams features, trends, and best practices.

Description:
Job Summary
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.
Role Summary The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies: Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers. Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants, Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO), Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV). Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate. Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts, denial rates, supply metrics vs competition.


Qualifications
Desired Skills -
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Job Summary
Provides technical expertise and serves as a primary customer support contact for diagnosing, troubleshooting, and executing complex repairs and maintenance of engine products at customer sites. Applies advanced diagnostic skills, specialized tools, service procedures, and product knowledge to ensure timely and effective resolution of customer issues while maintaining high standards of safety, quality, and customer service.
Key Responsibilities
Establishes and maintains productive customer relationships, ensuring prompt, professional, and efficient attention to customer needs.
Diagnoses and completes complex repairs on engine products at customer sites using specialized tools, diagnostic equipment, service publications, and documented procedures.
Performs preventive maintenance activities on engines and related components in accordance with documented schedules, standards, and service requirements.
Troubleshoots mechanical, electrical, electronic, fuel, cooling, exhaust, aftertreatment, driveline, controls, and sensor-related systems to identify root causes and resolve product issues.
Uses electronic service tools, software, and diagnostic equipment to interpret fault information, identify failed components, and determine appropriate repair actions.
Validates completed repairs by confirming that the original customer concern has been resolved and the product is operating as expected.
Escalates unresolved or complex technical issues to product specialists, technical experts, or supervisors, providing complete troubleshooting details and relevant technical information.
Provides technical guidance, coaching, and knowledge transfer to technicians and apprentices; may provide work direction and review repair plans, parts lists, and related technical requirements.
Completes accurate service documentation, including service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality documents, customer/equipment information, and technical records through applicable systems or forms.
Identifies additional service and sales opportunities based on customer requirements and product/service needs.
Completes required technical and functional training in line with business and skill requirements and actively develops technical capabilities.
Maintains service vehicles, tools, equipment, and work areas in a clean, safe, and operational condition.
Ensures compliance with all applicable Health, Safety Environmental policies, procedures, standards, and legislation.
Reports safety concerns, incidents, and other HSE issues to site management and the appropriate supervisor.
Supports continuous improvement by sharing technical knowledge, field insights, and opportunities to improve service processes and customer experience.
Key Responsibilities:
Service Delivery Monitoring :
Oversee Service Delivery Process (SDP) at dealerships, conduct audits, identify gaps, and drive improvements for a robust process.
Daily review and closure of critical breakdown and running-with-problem events by coordinating with customers, dealerships, and process owners.
Customer and Dealer Relationship Management :
Build strong relationships with key customers, proactively conduct customer visits, and address their concerns effectively.
Conduct monthly/quarterly meetings with OEMs/GOEMs and document actions for closure.
Performance Management :
Monitor Net Promoter Score (NPS) at dealerships, analyze detractors/passives, and implement improvements.
Review service KPIs, initiatives like SQM, Service Touch, Warranty, CEIT, and customer escalations with stakeholders.
Process Improvement :
Ensure compliance with NEPI BCD requirements and facilitate dealership visits for alignment.
Conduct dealer score audits, share improvement recommendations, and work towards target achievement.
Enhance Preventive Maintenance Compliance of Alternators / NGPI Compliance
Technical Support and Knowledge Sharing :
Investigate product/system problems, identify causes, recommend solutions, and document findings.

Role Overview:
We are looking for a proactive and solution-oriented Last Mile Servicing (LMS) Associate to
lead the Quick-commerce (and E-Commerce) appointment delivery process. You will ensure
seamless customer/consignee experience by resolving queries efficiently, coordinating with
internal teams, and contributing to continuous process improvements. This is an exciting
opportunity to grow in a fast-paced, tech-driven logistics environment.

Serve as the primary point of contact for consignees via calls, emails, and chat.
Resolve shipment-related queries, including tracking, delays, lost or damaged
packages.
Conduct RCA for delivery failures along with subsequent actionables.
Collaborate with operations, warehouse, and logistics teams to provide timely
solutions.
Maintain accurate records of customer/consignee interactions and feedback.
Identify recurring issues and work with internal teams to improve processes.
Sending out daily/weekly reports highlighting trends and insights.
Uphold a high standard of professionalism and empathy in all customer/consignee
interactions.
Who You Are:
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent with prior experience in logistics, e-commerce
operations, or customer service.
Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi; regional language skills are a plus
Tech-savvy, adept at MS Excel and CRM tools.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to multitask in a dynamic environment.
Customer-focused, patient, and resilient under pressure

Description:
Job Summary
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that its your career and Its yours to build which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity: Executive-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT:
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.


Your key responsibilities
Support consulting and advisory projects through research, data collection, analysis, and documentation.
Assist in preparing reports, presentations, concept notes, proposals, and other client deliverables.
Conduct secondary research, market assessments, policy reviews, and stakeholder mapping to support project objectives.
Analyze data and synthesize findings into clear and actionable insights.
Participate in client meetings, workshops, surveys, and stakeholder consultations.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to support project execution.
Assist in monitoring project timelines, deliverables, and reporting requirements.
Contribute to business development activities, including proposal preparation and knowledge management initiatives.
Stay updated on industry trends, government policies, and sector developments relevant to assigned projects.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to conduct research and interpret information from multiple sources.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
Ability to work effectively in a team environment and manage multiple tasks.
Strong learning mindset, professional attitude, and willingness to take ownership of assignments.


Qualifications
"Bachelors or Masters degree in Management, Economics, Public Policy, Engineering, Commerce, Finance, Social Sciences, or a related discipline."


Experience
0-2 years Entry Level


What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
Role Name: SAP BASIS Consultant
Experience: 4 to 12 Years
Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli
Work Mode: Hybrid
Roles & Responsibilities
Install, configure, administer, and monitor SAP systems across landscapes.
Perform SAP system upgrades, migrations, refreshes, and patching activities.
Manage SAP S/4HANA, SAP NetWeaver, and HANA database environments.
Execute client copies, system copies, kernel upgrades, and transport management activities.
Monitor system performance and optimize SAP application and database performance.
Perform user administration, role assignments, security, and authorization support.
Handle SAP Backup, Recovery, Disaster Recovery, and High Availability configurations.
Support incident management, problem resolution, and root cause analysis.
Collaborate with functional, development, infrastructure, and cloud teams.
Support implementation, upgrade, migration, and maintenance projects.
Ensure system availability, reliability, and compliance with organizational standards.

Mandatory Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SAP BASIS Administration.
Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA landscapes
Experience in Kernal Upgrade and Solution Management.
Strong knowledge of:
SAP HANA Database Administration
SAP NetWeaver Administration
Transport Management System (TMS)
SAP System Monitoring
Performance Tuning
Client Copy/System Copy
Kernel Upgrades and Patch Management
Experience in SAP installation, upgrade, and migration activities.
Knowledge of SAP security, users, roles, and authorizations.
Experience in troubleshooting SAP system performance issues.
Understanding of Backup, Recovery, High Availability, and Disaster Recovery concepts.
Experience in Linux/Unix operating systems.
Strong analytical and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Skills
SAP S/4HANA Conversion or Migration projects.
Exposure to SAP Solution Manager.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
HANA database migration and administration experience.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What Youll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
1–5 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role. Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a dynamic and target-driven Senior Manager SME Inside Sales to lead a large sales organization and drive revenue growth, customer retention, and account expansion. The role involves managing 2 Assistant Managers and 50–60 associates, building a high-performance culture, and delivering business targets through data-driven sales strategies and effective people leadership.

Key Responsibilities
* Own revenue, growth, retention, and productivity targets for the function.
* Lead and mentor 2 Assistant Managers and drive performance across 50–60 associates.
* Drive account growth through upselling, cross-selling, share-of-wallet gains, and increased order frequency.
* Improve customer retention, reduce churn, and strengthen long-term account relationships.
* Monitor sales funnel performance, conversion rates, revenue per associate, and key business KPIs.
* Drive forecasting, business reviews, performance management, and continuous process improvement.
* Collaborate with Operations, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product teams to enhance customer experience and business outcomes.
* Leverage customer insights and analytics to identify growth opportunities and improve platform stickiness.
Requirements
* 7+ years of experience in Inside Sales, Key Account Management, Account Management, or Customer Retention.

Muthoot Finance believes in promoting local hiring from the region. Every 5th employee is a woman and roughly 24% of the workforce comprises of women.
Shri. Amitabh Bachchan Ji is the Brand Ambassador of The Muthoot Group.
The Group takes humble pride in its 800 years of family business legacy and unblemished track record. Over these years, millions of underserved Indians have been served through a bouquet of products and services and have been helped in a big way to move ahead in life.

Description:
Job Summary
The opportunity: Senior Project Consultant-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh.


Your key responsibilities
Work closely with clients to understand their business challenges and provide practical, data-driven solutions.
Support government, public sector, and private sector projects from planning through implementation.
Conduct market research, policy analysis, stakeholder consultations, surveys, and interviews to generate actionable insights.
Analyze quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, opportunities, and recommendations.
Develop reports, presentations, concept notes, business cases, strategy documents, and client deliverables.
Prepare financial and operational assessments, forecasts, and impact analyses to support decision-making.
Collaborate with internal teams and subject matter experts to deliver high-quality project outcomes.
Build and maintain strong client relationships and contribute to business development initiatives.
Support proposal preparation, opportunity identification, and pursuit of new assignments.
Ensure timely delivery of projects while maintaining high standards of quality and professionalism.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and engage with senior stakeholders.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and data analysis tools.
Self-driven, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
Exposure to government advisory, public sector consulting, economic development, policy, or transformation projects will be an advantage.


Qualifications
Bachelor of Engineering
Master of Business Administration


Experience
4+ years of Experience

Description:
Group Company: AU Small Finance Bank Limited
Designation: Relationship Officer Two Wheeler
Office Location:
Position description: Primary interface of the bank with the customer as well as the channels for business sourcing
Primary Responsibilities:
1. Achieve assigned targets and productivity requirements - meet the threshold targets on monthly basis 2. Generate potential business leads from sourcing channels, follow up and bring it to closure 3. Assess customer profile, visit customer's place, collect necessary documentation and recommend customers to credit for approval 4. Ensure physical delivery of vehicle from the dealer/channel partner - stay vigilant about asset jumping/over pricing etc. 5. Follow up and collect deferrals and post disbursement documents in a timely manner. 6. Ensure only Direct sourcing from authorised dealers and empanelled channels - no third party sourcing, includes employees of other banks and financial institutions. 7. Manage relationship with dealers, Commercial Associates, referrals and other sourcing channels to generate business volumes through these channels. 8. Ensure Asset verification and Non starter-Early default cases and build relationships9. Ensure timely servicing of customer service requests

Description:
Job Summary
Executive-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh


Your key responsibilities

Technical Excellence
Support consulting and advisory projects through research, data collection, analysis, and documentation.
Assist in preparing reports, presentations, concept notes, proposals, and other client deliverables.
Conduct secondary research, market assessments, policy reviews, and stakeholder mapping to support project objectives.
Analyze data and synthesize findings into clear and actionable insights.
Participate in client meetings, workshops, surveys, and stakeholder consultations.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to support project execution.
Assist in monitoring project timelines, deliverables, and reporting requirements.
Contribute to business development activities, including proposal preparation and knowledge management initiatives.
Stay updated on industry trends, government policies, and sector developments relevant to assigned projects.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to conduct research and interpret information from multiple sources.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
Ability to work effectively in a team environment and manage multiple tasks.
Strong learning mindset, professional attitude, and willingness to take ownership of assignments.


Skills and attributes

To qualify for the role you must have
Bachelors or Masters degree in Management, Economics, Public Policy, Engineering, Commerce, Finance, Social Sciences, or a related discipline.
Experience
0-2 years Entry Level


What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements.
You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions.
We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
Job Summary
The opportunity: Senior Project Consultant-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
GOV: Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT:
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
Minimum 5 years of experience in consulting, advisory, strategy, research, analytics, policy, or project management. Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities. Experience in conducting research, stakeholder engagement, interviews, and quantitative and qualitative analysis. Excellent communication, report-writing, and presentation development skills. Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment and manage diverse stakeholders. Strong client management and project coordination skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and other analytical and reporting tools. Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality outcomes. Experience in government advisory, public policy, economic development, institutional strengthening, or transformation projects will be an added advantage. Engage with clients to understand business challenges and deliver practical, evidence-based solutions. Support the planning, execution, and monitoring of consulting and advisory assignments across government, public sector, and private sector engagements. Conduct market assessments, policy research, stakeholder consultations, and data analysis to generate meaningful insights and recommendations. Prepare high-quality reports, presentations, strategy papers, business cases, and other client deliverables. Develop financial, operational, and impact assessments to support informed decision-making. Work closely with project teams, subject matter experts, and stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery. Build and maintain strong client relationships while ensuring high standards of service and professionalism.
Skills and attributes
To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification
Any Post Graduation
Experience
5+ years of overall experience
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

About the Role
We are looking for an enthusiastic and target-oriented Admission Counselor to guide working professionals in choosing the right upGrad programs based on their career goals and professional experience.

Key Responsibilities
Connect with working professionals through calls and other communication channels to understand their career and learning requirements.
Counsel prospective learners about upGrad programs, courses, eligibility, and career benefits.
Follow up with leads and convert prospective learners into enrolled students.
Achieve assigned monthly admission and revenue targets.
Maintain regular follow-ups and build strong relationships with prospective learners.
Handle queries and objections related to programs, fees, eligibility, and career outcomes.
Maintain accurate lead and conversion records in the CRM.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth admission and enrollment process.

Requirements
0-3 years of experience in Inside Sales, EdTech Sales, Admission Counseling, Telesales, or Business Development.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong convincing, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities.
Comfortable working with sales targets and performance metrics.
Ability to understand customer needs and recommend suitable learning programs.
Good follow-up and relationship-management skills.
Candidates from EdTech, Education, BFSI, Telecom, or other sales-driven industries are preferred.
Willingness to work from the Pune office.
AboutCompany:
Started in 2015, upGrad is one of Asia's largest integrated Learning, Skilling, and Workforce Development Majors. It offers a range of online & hybrid skilling, pathway and study abroad courses, Certifications, and Bootcamps under its B2C portfolio. It also facilitates top Indian and global universities to offer their Diploma, Masters and Executive Doctorates. Additionally, select programs are tailored for Enterprise clients under the corporate skilling division, along with other recruitment and staffing services.
Origin: Co-founded by Ronnie Screwvala, Mayank Kumar, and Phalgun Kompall, upGrad was born to bridge the gap between imparting skills and employability, and is committed to providing affordable, accessible and high-quality lifelong learning at scale to millions worldwide. It caters to the end-to-end learning requirements of freshers to seasoned professionals in the age group of 18-60+ years who would use constant learning to enhance their skill sets while also receiving career acceleration.

Impact: To bridge the gap between academia and the industry, upGrad has built an immersive and 360-degree integrated learning solution that rests upon strong pillars like Content, Technology and Deep Personalization, further accelerating stronger career outcomes for learners. It enjoys a wide brands credibility and recall within India Inc. and globally, and continues to command strong course completion rates as high as 80%+ and higher Repeat and Referral rates annually. The skilling major has achieved two consecutive years of remarkable growth, closing FY23 and FY24 with over 55,000 successful career transitions, further establishing the credibility and mettle of the online higher education segment in India and globally.

Description:
Were Hiring: DevOps Engineers & Cloud Reliability Experts
(40+ Openings | 3 - 20 Yrs Exp | Multiple Roles)

Location: Mumbai / Pune / Chandigarh / Gurugram / Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Chennai
Specific location, shift timings, and work model may vary by position and role.
Industry: Fortune 500 Client Projects (Staffing via Hatchtra)
Employment Type: Full-Time | Permanent | Contract

About the Opportunity
Join us as we scale DevOps and Cloud Reliability practices for multiple Fortune 500 companies. We are looking for experienced professionals (3 - 20 years) to architect, build, and optimize enterprise-grade DevOps ecosystems.

If youre passionate about automation, cloud, reliability engineering, and scaling deployments, this is your chance to work on high-impact projects with global enterprises.

Open Positions & Designations
Were hiring across multiple seniority levels:
DevOps Engineers
(3 5 Yrs) – Engineer, Senior Engineer
Site Reliability Engineers (SRE)
(5 – 10 Yrs) – SRE, Senior SRE
Cloud & Platform Engineers
(5 – 10 Yrs) – AWS/Azure/GCP Specialists, Cloud Automation Engineers
DevSecOps Engineers
(5 – 12 Yrs) – Security-Focused DevOps, Cloud Security Engineers
Infrastructure Engineers
(5 – 10 Yrs) – Systems Engineers, Network Automation Engineers
Leadership Roles
(10 – 20 Yrs) – DevOps Manager, Head of Cloud Engineering, Director – DevOps

Key Responsibilities (Scale with Level)
Professional (3 – 5 Yrs)
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for applications and microservices.
Support cloud-based infrastructure provisioning and automation.
Troubleshoot production issues and perform root cause analysis.
Collaborate with QA, development, and operations teams for smooth deployments.
Write scripts (Python, Bash, PowerShell) for automation and monitoring.
Contribute to DevOps documentation and playbooks.

Mid-Level (5 – 10 Yrs)
Design, implement, and optimize CI/CD pipelines across multiple environments.
Automate cloud infrastructure provisioning using IaC tools (Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi).
Manage Kubernetes clusters, containerized workloads, and microservices deployments.
Implement observability solutions with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or Splunk.
Lead incident management, production troubleshooting, and escalation processes.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to DevOps best practices.

Senior/Leadership (10 – 20 Yrs)
Define and execute DevOps/SRE strategy for enterprise-scale, multi-cloud ecosystems.
Drive cloud migration, cost optimization, and governance initiatives for clients.
Oversee security automation and DevSecOps integration at all delivery stages.
Establish standards for CI/CD, observability, reliability, and automation at scale.
Collaborate with client executives, architects, and engineering heads to define tech roadmaps.
Build and lead high-performing DevOps teams, coaching engineers and architects to deliver excellence.

Tech Stack & Tools
CI/CD: Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Spinnaker
Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP
Containerization & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift
IaC & Automation: Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi, Helm
Monitoring & Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk, Datadog
Security & DevSecOps: Aqua, Prisma, HashiCorp Vault, Snyk
Scripting & Programming: Python, Bash, PowerShell, Go
Version Control: Git, Bitbucket

Qualifications
Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or equivalent
3+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Cloud Engineering
Hands-on expertise in CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and IaC
Strong knowledge of Linux/Windows systems, networking, and cloud computing
Understanding of observability, SRE principles, and incident response
For senior roles: proven leadership in driving DevOps culture in enterprises
Certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes) are a strong plus

About Hatchtra Innotech

Hatchtra Innotech is a growing organization focused on IT services, staffing, and corporate training. We help businesses succeed while creating meaningful career opportunities for professionals like you.

From end-to-end IT project delivery (development, testing, deployment, and support) to flexible staffing solutions, we work across diverse domains and technologies. We also offer certified training programs, customized learning paths, and expert-led sessions to help you continuously upgrade your skills.

With 70+ clients, we provide a platform where you can gain real-world experience, learn from industry experts, and grow in a supportive and collaborative environment.

Work on real, impactful projects
Learn continuously and grow your skills
