Description:
We're Hiring: Cloud Engineers AWS | Azure | GCP

(Multiple Openings | 4 - 10 Years Experience | Multiple Levels)
Location: Pune / Mumbai / Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Gurugram / Chandigarh / Chennai
Specific location and work model may vary by position and role.
Industry: Fortune 500 Client Projects (Staffing via Hatchtra)
Employment Type: Permanent | Contract

About the Role
We are looking for experienced Cloud Engineers specializing in AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to design, implement, manage, and optimize scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure.

The ideal candidates will have strong hands-on experience in cloud architecture, infrastructure provisioning, networking, security, automation, monitoring, and cloud operations. Candidates should be capable of managing cloud environments, troubleshooting infrastructure issues, optimizing performance and costs, and supporting enterprise-scale cloud transformation initiatives.

Open Positions & Designations
AWS Cloud Engineering
AWS Cloud Engineer (4 - 6 Years)
Senior AWS Cloud Engineer (6 8 Years)
Lead AWS Cloud Engineer (8 10 Years)
AWS Cloud Architect / Technical Specialist (8 – 10 Years)

Microsoft Azure Cloud Engineering
Azure Cloud Engineer (4 – 6 Years)
Senior Azure Cloud Engineer (6 – 8 Years)
Lead Azure Cloud Engineer (8 – 10 Years)
Azure Cloud Architect / Technical Specialist (8 – 10 Years)

Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Engineering
GCP Cloud Engineer (4 – 6 Years)
Senior GCP Cloud Engineer (6 – 8 Years)
Lead GCP Cloud Engineer (8 – 10 Years)
GCP Cloud Architect / Technical Specialist (8 – 10 Years)

1. AWS Cloud Engineer (4 – 10 Years)

Key Responsibilities
AWS Cloud Engineer (4 – 6 Years)
Provision, configure, and manage AWS cloud infrastructure.
Work with EC2, S3, EBS, VPC, IAM, RDS, ELB, and Auto Scaling.
Configure cloud networking, subnets, route tables, security groups, and network access controls.
Implement infrastructure automation using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or similar tools.
Monitor cloud resources using Amazon CloudWatch and configure alerts.
Manage backups, snapshots, patching, and infrastructure troubleshooting.
Implement IAM roles, policies, encryption, and security best practices.
Support application deployment, cloud migration, and operational activities.

Senior AWS Cloud Engineer (6 – 8 Years)
Design and implement scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant AWS environments.
Develop reusable Infrastructure as Code (IaC) modules using Terraform or CloudFormation.
Configure advanced networking, including Transit Gateway, VPC peering, VPN, and Direct Connect.
Implement CI/CD pipelines and automated infrastructure deployment.
Optimize cloud performance, availability, resource utilization, and costs.
Implement disaster recovery, backup, and business continuity strategies.
Work with ECS, EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, and other cloud-native services as required.
Establish monitoring, logging, security controls, and operational best practices.
Mentor junior engineers and conduct technical reviews.

Lead AWS Cloud Engineer / Architect ( 8 – 10 Years)
Architect enterprise-scale AWS cloud environments and landing zones.
Define cloud architecture standards, governance policies, and deployment patterns.
Lead cloud migration, modernization, and infrastructure transformation initiatives.
Design multi-account strategies, hybrid cloud connectivity, and disaster recovery solutions.
Drive security, compliance, resilience, and FinOps initiatives.
Establish automation frameworks and standardized IaC practices.
Lead technical discussions, architecture reviews, and cloud engineering teams.
Collaborate with application, DevOps, security, and enterprise architecture teams.

AWS Skills & Tools
Core Services: EC2, S3, EBS, EFS, RDS, DynamoDB, Lambda
Networking: VPC, Route 53, ELB/ALB/NLB, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect
Security: IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, Security Groups, AWS Organizations
Containers: Docker, ECS, EKS, ECR
IaC & Automation: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Python, Bash
Monitoring: CloudWatch, CloudTrail, AWS Config
DevOps: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline
Additional Services: SQS, SNS, API Gateway, Systems Manager, AWS Backup

2. Azure Cloud Engineer (4 – 10 Years)
Key Responsibilities
Azure Cloud Engineer (4 – 6 Years)
Provision, configure, and manage Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure.
Work with Azure Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, Azure SQL, and Virtual Networks.
Configure subnets, NSGs, route tables, VPN Gateway, and network connectivity.
Manage Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, managed identities, and access policies.
Automate infrastructure deployment using Terraform, ARM templates, or Bicep.
Monitor resources using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and alerts.
Support backup, recovery, patching, and infrastructure troubleshooting.
Assist with application deployment, cloud migration, and operational support.

Senior Azure Cloud Engineer (6 – 8 Years)
Design scalable, resilient, and secure Azure cloud environments.
Implement enterprise networking using VNet peering, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, and Azure Firewall.
Develop reusable Infrastructure as Code modules using Terraform or Bicep.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments.
Configure Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure App Service, Functions, and container services.
Implement monitoring, logging, security policies, and compliance controls.
Optimize resource utilization, performance, availability, and cloud expenditure.
Design backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to cloud architecture decisions.

Lead Azure Cloud Engineer / Architect (8 – 10 Years)
Architect enterprise-grade Azure environments, landing zones, and subscription structures.
Define cloud governance, security baselines, resource organization, and policy standards.
Lead Azure migration, modernization, and hybrid cloud initiatives.
Design identity, network, security, and connectivity architectures.
Establish automation frameworks, reusable IaC modules, and deployment standards.
Drive cost optimization, resilience, compliance, and operational excellence.
Lead architecture reviews, technical planning, and engineering teams.
Collaborate with enterprise architecture, security, DevOps, and application teams.

Azure Skills & Tools
Core Services: Azure VMs, Storage Accounts, Azure SQL, Azure Files
Networking: VNet, NSG, Azure Firewall, Load Balancer, Application Gateway, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute
Identity & Security: Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, Key Vault, Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud
Containers: AKS, Azure Container Registry, Docker
IaC & Automation: Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, Ansible, PowerShell, Azure CLI
Monitoring: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights
DevOps: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines
Additional Services: Azure Functions, App Service, Azure Backup, Site Recovery

3. GCP Cloud Engineer (4 – 10 Years)
Key Responsibilities
GCP Cloud Engineer (4 – 6 Years)
Provision, configure, and manage Google Cloud Platform infrastructure.
Work with Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
Configure VPC networks, subnets, firewall rules, routes, and Cloud NAT.
Manage IAM roles, service accounts, and access permissions.
Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and Google Cloud deployment tools.
Monitor cloud resources using Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging.
Support backups, recovery, patching, and cloud infrastructure troubleshooting.
Assist with application deployment, migration, and cloud operations.

Senior GCP Cloud Engineer (6 – 8 Years)
Design scalable, highly available, and secure GCP environments.
Implement advanced networking, including Shared VPC, VPC peering, Cloud VPN, and Cloud Interconnect.
Build reusable Infrastructure as Code modules using Terraform.
Deploy and manage workloads using GKE, Cloud Run, and Compute Engine.
Implement CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins.
Configure centralized logging, monitoring, alerting, and operational dashboards.
Optimize cloud performance, resource utilization, and infrastructure costs.
Implement backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions.
Support security, compliance, and cloud governance initiatives.
Mentor junior engineers and review technical implementations.

Lead GCP Cloud Engineer / Architect (8 – 10 Years)
Architect enterprise-scale GCP infrastructure and cloud landing zones.
Define organization structures, folder hierarchies, project strategies, and governance controls.
Lead cloud migration, modernization, and hybrid connectivity initiatives.
Design secure, scalable, and resilient cloud architectures.
Establish reusable Terraform modules and standardized deployment frameworks.
Drive cost optimization, security, reliability, and operational excellence.
Lead technical architecture reviews and provide guidance to cloud engineering teams.
Collaborate with data engineering, application development, security, and DevOps teams.

GCP Skills & Tools
Core Services: Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, Firestore
Networking: VPC, Shared VPC, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud NAT, Cloud VPN, Cloud Interconnect, Cloud DNS
Identity & Security: Cloud IAM, Service Accounts, Cloud KMS, Secret Manager, Organization Policy
Containers: GKE, Cloud Run, Artifact Registry, Docker
IaC & Automation: Terraform, Google Cloud CLI, Ansible, Python, Bash
Monitoring: Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Cloud Trace, Cloud Audit Logs
DevOps: Cloud Build, Cloud Deploy, Jenkins, GitHub Actions
Additional Services: Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, Backup and DR services

Common Skills Across All Cloud Platforms
Operating Systems: Linux, Windows Server
Cloud Fundamentals: Virtualization, networking, compute, storage, identity, and access management
Infrastructure as Code: Terraform and platform-native provisioning tools
Scripting: Python, Bash, PowerShell
Networking: DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, VPN, firewalls, load balancing
DevOps: Git, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes
Monitoring & Operations: Logging, alerting, incident management, root cause analysis
Security: Least-privilege access, encryption, vulnerability management, compliance
ITSM: Incident, change, problem, and service request management
Documentation: Architecture diagrams, operational runbooks, and technical documentation

Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
4 – 10 years of professional experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, cloud operations, or cloud architecture.
Strong hands-on expertise in at least one primary cloud platform: AWS, Microsoft Azure, or GCP.
Experience designing, deploying, and maintaining secure and scalable cloud environments.
Proficiency in cloud networking, IAM, compute, storage, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform and/or platform-native tools.
Understanding of CI/CD, automation, containerization, and DevOps practices.
Experience with cloud security, backup, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Relevant cloud certifications are preferred.
Experience with enterprise environments, cloud migration, hybrid cloud, and distributed systems is an advantage.

Preferred Certifications
AWS: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional, AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer – Associate
Azure: Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert
GCP: Associate Cloud Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect

Job Title: Interior Designer Livspace
Locations: Chandigarh | Indore | Bhopal
About Livspace
Livspace is a leading home interiors and renovation platform that simplifies the home interiors journey for homeowners. We combine design, technology, and execution excellence to create beautiful, functional spaces.
Role Overview
As an Interior Designer at Livspace, you will own projects end-to-end, from the first client interaction to final closure. You will combine design expertise, customer empathy, and business ownership to deliver exceptional customer experiences and achieve business goals.
Key Responsibilities
Translate customer requirements into functional and aesthetically appealing space plans.
Own and deliver complete interior design deliverables.
Provide an exceptional, trust-led customer experience.
Manage the project pipeline and achieve monthly revenue targets.
Ensure a smooth and seamless handover of projects to execution teams.
Required Skills and Qualifications
Minimum 2 years of experience in residential interiors, including modular interiors and space planning.
Bachelor’s degree in Interior Design, B.Arch, or equivalent qualification; alternatively, a 2–3 year diploma with 2+ years of residential interiors experience.
Proficiency in AutoCAD or similar design tools.
Experience in client-facing roles or design-and-build environments.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
High ownership mindset and comfort working in a target-driven environment.
Interested candidates can share their profiles at:
saurabh.jain02@livspace.com

The company serves homeowners across diverse market segments in India and Singapore.

To Apply - https://forms.gle/TBVpoDAymzYyP8aR6



Oxyzo Financial Services

About OXYZO:
OXYZO Financial Services Ltd is a leading Fintech NBFC headquartered in Gurugram.
We are into B2B lending and cover both SME and emerging corporate customers in Pan-India, having our offices spread across 20+ cities in India, including NCR, Chandigarh, Jaipur, Indore, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, etc.
OXYZO is part of the OfBusiness Group and was incorporated in 2016 having already built an AUM (Asset Under Management) of 11,100 Cr+ with a PAT of 375 Cr last year and is growing year on year with well-established processes and a governance framework with Marque investors including Creation Investments, Matrix Partners, Norwest, Tiger Global and Alpha Wave.

Responsibilities:
Actively sourcing and acquiring SME and mid-corporate clients across a spectrum of industries, including manufacturing, engineering, chemicals, pharma, textiles, and logistics.
Conducting thorough credit and risk analyses to inform sound decision-making, while adeptly preparing credit notes to facilitate smooth deal structuring.
Ensuring seamless document fulfilment and timely disbursement of credit facilities Working alongside the leadership and risk team to structure competitive deals and onboard clients effectively.
Collaborating with the leadership to identify and capitalise on new growth clusters and industries Building and leveraging a strong network within industry circles to expand the business portfolio and capitalise on emerging prospects.
AboutCompany:
OXYZO Financial Services Ltd is a leading RBI-registered NBFC headquartered in Gurugram. We are into SME & enterprise lending with 5k+ customers spread across Pan-India. We have our offices spread across 20+ cities in India, including NCR, Chandigarh, Jaipur, Indore, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, etc.

Incorporated in 2016, OXYZO has built an AUM (Asset Under Management) of 10,000 Cr+ since its inception in Nov 2017, and it is growing at a CAGR of 35-40% and a 4%+ RoA. We are backed by a marque set of PE/VC investors, including Creation Investments, Matrix Partners, Norwest, Tiger Global and Alpha Wave. We were valued as a unicorn in a Series A round in March 2022. OXYZO has 40+ lenders on its balance sheet, which includes SBI, SIDBI, Federal Bank, IDFC First Bank, Axis Bank, IndusInd Bank, Bandhan Bank, Bank of Baroda, Union Bank, Indian Bank, IOB, etc.

OXYZO also has a SEBI-registered Alternate Investment Fund (AIF) focused on emerging enterprises with commitments of INR 750Crs and a Debt Capital Market (DCM) advisory vertical which has structured/syndicated transactions of INR 4000Crs+ in the last 3 years.
CompanyAddress: Floor No.: 6th Floor Building No./Flat No Tower A Global Business Park, MG Road, Gurugram, Haryana, GURGAON, Haryana, India

Description:
Role Description:
This is a full-time, on-site Product Promotion Manager role based in Chandigarh, with a field-based business development focus. As a key member of the BMA team, you will be responsible for driving the strategic expansion of Bharat Medtec Ascents innovative and patented product portfolio across Chandigarh and the adjoining northern region. This leadership-oriented role requires a seasoned professional who can navigate complex hospital procurement cycles, build high-level clinical partnerships, and execute effective market-entry strategies for new medical technologies. The role also involves engaging with hospitals and healthcare providers, gathering market and customer feedback, and sharing insights with product and leadership teams to refine product positioning and strategy. The Product Promotion Manager will track key performance metrics, prepare regular reports, and contribute to building scalable and repeatable business development frameworks for multiple Medtec products.

Key Responsibilities:
Strategic Market Expansion: Identify and penetrate untapped market segments within corporate hospital chains, government institutions, and private nursing homes across the assigned region.
Key Account Management: Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), hospital administrators, and procurement heads.
Clinical Collaboration: Partner with surgical and medical teams to conduct product demonstrations, coordinate clinical training, and promote specialised devices through value-based selling.
Regulatory & Compliance: Ensure all business activities comply with applicable guidelines and international ethical standards for medical device marketing.
Tender Management: Lead the end-to-end institutional tender process, from technical specification development to commercial bid submission.

Required Qualifications & Skills:
Experience: Minimum 8-10 years of proven experience in medical device sales or business development. Experience in Neurology, Cardiology, Diagnostics, or other therapy areas is welcome.
Education: Bachelors degree in Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, or Pharmacy. An MBA in Marketing or Healthcare Management is highly desirable.
Regional Expertise: An established professional network within the Chandigarh healthcare ecosystem is highly desirable.
Technical Proficiency: Ability to discuss complex clinical outcomes and technical specifications with senior surgeons and specialists.
Analytical Prowess: Proficiency in market mapping, competitor analysis, and CRM-driven sales forecasting.
AboutCompany:
About Bharat Medtec Ascent (BMA)
Bharat MedTec Ascent (BMA), an initiative of HS Foundation India, is a product promotion platform dedicated to helping Indian MedTech startups successfully commercialise their innovations. We bridge the gap between product development and market adoption by enabling validated medical technologies to reach healthcare providers and patients across India.
Through a structured Product Promotion Program, BMA supports startups in building commercial readiness, strengthening clinician engagement, expanding sales and distribution networks, facilitating product adoption in both government and private hospitals, and enabling access to institutional procurement and tender opportunities. Backed by 40+ experienced product promotion professionals, clinical experts, and industry partners, we help innovators navigate the complexities of the healthcare market and accelerate sustainable growth.
Our mission is to enable indigenous MedTech innovations to scale faster, strengthen India's healthcare ecosystem, and contribute to a self-reliant future in medical technology.

Description:
ABOUT SAPCON STEELS PRIVATE LIMITED
At Sapcon, we don't just trade steel - we power the backbone of India's industrial growth. As one of the country's leading names in steel and industrial commodities, we've built our reputation on a simple promise: the right material, to the right customer, at the right time, every time.
With 35+ strategically located supply hubs across India and trusted partnerships with industry titans like JSPL, AMNS, SAIL and JSW, we sit at the intersection of scale and agility. From automotive plants and shipyards to solar farms, HVAC manufacturers, and the infrastructure shaping India's skylines, our steel moves industries forward.
Join us, and your work will directly fuel the projects transforming a nation.
Key responsibilities
Administer and configure the CRM: users, roles, permissions, profiles, fields, page layouts, and picklists
Build and maintain automations, including workflows, approval processes, assignment rules, and email templates
Own data quality: run regular de-duplication, imports and exports, validation rules, and data cleanup
Create and maintain reports and dashboards for sales pipeline, lead conversion, forecasting, and team performance
Reconcile CRM data with ERP and finance systems (orders, invoices, collections)
Research and build targeted lead lists by industry, region, company size, and product fit
Enrich leads with company data such as turnover, capacity, products, GST/registration details, and location
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Business, or a related field
2–4 years of hands-on experience administering a CRM such as Salesforce, Zoho CRM, HubSpot, Frappe CRM
Strong grasp of sales processes: lead to order cycle
Proficiency in Microsoft 365 especially Excel, including lookups, pivots, and data cleaning
Experience building reports and dashboards
Nice to have
CRM certification (e.g. Salesforce Certified Administrator, Zoho CRM Certified)
Basic knowledge of AI, SQL, APIs, or low-code automation tools (Zapier, Power Automate)
Detail-oriented, organised, and comfortable managing multiple requests

Job Summary
As a Customer Service Associate at Marks and Spencer, your main role is to assist customers, maintain store standards, and learn the basics of store operations.

Responsibilities
Greet & Assist Customers: Welcome customers with a friendly attitude and help them find what they need.
Understand Customer Needs: Listen to customers, understand their preferences, and recommend suitable products.
Support Visual Merchandising: Help maintain the store's appearance by following guidelines for product displays.
Proper Product Handling: Ensure products are handled carefully and organized correctly on the shelves.
Learn Store Procedures: Follow company guidelines for tasks like stocking, housekeeping, and cashiering.
Assist with Cashiering: When needed, help with basic cashier duties to provide smooth service.
On-the-Job Training: Take part in training sessions to improve your skills and grow within the role.

complete

Evaluation Engineer CARS24
Location: Chandigarh, Bathinda, Amritsar.
Department: Operations / Used Car Evaluation
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Evaluation Engineer to inspect and evaluate used vehicles. The candidate will be responsible for conducting technical inspections, identifying vehicle conditions, and preparing accurate evaluation reports to support vehicle procurement and pricing decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Conduct comprehensive inspections of used vehicles.
Evaluate vehicle condition including:
Engine performance
Transmission
Suspension
Electrical systems
Body & paint condition
Interior quality
Perform test drives to assess vehicle performance.
Use diagnostic tools and standard checklists for technical assessment.
Identify accidental history, repainting, or mechanical defects.
Prepare accurate vehicle evaluation reports and upload findings into the system.
Coordinate with procurement and operations teams for smooth vehicle acquisition.
Ensure adherence to company SOPs and quality standards.
Maintain transparency and professionalism during customer interactions.

Technical Skills

Good understanding of:
Automobile systems and components
Engine diagnostics
Vehicle body structure
OBD/diagnostic tools
Knowledge of accidental and flood damage identification preferred.
Basic computer and reporting skills.
Candidate should know two and four wheeler driving.
Candidate should have valid two and four wheeler driving license

Preferred Candidate Profile

Passionate about automobiles and vehicle technology
Ability to work in field operations
Comfortable with rotational shifts and travel within city locations
Valid Driving License preferred

Job Summary
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.


Responsibilities
Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the company's business
Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan
Coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
Maintain credit quality
Onboard new channel partners
Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications


Required Qualifications and Skills
1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred; Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities
Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills


Educational Qualifications
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage

Description:
Job Title: DataStage Developer
Experience: 2-8 Years
Location: PAN India
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a talented IBM DataStage Developer with 23 years of experience in ETL development, data integration, and data warehousing projects. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in IBM InfoSphere DataStage, SQL, and database technologies, with the ability to design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL solutions that support business intelligence and analytics initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy ETL jobs using IBM InfoSphere DataStage.
Develop and maintain data integration workflows for loading data from multiple source systems into data warehouses and data marts.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical ETL solutions.
Implement data cleansing, validation, and transformation logic.
Optimize DataStage jobs for performance, scalability, and reliability.
Perform unit testing, integration testing, and support UAT activities.
Troubleshoot ETL job failures and resolve production issues.
Work closely with database administrators, business analysts, and data architects.
Maintain technical documentation and adhere to development standards.
Ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance with organizational policies.
Required Skills
2 - 8 years of hands-on experience in IBM InfoSphere DataStage development.
Strong experience in ETL design and development.
Proficiency in SQL and database concepts.
Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
Knowledge of DataStage components including:
Designer
Director
Administrator
Manager
Parallel Jobs
Sequence Jobs
Understanding of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling.
Experience in Unix/Linux commands and shell scripting.
Knowledge of source code management tools such as Git.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

Title: Area Manager
Company: Center For Investment Education And Learning
Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, InstitutionalB2B Sales, Area Sales, About company, We are a skilling company, driven by the promise of a brighter India, vision of connecting formal education with practical skilling to create job ready students for BFSI. Description:
Job Title: Area Manager - Business Development
Locations: Ahmedabad, Kolkata, Chandigarh, Jaipur, Lucknow, Cochin
Reports to: Zonal Business Head
Job Type: Full-time (on-site)
Work Experience : 4 -7 years (Preferably in BFSI/ Education Industry)
Education: MBA or equivalent degree is preferred.
About Us: We are a skilling company, driven by the promise of a brighter India, vision of connecting formal education with practical skilling to create job ready students for BFSI. We are one of the largest corporate training companies in BFSI Industry and have been providing corporate learning solutions for 15 years to employees and professionals in Banking, Asset Management, Wealth Advisory, Insurance, Financial Distribution and Broking Companies.
FinX focuses on employability and employment for students, its subsidiary CIEL (Centre for Investment Education & Learning) focuses on corporate trainings, upskilling and Financial Awareness.
Role Overview: As the Area Manager - Business Development you will drive strategic partnerships with Universities, Colleges, MBA Institutes, Other educational institutions for BFSI focused vocational courses in your location. You will play a pivotal role in driving revenue growth, expanding business opportunities, and shaping the company's business growth. You will focus on securing key business mandates and building deep relationships with Vice Chancellors, Directors, Principals & HODs. This role requires a strong business acumen, relationship building experience, and the ability to work collaboratively across teams to achieve ambitious growth targets.
Key Responsibilities:
Relationship Building with Education Institutions: Establish and nurture strategic partnerships with Educational Institutions for our Industry focused vocational courses for their students with improved learning & placement outcomes.

Joint Management/PG/UG Programs: Lead efforts to secure mandates for customized BFSI Industry focused Joint programs wherein curriculum design, delivery, placement shall be our primary responsibility e.g. PGDBM (Financial Services), BCom (Capital Markets), PGDM( Banking, Lending & Credit)

Certifications: Drive alliances & initiatives to drive FinX Job- Readiness Certifications on BFSI, Wealth Management, Stock Markets, Equity, Debt, Lending, Alternate Assets etc. These certifications also have sales & behavioral skills embedded for a 360 degree perspective of knowledge & application

Short Courses: Embedding BFSI focused specialized trainer led short courses and NISM Certifications along with regular academic curriculum of UG/PG/ Management to improve knowledge level & employability profile of students e.g. Mutual Funds, Research Analyst, Equity Derivatives, Investment Banking, Financial Markets, Portfolio Management Services

Revenue Growth: Own and drive revenue growth, identifying new business opportunities, developing go-to-market strategies, and building a pipeline of potential clients.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams (product, marketing, operations) to ensure smooth delivery of solutions that meet client needs.

Client Relationship Management: Build long-term relationships with clients, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and repeat business.


Market Insights: Stay updated on market trends, competition, and opportunities, using insights to shape business development strategies.

Skills & Experience:
Proven track record (4 -7 years) in business development, corporate sales, or enterprise partnership roles, ideally in skilling, education, or HR services sectors.
Experience in BFSI ( Banks, KPOs, NBFCs , Mutual Funds, Broking, Insurance etc)
Strategic thinker with a business acumen and proven track record of execution
Excellent networking, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, start-up like environment.

We are looking at incumbents with the following qualities / skill set:

Ambitious
High energy and passion
Ability to build a business grounds-up
Believe in building long term relationships
Hard Working & Persistent
Good Communication Skills
Integrity, Ethics & Process Orientation

Why Join Us:

Be a key member of a mission-driven company aspiring to make a significant impact on skilling a future ready workforce. Shape the future of work by contributing to the growth of a platform that empowers people worldwide.
Competitive salary and benefits, with opportunities for professional growth and development.
This job description is designed to attract a seasoned relationship manager with the strategic vision and proven track record of execution needed to support the growth and expansion of FinX
AboutCompany:
We are a skilling company, driven by the promise of a brighter India, vision of connecting formal education with practical skilling to create job ready students for BFSI. We are one of the largest corporate training companies in BFSI Industry and have been providing corporate learning solutions for 15 years to employees and professionals in Banking, Asset Management, Wealth Advisory, Insurance, Financial Distribution and Broking Companies.

FinX focuses on employability and employment for students, its subsidiary CIEL (Centre for Investment Education & Learning) focuses on corporate trainings, upskilling and Financial Awareness.

Location: Chandigarh

Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Willingness to work in permanent night shifts.
Comfortable working 5 days a week with 2 rotational week-offs.
Candidates should be willing to work from the Chandigarh location.

This is an excellent opportunity to build a long-term career at sea with structured onboard mentorship, sign-on support, and progression toward higher ranks

Title Sales Associate
Reportingto Store Manager
SkipLevel Areas Operations Manager
Aboutthe Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
ActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartSalesAssociate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan&SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Storeupkeep& maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priorityRole & responsibilities
Note :
Family Insurance Policy and Monthly Incentive policy
Professionalized Training with Lenskart Academy ( Mandatory )

The Sales Executive shall be responsible for promoting and selling solar power solutions offered by Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd., with a primary focus on residential rooftop solar installations under the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, along with commercial and industrial solar projects.

Annual Bonus: Annual bonus as per company policy and applicable eligibility criteria.

AboutCompany:
GIBBON INFRASTRUCTURES PVT. LTD.
Company Profile
Renewable Energy | Solar Power Solutions | Civil Construction & Infrastructure Development
1. About the Company
Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. is an infrastructure and renewable energy company engaged in the solar power industry since 2021, alongside civil construction and infrastructure development activities. The company is committed to delivering reliable, technically sound, and cost-effective solutions that address the growing demand for sustainable energy and quality infrastructure.
With a focus on professional project execution, customer satisfaction, and responsible business practices, the company undertakes solar power installations and civil construction works for residential, commercial, institutional, and other project requirements.
Through its presence in the renewable energy sector and its involvement in construction activities, Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. aims to contribute to India's clean energy transition and infrastructure development.
2. Solar Power & Renewable Energy Division
Since 2021, the company has been engaged in solar power solutions, supporting the adoption of renewable energy through rooftop solar installations and commercial solar projects. Its activities include project planning, system supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and associated technical services.
The company undertakes solar projects across a range of capacities, from 3 kW residential rooftop systems to large-scale projects of up to 100 MW, subject to project scope and technical requirements.
Key Areas of Expertise
Residential rooftop solar power systems.
Solar installations under the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana.
Commercial and industrial solar power projects.
On-grid, hybrid, and off-grid solar solutions.
Solar photovoltaic (PV) system design and installation.
Supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of solar systems.
Solar project coordination and technical support.
Assistance with project documentation and relevant utility coordination.
The company works with solar equipment brands including Premier, Pahal, Adani, Vikram Solar, INA, Microtek, and Citizen, subject to project specifications and availability.
3. Civil Construction & Infrastructure Division
In addition to renewable energy, Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. undertakes civil construction and infrastructure-related works. The company recognises the importance of sound engineering practices, proper planning, quality materials, and efficient execution in delivering durable and dependable infrastructure.
Scope of Activities
Civil construction and building works.
Plain Cement Concrete (PCC) and Reinforced Cement Concrete (RCC) works.
Structural and allied construction activities.
Site preparation and development.
Foundation and related civil works.
Construction support for solar power installations.
Other civil and infrastructure works as per project specifications.
The company seeks to execute projects in accordance with applicable technical requirements, contractual obligations, safety practices, and agreed project schedules.
4. Our Vision
To establish Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. as a trusted organisation in renewable energy and infrastructure development by delivering sustainable solutions, maintaining professional standards, and creating long-term value for clients and stakeholders.
5. Our Mission
To promote the adoption of clean and renewable energy.
To deliver reliable and efficient solar power solutions.
To undertake civil construction works with a focus on quality and durability.
To maintain transparency, accountability, and professionalism in business operations.
To develop long-term relationships through customer satisfaction and dependable project delivery.
To contribute to sustainable development through responsible construction and energy solutions.
6. Our Core Values
Quality: Maintaining appropriate standards in materials, workmanship, and project execution.
Integrity: Conducting business with transparency, accountability, and ethical practices.
Reliability: Focusing on dependable solutions and professional service delivery.
Safety: Promoting safe working practices across project sites and operations.
Sustainability: Supporting renewable energy adoption and environmentally responsible development.
Customer Focus: Understanding client requirements and providing solutions aligned with project objectives.
7. Our Approach to Project Execution
Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. follows a project-oriented approach based on understanding client requirements, planning resources, coordinating technical activities, and executing works in accordance with agreed specifications.
For solar projects, the approach may cover site assessment, system design, equipment selection, installation, testing, commissioning, and associated documentation. For civil construction projects, the approach focuses on work planning, material and resource coordination, construction quality, site safety, and timely completion.
8. Commitment to Sustainable Development
The company recognises the growing role of renewable energy and dependable infrastructure in economic and social development. By operating across solar power and civil construction, Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. seeks to support energy efficiency, infrastructure improvement, and sustainable growth.
The company remains committed to strengthening its capabilities, developing professional partnerships, and delivering value-driven solutions for its clients.
9. Conclusion
Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. combines its experience in the solar power industry since 2021 with its involvement in civil construction and infrastructure works. Through a commitment to quality, technical competence, responsible execution, and customer satisfaction, the company aims to build lasting relationships and contribute meaningfully to India's renewable energy and infrastructure sectors.
GIBBON INFRASTRUCTURES PVT. LTD.
Powering a Sustainable Future. Building Infrastructure for Tomorrow.

Title - Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager

About Lenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers. Backed by IDG Ventures, Unilazer Ventures and TPG Capital, Lenskart has grown its array of services exponentially.
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Customer focus
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Product recommendation
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick- up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Store upkeep & maintenance
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
Title Store Manager
Reporting to Area Operations Manager
Skip Level City/Zonal Manager
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include
prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards
achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level
of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities
Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:Driving NetPromoter Score
Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that
Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring
this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving sales vs plan
Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People development (Attrition Control)
Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company
training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to
execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Cash & Inventory management
Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds

Description:
Profile Summary

Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

Driving Sales and Customer Service

a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually

b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store

c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership

d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.

e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.

f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.

g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.

h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

Manpower Planning & People Development

a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates

c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.

d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives

e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.

f. Overall responsibility for associate development

Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores

a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level

b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores

c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage

d. Managing the productivity of the staff

e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory

Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations

a. Regular Store Visits to:


Audit stores

Coaching the Store Managers

Motivate staff through sales discussions

Check VM, stock availability

Check store hygiene, grooming

Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.


b. Analyze data before Store Visits


Monitoring Sales through data.

Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores

Store Staffing levels.

Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.

NPS and MC scores

Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets


a. Bridge communication between Management and floor


Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.

Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.

Implementing and enforcing company regulations

Implement process change

Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets


Inventory Management

a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores

b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores

c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores

d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed

e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner

f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level

g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Key Personal and Professional Attributes:

a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.

b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.

c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.

d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.

e) Extroverted Personality

f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached

g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient

h) Passionate

i) Energetic

j) Positive Attitude

k) Ability to handle stressful situations

l) Problem Solving & Decision Making

m) Assertive

n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player

Candidate Profile:

a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry

b) Post-Graduation is a must

c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator

d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word

e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)

f) Sales oriented

g) Strong Management/leadership skills.

h) Strong organizational skills.

i) Strong team builder

Required Managerial Competencies

People Management

a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.

b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.

c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.

d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner

Proactive Problem Solving Skills

a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.

b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.

c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.

d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation

Commercial Savviness

a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.

b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.

c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints

Customer Expectation Management

a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer

b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests

c) Communicates effectively about sensitive matters and influences the client/customer when required

Planning and Organizing

a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments

b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches

c) Delegates work effectively among team members

Required Personality Traits

a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves

b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior

c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings

d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.

e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern

f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Description:
We are looking for a skilled Electrician to join our team at Ambuja Cements Ltd, responsible for maintaining and repairing electrical systems in a steel plant setting. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in electrical engineering and experience working with steel plants.

Roles and Responsibility


Troubleshoot and repair electrical issues in the steel plant.

Install, maintain, and test electrical equipment and systems.

Collaborate with other teams to ensure smooth operation of electrical systems.

Develop and implement preventive maintenance schedules to minimize downtime.

Ensure compliance with safety protocols and regulations.

Provide technical support and training to junior staff members.


Job Requirements


Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.

Proven experience as an electrician, preferably in a steel plant setting.

Strong knowledge of electrical engineering principles and practices.

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Familiarity with industry-standard tools and equipment.

Description:
Job role
A field service engineer's responsibilities usually focus on the the interaction of multiple technical systems and components and software. They are often seen performing direct maintenance or repairs on complex technology systems. Field service engineers' responsibilities may include, for example: Troubleshooting problems.
Job role
1.On-Site Maintenance and Repairs: Conduct regular inspections, maintenance, and repairs on a wide range of oil and gas equipment, including fuel dispensers and other types of equipment at retail outstations like Petrol pumps, to ensure their optimal performance and minimize downtime.
2.Troubleshooting: Diagnosing and troubleshooting complex technical issues that may arise during the operation of equipment, utilizing a deep understanding of the specific systems and processes involved in our industry.
3. Installation and Commissioning: Assisting with the installation, configuration, and commissioning of new equipment (fuel dispensers and other types of equipment at retail outstations like Petrol pumps), ensuring that it operates according to specified guidelines and safety standards.
4.Customer Support: Providing technical support and guidance to clients or customers, addressing their concerns, and offering solutions to maximize the efficiency and safety of their operations.
5.Safety Compliance: Ensuring that all work performed adheres to industry safety standards and regulations, and identifying potential safety hazards or risks to prevent accidents and promote a secure working environment.
6.Documentation and Reporting: Maintaining detailed records of service activities, including maintenance schedules, repairs performed, and any modifications made, and providing comprehensive reports to supervisors or management as required.
7.Training and Knowledge Sharing: Attending training sessions or workshops to enhance the understanding of equipment operations, maintenance procedures, and safety protocols.
8.Field Operations Coordination: Collaborating with other team members, including engineers, technicians, and project managers, to coordinate field operations, prioritize tasks, and ensure timely and effective resolution of technical issues.
9.Adherence to Company Policies: Following company policies and protocols, including those related to quality control, health, safety, and environmental protection, to uphold the organization's reputation and maintain high operational standardsRole & responsibilities

Description:
Job Summary
NagaEd is seeking a Program Manager to lead the implementation, monitoring evaluation (ME), and stakeholder engagement for a portfolio of school education programs in rural areas. Based in Nagaland, this role is crucial in ensuring that these programs are delivered effectively, aligned with community needs, and contribute to improving teaching quality and school outcomes. The Program Manager will work closely with schools, teachers, government bodies, and communities to ensure smooth execution across programs. The role will involve managing junior team members, contributing to program design, and ensuring that stakeholder voices are integrated into program implementation and improvements.
Organisational Unit Function
1. Program Implementation
Oversee and coordinate the implementation of a portfolio of education programs and school improvement initiatives in rural schools across the assigned districts.
Ensure all program interventions align with state and national education policies (e.g., NEP 2020).
Support teacher training sessions and ensure schools adopt best practices across programs.
Identify and resolve challenges in program execution, ensuring smooth rollout of each initiative.
Work collaboratively with internal teams to provide field-level insights that refine program strategies.
2. Monitoring Evaluation (ME)
Track progress against objectives and key performance indicators (KPIs) for each program.
Conduct field visits to monitor teacher effectiveness, student learning, and school improvements across the program portfolio.
Collect and analyze qualitative and quantitative data to measure program impact.
Prepare reports and case studies to document lessons learned and best practices.
Provide insights and recommendations for program adjustments based on findings.
3. Stakeholder Community Engagement
Serve as the key liaison between NagaEd, school administrators, teachers, and local communities.
Organize meetings, focus groups, and discussions to gather stakeholder feedback on program delivery.
Ensure community voices are integrated into program design, delivery, and ongoing improvements.
Work closely with local government education authorities, NGOs, and community leaders to build support for interventions.
Act as a bridge between stakeholders and NagaEd's internal teams, ensuring two-way communication.
4. Team Supervision Support
Provide guidance and manage junior program staff supporting field activities.
Foster a collaborative and supportive work environment, ensuring team members have the resources needed for success.
Ensure smooth coordination between field teams and internal teams across all programs.
Reporting Relationships
Reports to: Director
Supervises: Junior Program Officers, Field Coordinators (if applicable)
Communications (Internal/External)
School Administrators; Teachers - Implement training, ensure school adoption of interventions across programs
Government Education Authorities - Align programs with policies, secure support

Purpose of the Position
Academic Manager will support the Academic Lead in coordinating academic design and capacity-building activities under Mission SOAR Nagaland. Postgraduate degree with 7 years of program/academic coordination experience.

Strong project management and organisational skills.

Ability to manage timelines and quality assurance processes.
Experience with educational technology platforms is desirable.

Description:
COMPUTER TEACHER JOB DESCRIPTION
Position

Computer Teacher
Responsibilities
Provide quality computer training to students in the assigned school and conduct classes
online when required.
Plan and deliver engaging, age-appropriate computer lessons using clear explanations,
demonstrations, activities, and practical sessions.
Conduct regular computer laboratory/practice sessions and guide students through
hands-on exercises.
Prepare lesson plans, teaching materials, presentations, worksheets, assignments, and
practice exercises.
Conduct students assessments in a timely manner, including class tests, practical
assessments, assignments, and project work.
Evaluate student performance, provide constructive feedback, and support students who
require additional guidance.
Maintain student assessment data, attendance, records, and documentation of the
programs work in the school.
Use student-centered teaching methods and encourage participation, questioning,
problem-solving, creativity, and practical learning.
Maintain classroom discipline and ensure responsible use of computers, internet
resources, and laboratory equipment.
Conduct classes as per applicable government guidelines and the school’s academic
requirements.
The instructor has to conduct classes at ZPHS.
Support school-level administration of the project and complete project-related work
assigned by the reporting officer.
Coordinate with school staff and the reporting officer regarding schedules, student
progress, assessments, and program activities.
Deliver sessions in English and the official language of the state, as required.
Technical Skills
Strong knowledge of computer fundamentals, operating systems, file management, and
basic troubleshooting.
Proficiency in MS Office applications such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Knowledge of internet usage, email, online safety, digital citizenship, and basic cyber-
safety practices.

Knowledge of coding/programming concepts and ability to teach age-appropriate coding
through languages or platforms such as HTML, CSS, Python, Scratch, or similar tools.
Ability to conduct practical computer laboratory sessions and guide students through
coding and application-based exercises.

Ability to use digital teaching tools, online classrooms, presentations, multimedia
resources, and educational software.
Basic understanding of computer hardware, peripherals, networking concepts, and
common software installation/troubleshooting.
Ability to prepare digital learning materials, assessments, and student-performance data.
Teaching & Classroom Skills
Create structured lesson plans aligned with the prescribed curriculum and
government/school guidelines.
Explain technical concepts in simple, student-friendly language and adapt teaching to
different learning levels.

Use demonstrations, practical exercises, group activities, projects, quizzes, and real-
world examples to make lessons interactive.

Monitor student understanding during lessons and provide timely remedial support.
Manage classroom and computer-lab behavior while promoting a safe, respectful, and
inclusive learning environment.
Track learning outcomes and use assessment results to improve teaching and student
support.
Encourage students to develop logical thinking, problem-solving, creativity, digital
confidence, and responsible technology use.
Qualifications
B. Tech (any branch), MCA, or M.Sc. (Computer Science).
Any graduation with coding training certification.
Candidates with M. Tech / B. Ed. are given preference.
Experience
1+ years of experience in IT training, with familiarity in assessments, evaluation, and
practice sessions.

Location

Nagaland (Wokha)

Description:
Job Summary
The Senior People Officer is the experienced HR generalist within NagaEd, responsible for managing the applicant tracking system (ATS) pipeline, maintaining HR documentation and policies, administering compliance filings, and supporting the full employee lifecycle with growing independence. This role bridges the gap between administrative HR execution and strategic people operations handling complex HR processes that require judgement, accuracy, and a working knowledge of Indian employment practice. Reporting to the Operations Manager, the Senior People Officer takes ownership of HR processes rather than simply executing them. Where the People Officer handles coordination and data entry, this role manages the ATS pipeline end-to-end, drafts and maintains HR policy documents, prepares compliance filings, conducts initial screening of candidates, supports performance review administration, and serves as a knowledgeable resource on HR processes for the wider team. The Senior People Officer also provides task-level guidance to the People Officer and People Associate on shared workflows. Success in this role is measured by the quality and currency of HR documentation, the integrity of recruitment and employee data, the timeliness of compliance filings, and the ability to manage HR processes independently while knowing when to escalate.


Job Details
Department: Operations
Direct Reports: None (provides task-level guidance to People Officer / People Associate)
Manager: Operations Manager
Mentor/support: Operations Manager
Location: Kohima


Organisational Unit Function
ATS Pipeline Recruitment Management: Manage the applicant tracking system maintaining pipeline stages, updating candidate statuses, and ensuring data integrity throughout the recruitment cycle. Conduct initial CV screening and shortlisting against position description criteria, preparing shortlist recommendations for the hiring manager and Operations Manager. Coordinate and support interview processes scheduling panels, preparing assessment materials, collecting interviewer scorecards, and compiling evaluation summaries. Draft offer letters, employment contracts, and pre-employment correspondence for the Operations Manager s review and approval. Maintain recruitment analytics time-to-fill, pipeline conversion rates, and source effectiveness and surface insights to the Operations Manager. Ensure a professional, timely, and consistent candidate experience across all touchpoints.
HR Documentation Policy Administration: Maintain, update, and version-control NagaEd s HR policy documents, SOPs, the Employee Handbook, and associated templates. Draft new HR policies and SOP updates as directed by the Operations Manager researching best practice and ensuring alignment with Indian employment law requirements. Ensure all employees have signed and acknowledged current versions of key HR documents employment contracts, NDAs, handbook acknowledgements, and code-of-conduct agreements. Manage the HR documentation lifecycle drafting, review routing, approval tracking, distribution, and archiving maintaining a clear audit trail. Prepare HR correspondence confirmation letters, role change notifications, warning letters, and other employee communications for the Operations Manager s review.
Compliance Filing Statutory Administration: Prepare and coordinate statutory compliance filings POSH annual returns, Shops and Establishments Act returns, Professional Tax, and other applicable filings in coordination with the Operations Manager and external advisors. Maintain compliance calendars and trackers, ensuring all filing deadlines are surfaced to the Operations Manager at least two weeks in advance. Support POSH compliance administration maintaining the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) register, scheduling mandatory awareness training, and tracking completion. Coordinate with the Senior Finance Officer on employee-related statutory matters EPF, ESIC, and TDS records ensuring consistency between HR and finance records. Prepare documentation for labour inspections, audits, and regulatory queries as required.
Employee Lifecycle Records Management: Manage the HRIS (Zoho People or equivalent) employee master data, employment history, contract records, probation dates, and lifecycle milestones. Administer the probation review cycle tracking probation end dates, sending reminders to reviewing managers, compiling review documentation, and preparing confirmation or extension letters. Process employee changes promotions, transfers, reporting line updates, and salary revisions ensuring all changes are documented, filed, and reflected in HR systems. Maintain accurate and complete personnel files for all employees, ensuring audit readiness at all times. Administer the offboarding process exit checklists, knowledge transfer coordination, access revocation, final settlement documentation, and exit interview scheduling.
Performance Management Engagement Support: Support performance review cycles distributing review templates, tracking submission deadlines, compiling completed reviews, and maintaining performance records. Administer the goal-setting and OKR/KPI tracking process, ensuring all employees have current documented goals and that review cadences are maintained. Support the Operations Manager in running engagement initiatives pulse surveys, recognition programmes, team events, and feedback mechanisms. Compile and analyse HR data for engagement reporting participation rates, survey results, and trend tracking presenting summaries to the Operations Manager.
Leave, Attendance Payroll Coordination: Oversee leave and attendance management reviewing leave records for accuracy, resolving discrepancies, and maintaining up-to-date leave balances. Prepare monthly payroll inputs attendance summaries, leave adjustments, new joiner and leaver details, and variable components for handoff to the finance function. Respond to employee queries on leave policy, entitlements, and attendance with accuracy and in a timely manner.
Team Coordination Task Guidance: Provide day-to-day task-level guidance and quality checks to the People Officer and People Associate on recruitment coordination, data entry, filing, and onboarding logistics. Serve as the first escalation point for HR process queries from NagaEd staff before matters reach the Operations Manager. Ensure continuity of people operations during the Operations Manager s absence by maintaining standing HR processes and escalation protocols.


Reporting Relationships
This role reports directly to the Operations Manager. The Senior People Officer works with all NagaEd staff and managers on HR processes, coordinates with external advisors on compliance matters, and collaborates with the finance function on payroll and statutory employee contributions. The role does not hold formal line-management authority but provides task-level guidance to the People Officer and People Associate.


Selection Criteria
This role requires an experienced HR generalist who can manage multiple HR processes with accuracy and growing independence. The Senior People Officer must have a working knowledge of Indian employment practice, be comfortable drafting HR documents, and be able to exercise judgement on routine HR matters while knowing when to escalate.


Essential
Minimum 2 3 years of experience in HR generalist, HR administration, or people operations roles.
Working knowledge of Indian employment law fundamentals leave entitlements, POSH obligations, statutory filings, employment contract requirements.
Experience managing an ATS or structured recruitment pipeline.
Strong documentation and writing skills able to draft policies, SOPs, employment letters.
