Description:
ABOUT THE HANS FOUNDATION
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.
PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH & WELLNESS CENTRE
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.
GENERAL
Location of Job: South West Khasi Hills (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for a period of one year, renewable basis of performance and project requirements
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Coordinator
1. JOB PURPOSE
Nurse (ANM/GNM) will be responsible for providing preventive, promotive and curative health care services through VHSND in the assigned villages. S/he will accompany the team and will be responsible for providing counselling services to the community and other field level communication, counseling and health education support to the program. S/he will ensure participation of the community. S/he will maintain records of patient registrations and provide health education using IEC materials.
2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Visit along with the team in VHSND Programs.
Ensure support and work in coordination with local community workers such as Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers for effective service delivery.
Provide preventive, promotive and curative health care services.
Conduct individual and group sessions on reproductive health, mother and child health and nutrition, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and adolescent health.
Support in the management of Sub Center especially, record keeping, management of the patient flow and medicine distribution.
Coordinate to refer the patients to nearest health facility for secondary level treatment and follow up.
Responsible for supervision of village health workers and their capacity building.
Maintain relevant reports and documents.
3. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications : Bachelor s degree in nursing /ANM/GNM training or a related field with good knowledge in public health or hospitals
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experience of working in field/clinic for 1-3 years.
The candidate should be well versed with Hindi and local dialect.
Community mobilization and communication skills
THF is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions. We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other such matter.

Description:
Requirement of Pharmacist

BACKGROUND
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.

Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.

GENERAL
Location of Job: Ri Bhoi (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for 1 year, renewable basis performance
No. of Position: 2
Reporting to: Project Coordinator

Job Summary:
Pharmacist will be responsible for preparing and administering appropriate pharmaceuticals to patients. She/he achieves this by executing a physician s order. The job entails a high level of responsibility and knowledge. A pharmacist does not merely hand out prescribed medicine; he/she has the expertise and willingness to assist people and provide them with information and solutions.

1. Duties and Responsibilities:

The key responsibilities of this position are as given below:
Organize the pharmacy in an efficient manner to make the identification of products easier and faster;
Maintain full control over delivering, stocking and labeling medicine and other products and monitor their condition to prevent expiring or deterioration;
Review and execute physician s prescriptions checking their appropriateness and legality;
Listen carefully to customers to interpret their needs and issues and offer information and advice;
Provide assistance other medical services such as injections, blood pressure/ temperature measurements etc.;
Keep records of patient history and of all activities regarding heavy medication;
Comply with all applicable legal rules, regulations and procedures;
Liaoning with other healthcare personnel / medical officers to supply and receive relevant information about the background and progress of patients, as well as to refer order for progress to be made.
Assist the coordinator health/ medical officers during routine mobile OPD / health camps or in time of emergency.
Undertake any other duties assigned time to by Coordinating Office management
2. Other Indicative Requirements

Educational Qualifications
D. Pharma/B. Pharma from a recognized college/university
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)

Experience of working in field/clinic for 1-3 years.
The candidate should be well versed with Hindi and local dialect.
Community mobilization and communication skills
THF is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions. We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other such matter.

Description:
Field Associate - West Jaintia Hills (Khasi Language)
Location: Meghalaya
Experience Level: 1-3 years (Relevant fellowships in enterprise/livelihoods considered)
Role Overview
Ground Zero is seeking an energetic Field Associate to empower women-owned Producer Groups (PGs) under our Women s Enterprise Support System (WESS). The candidate will work independently on the ground, driving member participation, enterprise governance, local business operations, procurement, and market linkages in agri-business and rural commodities.
Key Responsibilities
Community Mobilization & Member Engagement: Mobilize women producer group members (~20 members per group) for collective business activities, procurement, aggregation, and local marketing.
Business Operations & Planning: Assist PG leaders in executing business plans across local value chains (agri-commodities, spices, etc.). Coordinate with input suppliers, buyers, and logistics service providers.
Governance & Financial Records: Guide PG leaders in maintaining financial discipline, books of accounts, meeting documentation, and governance records.
Capacity Building & Training: Organize and conduct block- and district-level training sessions for women entrepreneurs and producer group leaders.
Strategic Linkages & Stakeholder Support: Facilitate market, credit, and institutional linkages with government departments and community institutions with strategic guidance from senior leadership.
Field Monitoring & Reporting: Conduct needs assessments, value chain studies, and submit regular updates on field progress, financials, and operational challenges.
Qualifications & Candidate Profile
Education: Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Rural Management, Social Work, or a related discipline (Master s/MBA preferred).
Experience: 1-3 years of experience in rural development, livelihood promotion, SHGs/PGs, or enterprise development. Candidates from development/enterprise fellowship programs are also eligible.
Language Mandatory: Fluency in written and spoken Khasi is mandatory. Basic proficiency in English and Hindi is desirable.
Key Competencies: Strong field facilitation skills, basic computer proficiency (MS Excel, Word), and a proactive approach to solving field challenges.
Logistics: Owning a personal two-wheeler/bike is highly preferred for rural movement. Periodic travel to Shillong and Guwahati for strategic reviews will be required.
Diversity: Female candidates are preferred, though eligible male candidates are welcome to apply.

Description:
A. About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced Manager/ Senior Analyst Management Consulting (Commercial) to support the execution of a consultancy assignment with Meghalaya Energy Corporation Limited (MeECL) and its subsidiaries viz. Meghalaya Power Generation Corporation Limited, Meghalaya Power Transmission Corporation Limited and Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited. The role involves supporting the Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited in supporting in day to day commercial activities such as monitoring the billing, collections, identification of energy and revenue leakages etc.

B. Detailed expectations from the role:
The Manager shall be responsible for providing strategic and operational consulting support on Commercial function. Key responsibilities include:

Business Process Re-engineering
Review the existing process of reporting of key commercial parameters of the Distribution utility.
Prepare a Standard Operating Procedure for reporting of the key parameters along with responsibility matrix.
Engage with all the Stakeholders and get the feedback from them on the proposed SOP including middle and lower management.
Assist in the implementation of the Standard Operating Procedure within timeframes as approved by the Management.
Provide on recommendations on digital interventions along with the probable solutions along with the cost benefit analysis.
Formulate standardized daily, weekly and monthly reporting formats on key parameters with diagnostic analysis along with probable interventions to capture adverse deviations.

Billing and Collection
Monitoring the effective of billing and facilitating in ensuring 100 % billing.
Formulating Process of Billing Quality check. like- Under billed consumers, Overbilled, never billed.
Preparing of Billing, Collection & customer data Management Information reports from the billing Master data.
Billing & Collection Analysis of consumers of various categories.
Suggesting Changes & improvement of Billing system to minimize errors and system gaps.
Work in close coordination with the Unified Billing System provider.
Analyze the data of Smart Metered Consumers in terms of key parameters and prepare a report on the deviations along with the corrective actions. The report is to be circulated to all lower, middle and top management and vigilance team for corrective actions.
Suggesting the utilities on best practices in the industry for billing and collection checks.
Coordinate with Distribution Franchisee operator for submission of monthly MIS as per the contract document.

Management Review
Prepare presentation at sub-division level for the review meeting by management highlighting the key parameters along with the diagnostic analysis and suggestions for improvement.
Coordinate with the sub-divisions level officers for the Action Taken Report after each review meeting.

C. Required skill set:
Strong technical and commercial knowledge about the power distribution business.
Strong analytical, documentation, and report-writing skills.
Experience in handling smart meter data
Working knowledge of key regulatory interventions effecting the commercial parameters of DISCOM.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office applications.
Experience working with State DISCOMs, Government Utilities, or Power Sector Consulting organizations will be preferred.

D. Education and Experience:
BE/ B. Tech/ MBA/ M. Tech (Candidates with B. Tech and MBA may be preferred but not mandatory).
Knowledge of advanced MS Excel and Microsoft Power point is highly preferred.
Atleast 5 Years experience in Commercial Matters of DISCOM or consultancy company.

E. Location:
Shillong, Meghalaya.
The role will involve regular interaction with utility officials and may require field visits within Meghalaya based on project requirements.

F. Remuneration Structure:
We offer a motivation-based and competitive reward package aligned with international consulting industry benchmarks.
AboutCompany:
Mercados Energy Markets India Pvt. Ltd. (Mercados) is a specialist consultancy firm, exclusively focused on business solutions in the energy and environment domain. Since the beginning of its operations in India in 2008, Mercados has been supporting clients across the energy sector value chain. We strive to promote efficient and sustainable energy markets; design effective regulations and assist energy businesses to succeed. Our approach integrates innovative, state-of-the-art techniques with practical, tailor-made solutions to solve current energy sector challenges. We have permanent offices in New Delhi (head office), Gurugram, Mumbai, Ahmedabad and Lucknow and various Project offices across India.
Mercados has a dedicated team of over 185+ (and counting) professionals and has successfully completed 800+ assignments for its esteemed clients. Mercados operates under two broad verticals, namely Management Consulting and ‘Enterprise SaaS’. While the Management Consulting Vertical provides leading edge Advisory solutions to generation companies with over 42 GWs of conventional and renewable energy-based capacities, distribution companies with over 54 million consumers and large industrial consumers: the Enterprise SaaS Vertical aims at offering tailor-made digital solutions, power portfolio management, generation planning and algorithmic trading solutions – “jouleOS” - to Utilities in India.
Our Consulting portfolio envelopes diverse segments like ‘Strategy and Business Growth’, ‘Policy, Economic Analysis and Regulations’, ‘Planning, Energy Markets & Simulation Models’, ‘Transaction Advisory Services’, ‘Integrated Energy Supply Services’ and ‘Performance Improvement (Utility Management Services)’.

Description:
A. About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced Manager/ Senior Analyst Management Consulting (Procurement &Tendering) to support the implementation of a consultancy assignment with Meghalaya Energy Corporation Limited (MeECL) and its subsidiaries viz. Meghalaya Power Generation Corporation Limited, Meghalaya Power Transmission Corporation Limited and Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited. The role involves supporting procurement and tendering activities for utility projects, ensuring compliance with procurement procedures, facilitating bid management, vendor coordination, contract finalization, and monitoring procurement-related project deliverables.

B. Detailed expectations from the role:
The Manager shall be responsible for providing strategic and operational consulting support on procurement and tendering functions. Key responsibilities include:

Procurement & Tendering Support
• Provide day-to-day support to MeECL and its subsidiaries on procurement and tendering activities.
• Review the existing Operating Procedure of MeECL for bidding of services and goods.
• Prepare Request for Proposals (RFPs) for procurement of materials and services as per client requirements and in line with the State and Central Procurement Guidelines.
• Coordinate with the State E Procurement management team.
• Advise the client from time to time on updation of the procurement process and digital intervention in the procurement.

Vendor Identification & Bid Management
• Identify and facilitate the selection of suitable vendors in line with MeECL procurement processes.
• Support release of RFPs and tender documents.
• Coordinate pre-bid meetings and manage clarifications with prospective bidders.
• Facilitate all procurement activities through to contract award.

Bid Evaluation
• Review all the technical and commercial bids.
• Find out the deviations in the submitted bids from the conditions in the RfP.
• Prepare comparative statements, bid evaluation reports, and recommendations for tender finalization.
• Support evaluation committees during the bid assessment process.

MIS & Reporting
• Prepare, review, and validate MIS reports, dashboards, progress reports, and periodic submissions.
• Prepare a database for the bids with details of technical requirement, deviations allowed, revisions in the tenders done if any etc.
• Maintain procurement documentation and ensure timely reporting to the Client.
• Ensure quality and accuracy of reports, presentations, and Minutes of Meetings (MoMs).

Stakeholder Coordination
• Coordinate with officials MeECL, contractors, vendors, and internal consulting teams.
• Monitor procurement milestones and facilitate timely resolution of issues.

Additional Responsibilities
• Prepare a Standard Operating Procedures with timelines for each type of procurement and ensure compliance of the approved procedure.
• Support any other procurement and tendering activities assigned by the Client.
• Contribute to process improvement initiatives and procurement best practices within the project.

C. Required skill set:
• Strong understanding of procurement and tendering processes in the Power Sector including, distribution, generation and transmission.
• Experience in preparation of RFPs, bid evaluation, vendor selection, and contract award processes.
• Knowledge of public procurement procedures and utility procurement practices.
• Strong analytical, documentation, and report-writing skills.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
• Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office applications.
• Experience working with State DISCOMs, Government Utilities, or Power Sector Consulting organizations will be preferred.

D. Education and Experience:
• BE/ B. Tech or MBA (Candidates with B.Tech and MBA may be preferred but not mandatory).
• Atleast 5 Years experience in Procurement, Tendering & Contracts Management in a Power Utility / Discom company or Power utility consultancy company.

E. Location:
• Shillong, Meghalaya.
• The role will involve regular interaction with utility officials and may require field visits within Meghalaya based on project requirements.

F. Remuneration Structure:
• We offer a motivation-based and competitive reward package aligned with international consulting industry benchmarks.
AboutCompany:
Mercados Energy Markets India Pvt. Ltd. (Mercados) is a specialist consultancy firm, exclusively focused on business solutions in the energy and environment domain. Since the beginning of its operations in India in 2008, Mercados has been supporting clients across the energy sector value chain. We strive to promote efficient and sustainable energy markets; design effective regulations and assist energy businesses to succeed. Our approach integrates innovative, state-of-the-art techniques with practical, tailor-made solutions to solve current energy sector challenges. We have permanent offices in New Delhi (head office), Gurugram, Mumbai, Ahmedabad and Lucknow and various Project offices across India.
Mercados has a dedicated team of over 185+ (and counting) professionals and has successfully completed 800+ assignments for its esteemed clients. Mercados operates under two broad verticals, namely Management Consulting and ‘Enterprise SaaS’. While the Management Consulting Vertical provides leading edge Advisory solutions to generation companies with over 42 GWs of conventional and renewable energy-based capacities, distribution companies with over 54 million consumers and large industrial consumers: the Enterprise SaaS Vertical aims at offering tailor-made digital solutions, power portfolio management, generation planning and algorithmic trading solutions – “jouleOS” - to Utilities in India.
Our Consulting portfolio envelopes diverse segments like ‘Strategy and Business Growth’, ‘Policy, Economic Analysis and Regulations’, ‘Planning, Energy Markets & Simulation Models’, ‘Transaction Advisory Services’, ‘Integrated Energy Supply Services’ and ‘Performance Improvement (Utility Management Services)’.

Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid drivers license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.
Familiarity with sustainability metrics and ESG reporting is a plus.
Compensation & Benefits
Competitive base salary: ${salary}
Performance-based commission and bonus structure
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) plan with company match
Paid time off, holidays, and professional development opportunities
Company-sponsored training in solar technology and sales strategy

Description:
1. Shift In-Charge CPP Operations :
Qualification: Degree/Diploma in Electrical Engineering
Experience: 5-7 years in DCS-operated Captive Power Plant operations
Key Responsibilities:
Manage and monitor day-to-day CPP operations through DCS, ensuring safe, reliable and efficient plant performance.
Lead shift operations, coordinate with Boiler, Turbine and E&I teams, and ensure smooth power generation.
Monitor plant parameters, troubleshoot operational issues and ensure compliance with safety and operational standards.

2. Engineer Boiler :
Qualification: Degree/Diploma in Electrical Engineering
Experience: 5-7 years in Boiler Operations
Preferred: BOE Certificate
Key Responsibilities:
Monitor and operate boiler systems to ensure safe, stable and efficient steam generation.
Coordinate with shift teams for boiler start-up, shutdown, load management and troubleshooting.
Monitor key boiler parameters and ensure adherence to operational, safety and maintenance standards.
3. Engineer Turbine :
Qualification: Degree/Diploma in Electrical Engineering
Experience: 5-7 years in Turbine Operations
Key Responsibilities:
Operate and monitor turbine systems to ensure reliable and efficient power generation.
Handle turbine start-up, shutdown, load changes and operational troubleshooting as per SOPs.
Monitor turbine parameters and coordinate with Boiler and E&I teams for smooth plant operations.

4. Engineer Turbine Field Operator :
Qualification: ITI/Diploma in Electrical Engineering
Experience: 5-7 years in Turbine Operations
Key Responsibilities:
Conduct field monitoring and operation of turbine equipment and associated systems.
Perform routine equipment inspections, identify abnormalities and support troubleshooting activities.
Coordinate with the control room team during start-up, shutdown and load variation activities while maintaining safety standards.

5. Shift In-Charge E&I, CPP :
Qualification: Degree/Diploma in Electrical Engineering
Experience: 5-7 years in E&I operations within a Captive Power Plant
Key Responsibilities:
Lead shift-wise Electrical & Instrumentation operations and ensure reliable functioning of CPP systems.
Monitor electrical and instrumentation equipment, identify faults and coordinate troubleshooting with maintenance teams.
Ensure proper preventive maintenance, safety compliance and availability of critical E&I systems.

6. Engineer Instrumentation :
Qualification: Degree/Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering
Experience: 57 years in Instrumentation, preferably in a Captive Power Plant
Key Responsibilities:
Monitor and maintain instrumentation systems, control loops, sensors and field instruments across the CPP.
Troubleshoot instrumentation and control system issues to minimize downtime and ensure plant reliability.
Support calibration, preventive maintenance and smooth functioning of DCS/PLC and associated instrumentation systems.

Common Preference & Application :
Industry Preference: Candidates from Cement / Steel / Heavy Manufacturing industries will be preferred.

Location: Khliehriat, Meghalaya
Share CV: career@talentcraft.co.in

Note : Only shortlisted candidates will get call from consultant.

Description:
Block Functional Specialist Financial Inclusion
Shillong, Meghalaya
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic and result-oriented Block Functional Specialist Financial Inclusion to drive financial access, literacy, and empowerment initiatives for rural communities and Self-Help Groups (SHGs).
Key Responsibilities
Bank Linkage & Loan Facilitation: Facilitate SHG-bank linkages, streamline loan application processing, and monitor sanctioning, disbursement, and repayment.
Stakeholder Coordination: Liaise closely with local banks, Bank Sakhis, and Business Correspondents (BCs) to improve financial delivery networks.
Financial Literacy & Awareness: Conduct structured awareness programs on financial management and promote key government social security schemes (PMJJBY, PMSBY, APY).
Enterprise Support & Insurance: Assist SHG members in securing financial access for local enterprises, and support insurance enrollment and claim settlements.
Data & Community Management: Organize bank coordination meetings, foster community engagement, and maintain detailed data and reporting on financial inclusion metrics.
Key Qualifications & Eligibility
Education: Post-graduate degree or diploma in Science, Business Management (Finance), or Commerce from a recognized university or institution.
Age Limit: Below 30 years.
Experience: 1-2 years of experience in Rural Development and Poverty Alleviation programs.
1-2 years of experience working in Banks, Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs), or Microfinance Institutions (MFIs).
Technical Skills: Proficient in computer applications, with strong knowledge of MS Office and Google Sheets.

The society focuses on education, vocational training, and livelihood support for marginalized groups, particularly youth and women. With career opportunities in teaching, training, and social work, BIDS emphasizes holistic growth, skill development, and sustainable community impact.

Description:
Job Summary
Programme Lead - Community Libraries
Location: Shillong, Meghalaya, India
Contract: Fixed term consulting contract
Based on previous CTC and experience
Project Background
Sauramandala Foundation is an NGO founded in 2018 with a vision to bring about systemic change in the lives of remote communities through empathetic, collaborative, and contextual solutions that are co-created with the communities themselves.
About the Project (CM Youth Center):
The Government of Meghalaya, in partnership with Sauramandala Foundation, has established 22 rural community centres for youth, called the Chief Ministers Youth Centers (CMYC) with an aim to build resilience, agency and problem-solving skills in the community. The key programmes in the CMYCs are - Self Designed Learning, Entrepreneurship Development, Sports Coaching, Arts and Theatre and a Community Library Programme. The learning is open to all ages to have more involvement from the community. The CMYCs are set to expand from 22 centers to cover all 55 blocks of Meghalaya over a 2 year period.
Objective of the Engagement
To design and operationalize well-resourced, welcoming libraries in CMYCs that:
Build a culture of reading by working closely with children, young adults and youth in the community.
Serve as learning hubs supporting adolescent well-being and development.
Scope of Work
Curation
Build vibrant, culturally rooted, multilingual collections for children, young adults and youth.
Curate collections across themes of well-being, mental health, coming of age, gender, environment, sci-fi, indigenous knowledge and local culture and so on.
Ensure enough reading materials for beginner to confident and advanced readers.
Programme Design
Support the design of libraries and child and youth-friendly spaces.
Design a joyful community library programme that makes reading social, engaging and meaningful.
Create spaces for dialogue and self expression - reading circles, book discussions, open mics, writing labs, movie screenings and debrief reflections.
Integrate life skills and SEL into the library programme to build empathy, self-confidence, critical thinking etc.
Design for the library activities to travel to nearby villages around the Youth Center and to engage with existing Youth Clubs.
Building Community Ownership
Position the CMYC and the libraries as a community asset by engaging the community especially the adults to build a connection with the space.
Organise reading festivals, youth showcases, and community celebrations.
Create systems to encourage youth to play an active role in shaping the libraries - youth volunteers, library leaders and so on.
Strengthening libraries as safe, welcoming, learning hubs
Develop a simple monitoring framework for smooth operations.
Train first-time libraries with tools and techniques on youth engagement, creating safe spaces, facilitating shared reading experiences in the libraries.
Bring in low-cost digital tools and offline e-resources where possible.
Document learnings and adolescent and youth stories from the libraries.
Expected area of expertise
Master's Degree in Education/Library & Information Science or related field (preferred, not mandatory).
8-9 years of experience in setting up community libraries, training librarians and educators to build a culture of reading.
Any certifications on library science or engagements with organisations working in the field is preferred.
Strong knowledge of curation for different age groups from children to young adults and youth.
Ability to design and facilitate training workshops for first-time librarians.
Adaptability to an agile, cross-functional, collaborative working environment.

Description:
Job Summary
Recruitment Associate. Location: Meghalaya, India. Contract type: Fixed term consulting contract up to . Negotiable as per experience.


Role Overview
The Recruitment Associate will assist the Recruitment Manager in managing recruitment processes. This role involves coordinating candidate interviews, assisting with onboarding processes, maintaining recruitment databases and ensuring smooth recruitment operations. The Associate will also provide administrative support to the HR team as needed.


What will you do as the Recruitment Associate

Supporting a Positive Work Environment
Assist in implementing practices that support a safe, inclusive, and respectful workplace.
Help coordinate staff recognition efforts and team engagement activities.
Support efforts to gather employee feedback and share insights with the HR team for cultural improvements.


Recruitment & Onboarding Support
Assist with posting job openings, screening resumes, scheduling interviews, and preparing interview documentation.
Coordinate reference checks and support onboarding logistics for new hires.
Maintain accurate records of recruitment and onboarding processes.


Employee Relations Assistance
Support the HR Team in handling employee concerns and maintaining clear documentation.
Help coordinate and document discussions related to workplace issues or grievances.
Promote open communication by helping to manage feedback tools and suggestion channels.


Performance Management Support
Assist in coordinating the performance appraisal cycle, including scheduling and document preparation.
Help track the completion of employee KRAs and appraisals.
Provide administrative support for performance discussions and performance improvement processes.


Training & Development Coordination
Support the planning and logistics of training sessions (e.g., booking venues, managing attendance, sharing materials).
Collect participant feedback and compile summaries for review.
Assist in the development of basic training content related to values, inclusion, and workplace conduct.


HR Administration
Prepare and maintain HR documents such as offer letters, contracts, and confirmation letters.
Keep employee records up to date, including attendance, leave, and personnel files.
Assist in the administration of employee benefits, leave tracking, and policy communication.


Who are we looking for
Experience: 2-3 years of experience in recruitment or HR support roles.
Qualifications: Bachelor s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or related fields.
Strong organizational, communication and administrative skills.
Experience in recruitment processes, interview scheduling and candidate coordination.

Description:
About Virohan

Founded about a decade ago by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja, and Archit Jayaswal , Virohan is an education-to-industry partner building the workforce powering India s healthcare future. We partner with universities and colleges across India to deliver industry-aligned programs in Healthcare and management, helping students bridge the gap between education and real-world employability.

At Virohan, we believe healthcare education needs to go beyond classrooms. Our model combines academic learning with hands-on industry exposure and strong healthcare partnerships, ensuring students are prepared for real roles. Today, Virohan has trained 13,000+ healthcare professionals, with a growing network of university and industry partners across the country.
Backed by global investors including Blume Ventures (India), Mynavi Corporation (Japan), Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation (Switzerland), Artha Impact (Switzerland), Bharat Inclusive Technologies Seed Fund (India), and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Venture Capital (Japan) , we are building at the intersection of education and healthcare - two of India s fastest-growing sectors.

At our core, we are guided by a strong set of values that define how we work, build, and grow together - from ownership and bias for action to empathy, continuous learning, and raising the bar. If you re excited about building something meaningful at scale and solving real-world problems, you ll find yourself at home at Virohan.

Role Overview

The City Admission Manager will own Virohan s end-to-end performance in the assigned city-driving admissions, centre operations, team productivity, student experience, partner coordination, and local brand growth. This person will act as the single accountable business owner for the city, ensuring that all city-level teams deliver against growth, quality, and profitability goals.

What you ll be responsible for

Conduct market surveys alongside competitors.
Identify additional offerings for students.
Establish connections with educational institutions (schools, junior colleges, coaching classes).
Initiate discussions with HODs for seminar opportunities and other BTL activities.
Identify, onboard, and manage channel partners to expand offline sales reach and drive business growth.
Engage students, highlighting Virohans advantages.
Connect with parents during house visits.
Collect data from 12th board exam centers for attracting fresh students.
Plan canopy activities strategically for better outreach.
Plan and execute marketing activities, generating sales leads.
Manage local BTL activities effectively.
Reach monthly sales targets by nurturing agent relationships and networks.

An ideal candidate should have:

Comfortable with field sales; committed to daily market presence.
Proficient in consultative sale, adept at building trust without being forceful.
Capable of handling sales pressures.
Strong communication skills, particularly in regional languages.
Receptive to feedback, embracing learning from mistakes and setbacks.
Presentable appearance and previous fieldwork experience, preferably in education.
Strong presentation skills with the ability to effectively represent the company to diverse audiences.
Holds 2 to 5 years of marketing experience.

Required Skills
Counselling channel sales B2B partnership Telecalling Channel partnering

Description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT / TEAM LEAD - PHARMA SALES
Department: Sales Business Development
Industry: Pharmaceutical / Pharma OTC / Generics
Experience: 2-5 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Role Objective
The candidate will be responsible for driving sales and brand promotion through local market visits, retail/store engagement, dealer and distributor management, and market development. The role requires a candidate with practical knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic products market and experience in handling channel sales.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and grow sales across assigned local markets and territories.
Visit medical stores, pharmacies, retail outlets, and other relevant local stores for product promotion and sales development.
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers, distributors, stockists, and retailers.
Identify new dealers/distributors and expand the distribution network.
Promote assigned pharmaceutical, OTC, or generic products within the retail and distribution channel.
Generate orders and achieve monthly/quarterly sales targets.
Monitor product availability, stock movement, and market demand.
Coordinate with distributors and retailers to ensure regular product supply.
Conduct regular market visits to understand competitor activities, pricing, product availability, and customer requirements.
Support brand promotion activities and execute local-market sales initiatives.
Follow up on outstanding orders and coordinate for timely delivery.
Collect market feedback and communicate customer/product requirements to the management.
Prepare regular sales, market visit, and distributor activity reports.
For a Team Lead position, guide team members, monitor field activities, and support achievement of territory-level targets.
Required Experience
2-5 years of relevant sales/business development experience in the pharmaceutical sector.
Candidates must have experience in Pharma / Pharma OTC / Generic products.
Candidates with experience as Medical Representatives (MRs) may be considered only if their experience includes retail, distributor, dealer, stockist, or channel sales.
Experience in dealer/distributor handling and market development is mandatory.
Experience in local store/pharmacy visits and product promotion will be preferred.
Educational Qualification
Graduate in any discipline.
Candidates with B.Pharm / D.Pharm / B.Sc. / B.Com / BBA / equivalent qualifications may be preferred, depending on relevant sales experience.
Key Skills
Pharma Sales Business Development
Dealer Distributor Management
Retail/Local Market Visits
Brand Product Promotion
Channel Sales Market Development
Sales Target Achievement
Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate should be a field-oriented sales professional with strong knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic market, good communication and negotiation skills, and practical experience managing dealers, distributors, stockists, pharmacies, and retail outlets.
Budget: Maximum 30,000 net per month, depending on experience and suitability.

Description:
Job Description

The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals and youth on rural development, agriculture, skilling and economic inclusion, along with 15+ central and state government partners.

Our economic inclusion journey for 25 million Indians, has reached 10 states with $250M of government funding to cover 1.25M people. Our incubator, accelerator and grand challenges have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs including 17 Forbes 30U30, 3 EarthShot Prize winners, 1 Time Magazine cover and more.

Set up with support from 90+ eminent philanthropists , 40+ corporates and 15+ foundations including Gates, Mackenzie Scott, Vinod Khosla, Nandan Nilekani, Tata Trusts, Skoll, Meta, LinkedIn, HDFC, Mphasis, KPMG and LOreal, we are contributing towards a "poverty-free India, within our lifetime".

What are we solving for
We are solving for households in poverty who are also financially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.
At The/Nudge Institute, we are in the process of catalyzing the propagation of the same. Our purpose is to contribute to making the most excluded individuals a contributing member to the economy:

Enable govt to adopt by providing research, design, and implementation support
Continue to implement on its own to iterate the design for impact at scale
Enable more NGOs to adopt technical and capacity-building support
Continue to generate data on poverty and evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
Build technology solutions for NGOs and governments to adopt and implement at scale with quality.

What will you do
The/Nudge is working with various state SRLMs to help increase adoption of the graduation approach/ economic inclusion program by targeting vulnerable rural women through community institutions.
To understand and practice the Spirits of The/Nudge Institute and the respective SRLMs
Ensure all project activities are implemented on time with utmost quality as per approved Project Implementation Plan (PIP)/ Standard Operating Procedure (SoP)/ Package of Practice (PoP)/ Community Operational Manual (COM) in the respective districts.
Support the district in projects under PVTG Domain.
Coordinate with DMMU and BMMU to ensure smooth implementation of the project .
Coordinate and facilitate in organizing capacity building training of project team and community.
Coordinate and lead in organizing any project related event at regional and district.
Coordinate and support in any field visits of dignitaries and officials.
Ensure timely planning and implementation of project activities.
Ensure proper documentation and reporting related to the project to respective offices.
Facilitate the timely collection/ entry, processing and reporting of data.
Support and practice monitoring evaluation of projects.
Good stakeholder management at the grassroots level.

Who are we looking for in this role
Candidate must be graduate; post-graduate will be preferred, in relevant streams like rural development, rural management, agriculture, forestry, social work, anthropology etc.
Candidate must have 4-6 years of relevant experience in the development sector/ rural development projects/ poverty eradication projects/ livelihood promotion projects/ tribal development projects.
Candidate with work experience working in district-level positions in National Rural Livelihood Mission/ State Rural Livelihood Missions in Institution Building, Capacity Building, Social Inclusion, Social Development, and Livelihood promotion will be preferred.
The candidate must have her/his own two-wheeler with a valid driving license as it is a field job.
The Location for this role is based in Eastern West Khasi Hills

What s in it for you

Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including LD wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

You can learn more about what we do and how we do it through this deck .

.

Required Skills
government liaison Decision-Making Field Readiness field operations Teamwork Problem-Solving Communication Skills

Description:
Group Company: JSW Steel Limited
Designation: Shift Engineer
Job Brief: JSW Steel Limited is seeking a highly skilled and experienced professional to oversee and manage operations within the Steel Melting Shop (SMS). The role involves ensuring efficient and safe melting processes, maintaining equipment reliability, and optimizing production output in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in steel manufacturing, excellent problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to lead shift operations while adhering to quality and safety standards. This position demands proactive coordination with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence in line with JSW Steel's commitment to innovation and sustainability.
Responsibilities:
Manage and supervise all activities within the Steel Melting Shop during assigned shifts to ensure smooth and uninterrupted production.
Monitor and control the operation of furnaces, ladle metallurgy, and casting equipment to maintain product quality and process efficiency.
Implement and enforce safety protocols and environmental regulations to ensure a safe working environment for all personnel.
Coordinate with maintenance teams to schedule and oversee preventive and corrective maintenance of SMS equipment to minimize downtime.
Analyze process data and operational parameters to identify areas for process optimization and cost reduction.
Lead troubleshooting efforts for technical issues related to melting, refining, and casting processes, ensuring timely resolution.
Collaborate with quality control and metallurgical teams to ensure compliance with product specifications and standards.
Prepare and maintain detailed shift reports, including production metrics, incidents, and equipment status for management review.
Train and mentor junior engineers and operators to enhance team capabilities and knowledge sharing.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives by implementing best practices and innovative technologies within the SMS operations.
Ensure compliance with company policies, industry standards, and regulatory requirements throughout the shift.
Skills:
Steel Melting Process Control
Furnace Operation and Maintenance
Ladle Metallurgy Techniques
Continuous Casting Process
Industrial Safety Compliance
Preventive and Corrective Maintenance
Process Data Analysis
Troubleshooting and Problem Solving
Shift Operations Management
Quality Assurance in Steel Manufacturing
Team Leadership and Training
Environmental Regulation Compliance
Production Reporting and Documentation
Preferred Qualifications:
Bachelors degree in Metallurgical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field from a recognized institution.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in steel manufacturing operations, specifically within Steel Melting Shop or equivalent heavy industrial environment.
Proven experience in managing shift operations and leading technical teams in a manufacturing setting.
Strong knowledge of steel melting processes, furnace operations, ladle metallurgy, and casting techniques.
Familiarity with industrial safety standards, environmental regulations, and quality management systems relevant to steel production.
Proficiency in using process control systems, data analysis tools, and maintenance management software.
Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills tailored to a high-pressure manufacturing environment.
Required work experience
Years of experience: #*Years of experience*#

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
The position is accountable for proactively soliciting and handling sales opportunities. Ensures business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery. Assists in leading all day-to-day activities related to sales with a focus on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of sales objectives. Achieves personal sales goals.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 3 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.
OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 1 year experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Building Successful Relationships that Generate Sales Opportunities
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.
- Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings. Activities include sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc.
- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for sales opportunities.
- Manages and develops relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Provides accurate, complete and effective turnover to Event Management.
Managing Sales Activities
- Participates in sales calls with members of sales team to acquire new business and/or close on business.
- Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
Using Knowledge of Market Trends and Target Customer Information to Maximize Revenue
- Identifies new business to achieve personal and location revenue goals.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc. and knows how to sell against them.
- Closes the best opportunities for the location based on market conditions and location needs.
- Gains understanding of the location s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Supports the company s service and relationship strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Services our customers in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes and supports the company s customer service standards.
- Provides excellent customer service consistent with the daily service basics of the company.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Activity 1:
Service Provider shall depute a Scaffolding expert.
Activity 2:
The time duration for the work shall be twelve month in 8 hrs. in a day and execute the scaffolding inspection cum training work.
Activity 3:
Work shall be supervised, inspected and measured as directed by Engineer-in-charge and entered in the measurement book for
the Scope of Work with signature of contractor. Payment shall be made as per actual quantity executed. It is mandatory to maintain and
submit daily report of work & attendance to the EIC.
Activity 4:
1. Conduct thorough inspections of all scaffolding structures before use, during use, and after modifications.
2. Verify compliance with statutory requirements, industry standards, and site-specific safety protocols.
3. Identify hazards, defects, or unsafe practices and recommend corrective actions immediately.
4. Maintain inspection records and issue clearance certificates for scaffolds deemed safe for use.
5. Liaise with site management and safety officers to ensure scaffolding activities align with overall site safety plans.
Activity 5:
1. Assess current skill levels of internal scaffolders and identify training needs.
2. Provide on-the-job coaching, mentoring, and demonstrations of best practices.
3. Develop structured training modules to enhance knowledge of scaffold erection, modification, and dismantling
4. Promote awareness of safe working practices, load management, and fall protection systems.
5. Encourage continuous improvement and build a culture of accountability and safety among scaffold teams.

Description:
FB and Event Service Expert
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table or serving guests during a banquet or event.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our FB Service Experts is skilled in a wide range of event functions and able to take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests experience is well taken care of from start to finish.

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Title: Logistics Executive
Education: B.A - Bachelor of Arts in Any Specialization, B.Sc in Any Specialization, B.C.A. in Any Specialization, B.Com in Any Specialization, B.Tech / B.E. in Any Specialization
Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, Logistics ManagerSupply Chain ManagementDispatch ManagementSteel IndustryTMT Steel., TransportationFreight ManagementSAPERPVendor Management, About company, We Are JK Lakshmi Steel
Description:
Role & Responsibilities
Manage end-to-end logistics operations, including dispatch planning, transportation, and delivery of finished steel products such as TMT bars.
Plan and monitor daily vehicle placement, loading, dispatch schedules, and timely delivery to dealers, distributors, and customers.
Coordinate with Sales, Production, Warehouse, and Finance teams to ensure smooth dispatch operations.
Manage transporters and logistics vendors, negotiate freight rates, and optimize transportation costs.
Monitor vehicle utilization, freight expenses, transit time, and delivery performance.
Ensure proper documentation for dispatches, including invoices, e-way bills, delivery challans, and transport documents.
Track shipments and resolve delivery delays, transit issues, and customer complaints.
Ensure compliance with applicable transportation regulations, safety standards, and company policies.
Monitor logistics budgets, transport bills, freight reconciliation, and cost-control initiatives.
Maintain MIS reports on dispatches, freight costs, vehicle availability, and delivery performance.
Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, reduce logistics costs, and enhance customer satisfaction.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Graduate in any discipline; MBA in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or Operations will be an added advantage.
Relevant experience in logistics, transportation, dispatch, or supply chain management, preferably in the steel, cement, manufacturing, or infrastructure industry.
Experience in managing bulk material transportation, heavy vehicles, transporter networks, and dealer/customer deliveries.
Strong knowledge of dispatch planning, freight negotiation, vehicle utilization, and logistics cost optimization.
Working knowledge of GST-related transport documentation, e-way bills, invoicing, and compliance requirements.
Proficiency in MS Excel and experience with ERP/SAP systems will be preferred.
Strong vendor management, negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent coordination and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple dispatches and operational priorities.
Willingness to travel and work at plant or logistics locations as per business requirements.
AboutCompany:
We Are JK Lakshmi Steel

From the foundation to the frame.

For over 40 years, JK Lakshmi has held India's buildings together from the ground up. Our cement is in homes, schools, hospitals, bridges and roads across the country, trusted by the families who live in them and the engineers who design them.

Now we're adding the part that holds them up.

Steel is what keeps a structure standing. It carries the weight of every floor, every wall and every life inside. That's too important to leave to chance, so we're bringing the same discipline that built the JK Lakshmi name in cement to everything we make in steel: TMT bars, wires, structural channels and pipes.

We're not new to building India. We're simply taking the next step. What we did for cement, we're now doing for steel: raising the standard, checking every stage, and making sure the name on the product means something.

We're in your cement. Now we're in your steel.

Description:
Position Overview
We are looking for an energetic and result-oriented Sales Representative to develop sales and distribution in the assigned territory.
The candidate will be responsible for appointing and developing Stockists/Distributors, generating Primary & Secondary Sales, increasing retail coverage, opening new outlets, and achieving monthly sales targets.
Key Responsibilities
Identify and develop potential Stockists / Distributors in the assigned territory.
Assist in appointment and activation of new Stockists/Distributors.
Generate Primary Sales from Stockists/Distributors as per assigned targets.
Drive Secondary Sales through regular retailer and market visits.
Visit retailers, wholesalers and dealers according to the assigned beat plan.
Generate regular orders from existing and new retail outlets.
Open new retail outlets and increase numerical distribution in the territory.
Ensure availability and visibility of company products at retail outlets.
Develop new markets, towns and sales opportunities within the assigned area.
Build strong relationships with Stockists, Distributors, Wholesalers and Retailers.
Ensure adequate stock availability with Stockists/Distributors.
Implement company schemes, promotions and new product launches in the market.
Monitor competitor products, pricing, schemes and market activities.
Follow up with distributors for orders, supplies and payments where required.
Maintain daily market visit, order booking and sales reports.
Achieve monthly Primary Sales, Secondary Sales, Outlet Coverage and New Outlet Opening targets.
Candidate Profile
* Experience: fresh or 1-2 years in Field Sales / General Trade / Distribution Sales.
* Experience in FMCG / Food / Consumer Products / General Trade preferred.
* Good understanding of Primary and Secondary Sales.
* Experience in retailer/dealer development and stockist handling preferred.
* Good knowledge of the local market and surrounding areas.
* Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
* Target-oriented and willing to travel extensively in the assigned territory.
* Candidate should be comfortable with daily field visits.
* Two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance will primarily be measured on:
* Primary Sales Achievement
* Secondary Sales Achievement
* New Stockist / Distributor Development
* New Outlet Opening
* Productive Calls / Daily Market Coverage
* Retailer Order Generation
* Product Availability & Visibility
* Achievement of Monthly Sales Targets

Why This Role Matters
As a General Manager Sales, you will own the business performance and revenue growth for the assigned region. You will lead the sales function, drive operational excellence, and manage a high-performing team to deliver exceptional customer experience and business outcomes.

What You Will Own
Drive regional sales growth and achieve monthly/quarterly revenue targets.

Sales & Revenue Growth:

Motivate clients to choose bigger ads and run them more often to increase revenue.

• Client Acquisition & Relationship Management:
Identify and visit prospective clients through internal database or internal references.
Offer print advertisement solutions that match the clients business goals.
Build and maintain strong long-term client relationships.
Win repeat business from Clients by giving steady, reliable service.

Solution-Oriented Pitching:
Understand the client’s business needs and develop customized marketing proposal.
Use data insights, wherever possible, to help clients reach more customers in new areas.
Encourage client participation in Special Initiatives (festive editions, theme-based ads, etc.).
Support in field marketing activities related to SIs

Campaign Execution, Collections & Coordination:
Act as the point of contact for clients on all post-sale support (creatives, deadlines, placements).
Collect advertisement materials/creatives and ensure timely submission for publishing.
Coordinate with internal departments (Billing, RO Generation, Scheduling) to ensure smooth ad execution.
Follow up for payments and ensure timely collections.
AboutCompany:

Its flagship brand in Hindi language is Dainik Bhaskar, Divya Bhaskar is Gujarati language and Divya Marathi is Marathi language newspaper.

About MY FM, launched in 2006 as the radio business of DB Corp Ltd, stands out for its pioneering, research driven approach to radio in India. Before launching each station, MY FM conducted extensive research into listener behavior understanding preferences for RJ speaking styles & languages, and music choices which allowed the brand to tailor its content to the unique tastes of each city. This deep local insight and personalized programming enabled MY FM to build an immediate emotional connection with audiences, making it the most popular radio channel in its cities from day one and establishing it as Indias leading local FM network, especially across Tier II and III markets

Job Summary:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Accountant to manage daily accounting operations, GST compliance, ledger reconciliation, financial reporting, and documentation. Candidates with experience in steel, manufacturing, or trading industries will be preferred.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage day-to-day accounting entries, journal vouchers, and general ledger maintenance.
Handle accounts payable, accounts receivable, and vendor/customer reconciliations.
Prepare bank reconciliation statements (BRS) and monitor outstanding balances.
Assist in GST returns, TDS compliance, and input tax credit reconciliation.
Verify purchase invoices, sales invoices, debit notes, credit notes, and payment documents.
Maintain inventory and stock reconciliation records related to steel purchases and sales.
Monitor freight, transportation, and other operational expenses.
Prepare monthly MIS reports, expense statements, and account summaries.
Support internal audits, statutory audits, and month-end closing activities.
Work on accounting software/ERP such as SAP, Tally, and MS Excel.
Candidate Requirements
Graduate in Commerce (B.Com); M.Com or MBA Finance preferred.
25 years of relevant experience in accounting and finance.
Good knowledge of GST, TDS, accounting principles, and reconciliations.
Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting software/ERP.
Experience in steel, manufacturing, or trading companies will be an advantage.
Strong analytical skills, accuracy, and attention to detail.

Key Skills:
Accounting | GST | TDS | Accounts Payable | Accounts Receivable | Bank Reconciliation | Ledger Reconciliation | MIS Reporting | MS Excel | SAP | Tally | Inventory Accounting.

Preferred Industry: Steel / Iron & Steel / Manufacturing / Trading.

Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
District Head Land Acquisition | Industrial Project
Project

Industrial Project
Function

Land Acquisition / Project Development
Experience

15-20 Years of Relevant Experience
Location

Assigned District / Project Location
Reporting

State Head - Land Acquisition
Role Focus

Land Acquisition, District Management & Stakeholder Management

LAND ACQUISITION • DISTRICT MANAGEMENT • GOVERNMENT LIAISON • STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT
1. Role Overview
The District Head - Land Acquisition will be responsible for leading, managing and monitoring all land acquisition and land readiness activities within the assigned district for the Industrial Project. The role covers district level execution of land identification and sourcing, private and government land acquisition, title verification and due diligence, revenue documentation, statutory approvals, government liaisoning, stakeholder management, negotiations and timely possession/handover of required land parcels. The District Head will lead and coordinate the district land acquisition team, including Project Leads and Project Support personnel, and act as the key interface between the State Head, client/project teams, landowners, local stakeholders, legal teams, consultants and District/Revenue Authorities.
2. Key Responsibilities
A. Land Identification, Sourcing & Acquisition
Lead and monitor end to end land identification, sourcing, aggregation and acquisition activities across the assigned district.
Prepare and monitor district wise and village wise land acquisition plans in line with project requirements and timelines.
Ensure identification of suitable land parcels, preparation of land schedules, identification of landowners and plotting of required land on village/revenue maps.
Manage acquisition of private and government land through applicable State policies, revenue/allotment processes, LARR, surface rights, industrial development authorities or other applicable mechanisms.
Monitor parcel wise land aggregation, including area, ownership, acquisition status, documentation, possession and pending requirements.
Monitor private, government and other project relevant land processes applicable within the district.
B. Title Verification, Due Diligence & Legal Coordination
Oversee title verification and land due diligence covering ownership records, revenue records, encumbrances, disputes, transferability and other title related matters.
Coordinate with Legal teams and consultants for Title Search Reports (TSRs), legal opinions, agreements and resolution of title related issues.
Ensure proper collection, maintenance and updating of land documents, approvals, correspondence, agreements, survey records and other project documentation.
Ensure acquisition activities comply with applicable legal requirements, approved commercial parameters and project timelines.
C. Government Liaisoning, Revenue & Statutory Approvals
Liaise and maintain effective working relationships with District Administration, Collectorate, Revenue Authorities, Tehsil offices and other relevant Government Departments.
Monitor statutory permissions, land-use requirements, revenue permissions and project related approvals.
Develop and maintain relationships with District Administration, Revenue Authorities, local bodies, landowners and key local stakeholders.
Coordinate with relevant authorities and internal teams on revenue documentation, record entries, permissions and other district level land matters.
D. Landowner Negotiations, Stakeholder Management & Handover
Lead and support negotiations with landowners and other stakeholders regarding land rates, transaction terms and other commercial conditions within approved parameters.
Handle landowner, stakeholder, documentation, revenue and coordination issues at district level, escalating material matters to the State Head.
Ensure post-allotment/acquisition activities, including measurement, demarcation, revenue record entries and possession/handover of land parcels, are completed.
Ensure required land parcels are handed over to the client/project team within agreed timelines and in accordance with project requirements.
Anticipate district level risks, local issues and stakeholder concerns that may affect acquisition timelines and initiate appropriate corrective action.
E. Project Coordination, Mapping & Progress Reporting
Coordinate with Survey, Project, Legal, Compliance, Documentation, Administration and other internal teams for timely execution.
Review land acquisition progress against project milestones and identify delays, bottlenecks and critical dependencies.
Monitor the use of Google Earth, maps, satellite imagery and revenue/village maps for land identification, access assessment and parcel tracking.
Coordinate land requirements relating to project infrastructure, access, utilities, connectivity and ancillary facilities.
Conduct regular field visits and review the progress of Project Leads and field teams.
Prepare and submit periodic MIS, district level land acquisition reports, risk reports and progress updates to the State Head/Management.
Ensure land acquisition and land readiness activities remain aligned with the project's development and implementation schedule.
F. District Level Management & Team Leadership
Take overall ownership of land acquisition activities within the assigned district.
Allocate villages, clusters and land parcels among Project Leads/field teams and monitor their performance.
Lead, guide and monitor Project Leads, Project Support personnel and other field resources deployed within the district.
Set clear acquisition targets and timelines for the district team.
Review team performance, field activities, pending cases and documentation status regularly.
Guide team members in resolving landowner, revenue, documentation and local stakeholder issues.
Ensure effective coordination and communication between field teams and State/Head Office functions.
Ensure discipline, accountability and accurate reporting within the district land acquisition team.
Conduct periodic reviews with Project Leads and Project Support teams to ensure targets, documentation and timelines are achieved.
Provide accurate district level information to the State Head for management/client reviews and decision-making.
G. Authority, Accountability & Risk Escalation
Act as the primary district level authority for day-to-day land acquisition and land readiness activities.
Represent the project for routine coordination with district level authorities, landowners and other stakeholders.
Take appropriate operational decisions within approved commercial, legal and organisational parameters.
Escalate significant legal, commercial, regulatory, political/local stakeholder and project risks to the State Head.
Remain accountable for district wise land acquisition targets, documentation completeness and timely possession/handover of land.
3. Required Experience & Qualifications
8-12 years of relevant experience in Land Acquisition, Land Aggregation, Industrial Projects, Infrastructure, Energy, Real Estate or a closely related field.
Graduate qualification in Law, Engineering, Management, Commerce or another relevant discipline.
Strong hands on experience in managing land acquisition at district/project level.
Experience dealing directly with District Administration, Revenue Authorities, landowners, consultants and project stakeholders.
Practical experience in private and government land acquisition, title verification, due diligence, revenue documentation and statutory processes.
Demonstrated experience in landowner negotiations and resolution of complex land related issues.
Experience in leading and managing field based land acquisition teams.
Working knowledge of applicable State land/revenue framework and local acquisition environment.
4. Core Skills & Competencies
Land Acquisition & Aggregation
District Level Land Acquisition Management
Private & Government Land Processes
Title Verification & Due Diligence
Revenue Records & Land Documentation
Government Liaisoning & Statutory Approvals
District Administration Coordination
Landowner & Stakeholder Management
Commercial & Landowner Negotiation
Team Leadership & Performance Management
Survey, Demarcation & Field Coordination
Google Earth / Map Based Site Assessment
Risk Identification & Problem Solving
MIS, Documentation & Progress Reporting
Strong Communication & Negotiation Skills
Working knowledge of the local language and local land/acquisition environment (preferred)
Languages: English, Hindi and Local Language (preferred)
5. Key Success Measures
The District Head - Land Acquisition will be expected to ensure that the required land parcels within the assigned district are identified, legally and commercially assessed, acquired through applicable processes, properly documented and handed over in accordance with agreed project timelines.
Success will be measured through achievement of district-wise land acquisition targets, timely resolution of land and stakeholder issues, effective government liaisoning, accuracy and completeness of land documentation, performance of the district land team and timely possession/handover of encumbrance free land required for uninterrupted project execution.
