Description:
Role Overview
The Librarian will be responsible for the overall management, development, digitisation, and effective utilisation of the University Library and its learning resources. The role goes beyond the traditional management of books and circulation. The Librarian is expected to develop the library as a student-centric Learning Resource Centre that actively supports teaching, research, skill development, employability, innovation, and lifelong learning. The Librarian will ensure that physical and digital resources are easily accessible, appropriately organised, effectively utilised, and continuously aligned with the academic programmes and evolving requirements of Medhavi Skills University.
Key Responsibilities
A. Library Administration & Operations
Manage the day-to-day functioning of the University Library and associated learning/resource facilities.
Develop and implement library policies, SOPs, circulation procedures, membership norms, and operating guidelines.
Ensure systematic acquisition, accessioning, classification, cataloguing, shelving, circulation, and preservation of library resources.
Maintain accurate records of books, journals, periodicals, newspapers, reports, reference materials, and other resources.
Ensure efficient issue, return, renewal, reservation, and recovery of library materials.
Conduct periodic stock verification and reconciliation of library resources.
Maintain appropriate systems for damaged, lost, obsolete, and withdrawn materials.
Ensure appropriate library timings based on student s and academic requirements, including during examinations and other high-demand periods.
B. Digital Library & Technology
Develop and strengthen the University s digital library ecosystem.
Manage e-books, e-journals, research databases, institutional repositories, online learning resources, and other digital subscriptions.
Ensure effective implementation and utilisation of the Library Management System (LMS/ILMS).
Facilitate remote and campus-based access to digital learning resources wherever applicable.
Promote awareness and usage of digital databases and online academic resources among students and faculty.
Explore emerging technologies, including AI-enabled search, research and knowledge management tools, to enhance library services.
Maintain accurate digital catalogues and ensure easy discoverability of resources.
C. Academic & Student Support
Work closely with Heads of Schools, Programme In-Charges, faculty members, and academic teams to understand programme-specific resource requirements.
Ensure availability of textbooks, reference books, journals, case studies, reports, and digital resources required for different programmes.
Conduct library orientation programmes for newly admitted students.
Train students in effective use of catalogues, databases, e-resources, research platforms, and credible online information sources.
Support students in literature searches, assignments, projects, presentations, research, and academic referencing.
Develop initiatives to improve reading habits and library utilisation among students.
Organise book displays, reading campaigns, author interactions, knowledge sessions, quizzes, book reviews, and other library engagement activities.
D. Faculty & Research Support
Assist faculty and researchers in identifying relevant books, journals, databases, reports, and research materials.
Support literature review, reference management, citation practices, and information retrieval.
Facilitate awareness of research databases, open-access resources, institutional repositories, and scholarly publications.
Support the development and maintenance of an institutional repository for research papers, publications, reports, projects, dissertations, and other academic outputs, as applicable.
Coordinate with academic teams for continuous improvement of programme-wise library resources.
E. Acquisition & Resource Development
Prepare annual and periodic plans for acquisition of books, journals, databases, and other learning resources.
Collect recommendations from faculty, Schools, and academic departments.
Evaluate resource requirements based on curriculum, student strength, programme requirements, usage patterns, and applicable regulatory norms.
Coordinate with publishers, vendors, distributors, and service providers for procurement and subscriptions.
Support comparative evaluation and cost-effective procurement of library resources in accordance with University policies.
Monitor subscriptions and ensure timely renewal of essential databases, journals, magazines, and digital resources
F. Compliance, Accreditation & Documentation
Maintain all library documentation required for statutory, regulatory, accreditation, audit and quality-assurance purposes.
Support the University in documentation and data requirements relating to UGC,

Role Overview
The Assistant Professor - Rooms Division will contribute to the delivery and development of industry-oriented education in Front Office, Housekeeping, Accommodation Operations and Rooms Division Management. The role requires a strong combination of academic capability, hotel operations knowledge, practical demonstration skills, student mentoring, industry engagement and applied research.
Key Responsibilities
Teaching Learning
Develop and deliver engaging lectures, practical sessions, and workshops in Room Division subjects
Front Office Operations Guest Registration
Housekeeping Management Laundry Operations
Reservations, Yield Revenue Management
Property Management Systems (e.g., Opera, Fidelio)
Prepare lesson plans, session plans, and assessment tools aligned with CLOs and TLOs
Mentor, coach and advise students to achieve academic and professional excellence
Provide timely feedback on assignments, practical exams, and assessments.
Curriculum Academic Development
Update and revise syllabi to reflect industry best practices and emerging trends, to incorporate current industry practices, technology, and sustainability standards.
Create and manage practical exercises (e.g., front office simulations, housekeeping audits)
Design real-world simulations (e.g., mock check-in/check-out, room inspections) to reinforce learning.
Contribute to program accreditation, quality assurance, and periodic curriculum review processes.

Industry Engagement Research
Forge and maintain partnerships with hotels, resorts, and industry associations for guest lectures, internships, and site visits
Design and execute applied research or consultancy projects in Room Division (e.g., guest satisfaction studies, housekeeping innovations, front-office technology)
Publish research findings, case studies, and best-practice guides in peer-reviewed journals, conferences, and industry white papers
Present insights at academic and professional conferences to share knowledge and build scholarly reputation
Collaborate on joint projects with hospitality organizations, technology vendors, and industry bodies to drive innovation and practical impact
Industry Engagement

Guest lectures and masterclasses
Student site visits and industrial training
Internship and placement coordination
Keep abreast of emerging trends (e-concierge services, smart room technology, sustainablehousekeeping) and integrate them into teaching.
Service Administration
Participate in department and university committees (admissions, student welfare, qualityassurance)
Organize and oversee student-centric events like mock check-ins, workshops, and skill-drills

Description:
CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES
1. Academic:
Delivers and conducts Under-graduate student lectures/classes.
Conducts Under-Graduate Clinical classes.
2. Clinical:
Attends to the OPD patients during his slot of OPD timings.
Sees the inpatients admitted under his unit and also other inpatient referrals.
Attends to the emergency patients during on-call days.
Attends Operation Theatre schedules, to operate and oversee the Post-Graduates.
Covers up the duties of the other Assistant-Professors when they are on leave.
3. Others:
Submits articles to the media on a regular basis.
Any other job assigned by the HOD
SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & COMPETENCIES
Excellent interpersonal skills.
Great communication skills.
Good management skills.
Responsible and organized individual.
Exceptional research and writing skills.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
Qualification- MBBS and MS/DNB/MD in in the concerned subject and as per these regulations.
Teaching experience, research, and other requirements:
(a) one year as Senior Resident in the concerned subject as specified in a recognised medical institution.
Note 1: The requirement of one-year Senior Resident experience is relaxed for those appointed directly as Assistant Professor in Government medical institute immediately before the publication of these regulations.
Note 2: The experience gained by a Tutor in a medical institution of his specialty, having
a postgraduate degree, shall be considered equivalent to the experience required as a
Senior Resident for the purpose of eligibility for the post of Assistant Professor.
Note 3: The experience gained by a Demonstrator in a medical institution of his specialty, having a Master of Science and Doctor of Philosophy degree, shall be considered equivalent to the experience required as a Senior Resident for the purpose of eligibility for the post of Assistant Professor; or
(b) Specialist Medical Officers of the Armed Forces having at least one year teaching
experience or two years of clinical experience after obtaining the requisite postgraduate qualification in the concerned subject.
Note: In the specialty of Aviation Medicine and Marine Medicine two years of such experience in flying Squadrons and in Diving and Escape training Schools respectively will
be considered equivalent to one year of teaching experience (in lieu of Senior Resident) to become an Assistant Professor; or
(c) a non-teaching Consultant or Specialist or Medical Officer, possessing postgraduate medical degree with at least two years of experience in a Government hospital having at least 220 beds shall be eligible to become an Assistant Professor of that broad specialty without the requirement of experience as Senior Resident and shall complete the Basic Course in Biomedical Research within two years of appointment; or
(d) diploma holders appointed as Senior Residents in a recognised medical institution
before 08.06.2017 having total experience of four years as Senior Resident; or
(e) diploma holders working as Specialist or Medical Officer in the respective departments
of a government medical institution or Government medical institution running National Board of Examination and Medical Science recognised teaching programme having cumulative experience of six years.
AboutCompany:
Sikkim Manipal University was established in 1995. It is the first Government-Private initiative in the region and first ever Public Private Partnership (PPP) in the country for higher Education and Health Care services.
The University has two campuses: Health Sciences (Tadong) and the Technology campus (Majitar). All courses run by SMU are approved by the regulatory bodies like National Medical Commission (NMC), Nursing Council of India, Indian Association of Physiotherapy, All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) ,UGC and the Distance & Online Education Council.
SMIMS is a constituent of Sikkim Manipal University (NAAC A+ accredited university) situated in Gangtok, Sikkim.
The institute is recognized by National Medical Council and is attached to 550 bedded Central Referral Hospital, Tertiary Care Hospital.
It is ranked No.1 Emerging College in East India, No. 15 in Private Medical Colleges in India, and Best Private Medical College in East India

Description:
Sikkim Skill University is looking for Social Media Executive to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

A Social Media Executive is responsible for planning, executing, and managing social media campaigns to increase brand awareness, engagement, and sales. This role involves developing and maintaining a strong online presence for a company across multiple social media platforms, creating engaging content, and analyzing the success of social media efforts. Key Responsibilities : 1. Develop and implement social media strategies to increase brand awareness, engagement, and sales. 2. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create compelling and engaging content. 2. Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects in a fast - paced environment. 3. A creative and analytical mindset, with the ability to use data and metrics to continuously improve social media strategies. 4. A passion for social media and a deep understanding of how to use it to build brand awareness, engagement, and sales. 5. A strong understanding of brand messaging, tone, and voice, and the ability to consistently maintain a cohesive brand image across all social media channels.

Description:
Sikkim Skill University is looking for Estate Manager to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

An Estate Manager, also known as a Property Manager or Estate Supervisor, is responsible for overseeing and managing various aspects of a property or estate, ensuring its efficient operation and maintenance. Estate Managers can work in residential, commercial, or institutional settings, and their duties may vary based on the size and nature of the estate they are managing. Key Responsibilities : Property Maintenance : Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks. Ensure the property is clean, well - maintained, and aesthetically pleasing. Manage landscaping, gardening, and outdoor maintenance activities. Regularly inspect the property to identify maintenance needs and address them promptly. Financial Management : Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance. Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records. Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost - effective services. Security and Safety : Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants. Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary. Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures. Tenant and Guest Relations : Interact with tenants, guests, and residents in a professional and courteous manner. Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively. Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction. Staff Management : Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff. Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members. Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees. Administrative Tasks : Maintain accurate records of property - related activities, contracts, and expenses. Prepare regular reports for property owners or management. Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling, correspondence, and document management. Compliance and Regulations : Ensure the property complies with local, state, and federal regulations and codes. Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations affecting property management. Obtain necessary licenses and permits for the property's operation. Project Management : Oversee renovation, remodeling, and construction projects on the property. Coordinate with contractors, architects, and designers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget. Qualifications : Bachelor's degree in Business, Property Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Previous experience in property management, estate management, or a related field is highly desirable. Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills. Knowledge of property management software and basic financial principles. Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast - paced environment. Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

Description:
Role Overview:
Medhavi Skills University is seeking a dynamic Senior Manager Placements to lead the university s corporate engagement and student placement strategy at the Sikkim campus. This leadership role will be responsible for building strong industry partnerships, managing the placement team, and ensuring high-quality placement opportunities for students through strategic recruiter engagement. He will be responsible for getting all eligible
students placed.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Leadership & Team Management
Lead and manage the Campus Placement & Corporate Relations team to achieve placement goals.
Define KPIs, performance targets and accountability structures for the placement team.
Monitor team performance through regular reviews and ensure timely achievement of placement milestones.
Mentor team members and strengthen internal systems for effective placement management.
2. Industry Partnerships & Corporate Outreach for Placements
Develop and expand long-term partnerships with corporates, recruiters and industry bodies across sectors.
Identify and establish new recruitment partnerships for internships and final placements by frequent visits to Companies, Organizations PAN India.
Actively engage with industry leaders to position the university as a preferred talent sourcing partner.
Maintain strong relationships with existing recruiters to ensure recurring hiring engagements.
3. Placement Strategy & Performance Monitoring
Develop and implement the annual placement strategy for the campus.
Monitor placement progress across programs and ensure achievement of placement targets and quality benchmarks.
Establish systems for data-driven monitoring of placement performance, including placement dashboards and reports.
Provide periodic insights and updates to university leadership on placement outcomes.
4. Stakeholder Management
Work closely with academic leadership and faculty to align student skills with industry requirements.
Coordinate with internal teams to strengthen student employability and career readiness initiatives.
Ensure effective communication between students, recruiters, faculty, and the placement team.
5. Employer Branding & Institutional Representation

Description:
Job Summary
A technical procurement specialist supports various business lines to identify, shortlist, select, and acquire suitable goods or services or works from a third-party vendor through a direct purchase while ensuring timely delivery of the right quality and quantity. This role is also expected to maintain and build relationships with the existing suppliers and strategically diversify NOV s supplier base through market research. Having technical aptitude, the technical procurement specialists ensure the conformance of goods and services with engineering specifications during the entire procurement process.
Primary Responsibilities
Work closely with the operations teams to understand procurement requirements details and request vendor quotes.
Participate in the new vendor approval process.
Capture technical and commercial information and order goods in correct quantities to maintain the supply and demand balance.
Coordinate with planning teams to gather service PO workscope, generate service POs and communicate information related to the scope and delivery terms with vendors.
Follow up with vendors and suppliers regarding goods and service procurement and update production teams about delivery date changes when vendor PO due dates are rescheduled
Identify and resolve issues with vendors arising throughout the procurement process.
Identify ongoing procurement process improvement opportunities, review with management and implement as directed.
Liaise with the account payable department.
Comply with local regulations, API and ISO standard requirements.
Participate in API and ISO audits and represent the NOV purchasing department.
Perform other work-related tasks as assigned.
Comply with all NOV Company and HSE procedures and policies.
Analyze technical and commercial information from SMEs required to create vendor service POs.
Coordinate with the quality control department and independent verification authorities to manage inspection and witness activities at the vendor s site.
Determine the timing of placing orders for goods based on required dates and lead times.
Develop strong relationships with key suppliers and measure suppliers performance based on cost, quality, delivery, and service level.
Analyze the market to identify opportunities to expand the vendor base.
Determine vendors based on established criteria, negotiate the organization s purchasing agreements/contracts, and ensure their materials and products meet the company s specifications.
Identify sources based on internal global inventory analysis.
Coordinate with global NOV locations to fulfill unmet goods demand.
Identify potential bottlenecks and implement procurement strategies that support the company goals and long-term outsourcing objectives.
Routinely study vendor capabilities and new vendor establishments locally and regionally
Visit vendor locations to evaluate opportunities to diversify the regional vendor base.
Identify cost reduction opportunities by comparing multiple sources based on time-studies.
Coordinate with all shop departments to maintain knowledge of plant operations and equipment design in order to plan effectively.
Periodically review non-conformances and engineering changes to ensure suppliers are following correct revisions.
Research and obtain technical guidance from engineering and manufacturing experts to resolve technical questions during procurement.
Education & Experience Qualifications
A bachelor s degree/Diploma in Mechanical Engineering required.
Minimum of 04 years of experience with a working knowledge of procurement methods and procedures and processes.
CIPS Qualifications (Desirable)
Experience with ERP system required.
Knowledge of ISO, API, ASTM Material Standards required.
Knowledge of Casting, Forging, Heat Treatment process and raw material procurement required.
Knowledge of machining, Special coating & other manufacturing processes
Knowledge of Inventory Management
Proficient in use of Microsoft Office suite of products.
Strong communication in English (Both Verbal and Written)
Strong time management and analytical skills

Description:
About us
Build the future of banking.
Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences. 

Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today, over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Mastercard, and other reputed strategic investors, we reached a valuation of $2 billion in 2025.

Our focus is on establishing product lines that focus on key outcomes by addressing real customer pain points, modernizing legacy systems, and strengthening core fundamentals. As a result, our systems and platforms support a wide range of banking and payments capabilities, including:
1. Tachyon, our cloud-native banking stack built for population-scale systems
2. Cipher, our unified authentication platform for secure, high-volume banking environments
3. Digital Credit as a Service, enabling banks to launch credit lines on UPI
4. Elena, our intelligent and conversational AI platform for banking5. 5.Pixel, Indias first digital-native credit card, launched in partnership with HDFC Bank, for whom we also revamped their PayZapp mobile app: Winner of the Celent Model Bank Award for Payments Innovation 2024
6. Sparrow, the leading card experience for non-prime cardholders in the USand more across cards, payments, lending, and core banking.

We are an engineering-first organization that values ownership, bias for action, and long-term thinking. Together, we solve some of the hardest problems in banking tech. Our culture is built around trust, collaboration, and creating the conditions for you to drive impact proportionate to your potential. Reinforcing our commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace, we have been consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work.

If you want to build cutting-edge banking tech that enables banks to serve millions reliably, securely, and at a population scale, Zeta is your playground.If you would like to learn more about how we have grown and evolved over the years, watch our journey here. You can also explore our website and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram,YouTube, and X.
About the Role: 
We are looking for an Associate level legal professional who can act as a trusted business advisor who works collaboratively across business, sales, and other functions and has the knowledge and experience required to take on a variety of legal assignments, such as  employment law advisory, intellectual property advisory and portfolio management, transactional support and assistance, SaaS Agreements with potential customers of Zeta, and agreements with SaaS Vendors who provide SaaS to Zeta for internal consumption or integration within Zetas SaaS Offerings. 

Responsibilities
Drafting, negotiating, managing internal and external stakeholders, as well as managing external legal advisors assisting the company on such assignments.
Provide legal advice and opinions on all legal matters that impact the business and provide innovative solutions to minimize/manage the legal risks involved with the companys business operations in various jurisdictions around the world
To communicate effectively with internal stakeholders (such as management, leadership teams, Finance, HR, Information Security etc) and external stakeholders (customers/clients, vendors, investor representatives, industry association representatives).
To constantly improve and evolve the drafts and templates created by the legal team, from learnings from each customer. Strive to simplify drafting in order to achieve quicker turn-around-times and to make legal agreements easier for non-legal stakeholders to understand.

Skills
The candidate must have an excellent grasp of laws and market practices pertaining to a variety of technology agreements such as SaaS Master Service Agreements, Professional Services Agreements, Software Development Agreements; data protection laws and issues under a contract, intellectual property and other affiliated areas. 
The candidate should have the ability to work independently and within a team as and when required and must have unimpeachable integrity, honesty and the ability to maintain strict confidentiality.
The candidate should have excellent verbal and written communication skills in order to communicate with persons across different walks of life and cultures and in order to understand business requirements and communicate the required solutions. 
Ability to explain contract risks and obligations to non-lawyers.
Attention to detail, speed, and efficiency in reviewing and drafting documents.

Experience and Qualifications
5 year BA.LLB (Hons) degree from a reputed national law university/college. (Mandatory Requirement) LLM or postgraduate degree in law from a reputed international law university specifically in the field of technology law. (Optional Requirement). 
 Post Qualification Experience: 4 years In a top tier law firm, preferably within the technology law practice of the firm or at the least some level of experience in technology contracts; and/or As an in-house counsel in a Technology Company (preferably, SaaS however Non-SaaS technology company experience will also be accepted) People with prior experience in law firms, but currently working as in-house counsel will be preferred over people with no prior law firm experience.

Equal Opportunity
Zeta is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success

About us
Build the future of banking.Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences.

We are an engineering-first organization that values ownership, bias for action, and long-term thinking. Together, we solve some of the hardest problems in banking tech. Our culture is built around trust, collaboration, and creating the conditions for you to drive impact proportionate to your potential. Reinforcing our commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace, we have been consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work.
If you want to build cutting-edge banking tech that enables banks to serve millions reliably, securely, and at a population scale, Zeta is your playground.If you would like to learn more about how we have grown and evolved over the years, watch our journey here. About the Role:
We are looking for an Associate level legal professional who can act as a trusted business advisor who works collaboratively across business, sales, and other functions and has the knowledge and experience required to take on a variety of legal assignments, such as employment law advisory, intellectual property advisory and portfolio management, transactional support and assistance, SaaS Agreements with potential customers of Zeta, and agreements with SaaS Vendors who provide SaaS to Zeta for internal consumption or integration within Zetas SaaS Offerings.
Responsibilities
Drafting, negotiating, managing internal and external stakeholders, as well as managing external legal advisors assisting the company on such assignments.
Provide legal advice and opinions on all legal matters that impact the business and provide innovative solutions to minimize/manage the legal risks involved with the companys business operations in various jurisdictions around the world
To communicate effectively with internal stakeholders (such as management, leadership teams, Finance, HR, Information Security etc) and external stakeholders (customers/clients, vendors, investor representatives, industry association representatives).
To constantly improve and evolve the drafts and templates created by the legal team, from learnings from each customer. Strive to simplify drafting in order to achieve quicker turn-around-times and to make legal agreements easier for non-legal stakeholders to understand.

Skills
The candidate must have an excellent grasp of laws and market practices pertaining to a variety of technology agreements such as SaaS Master Service Agreements, Professional Services Agreements, Software Development Agreements; data protection laws and issues under a contract, intellectual property and other affiliated areas.
The candidate should have the ability to work independently and within a team as and when required and must have unimpeachable integrity, honesty and the ability to maintain strict confidentiality.
The candidate should have excellent verbal and written communication skills in order to communicate with persons across different walks of life and cultures and in order to understand business requirements and communicate the required solutions.
Ability to explain contract risks and obligations to non-lawyers.
Attention to detail, speed, and efficiency in reviewing and drafting documents.

Experience and Qualifications
7 year BA.LLB (Hons) degree from a reputed national law university/college. (Mandatory Requirement) LLM or postgraduate degree in law from a reputed international law university specifically in the field of technology law. (Optional Requirement).
Post Qualification Experience: 4 years In a top tier law firm, preferably within the technology law practice of the firm or at the least some level of experience in technology contracts; and/or As an in-house counsel in a Technology Company (preferably, SaaS however Non-SaaS technology company experience will also be accepted) People with prior experience in law firms, but currently working as in-house counsel will be preferred over people with no prior law firm experience.

Job Title: SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant

Location: Bangalore / Pune / Mumbai / Gandhinagar
Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and passionate SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant to join our growing SAP practice. As an SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant at Capgemini, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting SAP Business Workflow solutions to automate business processes and enhance operational efficiency. You will collaborate closely with functional consultants, business users, and technical teams to deliver innovative workflow-based solutions across SAP landscapes.
As an SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant, you will:
Design, develop, and implement SAP Business Workflow solutions to automate end-to-end business processes.
Configure and develop workflow components including Tasks, Standard Tasks, Workflows, Events, Methods, Rule Resolution, and Agents.
Create and enhance Business Objects (BOR) and ABAP OO-based workflow objects.
Develop custom workflow functionalities using ABAP programming techniques, User Exits, BAdIs, Enhancements, and Function Modules.

Job Description
Job Title: Product Lifecycle Risk Manager, AVP
Location: Mumbai, India
Alternative Locations: Pune, India / Bangalore, India


Role Description:
Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.
We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That’s why we are ‘Investors for a new now’.
As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.

About DWS Investment Risk:
The Chief Risk Office within DWS is an independent function responsible for protecting the business as well as being a trusted adviser and partner for supporting sustainable business growth.
As part of the Chief Risk Office, Investment Risk provides independent oversight and challenge of risks arising from DWS fiduciary activities, including the governance of investment products throughout their lifecycle.
The Product Life Cycle Risk Team is responsible for the New Product Approval framework, related policies, procedures, controls and governance tooling. The team works closely with Business, Investment, Product Management and control functions to support robust, transparent and regulatory-compliant product decisions.

What we’ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
Best in class leave policy
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities
Manage and further develop Product Risk processes, policies, controls and governance frameworks across the product lifecycle, ensuring consistent, scalable and effective standards.
Manage and continuously enhance the New Product Approval (NPA) framework, including transparent prioritization of initiatives and effective management of dependencies across the product pipeline.
Perform independent 2LoD reviews of NPA submissions and support the relevant Risk Type Heads in assessing and signing off product initiatives, including the identification, challenge and escalation of material risks and control gaps.
Own and further develop the NPA platform and related governance tooling, driving system enhancements, process automation and scalable workflow solutions.
Coordinate Product Governance activities across Business, Investment, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations and other control functions to ensure initiatives are complete, decision-ready and progressed effectively through the governance process.
Support governance committees and contribute to global Product Lifecycle initiatives through management information, decision materials, governance records, regulatory implementation and process transformation.

Your skills and experience
University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience, with at least five years of relevant experience in Asset Management, Product Governance, Product Management, Risk Management, Compliance, Operations, Regulatory Change or a related governance or control function.
Strong understanding of investment products, asset management operating models, product lifecycle management and Product Governance frameworks within a regulated financial services environment.
Knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, with the ability to assess regulatory developments and translate their impact into appropriate governance processes, policies and controls.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proven ability to independently review and challenge complex product initiatives, identify material risks and control gaps, and formulate clear, practical recommendations.
Experience managing or enhancing governance processes, workflows and control frameworks, including translating governance requirements into system enhancements and supporting tool implementation, testing, migration or automation initiatives.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organizational skills, with the ability to prepare concise materials for senior stakeholders and committees, constructively influence cross-functional teams and deliver high-quality outcomes across competing priorities.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word; experience with data analytics, reporting tools or process automation solutions is advantageous.

How we’ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

Description:
Role & Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements and design SAP FI solutions aligned with client needs.
Configure and support SAP FI modules including General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Asset Accounting (AA), and Bank Accounting.
Participate in end-to-end SAP implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support projects.
Conduct requirement gathering, fit-gap analysis, solution design, testing, and user training.
Work closely with cross-functional teams including SAP CO, MM, SD, PS, and technical teams.
Prepare functional specifications and support integration developments.
Ensure successful execution of UAT, cutover activities, and post-go-live support.
Collaborate with stakeholders to drive process improvements and digital transformation initiatives.
Provide consulting expertise and recommend SAP best practices.
Preferred Candidate Profile
6 to 20 years of experience as an SAP FI Functional Consultant.
Strong experience in SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA Finance.
Hands-on expertise in GL, AP, AR, AA, Bank Accounting, and Financial Closing processes.
Minimum 1-2 end-to-end SAP implementation projects.
Experience in global rollouts, support, or transformation programs.
Strong understanding of finance and accounting business processes.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
SAP S/4HANA Finance certification is an added advantage.
Consulting experience preferred.
Immediate to 60 days notice period preferred.
Perks and Benefits
Opportunity to work on large-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
Global client exposure across diverse industries.
Continuous learning and certification support.
Career growth within a leading technology and consulting organization.
Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
Competitive compensation and comprehensive employee benefits.
Access to cutting-edge digital and cloud transformation projects.
Experience: 6-20 Years
Job Type: Full-Time
Locations: Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune, Gandhinagar
Skills: SAP FI, SAP S/4HANA Finance, GL, AP, AR, AA, Bank Accounting, Financial Closing, SAP ECC, Implementation, Consulting.

Description:
Designation : Business Analyst
Location : Bangalore & Navi Mumbai Location

Responsibilities :
Business Analyst would be responsible for working closely with the Business Teams and helping them in making data driven decisions. This would require cross-communication between the Business Team, Product Team & Data Engineering as well. Apart from solving the business problem at hand, a Business Analyst would also be responsible for sharing insights and learning basis the data exploration/mining and convert these into clear action points and ensure that the same are being worked upon
Getting business requirements from the respective Business Teams, identifying the
underlying business case and building a generalized solution
Extracting & Exploring the data from database and other sources that may exist,
cleaning the data for any issues/missing values also needs to be owned upon
Converting the cleaned data into actionable insights and sharing the same with relevant
Audience
Automation of data problems/solutions that occur recursively
Flagging to Data Engineering in case of data sanity issues are to be seen
Ensure that the action insights shared with the business teams are worked upon
Ensure new business requirements are thoroughly vetted and signed off
Knowledge sharing within the team and outside if required

What are we looking for ?
2 to 4 years of work experience in the relevant field, preferably in a consumer facing company
Proficient in SQL and/or HQL , ability to handle complex/inner queries
Hands-on with Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel (basic data cleaning, pivoting and data exploration)
Must have worked on any one Data Visualization Tool (Tableau, Power BI, Microstrategy, Metabase etc)
Basic automation skills using Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel are expected
Hands on Knowledge of Python programming and Python for Data Analytics
Working knowledge on Machine Learning and Data Science Algorithms are a plus
Communication skills to get the business requirements and give out the final insights
Data Inquisitiveness

Description:
Synopsis:

The incumbent would be a member of the Organisation Development & Effectiveness team, which oversees the organization's learning and development efforts. The role would entail overseeing the allocated location's location learning activities (behavioural and leadership). The individual will be responsible for ensuring that the organization's training programs align with its overall goals and objectives and are tailored to meet the needs of individual employees at all levels.

Criteria:
Experience: 5 - 10 yrs.
Location: Bangalore/Mumbai/Mysuru
Education: Full-Time MBA (HR) Or any certified trainer with UG/PG Qualification
Training Delivery: Should have conducted/delivered behavioural training sessions.
Job Description:
Program Management and Delivery of Behavioural/ Soft Skills Training Programs for Middle & Senior Management.
Location Operations Manage all operations related to the training programs from the stage of planning to vendor management to post-training effectiveness.
Plan Quarterly Training Calendars and execute training workshops as per the plan to ensure threshold Learning parameters are met.
Creating learning materials: You will need to create learning materials that support the training programs, including training manuals, online courses, and instructional videos.
Liaison with internal and external learning SMEs to ensure the successful delivery of the training workshops.
As an internal Learning Consultant, work with Business Leaders to roll out interventions to address specific business challenges.
Create post-training effectiveness reports which include diagnosis, business impact, and recommendations to leaders.
Work with the OD team to establish strong linkages for the leadership programs and Lead and Manage at least one OD Project independently.
Manage all internal / external / surveillance / client audit and ensure all the processes are adhered to without any Non-Conformity
Managing the learning and development budget: You will need to manage the budget for learning and development programs, ensuring that resources are allocated effectively and efficiently.
Building relationships with stakeholders: You will need to build strong relationships with stakeholders across the organization, including senior leaders, department heads, and employees, to ensure that training programs meet their needs.

Must have skills:
Fluent and assertive in Communicating.
Effective consultation& Facilitation (Training Delivery) skills.
Content Development skills.
Basic Knowledge of assessments.
Stakeholder Management & Strong Networking capability Internal & External
Branding & Driving Organization-wide Learning communication.
Process compliance, Data management and Analysis

Preferrable Points:
Exposure or experience with organizations of similar nature, scale, and size to LTTS.
Facilitation skills (not as a freelancer)
Hands-on Experience with LMS (SuccessFactors)
Experience in instructional design and content design is preferred
AboutCompany:
L&T is a major technology, engineering, construction, manufacturing and financial services conglomerate, with global operations. The Company addresses critical needs in key sectors - Hydrocarbon, Infrastructure, Power, Process Industries and Defense - for customers in over 30 countries around the world.

We combine a proven track record and professional skills, woven together with a culture of trust & caring. Consistently rated among the best employers in the country, L&T offers unmatched leadership opportunities & growth. Our approach is built on empowering employees to take on challenging assignments and explore their potential.

Role & responsibilities

Design and own end-to-end GenAI architectures using AWS services (Python Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, Step Functions).
Lead model selection, tuning, optimization, including embedding models, RAG pipelines, multi-agent systems, and model-drift strategies.

Evaluate new GenAI capabilities and drive modernization of existing workflows.
Generative AI Development
Build and integrate applications with LLMs, image/video models, embeddings, vector databases, and inference endpoints.
Develop RAG, multi-modal, agentic workflows and fine-tuning pipelines.
Create prompt engineering guidelines, evaluation frameworks, and model guardrails (PII filtering, hallucination prevention).

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

Ensure robust security practices in all aspects of development and deployment.

8+ years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on AWS services.
Proficiency in programming languages Python.
Experience with Phyton related frame work and packages.
Strong understanding of serverless architecture and event-driven programming.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.
Preferred Qualifications:
AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Developer, AWS Certified Solutions Architect).
Experience with other AWS services like DynamoDB, API Gateway, and S3.
Knowledge of infrastructure as code (e.g., CloudFormation, Terraform).
Delivered at least one production-grade GenAI product or platform.
Experience with MLOps, DataOps, and model governance frameworks.

Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role
Capgemini is seeking highly skilled SAP Central Finance (CFIN) Consultants to join our growing SAP Finance Transformation practice. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAP Central Finance, SAP S/4HANA Finance, financial process transformation, data migration, and system integration. You will play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-wide Central Finance solutions for global clients.
Key Responsibilities
SAP Central Finance Implementation & Solution Design
Lead and participate in end-to-end SAP Central Finance (CFIN) implementation projects.
Gather business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP Central Finance solutions.
Configure and support SAP CFIN functionalities including:
Initial Load & Replication
Central Payment
Central Reconciliation
Application Interface Framework (AIF)
Source System Mapping
Key & Value Mapping
Design and implement real-time financial data replication using SAP LT Replication Server (SLT).
Collaborate with business teams to harmonize finance processes across multiple ERP landscapes.
Integration & Data Migration
Integrate SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, and non-SAP systems into the SAP Central Finance environment.
Manage data migration activities, including data cleansing, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation.
Support financial master data governance and integration with SAP MDG.
Ensure data consistency, completeness, and accuracy throughout migration and replication processes.
Troubleshoot replication and interface issues to ensure business continuity.
Finance Transformation & Process Optimization
Drive finance transformation initiatives leveraging SAP S/4HANA Central Finance capabilities.
Analyze existing business processes and recommend improvements based on SAP best practices.
Enable process standardization and harmonization across global business units.
Support business stakeholders in defining future-state finance operating models.
Financial Reporting & Support
Support financial reporting, analytics, and consolidation requirements.
Develop and enhance reporting solutions using SAP Fiori, Embedded Analytics, SAC, and BW.
Support month-end and year-end closing activities.
Provide post-go-live support and resolve issues related to:
Data Replication
Financial Postings
AIF Monitoring
Mapping Errors
Reconciliation Discrepancies
Financial Reporting
Required Skills & Qualifications
Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SAP Central Finance (CFIN).
Expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance and SAP FI/CO.
Experience with:
SLT Replication
AIF Framework
MDG Integration
Data Migration & Reconciliation
Financial Master Data Management
SAP Fiori Applications
Understanding of SAP integration methodologies and architecture.
Functional Expertise
Strong knowledge of:
General Ledger (GL)
Accounts Payable (AP)
Accounts Receivable (AR)
Asset Accounting (AA)
Cost Center Accounting
Profit Center Accounting
Internal Orders
Bank Accounting
Financial Closing & Reporting
Preferred Experience
6 to 15 years of SAP consulting experience.
Minimum 4+ years of hands-on SAP Central Finance experience.
At least one full lifecycle SAP Central Finance implementation is preferred.
Experience working on global SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
Exposure to Treasury, Group Reporting, and Cash Management would be an advantage.
Experience in Agile and SAP Activate methodologies.

Role & responsibilities
Job Description & Summary
PwC Professional skills and responsibilities for this position include but are not limited to:
Define cloud security guardrails across IAM, networking, and logging domains and enforce standards across client cloud environments.
Manage numerous engagements, primarily focused on helping organisations secure their cloud infrastructure and cloud-native services.
Lead threat modelling and security design reviews for cloud-native architectures and new cloud migration initiatives.
Partner with platform and DevOps teams to automate security controls, policy enforcement, and monitoring capabilities.
Conduct cloud security maturity assessments against industry-leading frameworks (such as CSA CCM, CIS Benchmarks, NIST CSF, etc.) to identify gaps and recommend improvements

Stay informed about emerging cloud threats, security technologies, and provider-native security capabilities, and incorporate this knowledge into client recommendations.

Strong knowledge of major cloud platforms (such as AWS, Azure, or GCP) and their native security tooling is advantageous.
Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code and security automation tools (such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Prisma Cloud, or Wiz) is beneficial.
Professional cloud security certifications such as CCSP, CCSK, AWS Security Specialty, or AZ-500 are a plus.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic and diverse team environment.
Demonstrated capability to manage multiple projects concurrently and adhere to deadlines.

Your Role

As a Data Analytics Architect, you will be responsible for designing end-to-end data architectures, establishing data standards and frameworks, and enabling business-driven analytics solutions. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and governance functions to deliver scalable, secure, and high-quality data ecosystems.



In this role, you will:

Define, design, and lead the implementation of end-to-end scalable data architectures from concept through production deployment.
Ensure alignment of data solutions with enterprise architecture standards, business objectives, and industry best practices.
Collaborate with compliance, privacy, risk, security, platform, and operations teams to incorporate all business and regulatory requirements into data solutions.
Develop data strategies, architectures, and policies covering:
Data Governance
Master Data Management (MDM)
Metadata Management
Data Quality
Data Security and Privacy
Provide technical leadership and act as a trusted advisor for data-related initiatives across programs.
Define and establish scalable, reusable standards, frameworks, and best practices for data architecture and analytics.
Lead data analysis activities including data profiling, transformation design, integration requirements, and quality assessments.
Design, document, and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models.
Oversee the complete data lifecycle, ensuring high-quality, scalable, and maintainable data solutions.
Guide development teams on architecture, implementation approaches, governance, and continuous improvement practices.
Conduct advanced analytics to generate actionable insights, identify trends, and measure key business outcomes.
Design visual analytics and dashboards that enable effective decision-making across stakeholders.
Apply statistical and analytical techniques to solve complex business problems and uncover business value.
Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, scientists, and platform teams to implement scalable analytics solutions.
Drive quality, governance, and delivery excellence across data and analytics initiatives.
Manage and optimize large-scale structured and unstructured datasets for reporting, analytics, and business intelligence use cases.



Your Profile

Mandatory Skills
12+ years of experience in Data Architecture, Analytics, and Enterprise Data Management.
Strong expertise in Data Architecture and Data Modeling techniques.
Hands-on experience in Data Engineering and Data Integration (ETL/ELT).
Deep understanding of Data Warehousing and Lakehouse Architecture.
Experience implementing Data Governance, Data Quality, and Master Data Management frameworks.
Strong capabilities in Data Analysis, Data Profiling, and Data Transformation.
Experience designing Business Intelligence and Data Visualization solutions.
Expertise in Statistical Analysis, Predictive Analytics, and Data Mining methodologies.
Experience working with Big Data platforms and distributed data processing frameworks.
Proficiency in SQL and programming languages such as Python and PySpark.
Strong understanding of Cloud Data Platforms and modern analytics architectures.
Experience in Data Security, Privacy, Compliance, and Regulatory requirements.
Knowledge of DataOps, CI/CD practices, and automation frameworks.
Strong stakeholder management, consulting, and technical leadership skills

About The Role

Job Title Industry SME Banking / Senior Manager S&C GN SONG

Management Level:06 Senior Manager

Location:Bangalore/ Gurgaon/ Chennai/ Pune/ Hyderabad/ Mumbai

Must have skills:Customer Service Strategy and Transformation, Technology, and Innovation

Good to have skills: Industry Trends and Disruptions, Digital Literacy, Value architect, Product Owner, Business Analyst, Digital transformation, Business case creations for Contact center transformation.

Experience: 10+ Years preferably in a Bank

Educational Qualification:Post Graduation in Business Management

Job

Summary:

We are seeking an initiative-taking and experienced Senior Manager to lead our Customer Service team, with a strong focus on leveraging technology, driving innovation, creating business value, reducing operational expenses, and maximizing customer satisfaction (CSAT). This role is critical in shaping the future of our customer service and ensuring we remain at the forefront of the banking industry.

If this role resonates with you, we invite you to discover many exciting global opportunities available within Accenture Strategy & Consultings Customer, Sales & Service practice.


Roles & Responsibilities:




Retail and Commercial Banking Expertise: Serve as a recognized subject matter expert (SME) on retail and commercial banking processes, products, and services. Maintain a deep understanding of core banking systems, lending, deposit, payment, and other banking functions.


Customer Service Strategy & Vision:Develop and execute a customer service strategy that aligns with the bank''s overall business objectives, focusing on technology integration, innovation, and delivering exceptional customer experience.


Customer Service KPI Mastery: Possess a strong understanding of key customer service performance indicators (KPIs) in the banking sector, including customer satisfaction (CSAT), Net Promoter Score (NPS), first call resolution (FCR), average handle time (AHT), cost per contact, Employee Satisfaction etc. Be able to analyze and interpret these KPIs to identify areas for improvement.


Competitive Analysis: Conduct competitive analysis to identify best practices and emerging trends in the banking industry. Benchmark the bank''s performance against competitors and identify opportunities to differentiate.


Technology & Innovation Leadership:Identify, evaluate, and implement innovative technologies and digital solutions to enhance customer service, such as AI-powered chatbots, personalized banking platforms, mobile-first solutions, and advanced analytics. Drive the adoption of these technologies within the customer service team.


Business Value Creation:Demonstrate a clear link between customer service initiatives and tangible business outcomes, such as increased customer acquisition, retention, cross-selling, and revenue generation. Develop metrics to track and report on the business value created.


Digital Transformation Leadership: Drive the digital transformation of customer service, including the implementation of self-service portals, mobile apps, CRM systems, and other relevant technologies. Focus on creating seamless omnichannel experiences. Experience in integrating these technologies into a Banking firm''s ecosystem is essential.


Cross-Functional Collaboration:Collaborate effectively with other departments, such as product development, marketing, and IT, to ensure alignment and seamless integration of customer service initiatives.


Client Engagement: Consult with clients on their customer service strategies and provide expert guidance on transformation initiatives, with a focus on technology and AI adoption. This may involve leveraging knowledge of specific insurance regulations and compliance requirements.


Pre-sales activities:Lead and contribute to pre-sales activities including response to RFPs, creating proofs of concept, creating effective presentations, demonstrating solutions during client orals, effort and cost estimation process, Business Case development etc.


Thought Leadership:Lead practice-specific initiatives including creating points of view, creating reusable assets on contact center space, performing analysis on industry research and market trends and bringing in innovative solutions etc.


Continuous Learning:Ability to take new challenges and to be an enthusiastic learner.


Qualification

Professional & Technical Skills:

MBA from a tier 1 or tier 2 institute.
10+ years of digital experience and solid knowledge of industry tools and understanding of designing intuitive and responsive user experiences.
Experience in working for a Banking company in Service Transformation role / Solid experience developing interactive models using conversational platforms and deep understanding of customer-centered design processes with consulting experience (optional).
Experience of working with business stakeholders across multiple geographic areas, with different priorities and requirements.
Ability to work in high-paced and complex projects and understand industry-specific customer service processes, operations and functional needs.
Thorough skills to manage stakeholder expectations and be engaging in resolving issues and risks for the success of the project.
Bachelors degree in related field or equivalent experience and Post-Graduation in Business management would be an added value.
Experience leading the design and implementation of contact center applications, from concept to deployment, is highly desirable.



Additional Information:
An opportunity to work on

transformative projects with key G2000 clients

Potential to

Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed

responsible business into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your

strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a

culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Description:
Real Estate Sales Executive ICSA LivX

About ICSA LivX:
ICSA LivX is a residential real estate and rental housing company based in Whitefield, Bangalore. We focus on providing quality rental homes and a seamless experience for tenants through well-managed properties and customer-focused services.

Role Overview:
We are looking for a proactive, confident, and target-oriented Real Estate Sales Executive to drive tenant acquisition and occupancy across our residential properties. The role involves handling customer enquiries, telesales, field sales, property visits, lead follow-ups, deal closures, and broker relationship management.

This is a sales-focused, on-site role suited to freshers and candidates with up to 2 years of experience who are eager to build a career in real estate sales.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Lead Management & Telesales
Handle inbound and outbound leads received through calls, WhatsApp, property portals, referrals, and other channels.
Contact prospective tenants, understand their requirements, and recommend suitable rental properties.
Conduct timely follow-ups to convert enquiries into confirmed bookings.
Maintain accurate lead records and update the CRM or Google Sheets regularly.
Ensure no potential customer is missed during the sales process.

2. Field Sales & Property Visits
Conduct property visits and site tours for prospective tenants.
Explain rental pricing, deposits, amenities, availability, and rental terms.
Build customer confidence and address questions or objections.
Negotiate within approved pricing guidelines and close rental deals.
Generate new leads through local outreach and networking in and around Whitefield.

3. Broker & Channel Partner Management
Build and maintain relationships with local property brokers and referral partners.
Manage broker WhatsApp groups and other lead-generation channels.
Share updated property availability, rental prices, and offers with brokers.
Coordinate site visits and follow up on broker-generated enquiries.
Track broker leads, conversions, pending follow-ups, and performance.
Coordinate broker commissions with management as per approved policies.

4. Sales Conversion & Occupancy
Work towards assigned sales and tenant acquisition targets.
Follow up with interested prospects until closure.
Coordinate with the relevant team to complete booking formalities after a deal is closed.
Support pre-sales and lead-generation activities for upcoming residential properties.
Maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective tenants to support occupancy growth.

5. Reporting & Coordination
Maintain daily records of calls, enquiries, site visits, follow-ups, and closures.
Submit regular sales updates to management.
Track lead sources and identify effective sales channels.
Ensure customer and broker information is recorded accurately.

Preferred Candidate Profile:
Freshers and candidates with 02 years of experience are welcome.
Candidates with experience in real estate sales, field sales, telesales, lead generation, or customer-facing roles will have an advantage.
Strong communication, negotiation, and customer-handling skills.
Comfortable making calls, conducting property visits, and meeting prospective customers.
Willingness to travel locally for field sales activities.
Basic knowledge of WhatsApp, Google Sheets, or MS Excel.
Self-motivated, target-oriented, and consistent with follow-ups.
A two-wheeler and valid driving licence are preferred.

Compensation & Benefits:
Salary: 2.5 - 3.0 LPA, depending on experience and suitability.
Performance-based sales incentives.
Opportunity to develop sales and real estate expertise in a growing business.

Job Details
Designation: Real Estate Sales Executive
Company: ICSA LivX
Location: Whitefield, Bangalore
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
Experience: 0 - 2 years
Work Mode: On-site with field sales activities

If you are confident in communicating with customers, enjoy sales, and want to grow in the real estate industry, we encourage you to apply.
AboutCompany: ICSA LivX is a rapidly growing property management startup dedicated to transforming the rental housing experience. We manage residential properties, drive occupancy through strong sales, and deliver exceptional tenant experiences through efficient on-ground operations. Join us to be part of a dynamic team where you'll have the opportunity to learn, take ownership, and grow alongside the company.

Description:
Dear Candidate,
Greetings from Vedantu!
We are hiring for the position of Direct Sales Associate and would like to invite you to be part of our high-growth EdTech sales team.

About Vedantu
Founded in 2014, Vedantu is a pioneer in online education in India, on a mission to make quality learning accessible, affordable, and personalized for every student.
Vedantu was founded by Vamsi Krishna (Co-Founder & CEO), Pulkit Jain (Co-Founder & Head of Product), and Anand Prakash (Co-Founder & Head of Academics). Before Vedantu, the founders started their first education venture, Lakshya, in 2006, which was acquired by MT Educare (Mahesh Tutorials) in 2012. Between them, they have taught and mentored over 10,000 students and trained more than 200 teachers.

Role Details
Designation: Direct Sales Associate
Department: Sales
Location: Bangalore
Working Days: 6 days a week 
Working Hours: 11:00 AM 8:00 PM
CTC:- 3.5 LPA - 6 LPA

What You Will Do
1.Connect with parents and students via calls, emails, and WhatsApp
2.Understand students learning needs and recommend the right courses through impactful demos
3.Manage the complete sales cycle, from first contact to payment collection and onboarding
4.Achieve daily talk-time and monthly revenue targets
5.Build long-term trust with parents and generate referrals

Who Can Apply
1.Any Graduate or Postgraduate
2.02 years of experience in inside sales, direct sales, or business development (EdTech, BFSI, Telecom, or B2C sales is an advantage)
3.Excellent English communication; Kannada (Bengaluru) or Tamil (Chennai) is a plus
4.Resilient, target-driven, and comfortable handling rejection

Whats in It for You
1.Uncapped, best-in-industry monthly incentives
2.Fast-track growth to Team Lead or Sales Manager roles within 12–18 months
3.1-week sales boot camp covering product knowledge, consumer psychology, and consultative selling

Description:
Job description: SAP BW4/HANA L3 Support and Enhancement.
A BW/4HANA L3 Support Engineer requires advanced technical support for SAP BW/4HANA systems, resolving complex issues escalated from lower support levels. This role requires deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA architecture, data modelling and troubleshooting techniques. Key responsibilities include analysing and resolving critical incidents, performing root cause analysis, and collaborating with development teams for long-term solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
Troubleshooting and Resolution: Investigate and resolve complex technical issues related to SAP BW/4HANA, often involving performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, or system errors.
Root Cause Analysis: Conduct thorough root cause analysis to identify the underlying causes of issues and implement preventative measures.
Collaboration: Work closely with L1 and L2 support teams, development teams, and other IT teams to resolve issues and improve system stability.
System Monitoring: Monitor the health and performance of SAP BW/4HANA systems, proactively identifying and addressing potential problems.
Knowledge Management: Document solutions, troubleshooting procedures, and best practices to build a knowledge base for future reference.
Mentorship: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior support engineers.
Incident Management: Manage critical incidents (P1 and P2 tickets) and ensure timely resolution.
System Enhancement: Contribute to the development and implementation of solutions to improve system performance and stability.
Required Skills & Experience:
Deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA: Including data modelling, data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Advanced troubleshooting skills: Ability to analyse complex issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
Strong communication and collaboration skills: Ability to effectively communicate with various stakeholders, including business users and technical teams.
Experience with SAP BW/4HANA administration: Including system configuration, performance tuning, and security.
Experience with ABAP development: For data extraction and transformation.
Knowledge of HANA platforms: (e.g., Native HANA modelling, AMDP) is often preferred.
Experience with incident management and ticketing systems: 3-5 years of experience is required.

Develop applications using ABAP RAP (managed/unmanaged).

Build and expose OData services (V2/V4).

Collaborate with functional and frontend teams (Fiori/UI5).
Conduct unit testing and peer code reviews.
Optimize performance on SAP HANA.

Preferred candidate profile
ABAP RAP (mandatory)
CDS views, annotations
OOABAP, OData services
SAP HANA, AMDP
SAP BTP (optional)
RESTful APIs, Git, Agile

Job Summary :
We are seeking an experienced SAP BTP CPI Integration Consultant to design, develop, and maintain integration solutions on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) using Cloud Platform Integration (CPI). The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAP integration technologies, cloud architecture, and API management.
Role & responsibilities
Design and implement integration scenarios using SAP CPI for SAP and non-SAP systems.
Develop and configure iFlows, adapters, and mappings in CPI.
Collaborate with functional and technical teams to gather integration requirements.
Ensure secure and efficient data exchange between on-premise and cloud systems.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize integration flows for performance and reliability.
Work with SAP BTP services such as API Management, Event Mesh, and Connectivity.
Document technical specifications and integration architecture.
Stay updated on SAP integration best practices and new features.
Experience in SAP CPI and integration projects.
Strong knowledge of SAP BTP, Cloud Integration, and API Management.
Hands-on experience with SOAP, REST, OData, IDoc, and SFTP protocols.
Familiarity with security concepts (OAuth, SSL, certificates).
Experience in mapping techniques (XSLT, Groovy scripting).
Understanding of SAP ERP, S/4HANA, and other SAP modules.
Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
Preferred candidate profile
SAP CPI certification.
Experience with SAP Event Mesh, Integration Suite, and Cloud Connector.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices for integration.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP Project Manager to lead SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing project delivery, stakeholder engagement, budget oversight, risk management, and ensuring successful deployment of SAP best practices using the SAP Activate methodology.
The Project Manager will collaborate with business stakeholders, SAP consultants, system integrators, and technical teams to drive projects from initiation through go-live and hypercare support.
Key Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects.
Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and resources.
Drive project governance and ensure compliance with SAP Activate methodology.
Facilitate requirement gathering, fit-to-standard workshops, and solution design discussions.
Coordinate cross-functional teams including Functional, Technical, Integration, Data Migration, and Change Management workstreams.
Monitor project progress and provide regular status reporting to leadership and steering committees.
Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment with business objectives.
Identify and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies.
Oversee testing cycles including SIT, UAT, and Go-Live readiness activities.
Support cutover planning, deployment, hypercare, and project closure activities.
Ensure delivery quality, adherence to best practices, and customer satisfaction.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
8+ years of SAP project management experience.
Minimum 2 full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects.
Strong understanding of SAP Activate methodology and Cloud ERP deployment models.
Experience managing global or multi-country SAP programs.
Proven expertise in project planning, budgeting, risk management, and vendor management.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience with Agile, Hybrid Agile, and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
Preferred Qualifications
SAP Activate Project Manager Certification.
PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, or Agile certifications.
Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP Integration Suite, and SAP Signavio.
Knowledge of finance, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, or HR business processes.
