Description:
Role Summary
The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities

Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.


Data Interpretation Business Performance Management
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.


Interaction with Stakeholders
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.)


Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants, Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO), Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts, denial rates, supply metrics vs competition


Qualifications
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Position Title: Team Leader Operations
Department: Operations Sales Voice (Ecommerce)
Location: Bhubaneswar

Key Responsibilities
1. Team & Performance Management
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of sales advisors to meet daily/weekly/monthly sales targets.
Conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback.
Monitor and improve team performance using operational KPIs
Implement performance improvement plans (PIP) for underperforming team members.

2. Operational Excellence
Ensure adherence to SLA, process policies, and compliance requirements.
Maintain daily and weekly operations dashboards and scorecards.
Ensure accurate score calculation, rating mechanisms, and parameter adherence.
Work closely with Quality, Training, and Workforce Management teams for smooth operations.
Support new process transitions and stabilize teams during pilot phases.
3. Sales Coaching & Customer Engagement
Coach advisors on effective sales communication, objection handling, and valuebased selling.
Ensure that every interaction focuses on convincing customers to complete their purchase from the cart.
Monitor call audits to identify gaps and implement targeted coaching sessions.
Drive bestpractice sharing to enhance sales effectiveness.


Educational & Experience Requirements
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory).
2-3 years of work experience in a relevant Contact Center sales voice process.
Prior experience in international/premium contact center environments, especially during new process transitions.
Minimum 1 year experience as a Team Leader in a sales voice/offline sales program (current role).

Interested candidates may share the resume at

Location: Pan India

Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain automation test frameworks for web and API applications.
Create robust and reusable automated test scripts using Java, C#, and Python.
Develop and execute functional, regression, smoke, and integration test suites.
Implement the Page Object Model (POM), Data-Driven, Hybrid, and BDD frameworks.
Analyze test results, identify defects, and work closely with development teams for resolution.
Integrate automated test suites with CI/CD pipelines.
Participate in Agile/Scrum activities including sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
Prepare and maintain test documentation, defect reports, and automation metrics.
Ensure quality standards and best practices are followed throughout the SDLC.
Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in Selenium WebDriver.
Proficiency in Java, C#, and/or Python.
Experience with automation frameworks using:
TestNG / JUnit (Java)
NUnit (C#)
PyTest (Python)
Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts.
Expertise in framework development using:
Page Object Model (POM)
Data-Driven Framework
Hybrid Framework
BDD Framework (Cucumber/SpecFlow)
Experience with source control tools such as Git, GitHub, or Bitbucket.
Knowledge of build tools such as Maven, Gradle, and MSBuild.
Experience with defect tracking tools like JIRA or Azure DevOps.
Good understanding of SQL and database testing.
API Testing Skills
Strong experience in API Testing using:
Postman
Rest Assured (Java)
Python Requests Library
Understanding of REST API concepts, JSON, XML, and Swagger/OpenAPI.
CI/CD & DevOps
Experience integrating automation suites with:
Jenkins
Azure DevOps
GitHub Actions
Understanding of Continuous Integration and Continuous Testing practices.
Preferred Skills
Experience in mobile automation using Appium.
Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
Knowledge of performance testing tools like JMeter.
Familiarity with Docker and containerized test execution.
ISTQB Certification is an added advantage.

Job Title: Senior Sales Manager Steel Industry
Location: Bhubaneswar, Jamshedpur, Mumbai, Bangalore
Industry: Steel
Experience: 7+ Years
Department: Sales & Business Development
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Senior Sales Manager with strong experience in the steel industry to drive business growth, develop new markets, manage key accounts, and lead the sales team. The ideal candidate should have in-depth knowledge of steel products, excellent negotiation skills, and a proven track record of achieving sales targets.

Key Responsibilities
Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve revenue and business growth targets.
Identify new business opportunities, develop new customers, and expand market presence.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, distributors, dealers, and industrial clients.
Lead, motivate, and manage the sales team to achieve individual and organizational targets.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing, and customer requirements.
Manage key accounts and negotiate commercial terms with customers.
Coordinate with internal departments to ensure timely order processing, delivery, and customer satisfaction.
Prepare sales forecasts, market reports, and business development plans.
Identify opportunities to improve sales performance, profitability, and customer retention.



Minimum 10 years of sales experience, preferably in the steel industry.
At least 5 years of experience in a sales leadership or managerial role.
Strong understanding of steel products, the supply chain, and the Indian steel market.
Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.


Required Skills
Steel Sales and Business Development
Strategic Sales Planning
B2B Sales and Key Account Management
Team Leadership and Sales Team Management
Customer Relationship Management
Negotiation and Commercial Skills
Market Analysis and Competitor Research
Revenue Growth and Sales Target Achievement
Sales Forecasting and Business Planning
Strong Communication and Interpersonal Skills


Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate will be a proactive sales professional with strong industry connections, a customer-focused approach, excellent leadership abilities, and the capability to develop long-term business relationships while driving sustainable revenue growth.

Interested candidates with relevant experience in steel sales and business development are encouraged to apply.

Description:
Job Summary:
Troubleshoots, assembles, installs, tests and maintains electrical systems using all necessary tools to keep equipment available and capable. Learns and understands the protocols of working safely with electricity and other energy sources with industrial equipment. May work independently and instruct or coach others.
Key Responsibilities:
Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) Stop work and immediately report any major injury hazards. Report any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard. Comply with HSE standards, policies, procedures and regulations. Use appropriate personal protective equipment. Promote interdependence by looking out for one another. Correct hazards within your control and capabilities. Recognize how your work may impact the environment and work to minimize the negative impact. Engage in HSE Training. Quality Applies high standards of workmanship and craftsmanship. Support equipment uptime and downtime failure analysis. Performs work in accordance with diagrams, sketches, operation manuals and specifications using various tools, measuring and testing instruments. Provide feedback into the Preventive Maintenance system. Follows all process documentation and quality procedures. Raises issues to minimize cost and quality exposures. Performs quality inspections. Delivery Fully proficient performing troubleshooting, electrical repairs and maintenance of equipment . Conforms to applicable codes and standards to maintain, install, and operate electrical systems. Instructs and coaches others and acts as an informal resource for team members with less capability. Maintains clean and orderly work area, including routine housekeeping and machine cleaning tasks. Performs other duties as required to meet business goals. Work with peers and support staff to: Identify and reduce manufacturing constraints Schedule maintenance activities around production requirements Solve problems and improve processes Participate in continuous improvement activities Teamwork Communicates effectively with the assigned team and with all support teams. Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements. Participates actively with local Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) teams in ways to improve quality, safety, process, material flow, and employee development.
Intermediate-level knowledge gained through education, training, or on-the-job experience.
Hands-on experience with SIEMENS TIA Portal, servo drive handling, programming, and troubleshooting.
Strong basic logic-building and analytical thinking ability.
Knowledge of LOTO, HIRA, and other industrial safety practices.
Knowledge of machine safety systems (added advantage).
Ability to perform Why-Why analysis and use structured problem-solving techniques.
Ability to identify and implement cost-saving techniques in daily work.
Hands-on experience with Yaskawa robots and familiarity with ABB/Yaskawa systems.
Experience working in Robot Studio or equivalent platforms.
3 to 5 years of experience in Yaskawa robotics /Fanuc (teaching, troubleshooting, maintenance).
Understanding of robot safety standards and regulations (ISO, ANSI/RIA).
Experience integrating ABB robotic systems with conveyors, and PLCs.
Need to Attend Daily Breakdown Electrical and Mechanical with Maintain 5S .
Experience
Requires intermediate-level experience gained through education, training, or on-the-job exposure.
3-5 years of experience in Siemens PLC Programming Knowledge, automation, or electrical machine maintenance preferred.
Experience with PLCs, robotics programming, troubleshooting, and industrial automation systems.
Preferers SIEMENS PLC training Certification
Competencies:
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Nimble learning - Actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Controls Safety - Recognizes controls related hazards in a manufacturing environment (Electrical, Hydraulic, Pneumatic) to incorporate safe practices and procedures as part of the daily work plan to reduce injuries and create a safe machine environment.

Electrical System Troubleshooting - Analyzes an electrical control system to resolve and repair electrical issues to return the system to proper operating conditions.

Factory Automation and Control Systems - Implements changes to further automate manufacturing processes using available technology, programming techniques, and identifying needed material and resources for project completion to provide the optimum automation for the manufacturing environment.

Machine Programming - Creates factory floor machine programs by designing and implementing solutions to improve usage of machine and overall operation.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the functions needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Requires significant relevant work experience or specialized skills obtained through education, training or on-the-job experience.

Organization: Birla Global University
Location: Bhubaneswar, Odisha
Experience: 8-12 Years
Department: Campus Infrastructure & Facilities
Reporting To: General Manager Campus
Job Description:
We are looking for an experienced Civil Engineer to manage campus infrastructure, civil construction, renovation, repair, and maintenance activities at Birla Global University.
Key Responsibilities:
Plan, execute, and monitor civil construction, renovation, and maintenance projects.
Prepare BOQs, cost estimates, rate analysis, tender documents, and project schedules.
Review architectural and structural drawings and ensure quality execution.
Manage contractors, vendors, consultants, and site teams.
Monitor project progress, budgets, material quality, and timelines.
Verify site measurements, RA bills, final bills, and variations.
Oversee maintenance of buildings, RCC structures, waterproofing, flooring, roads, drainage, and other campus infrastructure.
Ensure compliance with quality standards, IS Codes, NBC, and safety requirements.
Maintain project documentation, asset records, and maintenance reports.
Qualifications & Skills:
B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering.
8–12 years of relevant experience in civil construction, project execution, infrastructure, or facilities maintenance.
Strong knowledge of BOQ, estimation, billing, quantity measurement, and quality control.
Proficiency in AutoCAD and MS Excel; knowledge of MS Project/Primavera is an advantage.
Strong contractor management, planning, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
Experience in educational institutions, corporate campuses, or large infrastructure projects will be preferred.

Description:
Job Summary:
As part of a formal apprenticeship or regional training program, assists with facilities changes and improvements; assists with maintaining relationships with various suppliers and vendors of services provided to the facility; communicates changes and improvements to affected facility occupants. Performs activities under direct supervision.
Key Responsibilities:
Supports coordination with facilities management to schedule work and special projects for the assigned facility. Assists with planning for changes and improvements; assist with schedules and implements plan. Helps with developing, documenting, and reporting budgets for approval process; creates and writes purchase orders; approves payment of invoices. Assists to update, edit and print CAD layouts and master plans; assist with managing floor space and office space all locations within master plan. Assists with organizing installation of communications equipment with internal and external suppliers and customers. Participates in improvement processes; actively participates in self-and team audits and resulting process improvements. Works under close supervision according to defined facility procedures/processes. Attends classes and on/off site training programs (travel if required) and makes appropriate progress necessary to build basic skills and knowledge required to pass local certification.
Manage the Plant Manager s calendar, meetings, appointments, and priorities.
Coordinate daily morning meetings, including collection, consolidation, and presentation of key plant data and updates.
Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, reports, and supporting information for Plant Leadership meetings.
Coordinate meetings with Plant Leadership Team members and stakeholders across different plant locations.
Record meeting minutes, decisions, and action items, and follow up with respective owners for timely closure.
Prepare and maintain MIS, dashboards, trackers, and management reports as required.
Coordinate communication and information flow between the Plant Manager and key functional stakeholders.
Support the Plant Manager during plant visits, leadership reviews, audits, and other important meetings/events.
Maintain confidentiality of sensitive business and employee information.
Identify opportunities to improve meeting effectiveness, reporting, and administrative processes.
Coordinate EEEC activities at the plant level.
Coordinate purchase of required materials and services for plant visits, meetings, and other important forums/events.

The responsibilities outlined above are indicative and not limited to the listed activities. Additional responsibilities may be assigned based on business and organizational requirements.
Competencies:
Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Emergency Preparedness - Plans, manages and supports the site s emergency preparedness program; identifies risks and develops a risk management plan to address incidents such as power outage, flood, and fire; manages the maintenance of emergency systems for fire and flood protection; reports any system impairments.

Facilities Maintenance - Assesses the condition of the facility including its systems, structure, interiors, exteriors and grounds; manages facility operations and maintenance activities; develops and operates asset management systems for Preventative Maintenances that uses criticality analysis, predictive tools and prioritization.

Facilities Operation - Manages occupant services (parking, janitorial services, food services, concierge, facility helpdesk, security and safety); manages the maintenance contracting process; develops and manages the facility s operational planning requirements (temperature control, lighting, equipment replacement, water treatment and so forth).

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.

Experience:
Minimal or no work experience required.

Description:
Job Description
Supply Chain Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world.
With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships.
It s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers hands, you ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.


Qualifications Experience
B.Sc/M.Sc. (Chemistry/Microbiology/Food Technology/Biotechnology) or BE/BTech- Food Tech/Chemical Engineering.
6-10 years of experience in distillery, brewery or beverage manufacturing quality.
Knowledge of SAP/LIMS, laboratory systems, HACCP, ISO/FSSC 22000 and statistical quality tools.


About the role

Quality Governance Compliance
Lead and sustain the Unit Quality Food Safety Management System in line with organizational, regulatory and statutory requirements.
Ensure effective quality controls for RM/PM, liquid, in-process and finished goods, including end-of-line inspection and product release.
Lead internal audits, MRM and ensure readiness for external, certification and regulatory audits.
Govern QC holds, deviations, rework and disposition of non-conforming materials/products.
Ensure timely investigation and closure of consumer/customer complaints and escalation of significant quality risks.
Ensure accurate Quality MIS/KPI reporting and partner with cross-functional teams to deliver production without compromising Quality or Food Safety.


Continuous Improvement
Lead structured RCPS/RCA for quality incidents, complaints, deviations and recurring defects.
Ensure robust CAPAs are implemented with process owners and verified for effectiveness.
Analyse Quality KPIs and trends to identify systemic issues and improvement opportunities.
Drive reduction in defects, complaints, rejection, rework and Cost of Poor Quality.
Drive Right-First-Time and process capability improvements jointly with Operations and Engineering.
Ensure Quality risk assessment and validation for new products, packs, materials, equipment and process changes

Description:
Project Role : Data Management Practitioner
Project Role Description : Maintain the quality and compliance of an organizations data assets. Design and implement data strategies, ensuring data integrity and enforcing governance policies. Establish protocols to handle data, safeguard sensitive information, and optimize data usage within the organization. Design and advise on data quality rules and set up effective data compliance policies.
Must have skills : Graph Databases
Good to have skills : Neo4j, Python FrameworksMinimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required
Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education
Summary: As a Data Management Practitioner, a typical day involves overseeing the stewardship of an organization''s data assets to ensure they meet quality and compliance standards. This role includes designing and implementing comprehensive data strategies that uphold data integrity and enforce governance policies. The practitioner establishes and maintains protocols for managing data securely, protecting sensitive information, and optimizing the use of data across various departments. Additionally, they provide guidance on data quality standards and develop effective compliance policies to support organizational objectives and regulatory requirements.
Roles Responsibilities:
Design and implement scalable ETL and ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and load structured and unstructured data into graph databases.
Build and maintain knowledge graph infrastructure on platforms such as Neo4j, Stardog, Amazon Neptune, Stardog, or Apache Jena including indexing, query optimization, and availability tuning.
Write and optimize complex SPARQL, Cypher, and Gremlin queries for production graph workloads including traversal, inference, and aggregation.
Implement SHACL or ShEx constraints and automated validation pipelines to enforce data conformance against ontology schemas.
Develop APIs and microservices that expose graph data to downstream consumers including search, recommendation, and LLM/RAG pipelines.
Integrate knowledge graph layers with vector databases and embedding models to support hybrid semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation.
Collaborate with ontology designers to implement and version ontology changes safely in production without disrupting dependent services.

Project Role Description : Maintain the quality and compliance of an organizations data assets. Design and implement data strategies, ensuring data integrity and enforcing governance policies. The practitioner establishes and maintains protocols for managing data securely, protecting sensitive information, and optimizing the use of data across various departments. Additionally, they provide guidance on data quality standards and develop effective compliance policies to support organizational objectives and regulatory requirements.

Design and implement scalable ETL and ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and load structured and unstructured data into graph databases.

Implement SHACL or ShEx constraints and automated validation pipelines to enforce data conformance against ontology schemas.
Develop APIs and microservices that expose graph data to downstream consumers including search, recommendation, and LLM/RAG pipelines.
Integrate knowledge graph layers with vector databases and embedding models to support hybrid semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation.
Collaborate with ontology designers to implement and version ontology changes safely in production without disrupting dependent services.
Monitor graph platform performance, diagnose bottlenecks, and drive reliability improvements across ingestion and query layers.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Title Store Manager
Reporting to Area Operations Manager
Skip Level City/Zonal Manager
About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities
Area

Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving sales vs.
plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People development
(Attrition
Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards
Preferred candidate profile :
Candidate should has to 4 to 10 Years of Experience in store managing

Perks and benefits
ESI and PF
Family insurance policy
Incentive policy : Daily - weekends - monthly - festival incentive program.
Professional Training : 25 Days training in Bangalore post selection in Lenskart Academy .

Description:
Job Summary
Senior Executive - EHS


Reporting
Reporting To: Pankaj Kumar Tyagi


Location / Department / Type
Location: Gopalpur
Department / Function: EHS
Grade: Senior Executive
Type: Full-time


Qualification / Personal Attributes
Diploma/BE/B.Tech in Mechanical / Electrical / Chemical / Industrial Safety or equivalent.
Mandatory: Diploma/Certification in Industrial Safety (Govt. approved).
2-5 years of experience in a manufacturing / engineering / chemical / battery industry environment.
Strong knowledge of EHS statutory requirements and shop-floor safety practices.


Job Description
Implement and monitor all EHS systems as per statutory requirements and company standards.
Conduct daily safety inspections, risk assessments, job safety analysis (JSA), and permit-to-work (PTW) audits.
Ensure compliance with OSH Code, Factories Act guidelines, pollution control norms, fire safety norms, and environmental regulations.
Support incident reporting, root cause analysis (RCA), and closure of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
Conduct toolbox talks, safety trainings, induction programs, and awareness sessions for employees and contract workforce.
Monitor contractor safety compliance, PPE usage, and adherence to safety procedures at site.
Coordinate statutory inspections, audits, renewals, and documentation as per compliance calendar.
Ensure safety readiness during machine installation, commissioning, and production start-up phases.
Maintain EHS records, MIS reports, and support ISO/IMS/OHS audits.
Assist in emergency preparedness, mock drills, and implementation of fire protection measures.

Description:
Job Summary
Position: Forward Deployed AI / Software Engineer
Responsibilities
Work directly with clients to understand business requirements, workflows, technical environments, and operational challenges.
Translate ambiguous business problems into technical requirements, solution designs, prototypes, and production-ready applications
Build AI-powered applications, agentic workflows, APIs, data pipelines, and full-stack solutions
Design and implement systems around AI models, including tools, context, memory, permissions, runtime controls, observability, and feedback mechanisms.
Build and refine agent workflows covering planning, tool selection, execution, observation, recovery, and termination.
Develop workflow orchestration using graphs, state machines, and multi-step execution patterns
Build evaluation mechanisms to measure AI application quality, reliability, task completion, latency, and cost.
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and third-party services.
Troubleshoot AI-system issues such as hallucinations, context loss, unreliable tool calls, looping, and prompt-injection risks.
Collaborate with product, engineering, data, security, and client teams to take solutions from discovery to production.
Clearly communicate technical decisions, risks, limitations, and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Required Skills
Strong professional experience building and deploying production-grade software.
Strong proficiency in Python, TypeScript, or a similar programming language.
Hands-on experience building AI-powered applications or agentic systems.
Practical understanding of LLMs, prompts, context management, tool use, structured outputs, memory, and model selection.
Experience building or working with AI agents/agentloops involving planning, tool use, execution, observation, and recovery.
Understanding of workflow orchestration, graphs, state machines, or multi-step AI workflows.
Experience working with APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, and modern software engineering practices.
Experience taking a problem from discovery to prototype to validation to production.
Ability to work directly with clients or business stakeholders and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Strong debugging, problem-solving, communication, and ownership skills.
Comfortable working remotely with teams operating in CST business hours.
Preferred (Bonus) Skills
Experience with AI agent frameworks, workflow engines, coding agents, or custom AI orchestration systems.
Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector databases/search, knowledge graphs, fine-tuning, or model routing.
Experience with AI evaluation, regression testing, human evaluation, or production monitoring.
Familiarity with AI observability, tracing, token/cost analysis, latency monitoring, and quality dashboards.
Experience building multi-agent or multi-model systems.
Understanding of AI security risks including prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, and insecure tool usage.
Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD.
Experience in consulting, solutions engineering, professional services, or other customer-facing technical roles.
Experience working with complex enterprise environments.

Job Summary
Position: Forward Deployed AI / Software Engineer
Responsibilities
Work directly with clients to understand business requirements, workflows, technical environments, and operational challenges.
Translate ambiguous business problems into technical requirements, solution designs, prototypes, and production-ready applications
Build AI-powered applications, agentic workflows, APIs, data pipelines, and full-stack solutions
Design and implement systems around AI models, including tools, context, memory, permissions, runtime controls, observability, and feedback mechanisms.
Build and refine agent workflows covering planning, tool selection, execution, observation, recovery, and termination.
Develop workflow orchestration using graphs, state machines, and multi-step execution patterns
Build evaluation mechanisms to measure AI application quality, reliability, task completion, latency, and cost.
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and third-party services.
Troubleshoot AI-system issues such as hallucinations, context loss, unreliable tool calls, looping, and prompt-injection risks.
Collaborate with product, engineering, data, security, and client teams to take solutions from discovery to production.
Clearly communicate technical decisions, risks, limitations, and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Required Skills
Strong professional experience building and deploying production-grade software.
Strong proficiency in Python, TypeScript, or a similar programming language.
Hands-on experience building AI-powered applications or agentic systems.
Practical understanding of LLMs, prompts, context management, tool use, structured outputs, memory, and model selection.
Experience building or working with AI agents/agentloops involving planning, tool use, execution, observation, and recovery.
Understanding of workflow orchestration, graphs, state machines, or multi-step AI workflows.
Experience working with APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, and modern software engineering practices.
Experience taking a problem from discovery to prototype to validation to production.
Ability to work directly with clients or business stakeholders and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Strong debugging, problem-solving, communication, and ownership skills.
Comfortable working remotely with teams operating in CST business hours.
Preferred (Bonus) Skills
Experience with AI agent frameworks, workflow engines, coding agents, or custom AI orchestration systems.
Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector databases/search, knowledge graphs, fine-tuning, or model routing.
Experience with AI evaluation, regression testing, human evaluation, or production monitoring.
Familiarity with AI observability, tracing, token/cost analysis, latency monitoring, and quality dashboards.
Experience building multi-agent or multi-model systems.
Understanding of AI security risks including prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, and insecure tool usage.
Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD.
Experience in consulting, solutions engineering, professional services, or other customer-facing technical roles.
Experience working with complex enterprise environments.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Overall supervision of day-to-day operation of ETP, DM, RO, MEE, and ZLD plants to ensure smooth and uninterrupted functioning.
Monitor and control all treatment processes including screening, equalization, aeration, clarification, filtration, RO, evaporation, crystallization, and sludge handling.
Ensure treated water quality meets PCB / CPCB / consent standards at all times.
Conduct and verify regular testing of influent and effluent parameters such as pH, BOD, COD, TSS, TDS, Oil & Grease, and other required parameters.
Maintain and verify laboratory records, analysis reports, logbooks, and daily operational data.
Ensure compliance with Pollution Control Board regulations, consent conditions, and statutory requirements.
Maintain plant records including logs, registers, chemical consumption, sludge disposal, and inspection records.
Coordinate and support PCB, CPCB, ISO, and internal audits, and ensure timely closure of observations.
Plan and supervise preventive and breakdown maintenance of pumps, blowers, motors, pipelines, valves, and dosing systems.
Identify operational issues and take corrective and preventive actions to avoid plant breakdown or non-compliance.
Manage and monitor chemical dosing systems (lime, alum, polymer, acids, nutrients, antiscalants, etc.) as per process requirement.
Monitor chemical consumption, maintain inventory records, and raise chemical indents/requisitions in advance.
Ensure safe storage, handling, and usage of chemicals as per safety norms and MSDS.
Supervise operators and helpers, assign duties, and ensure proper shift management.
Train plant staff on operation, safety procedures, emergency handling, and best practices.
Monitor sludge generation, dewatering, drying, storage, and disposal through authorized vendors as per Hazardous Waste Rules.
Ensure use of PPE, enforce safety procedures, and maintain a safe working environment in the plant.
Maintain housekeeping, cleanliness, and discipline in the plant area.
Monitor and optimize power, water recovery, and chemical usage to improve efficiency and reduce operating costs.
Suggest process improvements and modifications for better performance and cost efficiency.
Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly operational and performance reports to management/client.
Immediately report abnormalities, breakdowns, safety incidents, or non-compliance to management and take corrective action.
Ensure to follow the SOP and strict adherence to all safety requirements in the waste water treatments.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Mechanical Engineer
To ensure the reliable and efficient operation of mechanical equipment installed in water and wastewater treatment plants.
Key Responsibilities
Supervise the maintenance and repair of pumps, motors, blowers, compressors, agitators, gearboxes, valves, pipelines and mechanical assemblies.
Carry out preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance as applicable.
Troubleshoot mechanical failures, abnormal vibration, leakage, overheating, noise and pressure-related issues.
Inspect MEE evaporators, condensers, heat exchangers, vacuum systems and associated equipment, within the assigned scope.
Coordinate maintenance of RO and MBR-related mechanical equipment, including feed pumps, backwash systems and membrane cleaning auxiliaries.
Ensure proper alignment, lubrication, coupling checks and equipment installation.
Prepare maintenance schedules, breakdown reports and spare-parts requirements.
Coordinate with vendors, contractors and operations personnel for equipment repairs.
Ensure tools, tackles and maintenance equipment are used safely.
Follow lockout/tagout (LOTO), permit-to-work and applicable isolation procedures.
Maintain mechanical maintenance records, equipment history and job completion reports.
Support commissioning, equipment trials and performance improvement activities.
KPIs: Equipment availability, reduction in breakdowns, preventive maintenance completion, maintenance turnaround time and cost-effective spare-parts management.

Electrical Technician
Role & Responsibilities
Installation and repair of electrical control panels, equipment and instruments following the electrical code, manuals, schematic diagrams, blueprints, and other specifications, using hand tools, power tools, and electrical and electronic test equipment.
Replacement of faulty electrical components of machine, such as relays, switches, and motors etc. using hand tools.
Diagnosis and replacement of faulty mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic components of machines and equipment.
Connection of power supply wires to equipment & instruments using hand tools and test equipment.
Laying cable trays & cables from electrical control panel to equipment & instruments at site & termination of individual cable.
Assist the Site engineer/Project engineer/Project executive for general electrical maintenance.
Shall be responsible for quality of workmanship of work/job done.
Preparing hand sketches of of Control drawing, Power drawing, Panel GA drawing as an input to the draughtman.
Preparation of BOQ of electrical items & cable schedule.
Assisting PLC programmer in programming & testing.
Always Commit to compliance with all safety standard and regulations.
Preparation of electrical drawings
Inspection of electrical panel
Preparation of electrical BOQ

Description:
Job Description Cluster Manager
Role objective
The Cluster Manager is primarily responsible for driving sales and building the loan portfolio across assigned branches, while ensuring good customer service, quality business and disciplined branch operations.
Key responsibilities
1. Sales and portfolio growth
Set branch-wise sales priorities and follow up with the sales team on customer acquisition and loan disbursements.
Monitor branch performance, identify gaps and take corrective action to achieve business targets.
Ensure portfolio growth is supported by proper customer verification, adherence to company policies and quality lending practices.
2. Customer service and branch readiness
Ensure every operating branch opens by 9:30 a.m. Escalate any delay immediately.
Ensure at least two employees are present at each branch. Where staffing falls short, contact Pavan Kalyan immediately to arrange deputation.
Ensure customers receive prompt, courteous service and that complaints and service delays are addressed quickly.
3. Auction-loan follow-up
Follow up with customers and branch staff on loans identified for the June auction.
Ensure each affected customer receives the auction message through WhatsApp, in line with the companys communication process.
Track customer responses and repayment commitments, and ensure branch staff complete the required follow-up.
4. Branch expansion
Identify suitable premises for new branches with the assistance of Team Leaders from nearby branches.
Coordinate site visits and submit shortlisted premises for review and approval.
5. Recruitment and staffing coordination
Follow up with HR on hiring the sales team for existing and proposed branches.
Coordinate with Deepika from MIS to download candidate profiles based on the required locations, such as Nagarkurnool, Mahabubabad and Nalgonda.
Assist AVPs and VPs in uploading candidate profiles onto FINS.
Send emails proposing the rejoining of suitable former employees and follow up with HR on the necessary approvals and joining arrangements.
Performance expectations
The Cluster Manager will be assessed on portfolio growth, loan disbursements, customer service, business quality, timely branch opening, staffing readiness and completion of assigned auction follow-ups.
- Each operating Branch is opened by 9.30am;
- If any Branch opening after 9.30am, shall be escalated;
- Min two employees are present in the Branch; If not, shall reach out Pavan Kalyan for deputation
- Follow up June Auction Loans with customers and Branch staff;
- Shall send Auction message to each customer through whatsapp;
- Identify premises for new Branches with the help of TLs of nearby Branches
- Follow up with HR as regards hiring of Sales team;
- Reach out Deepika of MIS to download profiles using location – For example – Nagarkurnool, Mehabubabad, Nalgonda.
- Shall help AVPs and VPs to upload profiles on FINS;
- Shall send mails for rejoining of staff;
- Follow up with Sales Team for Loan Disbursements.

Description:
AI MISSION DIRECTOR

Role & responsibilities

Lead the overall implementation of the Odisha AI Mission by providing strategic direction, institutional leadership, and programme oversight across all Mission pillars.
Develop and periodically update the Mission roadmap, implementation strategy, annual action plans, and long-term vision for AI adoption across the Government of Odisha.
Advise senior government leadership on AI strategy, emerging technologies, policy priorities, and opportunities for AI-led governance transformation.
Ensure alignment of Mission activities with state development priorities, national AI initiatives, and global best practices
Oversee implementation of all programmes under the Odisha AI Mission, including compute infrastructure, datasets, AI applications, skilling, research, innovation, startups, and ecosystem development.
Drive cross-departmental AI adoption by identifying high-impact use cases, supporting implementation, and monitoring outcomes across government departments.
Establish programme governance frameworks, monitoring mechanisms, and performance indicators to ensure timely delivery of Mission objectives.
Lead periodic reviews of Mission progress and provide strategic recommendations for course correction and programme optimisation.
Lead the formulation and implementation of AI-related policies, standards, operational frameworks, and institutional guidelines for responsible AI adoption across the State.
Develop governance mechanisms for AI procurement, evaluation, deployment, data sharing, responsible AI, and lifecycle management.
Support departments in developing AI strategies, implementation roadmaps, and sector-specific adoption frameworks.
Represent the Government of Odisha in national policy consultations, inter-governmental forums, and strategic AI initiatives.
Build and strengthen Odisha's AI ecosystem by fostering collaboration between Government, industry, academia, startups, research institutions, investors, and civil society.
Lead strategic partnerships with technology companies, academic institutions, international organisations, multilateral agencies, and ecosystem partners to accelerate AI adoption.
Promote AI innovation through challenge programmes, innovation grants, hackathons, research collaborations, startup engagements, and accelerator programmes.
Position Odisha as a preferred destination for AI investments, research, talent development, and emerging technology initiatives.
Promote adoption of interoperable, secure, scalable, and reusable AI infrastructure across departments.
Lead Mission budgeting, financial planning, procurement oversight, utilisation monitoring, and resource allocation in accordance with Government financial rules.
Oversee procurement of AI technologies, consulting engagements, system integrators, and implementation partners.
Ensure effective contract management, vendor governance, risk mitigation, and programme compliance.
Monitor programme outcomes through robust evaluation frameworks and evidence-based impact assessment.
Build AI awareness and institutional capacity across Government through leadership engagement, training programmes, workshops, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
Support departments in strengthening their AI implementation capabilities through technical guidance and advisory support.
Promote adoption of responsible AI practices, data literacy, and AI readiness across government institutions.
Build strong relationships with senior government leadership, Secretaries, Heads of Departments, district administrations, public sector organisations, academic institutions, industry leaders, and development partners.
Represent the Odisha AI Mission at national and international conferences, policy forums, investment summits, and strategic engagements.
Lead, mentor, and develop the AI Cell team by fostering a high-performance, collaborative, and innovation-driven organisational culture.
Establish effective performance management systems, capability development initiatives, and succession planning for the AI Cell.


Preferred candidate profile

Essential
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering, Public Policy, Economics, Statistics, Management, or a related discipline.

Preferred
Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Data Science, Business Administration, Public Policy, Technology Management, or related fields.
Additional qualifications in public administration, digital transformation, or technology policy will be an advantage.

Desirable Skills & Experience
15+ years of professional experience, including at least 8 years in senior leadership roles managing large-scale technology, digital transformation, AI, or innovation programmes.
Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives involving Government, industry, academia, and development partners.
Strong understanding of artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, data governance, digital public infrastructure, cloud computing, and emerging technologies.
Proven experience in strategy formulation, programme management, institutional development, and execution of large public-sector initiatives.
Experience working with Central or State Governments, multilateral organisations, public policy institutions, or large technology organisations.
Strong understanding of government procurement, programme governance, financial management, and public-sector implementation frameworks.
Experience in developing strategic partnerships, investment facilitation, and ecosystem building.
Excellent communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and leadership skills with the ability to engage Ministers, senior bureaucrats, CEOs, investors, and international partners.
Demonstrated ability to build and lead multidisciplinary teams in high-visibility, fast-paced environments.
Strong analytical and decision-making capabilities with a track record of translating strategy into measurable outcomes.

Technology Consultant (Full Stack)

Role & responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain full-stack applications for AI pilots and MVPs, including backend systems, APIs, databases, data pipelines, application logic, and user-facing interfaces.
Develop AI/ML/LLM integrations and model-serving workflows, and integrate applications with departmental systems, third-party APIs, enterprise AI tools, dashboards, authentication, logging, and monitoring systems.
Develop responsive frontend interfaces for AI applications, dashboards, forms, and decision-support tools, including role-based views, filters, drilldowns, charts, and workflow interfaces.
Ensure usability for Government users through clear empty, loading, and error states; accessibility; multilingual/Odia-ready interfaces where required; privacy notices; and consent flows.
Implement secure backend and application design covering access control, encryption, audit logs, secrets management, PII masking, and secure file/data handling.

Collaborate with business and domain stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable, secure, and user-centric technical solutions.

Preferred candidate profile

Mandatory
Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field from a recognized university/institute
Desirable

Certifications in cloud platforms (AWS Certified Developer/Solutions Architect, Azure Developer Associate, etc.) or security (CISSP, CEH, etc.)
Experience

Strong experience in backend engineering, including APIs, databases, data pipelines, application development, and integration with enterprise/third-party systems.

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given
territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise
Value (GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities

Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high.
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner.
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale,conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,
commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations(competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness
and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal
drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Company Name: Urban Yatra
Department: MIS / Business Operations
Designation: Senior Executive MIS
Reporting To: MIS Manager / Operations Head / Management
Location: Soubhagya Nagar
Employment Type: Full-Time
1. Job Purpose
The Senior Executive – MIS will be responsible for collecting, consolidating, analysing, and reporting business data related to sales, tour bookings, customer enquiries, travel operations, revenue, and team performance. The role will ensure accurate and timely reporting to support management decisions, improve operational efficiency, and monitor business performance.
2. Key Roles and Responsibilities
A. MIS Reporting and Data Management
Prepare and circulate daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports for management.
Maintain accurate databases of sales, bookings, customer enquiries, revenue, cancellations, and refunds.
Consolidate data from various departments and ensure data accuracy and consistency.
Develop and maintain standardized reporting formats, dashboards, and trackers.
Identify data discrepancies and coordinate with relevant teams for timely correction.
B. Sales and Business Performance Analysis
Prepare sales performance reports for domestic tours, international tours, holiday packages, and other travel services.
Track leads generated, enquiries received, conversions, booking values, and revenue performance.
Monitor individual and team-wise sales targets versus actual achievements.
Analyze lead conversion ratios, lost enquiries, and reasons for non-conversion.
Prepare business performance summaries and highlight key trends to management.
C. Tour Operations and Booking MIS
Track confirmed bookings, upcoming departures, tour schedules, and package-wise performance.
Maintain reports on booking status, cancellations, refunds, and pending customer payments.
Monitor supplier payments, vendor-related data, and tour-wise cost information, in coordination with the relevant departments.
Prepare operational trackers for customer documentation, vouchers, tickets, hotel bookings, and other travel arrangements, as applicable.
Highlight pending tasks, booking discrepancies, and operational exceptions to the concerned teams.
D. Financial and Revenue Reporting
Prepare revenue, collection, outstanding payment, and refund reports.
Track tour-wise and package-wise revenue and costs in coordination with the Finance team.
Assist in monitoring gross margins and profitability of travel packages.
Reconcile MIS data with sales and finance records.
Support management in budgeting, forecasting, and business planning through accurate reports.
E. Dashboard Development and Automation
Use advanced Excel
Develop automated reports and dashboards to reduce manual work and improve reporting efficiency.
Use Power Query and Power BI, where applicable, to streamline data consolidation and visualization.
Maintain data integrity, confidentiality, and proper documentation of reports.
F. Coordination and Management Support
Coordinate with Sales, Tour Operations, Reservations, Customer Support, and Finance teams to collect and validate data.
Ensure reports are shared within defined deadlines.
Prepare management summaries highlighting achievements, gaps, trends, and areas requiring attention.
Support management with ad hoc reports, business analysis, and special projects.
3. Required Skills and Competencies
Strong knowledge of MS Excel and MIS reporting.
Experience in data analysis, dashboard preparation, and report automation.
Good analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.
Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
Ability to manage multiple reports and meet strict deadlines.
Good communication and interdepartmental coordination skills.
Knowledge of travel bookings, tour packages, travel operations, or travel CRM systems will be an advantage.
4. Educational Qualifications
Graduate in Commerce, Business Administration, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Applications, or a related discipline.
Additional certification in Advanced Excel, MIS, Data Analytics, or Power BI will be preferred.
5. Experience
3–5 years of experience in MIS, reporting, business analysis, or operations reporting.
Experience in the tours and travel, hospitality, e-commerce, or service industry will be preferred.
Prior experience in preparing management dashboards and handling large datasets is desirable.
6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance will be evaluated based on:
Timely submission of daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports.
Accuracy and completeness of reports and business data.
Reduction in manual reporting effort through automation.
Accuracy of sales, revenue, booking, and collection tracking.
Timely identification and escalation of discrepancies.
Effectiveness of dashboards and actionable business insights.
Coordination and responsiveness to management reporting requirements.
7. Working Relationships
The role will work closely with:
Sales and Business Development
Tour Operations and Reservations
Customer Support
Finance and Accounts
Management Team
Bottom of Form
Experience- 3 to 5 years
Salary Offered- 18k- 22k

Description:
Senior Executive Sales & MIS
Company Name: Urban Yatra
Department: Sales & MIS
Job Location: [Insert Location]
Experience Required: 3–5 Years
Salary Offered: 18,000–22,000 per month (Negotiable)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Reporting To: Sales Head / Management
1. About Urban Yatra
Urban Yatra is a tours and travel company committed to providing quality travel experiences and customized holiday solutions. We are looking for a detail-oriented and target-driven Senior Executive – Sales & MIS to manage sales coordination, monitor business performance, maintain accurate reports, and support management in achieving sales and revenue targets.
2. Job Purpose
The candidate will be responsible for monitoring sales activities, managing sales data, preparing daily and monthly MIS reports, tracking leads and conversions, analyzing sales performance, and coordinating with the Sales, Operations, and Finance teams. The role requires a combination of strong analytical skills, sales coordination, reporting accuracy, and follow-up discipline.
3. Key Roles and Responsibilities
A. Sales Monitoring & Coordination
Monitor daily sales activities, customer enquiries, leads, and booking conversions.
Track lead status from initial enquiry to quotation, follow-up, and confirmed booking.
Monitor salesperson-wise and team-wise sales performance against assigned targets.
Follow up with the sales team on pending leads, quotations, and potential bookings.
Track lost leads and analyze reasons for non-conversion.
Coordinate with the sales team to improve follow-up efficiency and conversion rates.
Monitor booking values, advance payments, and pending customer collections.
Support the sales team in maintaining updated customer and booking records.
B. MIS Reporting & Data Analysis
Prepare and circulate daily, weekly, and monthly sales MIS reports.
Maintain accurate records of enquiries, leads, conversions, bookings, revenue, and collections.
Prepare salesperson-wise, channel-wise, and package-wise performance reports.
Develop Excel dashboards to track sales targets versus actual achievements.
Analyze sales trends, conversion ratios, lead response, and revenue performance.
Identify discrepancies in sales data and coordinate with the concerned teams for correction.
Prepare management reports highlighting business performance, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
Generate customized reports as required by management.
C. Revenue & Booking Tracking
Monitor confirmed bookings for domestic tours, international tours, group departures, and customized holiday packages.
Maintain booking-wise revenue and payment status trackers.
Coordinate with the Finance team regarding pending collections, outstanding balances, and refunds.
Track cancellations, booking amendments, and changes affecting reported sales.
Assist in monitoring package-wise revenue and profitability in coordination with Finance.
Ensure that booking and payment information is accurately reflected in MIS reports.
D. CRM & Data Management
Ensure timely and accurate updating of customer enquiries, lead status, follow-ups, and booking details in the CRM or sales tracker.
Maintain centralized databases for sales activities and customer records.
Ensure data consistency between CRM systems, Excel reports, and booking records.
Maintain proper documentation and confidentiality of company and customer information.
Establish standardized reporting formats and improve data quality.
E. Sales & Operations Coordination
Coordinate with the Operations team for the status of confirmed bookings and upcoming departures.
Track the handover of confirmed bookings from Sales to Operations.
Monitor pending customer documents, travel vouchers, confirmations, and other booking-related requirements.
Escalate discrepancies, delayed follow-ups, and booking-related issues to the concerned teams.
Support smooth communication between Sales, Operations, and Finance.
F. Reporting Automation & Process Improvement
Use Advanced MS Excel features such as Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, charts, and dashboards.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive reporting tasks and reduce manual errors.
Use Google Sheets, Power Query, Power BI, or CRM reporting tools wherever applicable.
Recommend improvements in sales tracking, reporting formats, and internal processes.
4. Educational Qualifications
Graduate in Commerce, Business Administration, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Applications, or a related discipline.
Certification in Advanced Excel, MIS, Data Analytics, or Power BI will be an added advantage.
5. Experience & Technical Skills
3–5 years of relevant experience in Sales MIS, Sales Coordination, Business Reporting, or Sales Operations.
Advanced working knowledge of MS Excel and data analysis.
Experience in preparing dashboards, sales reports, and management summaries.
Working knowledge of CRM software and Google Sheets.
Knowledge of Power BI or Power Query will be preferred.
Experience in the tours and travel, hospitality, or service industry will be an advantage.
6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance will be evaluated based on:
MIS Accuracy: Accuracy and completeness of sales and revenue reports.
Reporting Timeliness: Submission of daily, weekly, and monthly reports within deadlines.
Sales Tracking: Timely monitoring of leads, follow-ups, quotations, and conversions.
Target Monitoring: Accurate reporting of sales targets versus actual achievements.
Data Management: Timely updates and consistency across CRM and reporting systems.
Revenue Tracking: Accuracy of booking values, collections, and outstanding payment reports.
Issue Identification: Timely identification and escalation of data discrepancies and sales performance gaps.
Process Improvement: Reduction in manual reporting effort and avoidable data errors.
Coordination: Effective follow-up with Sales, Operations, and Finance teams.
7. Compensation & Benefits
Salary Offered: 18,000–22,000 per month, negotiable based on experience and skills.
Performance-based incentives, if applicable, as per company policy.
Opportunity to develop expertise in sales analytics and travel business operations.
Professional growth opportunities within Urban Yatra.

Good communication skills in the local language plus basic Hindi/English.
Prior experience as a service advisor, mechanic, technician or car evaluator is an advantage.
Willingness to do field work and travel locally.


What CARS24 Offers
Fixed salary with performance incentives (exact band as per current approved CTC for each location).
Structured training and onboarding.
Growth opportunities within procurement and operations.

Description:
Senior Executive Business Development
Company Name: Urban Yatra
Department: Business Development / Sales
Job Location: Shoubhagya Nagar
Experience Required: 3–5 Years
Salary Offered: 18,000–22,000 per month (Negotiable)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Reporting To: Business Development Manager / Sales Head / Management
1. Job Purpose
The Senior Executive – Business Development will be responsible for generating new business opportunities, acquiring customers, building strategic partnerships, converting leads into bookings, and achieving sales targets. The candidate will play a key role in expanding Urban Yatra’s customer base and increasing revenue through effective sales strategies and relationship management.
2. Key Roles and Responsibilities
A. Business Development & Lead Generation
Identify and develop new business opportunities to expand the company's customer base.
Generate leads through cold calling, networking, referrals, digital channels, and market research.
Identify potential customers for domestic and international holiday packages, group tours, corporate travel, and customized travel solutions.
Explore new market segments and opportunities to increase sales and revenue.
Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective customers and business partners.
B. Sales & Revenue Generation
Promote and sell travel packages, holiday tours, group departures, and customized travel services.
Understand customer travel requirements and recommend suitable packages based on budget and preferences.
Prepare quotations, itineraries, and proposals in coordination with the Operations team.
Follow up with prospective customers and convert enquiries into confirmed bookings.
Achieve monthly sales targets, revenue goals, and business development objectives.
Negotiate with customers and close deals while maintaining company profitability.
C. Client Relationship Management
Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing and prospective customers.
Ensure timely follow-ups and professional communication throughout the sales process.
Understand customer needs and provide suitable travel solutions.
Maintain customer satisfaction and encourage repeat business and referrals.
Handle customer queries and coordinate with internal teams to resolve issues.
D. Corporate & B2B Business Development
Identify and approach corporate clients, travel agents, channel partners, and other potential business associates.
Develop partnerships with companies, institutions, travel agencies, and relevant organizations.
Generate business through corporate travel requirements, group tours, employee holiday packages, and other relevant opportunities.
Maintain regular communication with partners to develop long-term business relationships.
Identify opportunities for bulk bookings and recurring business.
E. Market Research & Competitor Analysis
Research market trends, customer preferences, and competitor offerings.
Identify new destinations, travel products, and customer segments with business potential.
Provide feedback to management on market opportunities, customer expectations, and pricing trends.
Recommend strategies to improve lead generation, conversion rates, and sales performance.
F. Sales Reporting & Coordination
Maintain accurate records of enquiries, leads, follow-ups, quotations, and confirmed bookings.
Update CRM systems and sales trackers regularly.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance reports.
Coordinate with the Operations and Reservations teams to ensure smooth execution of confirmed bookings.
Track customer payments and coordinate with the relevant team for outstanding balances.
Monitor sales performance against targets and identify opportunities for improvement.
Required Skills & Competencies
Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and convincing skills.
Proven ability to generate leads and convert prospects into customers.
Strong relationship-building and networking abilities.
Good understanding of sales processes and business development strategies.
Target-oriented mindset with a focus on revenue growth.
Ability to prepare quotations, proposals, and sales reports.
Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office, and CRM tools.
Strong follow-up, planning, and time-management skills.
Knowledge of domestic and international tour packages will be an advantage.
5. Educational Qualifications
Graduate in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, Tourism, Hospitality, or a related discipline.
An MBA or additional qualification in Sales, Marketing, or Tourism Management will be an added advantage.
6. Experience Required
3–5 years of relevant experience in Business Development, Sales, Client Acquisition, or Relationship Management.
Experience in the tours and travel, hospitality, tourism, or service industry is preferred.
Candidates with experience in corporate sales, B2B partnerships, holiday packages, or travel-related services will have an added advantage.
7. Compensation & Benefits
Salary: 18,000–22,000 per month, negotiable based on experience, skills, and suitability.
Performance-based incentives may be offered as per company policy.
Opportunity to grow professionally in the travel and tourism industry.
Supportive work environment with opportunities to contribute to business expansion.
Ideal Candidate Profile
We are looking for a proactive, confident, and commercially driven professional who can independently generate leads, build customer relationships, close sales, and contribute to the growth of Urban Yatra. The ideal candidate should have a strong sense of ownership, a customer-focused approach, and the ability to achieve business targets consistently.
Experience: 3 to 5 years
Salary Offered: 18k-22k (Negotiable)
Drop your resume at: odisha@urbanyatra.com
