Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Incumbent as FG Outsource Quality Lead will be responsible for Managing Quality across various Finished Goods Suppliers / Products/Processes/ Customers (Internal & External)/. Will be responsible for preparing Quality Assurance Strategy for ensuring right quality enablers for Supplier / Manufacturing value chain for continuous improvement of Overall Quality Metrics. This will be driven through sustainable quality systems including applicable regulatory compliances.
Key Deliverables
Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ), Call Rate & Return Reduction, Flawless New Launches of Outgoing Products, QMS, Radar Score Enhancement, Supplier Upgradation Roadmap by Enhancing Quality Maturity Progression Score, Radar Score, Tier 2 Supplier PPM Reduction, Rolling Throughput Yield Improvement, Competency Building of team at Supplier through trainings.
  Duties and responsibilities
  a) Integrate with various functions to formulate New Product Introduction Gate wise quality deliverables through Quality Risk Assessment sign off, tracker & objective targets. Reviewing and ensuring compliance to validation as per standards and set objectives at respective Gates. b) Ensure supplier engagement on PPAP, run@rate delivery. Execute APQP on Finished Goods bought out parts. c) Establish process controls, Quality systems, and critical touch points. Review performance of new products for 6 months since launch. Ensure Flawless Launch and Early Care of new product. d) Drive Built in Quality through identification on Critical stations/parameter and deploying preventive product/process controls for these parameters. e) Ensure Touch & Feel of product at par with Global standards. f)  Set a culture of shop engagement through Plan-Do-Check-Act, Problem Countermeasure Monitoring, Process Stage wise improvement tracking and Quality Circles g) Risk mitigation through Change Management / validation. h) Quality Command Centers for Top-bottom, bottom-top communication. Continuous connect to customer / dealers.
i) Upgrade Measurement system, online data acquisition, error proofing across suppliers.
j) Support chronic / sporadic problem resolution and set up immediate containment to Protect the Customer.
k) Raise Quality flag. Authorize deviation change request with support of Engineering
l) Support levelled escalations system
m) Assess various suppliers through radar mechanism width and depth of deployment of various initiatives.
n) Skill map / certifications of all FG quality professional
o)  People Development
   Qualifications
  BE /B.Tech with 14+ years’ experience.
Additional knowledge of QMS, IMS, Change Management,  Six Sigma, Shanin, DOE will be preferred

We are looking for an enthusiastic and target-oriented Admission Counselor to guide working professionals in choosing the right upGrad programs based on their career goals and professional experience.

Connect with working professionals through calls and other communication channels to understand their career and learning requirements.

Description:
Job Summary
Role Summary - The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies: Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants, Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO), Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts, denial rates, supply metrics vs competition


Qualifications

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills

Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Manager Finance Accounts
Company: JSW JFE Electrical Steel Private Limited
Division: Joint Venture between JSW Steel and JFE
Location: Vijayanagar
Reporting To: CFO / GM Finance Accounts
Position Status: New Position
Number of Positions: 1
Hiring Priority: Urgent / Immediate


1. Purpose of the Role
The Senior Manager Finance Accounts will oversee day-to-day Finance Accounts operations, financial reporting, Management Information Systems (MIS), statutory and internal audits, and compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements. The role will ensure accurate and timely preparation of financial statements in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) and Schedule III, strengthen internal financial controls, and support management decision-making through financial analysis and reporting.
The position will also coordinate with the JV partner, JFE, and internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective financial governance, audit readiness, budgetary control, and timely submission of financial information.


2. Key Result Areas and Responsibilities
KRA 1: Financial Reporting, Accounting and MIS
Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing and reporting activities.
Prepare and review financial statements in accordance with Ind AS and Schedule III requirements.
Ensure timely preparation of MIS reports, financial analysis, and management reporting.
Coordinate with JFE and relevant internal stakeholders for financial information, reporting, and reconciliation.
Support impairment testing, financial modelling, and Annual Business Plan (ABP) preparation.
Prepare and submit standalone and consolidated financial statements to JSW Steel for consolidation, as applicable.
KRA 2: Statutory Audits, Internal Audits and Compliance
Coordinate statutory, quarterly, internal, tax, and other applicable audits.
Facilitate the timely completion of audits by reviewing supporting documentation and responding to auditor queries.
Monitor Internal Financial Controls over Financial Reporting (ICFR) and support the strengthening of internal controls.
Ensure timely submission of audited financial results and other required financial information.
Coordinate with tax, legal, secretarial, and other relevant teams to ensure compliance with applicable statutory and regulatory requirements.
KRA 3: Budgetary Control and Financial Planning
Monitor and control capital expenditure (Capex) against approved budgets.
Analyse budget variances and provide insights to management for corrective action.
Support the preparation and review of the Annual Business Plan (ABP) and financial models.
Track project-related expenditure and support financial monitoring of the Greenfield manufacturing facility.
Contribute to the implementation and optimisation of SAP and related financial processes.
KRA 4: Corporate Governance, Board Reporting and JV Coordination
Prepare related-party transaction (RPT) information, results-page inputs, and financial data required for Board meetings.
Coordinate with the Secretarial and Legal teams for Board agenda items, minutes, disclosures, and applicable compliance requirements.
Ensure timely sharing of financial reports and information with JSW Steel and JFE.
Support corporate governance requirements and address finance-related legal and regulatory matters, wherever applicable.


3. Reporting Structure and Key Interfaces
Reports to: CFO / GM Finance Accounts
Peer Positions:
Manager Treasury
Manager FPA / Controlling
Manager Tax
Positions Reporting to the Role:
Executive / Manager Finance Accounts


4. Educational Qualifications and Experience
Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) or Cost Accountant (ICWA/CMA).
1015 years of relevant post-qualification or professional experience in Finance Accounts, financial reporting, audit, and compliance.
Strong knowledge of Ind AS, Schedule III, statutory and internal audits, financial controls, and regulatory reporting.
Experience in budgetary control, financial modelling, MIS, and capital expenditure monitoring.
Working knowledge of SAP and financial reporting systems is preferred.
Experience in a manufacturing organisation or a joint venture environment would be an advantage.


5. Key Competencies
Strong functional knowledge of Finance Accounts.
Analytical thinking and financial problem-solving.
Financial reporting and audit management.
Planning, budgeting, and cost control.
Stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination.
Team management and collaboration.
Effective written and verbal communication.
Attention to detail, integrity, and a strong governance orientation.


6. Key Stakeholders
Internal:
Corporate Finance Accounts team
Plant and Project teams
Tax team
IT team
Secretarial and Legal teams
JV partner representatives
External:
Statutory and internal auditors
Tax authorities
Other relevant regulatory and professional stakeholders


7. Key Success Factors
Timely and accurate preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.
Completion of statutory, internal, and tax audits within prescribed timelines.
Compliance with Ind AS, Schedule III, and applicable direct and indirect tax laws.
Effective monitoring of Capex budgets and financial plans.
Accurate and timely submission of financial information to JSW Steel and JFE.
Strong internal financial controls and audit readiness.
Timely preparation of Board-related financial information and RPT disclosures.
Successful support for SAP implementation and process improvements.


8. Business Context
JSW JFE Electrical Steel Private Limited (J2ES-V) is a joint venture between JSW Steel and JFE to establish a Greenfield Cold Rolled Grain Oriented (CRGO) electrical steel manufacturing facility at Vijayanagar, with a proposed annual capacity of 100,000 MT and an estimated project cost of 7,102 crore.
The Senior Manager Finance Accounts will play a critical role in establishing robust financial reporting, governance, compliance, and control processes to support the company's project execution and operational requirements.

Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
JSW JFE Electrical Steel Private Limited


1. Position Details

Particulars Details Position Name Manager Treasury Banking Current Position Holder New Division JSW JFE Electrical Steel Private Limited (JV between JSW Steel JFE) Location Vijayanagar Reporting To Head Treasury / CFO Recruitment Priority Urgent / Immediate Number of Positions 1

2. Purpose of the Role
To manage the company's cash flows, liquidity, banking operations, foreign exchange (forex) exposure, trade finance instruments (LC/BG), and loan compliance for a manufacturing setup. The role requires strong knowledge of Ind AS, treasury operations, financial risk management, and stakeholder management to ensure effective financial planning, regulatory compliance, and optimal utilization of funds.


3. Organization Chart
Position Reports To: CFO / Head Treasury
Peer Positions: Manager FA, Manager FPA Controlling, Manager Tax
Positions Reporting To This Role: Executive / Deputy Manager Treasury
Organization chart to be attached as an annexure.


4. Key Result Areas (KRAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Cash Flow and Liquidity Management: Manage daily cash flows, liquidity, short-term investments, and working capital limits, including cash credit (CC), letters of credit (LC), and bank guarantees (BG).
Trade Finance Management: Oversee LCs, BGs, standby letters of credit (SBLCs), amendments, and import/export documentation.
Forex and Risk Management: Monitor foreign exchange exposures arising from imports and exports and execute appropriate hedging transactions.
Loan and Project Finance Management: Monitor long-term loans, external commercial borrowings (ECBs), project finance, repayment schedules, and covenant compliance.
Treasury Accounting and Compliance: Ensure accurate treasury accounting, including interest accounting, mark-to-market (MTM) valuations, and hedge accounting in accordance with applicable Ind AS requirements.
Banking and Stakeholder Management: Liaise with banks, rating agencies, statutory auditors, and internal stakeholders to ensure effective treasury operations.
Process Improvement and Automation: Drive treasury automation, ERP/Treasury Management System (TMS) integration, and process efficiency.


5. Critical Tasks and Key Activities

KRA 1: Cash and Liquidity Management
Objective: Ensure optimal liquidity for operational expenditure, capital expenditure, vendor payments, and statutory dues while minimizing idle cash balances.
Key Activities:
Monitor daily cash and bank balances and maintain adequate liquidity for business operations.
Prepare and review daily and weekly cash flow forecasts.
Ensure timely execution of vendor payments, payroll, utility payments, and statutory obligations.
Monitor and optimize working capital facilities and banking limits.
Invest short-term surplus funds in accordance with the company's Treasury Policy.
Identify opportunities to improve cash utilization and minimize financing costs.


KRA 2: Loan Management and Covenant Compliance
Objective: Ensure accurate tracking, timely servicing, and compliance with the terms and conditions of long-term loans, ECBs, and project financing arrangements.
Key Activities:
Monitor loan drawdowns, interest payments, repayment schedules, and outstanding balances.
Ensure compliance with loan covenants and financing agreements.
Prepare and submit Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) and other financial ratio calculations to lenders.
Coordinate with project teams to monitor capital expenditure, project funding requirements, and utilization of funds.
Maintain accurate loan documentation and financing records.
Coordinate with banks and lenders for loan-related reporting and compliance requirements.


KRA 3: Trade Finance and Forex Risk Management
Objective: Ensure timely and accurate execution of trade finance transactions while mitigating foreign exchange risks associated with imports and exports.
Key Activities:
Arrange, open, amend, and monitor LCs, BGs, and SBLCs in coordination with banks and internal stakeholders.
Ensure compliance with UCP 600, FEMA, RBI guidelines, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
Monitor shipping documents, usance periods, maturity dates, and payment obligations.
Identify and monitor foreign exchange exposures arising from import and export transactions.
Execute approved forex hedging transactions in accordance with the company's Treasury Policy.
Maintain appropriate documentation and accounting records for hedge transactions in line with applicable Ind AS requirements.
Monitor forex market movements and assess their potential impact on the company's financial position.


6. Decision-Making Authority
Decision-making authority shall be exercised in accordance with the company's approved delegation of authority, treasury policy, and applicable internal control procedures.


7. Educational Qualifications and Work Experience
Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) or MBA in Finance.
Experience: 510 years of relevant experience in treasury, banking operations, forex management, trade finance, and loan management.
Preferred Skills: Working knowledge of SAP or other ERP systems and treasury management platforms.
Industry Preference: Experience in manufacturing, capital-intensive industries, or project-based organizations would be an advantage.


8. Competencies Required
Strong knowledge of treasury and banking operations.
Expertise in foreign exchange risk management and hedging.
Sound understanding of trade finance instruments, including LCs, BGs, and SBLCs.
Strong cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning, and financial analytics skills.
Knowledge of Ind AS, treasury accounting, and hedge accounting.
Understanding of loan management, project finance, and covenant compliance.
Strong negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Effective communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
Knowledge of SAP, ERP systems, and treasury automation tools.


9. Working Relationships Stakeholders
Internal Stakeholders
Corporate Finance Accounts (FA) Team
Projects Team
Information Technology (IT) Team
Joint Venture (JV) Partner
External Stakeholders
Banks and Financial Institutions
Statutory Auditors
Rating Agencies
Other Financial and Regulatory Stakeholders, as applicable


10. Key Success Factors and Challenges
Cash Flow and Liquidity Optimization: Ensure accurate cash flow forecasting, effective liquidity management, and efficient working capital utilization.
Project Financing and Cost Optimization: Support project financing requirements, manage trade finance effectively, and optimize the overall cost of funds.
Forex Risk Management and Compliance: Effectively manage foreign exchange exposures while maintaining strong financial controls, regulatory compliance, and governance.
Banking Relationship Management: Establish and maintain an effective banking ecosystem to support the organization's operational and project financing requirements.
Treasury Systems and Process Excellence: Strengthen treasury processes, controls, automation, and reporting mechanisms.


11. Additional Information
This is a newly created position within the Finance Accounts Department of JSW JFE Electrical Steel Private Limited (J2ES-V), a joint venture between JSW Steel and JFE.
The company is setting up a greenfield CRGO (Cold Rolled Grain-Oriented) electrical steel manufacturing facility at Vijayanagar, with an annual production capacity of 100,000 MT and an estimated project cost of 7,102 crore .
The role will support the establishment and management of the treasury and banking framework required to meet the organization's operational, project financing, and long-term financial management requirements.

Description:
About Swiggy:

Swiggy is Indias leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming Indias leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees

.Role: Sales Manager I

A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants learning their business understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.

Job Description:

Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggys products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Google sheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction 80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month What We're Looking For

Experience & Background:

0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partners.
Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Job Description
Own a portfolio of multi-outlet restaurants: Manage 30-40 high-value accounts(60 to 80 in case of Indianext cities), each with 2-10 outlets. These accounts represent 40-60% of city revenue
Executive relationship management: Build relationships with franchise owners, regional managers, and operational heads. You are often dealing with decision-makers, not individual restaurant managers
Consultative strategy: Move beyond product features. Help restaurants think about their growth strategy across, e.g., optimizing delivery times, increasing order frequency, and cross-location consistency
Field presence with data: Conduct monthly visits to key accounts to understand operations, gather feedback, troubleshoot adoption barriers, and surface new opportunities
Advanced analytics: Build detailed business reviews (QBR) for accounts. Analyze their performance across cuisine, compare against benchmarks, and present growth strategies
Pipeline development: Identify expansion opportunities with existing accounts (new locations, new products/cuisine). Turn your relationship into revenue growth
Excel excellence: Build executive presentations, ROI models for pitches, and monthly and quarterly business reviews with charts and trend analysis. Your spreadsheets must be presentation-ready for C-level stakeholders

Track record in managing multi-stakeholder deals

Advanced Excel skills: pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data visualization, forecasting. You should be able to build a dashboard for each RP, which can help you and the restaurant partner to keep track of their business with us
MBAs/PGDMs would be preferred in any discipline
Strong Industry Understanding: Since this is a mid-senior account management role, working knowledge of the restaurant ecosystem (unit economics, delivery margins, competitive landscape, aggregator dynamics) should be expected. Industry familiarity will significantly reduce ramp-up time and improve consultative quality. Qualifications
2-4 years in account management, B2B sales, or enterprise sales (proven progression from SDR/AE to AE or AM role)

Description:
Job Description
Responsibilities
Own the end-to-end hiring targets for delivery partners across assigned cities/zones - drive planning, execution, and daily monitoring of performance against targets, with root cause analysis and corrective action for underperforming locations.
Own the reliability of new delivery partners completing their first assignment, identifying drop-off points in the process and driving regular corrective interventions; monitor input volumes, call quality, and outreach attempt rates.
Drive early-stage activation of new joiners to improve their productivity and retention, tracking progress of new joiner cohorts and deploying targeted initiatives to help them become fully productive.
Own the smooth transition of new joiners from the payment/agreement stage through to full onboarding, targeting high completion rates weekly through close coordination with city-level partner agencies.
Conduct structured ground visits to engage with delivery partners (own and other marketplace) to gather first-hand feedback and competitive intelligence on payouts, incentives, and sourcing approaches to inform strategy.
Maintain a disciplined visit-planning cadence and ensure timely logging of field interactions to convert ground insights into action.
Strengthen partnerships with outsourced hiring agencies through structured performance reviews, driving agency accountability on onboarding speed, transition completion, productivity, quality, and target achievement.
Design and implement interventions to lift agency hiring efficiency, backed by regular call quality audits and coaching.
Ensure tight cross-functional coordination with city operations teams, hiring partner agencies, and central teams to keep hiring workflows running smoothly.
Identify process gaps and drive ongoing improvement initiatives; maintain and enforce updated standard operating procedures across the team.
Build and lead a high-performing team - manage headcount and rostering, drive individual performance through regular one-on-ones and coaching, and identify/develop future leaders.
Own productivity targets for the field recruiting team across assigned cities/zones - track output regularly, flag under-performers for timely intervention, and maintain approved team headcount.
Drive regular business reviews against defined goals with city and leadership stakeholders, using performance data to steer decisions.
Conduct regular audits (call quality, agency performance, and process compliance) to ensure adherence to operational standards; act as escalation point for supervisor-related or complex operational issues.
Qualifications
Desired Skills Qualifications
Proven experience managing large-scale, multi-city hiring or field operations, preferably in e-commerce, logistics, or allied industries.
Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills, with the ability to work with performance data to drive corrective action.
Ability to operate with urgency across fast-moving review cycles and manage ambiguity in a dynamic environment.
Excellent stakeholder management skills able to coordinate effectively with partner agencies, city operations teams, and central teams.
Hands-on experience in process design, SOP governance, and driving process improvement initiatives.
Strong people leadership skills team management, coaching, one-on-ones, and succession planning.
Field-oriented mindset with willingness to conduct regular ground visits and engage directly with delivery partners and competitor agents.
Strong communication, composure under pressure, and a proactive, result-oriented approach with high attention to detail.

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
- Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
- Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
- Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
- Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
- Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
- Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
- Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
This position is with ITC 24mantra.

The Manager FPP will be responsible for farm extension services, sustain and expand Area under Organic Contract Farming, Procurement of Agricultural Commodities.
Responsibilities
Organic Crop Production
Assist in planning and implementation of organic farming practices
Support soil health management .
Conduct regular field visits to monitor crop growth, pest/disease incidence, and soil conditions
Guide farmers on organic cultivation practices and input usage
Promote sustainable techniques such as mulching and water conservation
Procurement Operations
Coordinate procurement of organic produce directly from farmers/FPOs
Ensure quality standards and organic integrity during sourcing and aggregation
Maintain procurement schedules aligned with harvest cycles
Verify traceability and documentation for organic certification compliance
Support price negotiation and vendor/farmer relationship management
Compliance & Documentation
Maintain farm records, input logs, and traceability systems
Assist in internal inspections and external organic certification audits (NPOP, USDA, EU standards)
Ensure adherence to Internal Control Systems (ICS) for organic certification
Farmer & Stakeholder Coordination
Work closely with farmers, FPOs, and field officers
Conduct training and awareness programs on organic farming practices
Build strong relationships to ensure consistent supply and quality

Qualifications
Education - B Sc Agriculture
Experience - Min 5 yrs experience in Field Crop production or procurement, contract farming. Experience in Organic farming will be preferred.
Team Handling experience is must
Language - Telugu

Location - Srikakulam

The position assists with the soliciting and handling of sales opportunities.

- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required

Description:
JSW JFE Electrical Steel Private Limited


Position Details
Position Name: Manager - Treasury & Banking
Current Position Holder: New
Division: JSW JFE Electrical Steel Private Limited (JV between JSW Steel & JFE)
Location: Vijayanagar
Reporting To: Head - Treasury / CFO
Recruitment Priority: Urgent / Immediate
Number of Positions: 1


Purpose of the Role
To manage the company's cash flows, liquidity, banking operations, foreign exchange (forex) exposure, trade finance instruments (LC/BG), and loan compliance for a manufacturing setup. The role requires strong knowledge of Ind AS, treasury operations, financial risk management, and stakeholder management to ensure effective financial planning, regulatory compliance, and optimal utilization of funds.


Organization Chart
Organization chart to be attached as an annexure.


Key Result Areas (KRAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


Critical Tasks and Key Activities

Kra 1: Cash and Liquidity Management
Objective: Ensure optimal liquidity for operational expenditure, capital expenditure, vendor payments, and statutory dues while minimizing idle cash balances.
Key Activities:


Kra 2: Loan Management and Covenant Compliance
Objective: Ensure accurate tracking, timely servicing, and compliance with the terms and conditions of long-term loans, ECBs, and project financing arrangements.


Kra 3: Trade Finance and Forex Risk Management
Objective: Ensure timely and accurate execution of trade finance transactions while mitigating foreign exchange risks associated with imports and exports.


Decision-Making Authority
Decision-making authority shall be exercised in accordance with the company's approved delegation of authority, treasury policy, and applicable internal control procedures.


Educational Qualifications and Work Experience


Competencies Required
Strong knowledge of treasury and banking operations.
Expertise in foreign exchange risk management and hedging.
Sound understanding of trade finance instruments, including LCs, BGs, and SBLCs.
Strong cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning, and financial analytics skills.
Knowledge of Ind AS, treasury accounting, and hedge accounting.
Understanding of loan management, project finance, and covenant compliance.
Strong negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Effective communication

Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Manager Finance Accounts
Company: JSW JFE Electrical Steel Private Limited
Division: Joint Venture between JSW Steel and JFE
Location: Vijayanagar
Reporting To: CFO / GM Finance Accounts
Position Status: New Position
Number of Positions: 1
Hiring Priority: Urgent / Immediate


1. Purpose of the Role
The Senior Manager Finance Accounts will oversee day-to-day Finance Accounts operations, financial reporting, Management Information Systems (MIS), statutory and internal audits, and compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements. The role will ensure accurate and timely preparation of financial statements in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) and Schedule III, strengthen internal financial controls, and support management decision-making through financial analysis and reporting.
The position will also coordinate with the JV partner, JFE, and internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective financial governance, audit readiness, budgetary control, and timely submission of financial information.


2. Key Result Areas and Responsibilities
KRA 1: Financial Reporting, Accounting and MIS
Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing and reporting activities.
Prepare and review financial statements in accordance with Ind AS and Schedule III requirements.
Ensure timely preparation of MIS reports, financial analysis, and management reporting.
Coordinate with JFE and relevant internal stakeholders for financial information, reporting, and reconciliation.
Support impairment testing, financial modelling, and Annual Business Plan (ABP) preparation.
Prepare and submit standalone and consolidated financial statements to JSW Steel for consolidation, as applicable.
KRA 2: Statutory Audits, Internal Audits and Compliance
Coordinate statutory, quarterly, internal, tax, and other applicable audits.
Facilitate the timely completion of audits by reviewing supporting documentation and responding to auditor queries.
Monitor Internal Financial Controls over Financial Reporting (ICFR) and support the strengthening of internal controls.
Ensure timely submission of audited financial results and other required financial information.
Coordinate with tax, legal, secretarial, and other relevant teams to ensure compliance with applicable statutory and regulatory requirements.
KRA 3: Budgetary Control and Financial Planning
Monitor and control capital expenditure (Capex) against approved budgets.
Analyse budget variances and provide insights to management for corrective action.
Support the preparation and review of the Annual Business Plan (ABP) and financial models.
Track project-related expenditure and support financial monitoring of the Greenfield manufacturing facility.
Contribute to the implementation and optimisation of SAP and related financial processes.
KRA 4: Corporate Governance, Board Reporting and JV Coordination
Prepare related-party transaction (RPT) information, results-page inputs, and financial data required for Board meetings.
Coordinate with the Secretarial and Legal teams for Board agenda items, minutes, disclosures, and applicable compliance requirements.
Ensure timely sharing of financial reports and information with JSW Steel and JFE.
Support corporate governance requirements and address finance-related legal and regulatory matters, wherever applicable.


3. Reporting Structure and Key Interfaces
Reports to: CFO / GM Finance Accounts
Peer Positions:
Manager Treasury
Manager FPA / Controlling
Manager Tax
Positions Reporting to the Role:
Executive / Manager Finance Accounts


4. Educational Qualifications and Experience
Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) or Cost Accountant (ICWA/CMA).
1015 years of relevant post-qualification or professional experience in Finance Accounts, financial reporting, audit, and compliance.
Strong knowledge of Ind AS, Schedule III, statutory and internal audits, financial controls, and regulatory reporting.
Experience in budgetary control, financial modelling, MIS, and capital expenditure monitoring.
Working knowledge of SAP and financial reporting systems is preferred.
Experience in a manufacturing organisation or a joint venture environment would be an advantage.


5. Key Competencies
Strong functional knowledge of Finance Accounts.
Analytical thinking and financial problem-solving.
Financial reporting and audit management.
Planning, budgeting, and cost control.
Stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination.
Team management and collaboration.
Effective written and verbal communication.
Attention to detail, integrity, and a strong governance orientation.


6. Key Stakeholders
Internal:
Corporate Finance Accounts team
Plant and Project teams
Tax team
IT team
Secretarial and Legal teams
JV partner representatives
External:
Statutory and internal auditors
Tax authorities
Other relevant regulatory and professional stakeholders


7. Key Success Factors
Timely and accurate preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.
Completion of statutory, internal, and tax audits within prescribed timelines.
Compliance with Ind AS, Schedule III, and applicable direct and indirect tax laws.
Effective monitoring of Capex budgets and financial plans.
Accurate and timely submission of financial information to JSW Steel and JFE.
Strong internal financial controls and audit readiness.
Timely preparation of Board-related financial information and RPT disclosures.
Successful support for SAP implementation and process improvements.


8. Business Context
JSW JFE Electrical Steel Private Limited (J2ES-V) is a joint venture between JSW Steel and JFE to establish a Greenfield Cold Rolled Grain Oriented (CRGO) electrical steel manufacturing facility at Vijayanagar, with a proposed annual capacity of 100,000 MT and an estimated project cost of 7,102 crore.
The Senior Manager Finance Accounts will play a critical role in establishing robust financial reporting, governance, compliance, and control processes to support the company's project execution and operational requirements.

Description:
DBS Bank India Limited
DBS Bank has been present in India for 30 years, opening its first office in Mumbai in 1994. DBS Bank India Limited is the first among the large foreign banks in India to start operating as a wholly owned, locally incorporated subsidiary of a leading global bank. As a trusted partner, DBS provides a range of banking services for large, medium, and small enterprises and individual consumers in India, focusing on a seamless customer experience that helps them Live more, Bank less’. In November 2020, Lakshmi Vilas Bank was merged with DBS Bank India Limited. DBS Bank India is now present in ~350 locations in 19 Indian states.
Position Title

Branch Relationship Manager - Growth

Department

CBG - NDS
Rank

Officer/Senior Officer/Analyst

Reports To

Branch Manager
Job Purpose

To deliver exceptional volume and revenue performance with a primary focus on acquiring new-to-bank (NTB) DBS clients having an AUM INR 1 million through a “need-based approach,” while also engaging and growing existing clients.
To drive sustained acquisition momentum through active sourcing, local market penetration, and network building, and ensure client coverage and product penetration via cross-sell and up-sell of DBS products and services.
To manage & maintain the highest customer satisfaction and service levels through proactive client engagement & relationship management, coordinating internally with DBS Service, Distribution, and Product teams.
Key Accountabilities

Primary ownership of NTB acquisition: Consistently acquire and upgrade quality clients in the branch catchment with a strong focus on sourcing new affluent clients into the Treasures segment.
Build and execute a robust acquisition pipeline through self-sourcing, referrals, branch walk-ins, local area prospecting, corporate and community engagement.
Engage with existing customers to deepen the wallet share through retention and growth of AUM.
Accountable for achieving monthly & annual volume and revenue objective, as agreed.
Ensure activation of e-Channels (I-Banking / M-Banking/ Online MF/Debit Card) and Savings Book growth for both newly acquired and existing clients.
Ensure proper implementation & execution of product strategies through effective relationship management.
Develop the client trust and loyalty for entrenched relationship with DBS through lifestyle and beyond banking propositions
Ensure optimum product mix and new- to- product clients aimed at customer level profitability and enhancing client coverage.
Drive and deliver exemplary customer service in the local market and uphold DBS service standards.
Ensure internal and regulatory compliance through strict adherence to DBS sales process, timely risk reviews and exercising due diligence while on-boarding.
Ensure exemplary service delivery of these clients by building appropriate workflows and processes incl. doorstep banking etc.
Establish DBS as the primary banker for newly acquired clients and strengthen its position as a prominent banking provider through consistent acquisition and superior service delivery.
Job Duties & responsibilities

Establish, manage and grow the AUM of mapped Client segment by acquiring and nurturing the client having AUM => INR 1 M
Ensure complete knowledge of all products & services through continuous skill and knowledge improvement.
Resolve customer queries and complaints within the agreed TAT as per the DBS customer service policy.
Coordinate and work closely with CBG colleagues, Service teams, Product specialist to ensure that team objectives are met through an environment that nurtures harmony and collaboration through teamwork
Work closely with the Line Manager and City / Cluster Head to ensure achievement of common team and Branch objectives.
Ensure internal and regulatory compliance and address operational risks if any, e.g. Health & Safety standards, security of premises, AML / KYC and ongoing risk reviews.
To exercise appropriate due diligence while on-boarding and engaging with clients.
Establish DBS as a primary banker for clients and as a prominent banking provider in India.
Required Experience

Minimum 2 years of experience in a reputed bank and proficient in banking products.
Education / Preferred Qualifications

Preferably MBA (not mandatory)
Mandatory - Graduate (10+2+3 years of education)
AMFI / IRDAI / FEDAI certified candidates with BCSBI certification would be an added advantage
Core Competencies

Strong Relationship Management and influencing skills
Strong service orientation, customer-centric behavior
Effective probing and listening skills.
Self-driven and ambitious.
Good written and verbal communication skills
Results-orientated & the ability to deliver results under pressure
In-depth knowledge of local market and competition.
Understanding of competitive positioning
Focused on developing image and goodwill of the brand
Creative, inquisitive mind with problem solving abilities
Ability to deliver results within tight timelines
Attention to details, analyzing abilities
Technical Competencies

Understanding of HNI Sales/ wealth management product suite, platforms and operational procedures
Understanding of banking and para-banking guidelines issued by RBI (local regulations in India) and local laws and regulations that impact businesses in general.
Understanding of KYC requirements & Anti-money Laundering Policies.
Knowledge of financial markets and products to assist in meaningful engagement with client
Work Relationship

Management of clients and prospects for acquisition and deepening of wallet share
Close interaction with Branch Manager, BOSH, CSO, CH, RH, Treasures RM’s and Treasures Elite Team Leader
Operations team to ensure consistent delivery of volume and revenue targets.
Close and regular interaction with Branch Product specialists for effective skill / knowledge
Development of self and explore potential in existing books through joint engagement with clients
DBS India - Culture & Behaviors

Performance through Value Based Propositions
Ensure customer focus by delighting customers & reducing complaints
Build pride and passion to protect, maintain and enhance DBS’ image and reputation
Enhance knowledge base, build skill sets & develop competencies
Execute at speed while maintaining error free operations
Maintain the highest standards of honesty and integrity

Description:
Incumbent as Factory Quality Head will be responsible for Managing Quality across Suppliers / Products/Processes/ Customers (Internal & External). Will be responsible for preparing Quality Assurance Strategy for ensuring right quality enablers for Supplier / Manufacturing value chain for continuous improvement of Overall Quality Metrics. This will be driven through sustainable quality systems including applicable regulatory compliances.
Key Deliverables
Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ), Call Rate & Return Reduction, Flawless New Launches of Outgoing Products, QMS, Radar Score Enhancement, Quality Improvement Roadmap by Enhancing Quality Maturity Progression Score, Radar Score, Tier 2 Supplier PPM Reduction, Rolling Throughput Yield Improvement, Competency Building of team through trainings.
Duties and responsibilities
a) Integrate with various functions to formulate New Product Introduction Gate wise quality deliverables through Quality Risk Assessment sign off, tracker & objective targets. Reviewing and ensuring compliance to validation as per standards and set objectives at respective Gates. b) Ensure supplier engagement on PPAP, run@rate delivery. Execute APQP on bought out parts. c) Establish process controls, Quality systems, and critical touch points. Review performance of new products for 6 months since launch. Ensure Flawless Launch and Early Care of new product. d) Drive Built in Quality through identification on Critical stations/parameter and deploying preventive product/process controls for these parameters. e) Ensure Touch & Feel of product at par with Global standards. f)  Set a culture of shop engagement through Plan-Do-Check-Act, Problem Countermeasure Monitoring, Process Stage wise improvement tracking and Quality Circles g) Risk mitigation through Change Management / validation. h) Quality Command Centers for Top-bottom, bottom-top communication. Continuous connect to customer / dealers.
i) Upgrade Measurement system, online data acquisition, error proofing across suppliers.
j) Support chronic / sporadic problem resolution and set up immediate containment to Protect the Customer.
k) Raise Quality flag. Authorize deviation change request with support of Engineering
l) Support levelled escalations system
m) Assess various suppliers through radar mechanism width and depth of deployment of various initiatives.
n) Skill map / certifications of all factory quality professional
o)  People Development
Qualifications
BE /B.Tech with 14+ years’ experience.
Additional knowledge of QMS, IMS, Change Management,  Six Sigma, Shanin, DOE will be preferred

Description:
Job Purpose
The ITI Fitter is responsible for executing preventive and breakdown maintenance of heavy plant machinery within the AAC block manufacturing unit. The primary focus is to ensure optimum machine availability, minimize production downtime, and assist in the smooth operation of specialized concrete processing equipment

Key Responsibilities
Equipment Maintenance & Repair: Perform routine, preventive, and emergency breakdown maintenance on core AAC plant machinery, including:
Raw Material Section: Jaw crushers, ball mills, and slurry pumps.
Dosing & Mixing Unit: Weighing hoppers, heavy slurry mixers, and pouring systems.
Cutting Line: Cutting machines, wire-changing mechanisms, and tilting cranes.
Curing Section: Autoclave doors, high-pressure steam valves, pipelines, and track networks.
Utility & Handling: Conveyor belts, gearboxes, hydraulic presses, pneumatic actuators, and transfer cars
Education: ITI (Fitter / Mechanic) trade certificate passed from a recognized NCVT institute. A Diploma in Mechanical Engineering is also acceptable.

Experience: 1 to 4 years of proven hands-on experience in an AAC Block plant, Cement factory, Fly Ash plant, or heavy industrial manufacturing unit. (Freshers with exceptional practical ITI training may be considered)

Role & responsibilities
Generate new business through field sales, references, leads, and customer interactions.
Promote and sell banking products such as Savings Accounts, Current Accounts, Fixed Deposits, Insurance, Loans, Credit Cards, and Investment Products.
Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers.
Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets assigned by the organization.
Conduct customer meetings, presentations, and product demonstrations.
Cross-sell and up-sell banking products based on customer needs.
Ensure proper documentation and compliance as per banking norms.

Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Strong customer handling and relationship-building abilities.
Self-motivated, target-oriented, and willing to work in a field sales environment.
Basic knowledge of banking products and financial services will be an added advantage.
Proficiency in MS Office and digital banking applications.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
We are looking for enthusiastic and result-oriented MBA freshers from the 2025 and 2026 batches to join our team as Collection Manager Management Trainees. The selected candidates will be responsible for supporting collection operations for unsecured personal loans, monitoring overdue accounts, coordinating with customers for timely repayments, and ensuring collection targets are achieved while maintaining professional customer relationships.
This role offers an excellent opportunity to build a career in retail lending, credit operations, and collections management.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor overdue accounts and follow up with customers for repayment of unsecured personal loans.
Contact customers through calls and other approved communication channels to remind them of pending payments.
Understand customer payment issues and coordinate with them to facilitate timely repayment.
Support collection teams in achieving monthly recovery targets and reducing delinquency.
Track overdue accounts, payment commitments, and collection performance.
Analyze collection reports and identify accounts requiring priority follow-up.
Coordinate with field collection executives, team leaders, and internal departments for effective recovery.
Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, payment commitments, and collection activities.
Ensure all collection activities comply with company policies, applicable RBI guidelines, and fair practices.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly collection performance reports for management review.
Eligibility Criteria
MBA / PGDM graduates from the 2025 or 2026 batch.
Freshers with a specialization in Finance, Marketing, Business Administration, or related fields are preferred.
Good communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel and reporting tools.
Willingness to work in a target-driven environment.
Ability to handle customer interactions professionally and work effectively in a team.
Required Skills
Communication and negotiation skills
Customer relationship management
Analytical and decision-making skills
Target orientation and result focus
Time management and teamwork
Basic financial and numerical understanding

Preferred candidate profile
AboutCompany:
The Muthoot Group is a leading business conglomerate that has successfully expanded, in each and every town, across the nation. The Group has 20 diversified business divisions and 5443+ branches with a global presence across USA, UK, UAE, Costa Rica, Sri Lanka and Nepal.
The Group serves over 2.5 lakh customers every single day through its network of branches. Till date, the Group has served over 70 crore customers, including repeat customers. The Muthoot Groups story from humble beginnings to its ever growing stature is built on the firm foundation of 7 fundamental principles of Ethics, Values Reliability, Dependability, Trustworthiness, Integrity and Goodwill. The Group practices an equal opportunity policy wherein people from all sections of the society have equal opportunities to join and be part of the 40,000+ strong Muthoot Family.
Muthoot Finance, the flagship company of The Muthoot Group has been rated India’s No. 1 Most Trusted Financial Services Brand for five consecutive years, from 2016 to 2020 by TRA’s Brand Trust Report. It has been certified as ‘Great Place To Work, 2021-22’ and has been recognised and featured as one of the Top 30 Best Places to Work at in India by Skill Tree Global Knowledge Consortium in the Workplace Excellence Show on CNBC TV-18 in 2016.
The Company offer 30+ Staff Welfare Measures ranging from Fast Track Promotions, Career Development Programs, National Pension Scheme, Foreign Trips, five types of Annual Incentives/Bonuses, Cash Rewards, Contests with prizes, Maternity Benefits, Medical benefits, Employee Insurance etc. to name a few.
Muthoot Finance believes in promoting local hiring from the region. Every 5th employee is a woman and roughly 24% of the workforce comprises of women.
Shri. Amitabh Bachchan Ji is the Brand Ambassador of The Muthoot Group.
The Group takes humble pride in its 800 years of family business legacy and unblemished track record. Over these years, millions of underserved Indians have been served through a bouquet of products and services and have been helped in a big way to move ahead in life.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced DevOps Developer with 10-12 years of hands-on experience in DevOps engineering, cloud infrastructure, automation, CI/CD pipeline development, and container orchestration. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable, secure, and highly available infrastructure and deployment solutions. The candidate should have strong expertise in DevOps tools, cloud platforms, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), scripting, Kubernetes, and continuous integration and delivery practices. The role requires close collaboration with development, QA, security, and infrastructure teams to improve deployment efficiency, system reliability, and operational performance.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing, deployment, and release management.
Implement and manage DevOps solutions using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions.
Design, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or equivalent tools.
Implement and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, application deployment, and operational tasks using Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
Monitor application and infrastructure performance using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK Stack, or equivalent monitoring solutions.
Implement DevSecOps practices, including security scanning, vulnerability management, secrets management, and compliance controls.
Troubleshoot complex issues related to deployments, cloud infrastructure, networking, containers, and application performance.
Optimize infrastructure utilization, scalability, availability, and cloud costs.
Establish and maintain version control, branching strategies, release processes, and configuration management standards.
Implement high availability, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity practices.
Collaborate with architects, developers, QA teams, and other stakeholders to streamline software delivery.
Mentor junior engineers, establish technical best practices, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
Prepare technical documentation, deployment procedures, runbooks, and operational guidelines.
Experience and Qualifications
10-12 years of overall experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure Automation, or related technical roles.
Strong hands-on experience designing and implementing enterprise-grade DevOps solutions.
Proven experience building and maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines in complex environments.
Experience managing production infrastructure and troubleshooting critical technical issues.
Ability to work independently, lead technical initiatives, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred.
Good to Have Experience with GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux.
Knowledge of service mesh technologies such as Istio.
Exposure to serverless architectures and cloud-native application development.
Experience with DevSecOps tools such as SonarQube, Trivy, Snyk, or Checkov.
Familiarity with AIOps, platform engineering, and self-service infrastructure automation.
Relevant cloud or Kubernetes certifications.
Key Competencies
Strong technical ownership and problem-solving ability.
Ability to design scalable, reliable, and secure solutions.
Excellent troubleshooting and incident-resolution skills.
Effective stakeholder communication and cross-functional collaboration.
Commitment to automation, continuous improvement, and engineering best practices.

Description:
Job description
Gold Appraiser / Gold Valuation Executive Operations
Location: Multiple Locations Andhra Pradesh & Telangana
Department: Operations
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and customer-focused Gold Appraiser / Gold Valuation Executive and Manager to join our Operations team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for accurate gold appraisal, processing gold loan applications, maintaining branch records, and delivering excellent customer service while ensuring compliance with company policies.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Evaluate and appraise gold ornaments using standard valuation methods and approved equipment.

2. Verify the purity, weight, and quality of pledged gold.

3. Process gold loan applications and complete all operational formalities.

4. Verify customer KYC and loan documentation.

5. Maintain loan files, operational registers, and branch records accurately.

6. Handle documentation, books of accounts, and operational records.

7. Ensure safe custody of pledged gold and related documents.

8. Follow up with customers for loan renewals, repayments, and closures.

9. Provide prompt and professional customer service.

10. Ensure compliance with company policies, audit standards, and regulatory guidelines.

11. Support daily branch operations and maintain operational efficiency.

Eligibility:
1. Any Graduate
2. Knowledge of gold appraisal or willingness to learn.
3. Good communication and customer handling skills.
4. Basic computer knowledge.
5. Attention to detail and strong ethical standards.

Preferred Skills:
1. Gold valuation and appraisal.
2. Gold loan operations.
3. Documentation and record management.
4. Customer relationship management.
5. KYC verification.
6. Operational compliance.
7. Communication and interpersonal skills.
8. MS Office and basic computer operations.

Salary: Best in the Industry + Performance Incentives.

Description:
Job Description Cluster Manager
Role objective
The Cluster Manager is primarily responsible for driving sales and building the loan portfolio across assigned branches, while ensuring good customer service, quality business and disciplined branch operations.
Key responsibilities
1. Sales and portfolio growth
Set branch-wise sales priorities and follow up with the sales team on customer acquisition and loan disbursements.
Monitor branch performance, identify gaps and take corrective action to achieve business targets.
Ensure portfolio growth is supported by proper customer verification, adherence to company policies and quality lending practices.
2. Customer service and branch readiness
Ensure every operating branch opens by 9:30 a.m. Escalate any delay immediately.
Ensure at least two employees are present at each branch. Where staffing falls short, contact Pavan Kalyan immediately to arrange deputation.
Ensure customers receive prompt, courteous service and that complaints and service delays are addressed quickly.
3. Auction-loan follow-up
Follow up with customers and branch staff on loans identified for the June auction.
Ensure each affected customer receives the auction message through WhatsApp, in line with the companys communication process.
Track customer responses and repayment commitments, and ensure branch staff complete the required follow-up.
4. Branch expansion
Identify suitable premises for new branches with the assistance of Team Leaders from nearby branches.
Coordinate site visits and submit shortlisted premises for review and approval.
5. Recruitment and staffing coordination
Follow up with HR on hiring the sales team for existing and proposed branches.
Coordinate with Deepika from MIS to download candidate profiles based on the required locations, such as Nagarkurnool, Mahabubabad and Nalgonda.
Assist AVPs and VPs in uploading candidate profiles onto FINS.
Send emails proposing the rejoining of suitable former employees and follow up with HR on the necessary approvals and joining arrangements.
Performance expectations
The Cluster Manager will be assessed on portfolio growth, loan disbursements, customer service, business quality, timely branch opening, staffing readiness and completion of assigned auction follow-ups.
- Each operating Branch is opened by 9.30am;
- If any Branch opening after 9.30am, shall be escalated;
- Min two employees are present in the Branch; If not, shall reach out Pavan Kalyan for deputation
- Follow up June Auction Loans with customers and Branch staff;
- Shall send Auction message to each customer through whatsapp;
- Identify premises for new Branches with the help of TLs of nearby Branches
- Follow up with HR as regards hiring of Sales team;
- Reach out Deepika of MIS to download profiles using location – For example – Nagarkurnool, Mehabubabad, Nalgonda.
- Shall help AVPs and VPs to upload profiles on FINS;
- Shall send mails for rejoining of staff;
- Follow up with Sales Team for Loan Disbursements.

# Job Description (JD) CNC Programmer cum Operations Coordinator
### Stainless Steel Fabrication / Sheet Metal Manufacturing Industry

**Job Title:** CNC Programmer cum Operations Coordinator
**Department:** Engineering, Fabrication & Operations
**Location:** [Location]
**Reporting To:** Operations Manager / Production Manager

---

## Job Summary

The CNC Programmer cum Operations Coordinator is responsible for developing CNC programs for laser cutting, punching, and bending machines while coordinating daily production activities across design, stores, fabrication, machining, and dispatch departments. The role ensures efficient machine utilization, material optimization, production scheduling, and on-time project execution.

---

## Key Responsibilities

### CNC Programming

- Create CNC programs for Laser Cutting, CNC Punching, and CNC Press Brake machines.
- Prepare nesting layouts to maximize sheet utilization and reduce scrap.
- Generate machine programs from CAD drawings and engineering designs.
- Optimize cutting paths and machine cycle times.
- Verify programs before production release.
- Maintain CNC program libraries and revision records.
- Support operators during program setup and troubleshooting.

### Technical & Engineering Support

- Interpret fabrication drawings, CAD files, and customer specifications.
- Coordinate with design engineers to resolve technical issues.
- Prepare production drawings and job files.
- Ensure manufacturability of designs before production release.
- Support design modifications and engineering changes.

### Operations Coordination

- Coordinate daily production schedules with fabrication and machining teams.
- Monitor work orders and production progress.
- Ensure timely availability of materials, tools, and programs.
- Coordinate between Stores, Production, Quality, and Dispatch.
- Track and expedite priority jobs to meet delivery commitments.
- Identify bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.

### Production Planning & Monitoring

- Prepare daily and weekly production plans.
- Track machine loading and capacity utilization.
- Monitor production output against targets.
- Generate production status reports for management.
- Ensure adherence to delivery schedules.

### Material Optimization

- Optimize sheet utilization through efficient nesting.
- Minimize raw material wastage and scrap generation.
- Review cutting plans for cost effectiveness.
- Coordinate material requirements with stores and purchase departments.

### Quality Control Support

- Ensure programmed dimensions conform to approved drawings.
- Support first article inspection (FAI).
- Assist in resolving dimensional and fabrication issues.
- Coordinate corrective actions for production non-conformities.

### ERP & Documentation

- Update production data in ERP systems.
- Maintain CNC program records and revision control.
- Generate production reports and machine utilization reports.
- Maintain job tracking sheets and production schedules.

### Safety & Compliance

- Follow company safety procedures and machine operating standards.
- Support implementation of 5S and lean manufacturing initiatives.
- Ensure compliance with quality management systems and SOPs.

---

## Educational Qualification

- Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or Industrial Engineering.
- Certification in CNC Programming, CAD/CAM, or Nesting Software preferred.

---

## Experience

### Junior CNC Programmer
- 2-4 years experience

### CNC Programmer cum Operations Coordinator
- 4-8 years experience in sheet metal fabrication and CNC programming

### Preferred Industry Experience
- Stainless Steel Fabrication
- Sheet Metal Manufacturing
- Electrical Enclosure Manufacturing
- Pharma Equipment Manufacturing
- Food Processing Equipment Manufacturing
- Industrial Fabrication

---

## Technical Skills

### Software
- AutoCAD
- SolidWorks
- SigmaNEST
- TruTops
- Metalix
- RADAN
- NC Express
- ERP Software
- Microsoft Excel

### Machinery
- Laser Cutting Machines
- CNC Punching Machines
- CNC Press Brake Machines
- Bending Tools & Die Selection

### Technical Knowledge
- Sheet Metal Manufacturing
- Nesting Optimization
- Fabrication Drawings
- Production Planning
- Material Requirement Planning (MRP)
- Quality Control Processes

---

## Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

| KPI | Target |
|------|---------|
| Production Schedule Adherence | 95% |
| Sheet Utilization Efficiency | 95% |
| CNC Program Accuracy | 98% |
| On-Time Job Release | 95% |
| Machine Utilization | 85% |
| Rework Due to Programming Errors | 1% |
| Delivery Schedule Compliance | 95% |
| ERP/Data Accuracy | 99% |

---

## Key Deliverables

- Error-free CNC programs.
- Maximum sheet utilization and reduced scrap.
- Timely release of jobs to production.
- Smooth coordination between departments.
- High machine productivity and on-time delivery.
- Accurate production tracking and reporting.

## Career Progression

**CNC Operator CNC Programmer CNC Programmer cum Operations Coordinator Team Lead Operations Operations Manager Plant Manager**
