Description:
Risk Consulting EY Comply: Position: Senior Regulatory Reporting

Hands-on experience in From any of this form FFIEC 031 , FRY 9C , FRY 15 , FFIEC 041/051 , FR 2062a , Basel & Liquidity reporting , COREP/FINREP , Money Transmission reporting .

NOTE = 0 Days Notice or 1 Month Notice period
The Opportunity
We are looking for a skilled Senior Regulatory Reporting Professional to support the delivery of technology-enabled regulatory reporting services for digital asset clients. The role focuses on end-to-end report production, data validation, reconciliations, controls, issue management, and regulatory change across U.S. and global reporting obligations. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with clients, onshore teams, technology teams, and operations stakeholders to strengthen reporting accuracy, improve governance, support automation, and build scalable processes aligned with evolving products, entities, and regulatory requirements.
Your Key Responsibilities
Regulatory Production & Submissions: Lead regulatory reporting workstreams, including end-to-end preparation, review, and timely submission of U.S. and global filings such as MTL reporting, transaction reporting, financial condition reporting, and capital calculations.
Broader Banking Regulatory Reporting Exposure: Apply relevant exposure to banking regulatory returns, including capital adequacy, liquidity reporting, ICAAP reporting, balance sheet reporting, and regulatory disclosures, where applicable to the clients operating model.
Regulatory Change, Awareness & Reporting Logic: Monitor relevant regulatory developments, interpret reporting instructions, assess data and process impacts, and coordinate timely updates to reporting logic, templates, procedures, controls, and technology workflows.
Data Sourcing & Analytical Reviews: Perform complex data extraction, validation, variance analysis, and root-cause exception investigations across large datasets to ensure data completeness and integrity.
Control Governance & Audit Readiness: Embed rigorous quality controlsincluding maker-checker reviews, clear audit trails, evidence retention, and sign-off protocols—across all reporting cycles.
Automation & Process Improvement: Identify reporting process inefficiencies and support automation initiatives using tools such as SQL, Python, and modern data platforms to reduce manual effort and operational risk.
Analytics & Responsible AI Awareness: Apply awareness of responsible AI and analytics use cases to support anomaly detection, exception analysis, reporting commentary, and workflow monitoring.
Team Leadership & Stakeholder Alignment: Provide technical coaching and review support to junior team members while coordinating seamlessly across cross-functional partners and U.S.-based stakeholders.
Time-Zone Flexibility: Willingness to operate during late/extended hours to ensure seamless hand-offs with U.S.-based stakeholders and meet strict global submission deadlines.
Al fluency - Demonstrates broad knowledge of AI trends, opportunities, and risks within operations. Supports the implementation of AI driven process improvements, encourages responsible AI adoption within the team, and contributes to efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
Skills and attributes for success
Ideally, you’ll also have
4–6 years of relevant experience, including 2–6 years in a senior role within regulatory reporting or financial services.
Hands-on experience with U.S. regulatory filings, financial condition reporting, customer liability reporting, permissible investments, transaction reporting, and Money Transmitter License (MTL) submissions.
Hands-on experience in FFIEC 031 , FRY 9C , FRY 15 , FFIEC 041/051 , FR 2062a , Basel & Liquidity reporting , COREP/FINREP , Money Transmission reporting .
Master’s degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field is preferred; CA, CPA, CFA, MBA, or an equivalent professional qualification would be an advantage.
Strong end-to-end understanding of regulatory reporting production cycles, data validation, reconciliations, variance analysis, workpaper preparation, and review controls.
Solid working knowledge of financial statement analysis, regulatory capital concepts, ICAAP reporting, and applicable regulatory compliance frameworks.
Exposure to banking regulatory reporting frameworks, including capital adequacy, ICAAP reporting, liquidity risk reporting, balance sheet schedules, and regulatory disclosures, would be beneficial.
Proven ability to translate complex regulatory mandates into business requirements.
Knowledge of reporting platforms and data tools, along with hands-on experience in SQL, Python, Snowflake, or Looker, would be an added advantage.
Awareness of Generative AI tools and workflow automation to support data extraction, exception analysis, and reporting efficiency would be an advantage.
Strong control mindset, including practical experience with maker-checker reviews, robust audit trails, evidence retention, issue management, and key risk/control testing.
Advanced data analytics skills, with the ability to query large datasets, perform root-cause analysis on exceptions, and communicate structured findings clearly.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of effectively managing relationships across onshore/offshore teams, product managers, engineers, and executive stakeholders.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, demonstrating strong ownership, continuous improvement, and agility in adapting to evolving regulatory landscapes.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint is required. U.S. visa readiness or international travel willingness is preferred but not mandatory.

• Experience working with North American enterprise customers.

Description:
Job Title: Academic Counsellor / Sr. Academic Counsellor
Department: Business Development / Admissions
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Days: 6 Days (Mon-Sat), Work From Office
Note: 1 South Indian language is mandatory for Bangalore location(kannada/Telugu preferred)
Job Overview
We are looking for a target-oriented Counsellor to handle lead generation, student counselling, sales, and admissions. The role involves guiding students, parents, and working professionals on educational programs, study-abroad opportunities, and career-oriented training while ensuring smooth enrolment and achieving business targets.
Roles & Responsibilities
Generate leads through calls, digital platforms, referrals, and promotional activities.
Counsel students and parents on courses, eligibility, career opportunities, and study-abroad options.
Manage the admission process, including applications, documentation, follow-ups, and enrolment.
Guide study-abroad applicants on university selection, applications, and visa-related procedures in coordination with relevant teams.
Promote educational programs and training services to prospective customers.
Achieve counselling, admission, and sales targets through effective lead conversion.
Maintain lead records, follow-ups, and reports using CRM tools or Excel.
Coordinate with internal teams and institutional partners for smooth admissions and onboarding.
Required Skills
Excellent communication, counselling, and negotiation skills.
Strong sales orientation and target-achievement mindset.
Good relationship management and follow-up skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
Qualification & Experience
Graduate in any discipline,postgraduate qualification preferred.
1+years of experience in counselling, admissions, sales, business development, or education consulting.
Study-abroad or Online Degree sales experience is an advantage.

Description:
Open Locations - Kolkata/Bangalore/Pune/Noida/Kochi
We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Managed Services Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EYs global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
Key Requirements
As a Senior within the Actuarial managed services team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
Good understanding of US product lines and regulatory standards; hands-on implementation experience (desirable)
Experience of handling a small to moderate sized team will be an advantage
Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
Ability to maneuver around existing modeling setup to incorporate the asset or liability cashflows
Understanding of AoC concept and AoC steps (unwinding, roll forward, assumption changes, experience variances)
Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
Hands-on experience in actuarial valuation software such as Prophet / Axis / MG Alpha. Advanced level experience in one of these softwares will be valuable
Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
Good experience of preparing PPT decks
In-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of one or more geographies
iduals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
Skills and attributes for success
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
To qualify for the role, you must have
3-6 years of experience in valuation / reporting / pricing or modelling function in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
Good analytical skills
Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus
Ideally, youll also have
Good actuarial exam progress
Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

SAP SD (Sales & Distribution)

Experience working in large-scale enterprise SAP landscapes.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

Hiring Criteria
Minimum 8 years of relevant SAP ABAP experience.
Must have hands-on experience in S/4HANA Migration/Conversion projects.

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP - MM - Senior Associate, you will focus on implementing, configuring, and maintaining the SAP Procurement module to streamline and automate procurement processes, including purchasing, supplier management, contract management, and inventory management. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for planning and executing SAP Implementation, Development, and Support activities related to SAP Materials Management. You will handle all Purchasing and Inventory Management tasks, providing solutions and functional specifications to meet client requirements. Your role will involve creating presentation decks, process flows, and configuration documents, confirming alignment with client standards and requirements.
Responsibilities
- Leading the implementation and configuration of SAP Procurement modules to streamline purchasing and supplier management processes
- Planning and executing SAP Materials Management activities, including purchasing and inventory management
- Configuring SAP MM and delivering work products that align with client standards and requirements
- Conducting AS-IS studies, gap analysis, and blueprinting for SAP MM projects
- Integrating SAP MM with Extended Warehouse Management and other SAP modules
- Creating presentation decks and process flows for client workshops using Microsoft Visio
- Developing Process Definition Documents and Business Process Procedures for proposed solutions
- Managing procure-to-pay functional workstreams for SAP S/4HANA Brownfield projects
- Addressing module-specific functional conversion items such as vendor master harmonization and invoice consistency
- Applying SAP MM and Ariba integration expertise to support business continuity during migrations
- Driving fit-gap sessions and functional delta analysis using S/4HANA tools
- Utilizing AI and automation tools to optimize processes and enhance user experience
- Preparing test scripts and conducting testing post-MM upgrades
- Regularly interacting with onsite teams and clients to provide status updates and maintain relationships

Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Noida, Pune and Kolkata
CompanyAddress: 4th Floor, Bagmane Tech Park, Byrasandra Village, KR Puram Hobli, CV Raman Nagar, Bangalore, KA, BANGALORE, Karnataka, India

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. Well help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP - EWM / WM Senior Associate, you will be at the forefront of delivering impactful solutions within our SAP Supply Chain and Operations practice. You will engage with clients directly, leveraging your skills to address complex business challenges from strategy to execution. Within our Digital Core Modernisation network, you will utilize a broad range of tools and techniques to extract insights from industry trends, enhancing client engagements and driving process quality.
As a Senior Associate, you will develop meaningful client connections and anticipate their needs, using critical thinking to navigate complex situations. You will guide and mentor junior team members, fostering a collaborative environment that encourages growth and learning. Your role will involve maintaining professional standards and adapting to diverse perspectives, all while building your personal brand and technical skills.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of a dynamic team that supports global delivery capabilities, providing cost-effective services that enhance client engagement processes. Your contributions will be pivotal in upholding the firm's code of ethics and business conduct, confirming quality and relevance in all deliverables.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Role & responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced and driven Manager - Talent Acquisition (Leadership Hiring) to lead end-to-end recruitment for senior and leadership-level positions across the organization. This is currently an Individual Contributor (IC) role, requiring strong stakeholder management, executive search capabilities, market intelligence, and a consultative hiring approach. Based on business needs and performance, the role may evolve into a people management position with team leadership responsibilities in the future.
Key Responsibilities
Leadership Hiring
Manage end-to-end recruitment for leadership and critical positions across business functions.
Partner with senior business leaders to understand talent requirements, organizational priorities, and succession needs.
Develop and execute targeted search strategies to identify and engage high-caliber leadership talent.
Build and maintain strong leadership talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
Conduct market mapping, competitor analysis, and talent intelligence research.
Stakeholder Management
Act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers and business leaders.
Drive hiring discussions, calibration meetings, and offer negotiations for senior-level hires.
Ensure an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
Influence hiring decisions through data-driven insights and market trends.
Talent Acquisition Excellence
Design and implement innovative sourcing strategies, including executive search methodologies.
Track and report key recruitment metrics and leadership hiring effectiveness.
Ensure compliance with internal hiring policies and recruitment governance.
Collaborate with HR Business Partners and business leaders on workforce planning initiatives.
Employer Branding & Market Intelligence
Strengthen the organization's leadership hiring brand through networking and industry engagement.
Stay updated on industry trends, talent availability, compensation benchmarks, and competitor movements.
Build strong external networks with industry leaders, executive search firms, and professional associations.
Future Team Leadership Opportunities
Mentor and guide recruiters as needed on leadership hiring best practices.
Support capability building within the Talent Acquisition function.
Potentially lead and manage a team of recruiters based on business growth and organizational requirements.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
8+ years of Talent Acquisition experience with significant exposure to leadership and niche hiring.
Proven experience in hiring for Director, VP, AVP, General Manager, and other leadership positions.
Experience working with senior stakeholders and leadership teams.
Strong expertise in executive search, talent mapping, and passive candidate engagement.
Preferred Skills
Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Strong negotiation and offer management capabilities.
Data-driven decision-making and analytical mindset.
Strong networking and relationship-building abilities.
High level of ownership, accountability, and business acumen.
Experience in technology, product, digital, consulting, or corporate leadership hiring is preferred.
Key Competencies

Executive Presence
Strategic Thinking
Stakeholder Management
Consultative Hiring
Talent Market Intelligence
Decision Making
Communication & Influencing
Relationship Management
Problem Solving
Results Orientation
Success Measures
Leadership hiring closure rate and quality of hire.
Time-to-fill and stakeholder satisfaction.
Leadership talent pipeline strength.
Candidate experience and offer-to-join ratio.
Contribution to strategic workforce planning and talent acquisition initiatives.

Client Advisor Job Description
About NoBroker
NoBroker is a technology-led real estate platform focused on simplifying the property buying, selling, and renting experience through technology. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where ownership, customer experience, and business outcomes are highly valued.
About the Role
We are looking for Client Advisors to join our sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales, understanding customer requirements, guiding customers through NoBroker’s products and services, and converting leads into successful customers.
The role requires strong communication, relationship-building, follow-up, and negotiation skills, along with a target-oriented mindset.
Key Responsibilities
Drive sales and revenue targets within the assigned territory.
Identify and connect with potential customers to understand their property requirements.
Guide customers on NoBroker’s plans, products, and value-added services.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships throughout the sales journey.
Generate leads through calls, referrals, follow-ups, and local market opportunities.
Conduct product/service demonstrations and clearly explain pricing and benefits.
Handle customer queries, objections, and escalations effectively.
Convert leads into customers and consistently achieve individual sales targets.
Follow up with prospective customers to maximize conversions.
Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities for premium plans and additional services.
Maintain accurate customer information, follow-ups, and sales activities in the CRM.
Track daily sales performance, pipeline status, and achievement against targets.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and service delivery.
Stay updated on local market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities.
Prepare regular sales reports and share performance updates with the reporting manager.
Candidate Requirements
Experience: Freshers can apply.
Education: Any Graduation.
Age: Up to 30 years.
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Good customer-handling and relationship-management abilities.
Strong persuasion, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
Self-motivated, persistent, and result-oriented.
Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced sales environment.

Description:
Job Summary
The opportunity: Project Analyst-National-Forensics-ASU - Forensics - Discovery - Noida
National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience.
ASU - Forensics - Discovery :
Successful organizations depend on their reputation for keeping promises, respecting laws and behaving ethically to maintain stakeholder trust. EY Forensic & Integrity Services professionals help organizations protect and restore enterprise and financial reputation. We assist companies and their legal counsel to investigate facts, resolve disputes and manage regulatory challenges. We put integrity at the heart of compliance programs to help better manage ethical and reputational risks.
Our integrated approach ranges from enhancements in areas of perceived weakness or issues - including governance, controls, culture and data insights - to full organizational design and structural implementation. We want to help companies safeguard and restore financial and brand reputations. The insights and quality services we deliver help build trust and confidence in the capital markets and in economies the world over.
Responsibilities
Review documents, emails, and datasets as part of data breach review projects. Identify and classify Personally Identifiable Information (PII), Protected Health Information (PHI), financial information, and other sensitive data. Conduct quality control and quality assurance checks to ensure review accuracy, consistency, and completeness. Validate review decisions against established project protocols and client guidelines. Escalate exceptions, inconsistencies, and complex findings to project leads. Maintain strict confidentiality and comply with applicable data security requirements. Meet defined productivity, quality, and turnaround expectations.
Qualifications
LL.B.
Experience
Document Review (MDR) and Data Breach (DBR)
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
The opportunity
Were looking for candidates with experience in carrying out routine substantive and controls-based assurance testing for the engagement teams during the financial year end for the Europe or US region.
Your key responsibilities
•Clearly and accurately document the execution of specific review procedures as defined by the engagement teams
Demonstrate basic understanding of an industry or sector and be aware of technical issues
Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the client's business
Recognize potential review issues or unusual relationships from basic analysis of the financial statements and communicate them to the immediate supervisor  
Collaborate with seniors and engagement teams to set goals and responsibilities  
Deliver work in line with designated methodology, project plan or process in line with EY standards  
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with the team members 
Maintain a strong client focus, be responsive to team requests, and develop/maintain productive working relationships with team contacts  
Where appropriate, challenge procedures used in the past by team members and attempt to enhance review techniques
Compare efficiency of review procedures performed across different clients and suggest ideas for improvement.
Contribute ideas/opinions to the assurance teams and listen/respond to other team members' views
Use technology to continually learn, share knowledge with team members, and enhance service delivery  
Promote EY’s ethical and professional standards, including data confidentiality, especially when dealing with outsiders
•• Skills and attributes for success
• Confident and outgoing individual with strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to meet tight deadlines and ensure that work is of a consistently high standard
• Ability to multi-task, pay attention to detail, prioritize projects and follow up on routine
 tasks diligently
 Knowledge of basic accounting and book-keeping,  
• Ability to communicate with leaders and peers with ease
• Plan ahead and anticipate potential issues before they arise
 Good written and oral communication skills
 Ability to work effectively in a team
To qualify for the role, you must have
Candidates who are ACCA Affiliate or Part qualified (9 papers and above) OR CA qualified / CA Inter with Articleship completed OR CPA semi qualified.
6 months to 1 year of relevant work experience preferred.
Ideally, you’ll also have
Interest in business and commerciality.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)

Global Managed Service - Identity and access Management - Staff
The IAM Administrator role will be primarily responsible for the support and enhancements that are required for the engagement. Also adhering to stated SLA s and ensuring high standards of quality deliverables.
Responsibilities
Experience in working on any two IAM engagements providing application support (SailPoint IIQ or SailPoint IDN)
Follow approved life cycle methodologies
Resolve technical issues through debugging, research, and investigation.

SOD

Description:
Job Summary
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY- Assurance - Senior Associate
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
The opportunity
We re looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.
Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement team s work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on one s own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across one s aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead one s GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback training. Lead by example.
Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.
Ideally, you ll also have
Proficiency in MS - Excel, MS - Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

Reportingto Store Manager

AboutLenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
Aboutthe Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
ActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartSalesAssociate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan&SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Storeupkeep& maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile
Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Description:
Its fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
Were committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.
About Fractal
Fractal is one of the most prominent providers of Artificial Intelligence to Fortune 500 companies.Fractals vision is to power every human decision in the enterprise, and bring AI, engineering, and design to help the worlds most admired companies.Fractal currently has 4000+ employees across 16 global locations, including the United States, UK, Ukraine, India, Singapore, and Australia.
Fractals businesses include Crux Intelligence (AI driven business intelligence), Eugenie.ai (AI for sustainability), Asper.ai (AI for revenue growth management) and Senseforth.ai (conversational AI for sales and customer service). Fractal incubated Qure.ai, a leading player in healthcare AI for detecting Tuberculosis and Lung cancer.
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Azure Lead Architect to join our consulting practice. In this leadership role, you will work with enterprise clients to design, build, and modernize cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure. You will be responsible for leading architecture engagements, defining cloud strategies, and guiding cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and secure cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design and implementation of Azure-based solutions for complex enterprise applications.
Define cloud architecture and roadmap in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.
Assess client s current environment and make architecture recommendations for cloud adoption, migration, and optimization.
Own end-to-end solution architecture and act as a trusted advisor to client leadership.
Collaborate with DevOps, Security, Data, and Application teams to align cloud solutions with enterprise strategy.
Mentor and guide development teams on best practices in cloud architecture.
Conduct architecture reviews, risk assessments, and cost-benefit analysis.
Support pre-sales and proposal development including effort estimation, technical solutions, and client presentations.
Stay updated with the latest Azure offerings and industry trends.
Required Skills Qualifications
12+ years of experience in IT, with 6+ years of hands-on experience in Azure architecture and implementation.
Strong expertise in Azure services such as Azure App Services, AKS, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure DevOps, ARM/Bicep/Terraform templates.
Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, governance, and security principles.
Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Strong background in enterprise application design and microservices architecture.
Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert) preferred.
Bachelors or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Prior experience in a client-facing consulting role.
Knowledge of other cloud platforms like AWS or GCP is a plus.
Why Join Us
Opportunity to work with top-tier clients across industries.
Exposure to cutting-edge cloud projects and digital transformation programs.
Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
Learning and development opportunities with access to cloud certifications and trainings.
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, youll enjoy your career with us!

You ll also troubleshoot and resolve issues in development, testing, and production environments.
Enable Model tracking, model experimentation, Model automation Develop scalable ML pipelines

Machine Learning Services (either of): Kubeflow, DataRobot, HopsWorks, Dataiku or any relevant ML E2E PaaS/SaaS
Work across all phases of Model development life cycle to build MLOPS components
Build the knowledge base required to deliver increasingly complex MLOPS projects on the Cloud(AWS, Azure, GCP)/On Prem Be an integral part of client business development and delivery engagements across multiple domains.

5-10 years experience building production-quality software
Strong experience in System Integration, Application Development or DataWarehouse projects across technologies used in the enterprise space
Basic Knowledge of MLOps, machine learning and docker
Object-oriented languages (e.g. Python, PySpark, Java, C#, C++ )
Experience developing CI/CD components for production ready ML pipeline.
Database programming using any flavors of SQL
Knowledge of Git for Source code management
Ability to collaborate effectively with highly technical resources in a fast-paced environment
Ability to solve complex challenges/problems and rapidly deliver innovative solutions
Team handling, problem solving, project management and communication skills creative thinking
Foundational Knowledge of Cloud Computing either one AWS, Azure or GCP
Hunger and passion for learning new skills
EDUCATION:

Description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
The role involves converting 3D CAD models and engineering data into high-quality 2D illustrations, exploded views, assembly illustrations, installation/removal procedures, and procedural graphics.

The illustrations must comply with applicable technical documentation standards and support the development of Interactive Electronic Technical Publications (IETP), Repair Parts and Illustrations List (RPIL), Illustrated Parts Data (IPD), and Component Maintenance Publications (CMP).

Qualifications and Experience
B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical, Aerospace, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation Engineering, or an equivalent discipline.
3-5 years of relevant experience in technical illustration and engineering documentation.
Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, CATIA, or equivalent tools.
Strong understanding of technical drawing and documentation standards, including ATA iSpec 2200 and S1000D.
Proven experience in creating technical illustrations compliant with S1000D standards.
Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, or equivalent technical illustration tools.
Experience in Illustration Content Number (ICN) management and associated technical publication workflows.
Experience with RPIL, Repair Parts Support (RPS) development, and IPD illustrations is highly advantageous.
Familiarity with IETP standards and Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) deliverables is highly desirable.
Experience working with engineering databases and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools such as Teamcenter, SAP, Agile PLM, Windchill, or 3D Via.
Proficiency in workflow and work-tracking tools such as JIRA.

Key Responsibilities
Create accurate 2D technical illustrations from 3D CAD models, engineering drawings, and technical references.
Develop detailed illustrations, including exploded views, assembly views, section views, detail views, and installation/removal procedures.
Produce procedural graphics and illustrations for technical manuals, maintenance manuals, service manuals, assembly instructions, and parts documentation.
Develop illustrations for IETP, RPIL, IPD, and CMP deliverables.
Use Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, or equivalent software to create high-quality, vector-based technical illustrations.
Interpret CATIA 3D models to understand product structures, components, assemblies, and engineering designs.
Ensure accuracy in geometry, orientation, proportions, and component relationships.
Apply appropriate line weights, colour shading, hatching, callouts, symbols, arrows, and graphical conventions in accordance with applicable standards.
Analyse complex engineering data, including drawings, specifications, CAD models, bills of materials (BOMs), schematics, wiring diagrams, and Service Bulletins, to develop technically accurate illustrations.
Collaborate with engineers, technical authors, designers, subject-matter experts, and the wider Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) team to clarify technical information and validate content.

Description:
Job Description

Work Mode : Hybrid/Any of the office location
Work Location: Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Chennai, Trichy, Bangalore, Noida, Gurgaon.

Job Summary Consultant-Oracle with HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Oracle Time and Labor (OTL) (Functional), HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Fast Formula (Functional), and HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Mastek EWS (Enterprise Workforce Scheduler) (Functional) experience, responsible for delivering functional solutions and support across Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud Time and Labor and related workforce scheduling processes.
Candidate must have relevant experience of 5 to 9 Years.

Qualifications and Skills
Relevant degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, HR, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Hands-on functional experience in HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Oracle Time and Labor (OTL) (Functional).
Practical experience in HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Fast Formula (Functional), including writing, testing, and troubleshooting formulas.- Functional experience in HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Mastek EWS (Enterprise Workforce Scheduler) (Functional) or similar workforce scheduling tools.
Familiarity with end-to-end HCM processes, including core HR, absence, and payroll interactions with Time and Labor.
Ability to document requirements, configurations, and test scenarios clearly and concisely.
Strong analytical skills and ability to translate business requirements into Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud configurations.

Key Responsibilities
Work as a functional Consultant-Oracle for HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Oracle Time and Labor (OTL) (Functional), ensuring accurate time capture, approvals, and integrations with payroll and absence management.
Configure, validate, and optimize HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Fast Formula (Functional) to support complex business rules, calculations, and eligibility criteria across HCM modules.
Implement and support HCM - Oracle Fusion Cloud - Mastek EWS (Enterprise Workforce Scheduler) (Functional) to manage workforce scheduling, shift planning, and resource allocation.- Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, map them to Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud capabilities, and design functional solutions for Time and Labor and workforce scheduling.
Perform end-to-end functional testing for OTL, Fast Formula, and Mastek EWS configurations, including regression testing for new releases and patches.
Support production incidents and service requests related to Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud Time and Labor, Fast Formula, and workforce scheduling, ensuring timely resolution and root cause analysis.
Prepare functional design documents, configuration workbooks, and user guides for Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud modules in scope.
Conduct user training and knowledge transfer sessions for HR, payroll, and operations teams on OTL, Fast Formula, and Mastek EWS functionalities.
Coordinate with technical teams for integrations, reports, and extensions related to Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud Time and Labor and scheduling solutions.
Ensure adherence to best practices, governance, and compliance requirements in all Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud configurations and deployments.

Other Capabilities
Strong understanding of Oracle HCM Fusion Cloud Time and Labor processes, including time entry, approval workflows, and time valuation rules.
Ability to interpret and design complex Fast Formulas to support business-specific rules and calculations.
Experience working with workforce scheduling concepts such as shifts, rosters, rotation patterns, and resource optimization in Mastek EWS (Enterprise Workforce Scheduler).- Good stakeholder management and communication skills to work with HR, payroll, operations, and IT teams.
Capability to work in a consulting environment, managing multiple assignments and priorities with minimal supervision.
Problem-solving mindset with attention to detail in configuration and testing activities.

Paytm is India's leading digital payments and financial services company, focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform through a wide range of payment use cases. Paytm offers services such as utility bill payments, money transfers, UPI, Wallet, FASTag, Postpaid, and Payment Gateway solutions. For merchants, Paytm provides comprehensive payment acceptance solutions, including QR, Soundbox, EDC, and Payment Gateway, while enabling business growth through commerce and financial services.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):

Paytm Payments Services Limited (PPSL) is the RBI-regulated Payment Aggregator responsible for Paytm's Online Payment Gateway business. PPSL enables thousands of merchants, startups, and enterprises to offer seamless digital payment experiences through multiple payment modes, including UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI, and BNPL. Our mission is to help businesses accelerate growth through secure, reliable, and scalable payment solutions.

About the Role:

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented professional to support the Payment Gateway Sales team across pre-sales activities, client solutioning and sales operations. The role will work closely with Sales, Product, Technology and Operations teams to ensure smooth coordination, effective client engagement and seamless business execution.

Expectations / Requirements:
Generate and qualify enterprise leads through cold calling, outbound prospecting and market research.
Understand prospect requirements, conduct initial discussions and build a strong pipeline for the Enterprise Sales/KAM team.
Maintain lead pipeline, follow-ups and accurate updates in CRM/internal systems.
Coordinate with Product, Technology, Integration, Risk and Operations teams for smooth merchant onboarding and integration.
Act as a SPOC for merchant queries, issues and grievances, ensuring timely resolution and closure.
Track merchant onboarding, integration and operational issues, identify bottlenecks and drive timely resolution.
Prepare MIS, reports and dashboards covering leads, onboarding, integrations and operational metrics.
Support Sales with operational activities, documentation, approvals and internal coordination.
Leverage AI tools and automation to improve productivity, prospect research, reporting and operational efficiency.
Identify process gaps and drive improvements in TAT, operational efficiency and merchant experience.

Qualifications & Skills:

2+ years of experience in Pre-Sales, Inside Sales, Sales Support, Merchant Operations or similar roles.
Strong experience in B2B/Enterprise lead generation, cold calling and lead qualification.
Prior experience in Fintech, Payments, Banking or Technology preferred.
Exposure to merchant onboarding, payment integration or merchant support is an added advantage.
Strong communication, stakeholder management and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with prospects, merchants and internal teams.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and execution skills with proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM/reporting tools.
Hands-on experience with AI tools to improve prospecting, research, reporting, productivity and day-to-day execution is mandatory.
Strong ownership, customer focus and ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

Superpowers / Skills that will help you succeed:
Proven ability in cold calling, lead generation & lead qualification
Strong B2B/Enterprise sales orientation
Excellent stakeholder management & coordination
Customer-centric approach with strong problem-solving skills
Good analytical and reporting skills
Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment
Strong ownership, follow-through and execution mindset
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM tools

Location:
Noida | Mumbai | Bengaluru
Why Join Us:
At Paytm Payments Services, you'll work on one of India's largest digital payment platforms, solving complex business challenges for leading enterprises. You'll collaborate with high-performing teams, gain exposure to cutting-edge payment technologies, and play a key role in enabling India's digital commerce ecosystem.
Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With 500M+ registered users and 21M+ merchants, Paytm offers immense opportunities to build, innovate, and grow while contributing to India's largest digital payments ecosystem

About Bharat Shishu Vidya Initiatives Pvt. Ltd.
Bharat Shishu Vidya Initiatives Pvt. Ltd. (BSVI) is an Indian education company committed to strengthening foundational learning, recognising educational excellence and creating meaningful opportunities for schools, educators and young learners across the country.
Our initiatives focus on early childhood education, school engagement, national-level assessments and recognition of educational leadership.
Our flagship initiatives include:
Preschool Olympiad (PSO): A national foundational-stage assessment initiative for children from Nursery to Grade 2, designed to assess and encourage the development of essential skills in Mathematics, Science and English. PSO has engaged schools across 19 Indian states and supports the vision of NEP 2020 and NIPUN Bharat.
Bharat Preschool Excellence Awards (BPEA): A national awards and early-years leadership platform that recognises outstanding preschools, educators and education leaders. Through its awards and leadership summit, BPEA brings together school founders, principals, education experts and industry partners to celebrate excellence and encourage innovation in early childhood education.
At BSVI, we believe that improving foundational education requires collaboration between schools, educators, families and industry partners.
We are building a growing ecosystem of educational initiatives with opportunities for professionals in school relationships, business development, partnerships, operations and education-focused events.
Our mission is to strengthen the foundations of education while recognising and supporting the institutions and individuals shaping India's next generation.

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Graph Data Engineer with strong expertise in enterprise graph data modeling, knowledge graphs, semantic technologies, graph databases, and large-scale data engineering.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience designing and implementing graph-based data solutions, developing ETL/ELT pipelines, integrating heterogeneous data sources, and building scalable distributed data platforms. Experience with graph query languages, Python development, cloud platforms, and modern lakehouse architectures is highly desirable.

Primary Skills Must Have

Enterprise Graph Data Modeling: Property Graphs (LPG), RDF, ontologies, and semantic modeling.
Graph Databases: Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Dydra, or equivalent graph database technologies.
Graph Query Languages: Cypher, SPARQL, and Gremlin.
Python Development: Strong programming and data processing skills.
ETL/ELT Development: Design, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines.
Big Data Technologies: Apache Spark, Databricks, Airflow, or similar platforms.
Data Integration & Engineering: Integration of data from multiple enterprise sources.
Data Modeling: Relational, analytical, graph, and lakehouse data modeling.
Distributed Data Platforms: Experience designing and working with scalable data processing systems.
DevOps & Automation: CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and deployment automation.
Enterprise Data Architecture: Designing robust, scalable, and maintainable enterprise data solutions.

Secondary Skills Good to Have

Databricks Lakehouse Platform
Delta Lake and Unity Catalog
AWS services: S3, Neptune, Glue, Athena, IAM, and Lambda
Graph Analytics and Graph Data Science
Graph-based Machine Learning
Semantic Search and Knowledge Graphs
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions
Recommendation Systems
Data visualization tools such as Dash, Shiny, Grafana, Splunk, and Databricks Visualization

Key Responsibilities

Design and implement enterprise-scale graph data models using LPG, RDF, ontologies, and semantic modeling techniques.
Develop and optimize graph database solutions using Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Dydra, or equivalent platforms.
Build and optimize graph queries using Cypher, SPARQL, and Gremlin.
Develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, Apache Spark, Databricks, Airflow, or similar technologies.
Integrate structured and semi-structured data from multiple enterprise systems.
Design and implement graph-based data architectures that support analytics, semantic search, and knowledge discovery.
Collaborate with enterprise architects, data scientists, and engineering teams to deliver scalable data solutions.
Implement data quality, governance, security, and performance optimization practices.
Establish CI/CD processes and Infrastructure-as-Code practices for reliable deployments.
Evaluate emerging graph technologies and identify opportunities to improve data connectivity, analytics, and business outcomes.

Candidate Profile

10+ years of overall experience in data engineering, data architecture, or related technical roles.
Strong hands-on expertise in graph data modeling, graph databases, and graph query languages.
Proven experience developing production-grade Python applications and ETL/ELT pipelines.
Experience with distributed data processing and modern data platforms.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
Ability to work with enterprise stakeholders and deliver solutions in a client-facing environment.
Willingness to work in a hybrid model from the client location in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Noida.

1. To review analytical specifications, standard and general test procedures, test data sheet of raw material, packing material, finished product, stability and micro analysis.
2. To review the data submitted by QC for its completeness.
3. To ensure management of working/ reference/ impurity standard and column management.
4. To ensure contemporaneous documentation.
5. To check raw data /audit trail / software (as applicable) at a given frequency to ensure regulatory guidance compliance.
6. Responsible for finish product, stability, Raw material, packaging materials, micro results and in process sample batch release in LIMS.
7. To review of stability protocols in coordination with stability group and review the stability report
8. To review predictive stability analysis on data generated for stability study
9. Review of analytical method transfer and method validation documents.
10. To coordinate with CQA/ PTC department for implementation related to the official monographs/ General chapters/ corporate quality policy.
11. Reviews of documents i.e. risk assessment, change control, deviation and routine documents of testing area associated to the function.
12. To ensure retrieval of QC data and support for its presentation during audit.
13. Responsible for implementing company quality ethics policy for data integrity and inform management and responsible data integrity compliance head on any data integrity issues as per corporate data governance policy.
14. Responsible for release of Raw materials, Packaging material, Stability Study, in process, Microanalysis and finished products.
15. Responsible for Review of Raw materials, Packaging material, Stability Study, in process, Microanalysis and finished products analytical report before release.
16. Responsible for Stability chambers management (Withdrawal/charging of stability samples, Monitoring of Stability chambers temperature and humidity, preventive maintenance of stability Chambers, Calibration of stability calibration). To charge and withdraw stability samples as per scheduler. To maintain and monitor storage conditions of stability chambers and to ensure recording of temperature & humidity of all stability chambers as per the defined frequency. To identify and report to QA for any excursions to the defined storage conditions of the stability chamber. Responsible for reconciliation of stability sample.
17. Responsible for Management of control samples of finished product, raw materials and packaging material.
18. Responsible for Review and release of Calibration before release of instrument for routine use.
19. Responsible for Review of analytical data for process validation and analytical data for market complaint.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Engineering Assurance
1. To ensure service floor compliance to cGMP and GDP in technical area/utility area/equipment up keeping.
2. Responsible for implementing company Quality Ethics policy for data integrity and inform management and responsible Data integrity compliance head on any data integrity issues as per corporate Data governance policy.
3. Responsible daily oversight of document destruction process.
4. Responsible for quality oversight of personnel, process and practice to meet the cGMP and compliance requirement.
5. To review electronic records like PLC, SCADA, equipment printouts, audit trails, alarms as per site SOP.
6. To ensure compliance to preventive maintenance/ calibration planner.
7. To verify equipment preventive maintenance checklist and its execution.
8. To supervise Annual maintenance contracts of specified equipment and technical agreement with the service providers.
9. To review SOPs of engineering department and ensure compliance.
10. To verify qualification /validation activities of all Utility systems and continuous performance.
11. To evaluate and comment on change proposals/ deviation and other applicable QMS documents initiated in the area of operation.
12. To review the calibration records of equipment/instrument (other than QC).
13. To review maintenance requests and ensure the completeness with respect to compliance.
14. To verify the daily logs of, AHU/HVAC, Water system, Dust collector, Compressed air''.
15. To review the filter replacements records and filter cleaning records.
16. To review the Data loggers calibration certificates of storage area of warehouse.
17. To review calibration records of standards weights calibrated by outside party of balances of Engineering and Warehouse.
18. To review SOPs of engineering department and ensure compliance.
19. To ensure compliance to preventive maintenance/ calibration planner.
20. To ensure compliance to Filter cleaning schedule and HEPA Filter Qualification Planner.
21. To verify qualification /validation activities of all Utility systems.
22. To verify the effectiveness of change control and CAPA implementation in Engineering.
23. To participate in investigation of deviations and incidents in Engineering.
24. To review and manage the User Access Management of Utility and warehouse equipment.
AboutCompany:
Zydus MedTech is the WOS of Zydus Lifesciences, focused on transforming healthcare through innovative medical technologies. With a legacy of over 70 years, Zydus group has established its presence in more than 85 countries.
At Zydus MedTech, our manufacturing is built on precision, quality, and sustainability. Our state-of-the-art facilities, ISO 13485-certified and equipped with advanced automation, ensure seamless production of next-generation medical technologies. Within our clean rooms where the highest sterility standards prevail-every product is forged with integrity, safeguarding patient safety and redefining reliability.
Zydus Lifesciences Limited (Formerly known as Cadila Healthcare Limited), a leading Indian Pharmaceutical company is a fully integrated, global healthcare provider. With in-depth domain expertise in the field of healthcare, it has strong capabilities across the spectrum of the pharmaceutical value chain. From formulations to active pharmaceutical ingredients and animal healthcare products to wellness products, Zydus has earned a reputation amongst Indian pharmaceutical companies for providing comprehensive and complete healthcare solutions.
One of the salient features of Zydus is its rich history and lineage. The origin of the company dates all the way back to the 1950s. The company was founded in the year 1952 by Mr. Ramanbhai B. Patel (late), a first-generation entrepreneur and a doyen in the field of Indian Pharmaceuticals.
In 1995, the group was restructured and thus was formed Cadila Healthcare under the aegis of the Zydus group. From a humble turnover Rs. 250 crores in 1995 the group witnessed a significant financial growth and registered a turnover of over Rs. 17,000 crores in FY-21.
Adhering to its brand promise of being dedicated to life in all its dimensions, Zydus continues to innovate with an unswerving focus to address the unmet healthcare needs. Simultaneously it rededicates itself to its mission of creating healthier, happier communities across the globe.

Area

Key Accountabilities / Responsibilities
Product Costing

Prepare and maintain standard cost estimates in SAP S/4 HANA.
• Prepare product cost sheets and conversion cost calculations.
• Support costing for new product introductions and technology transfers.
• Analyze cost variances and product profitability.
US Product Costing & COGS

Prepare COGS for US market products.
• Develop cost sheets for Baddi, Topical and Viona products.
• Support budget cycle costing for regulated market products.
• Monitor product profitability and margins.
Plant Accounting

Manage plant costing and accounting activities.
• Review daily production reports and utility consumption.
• Monitor manufacturing cost trends and cost variances.
• Support monthly financial closing activities.
MIS & Financial Reporting

Prepare monthly MIS and Finance Dashboard.
• Analyze P&L performance, yield variances and manpower productivity.
• Present key financial highlights and improvement opportunities.
• Support management reviews through financial analytics.
Budgeting & Forecasting

Prepare annual OPEX budgets and monthly forecasts.
• Conduct budget versus actual analysis.
• Support site cost control initiatives.
• Monitor spending against approved budgets.
Inventory & Asset Management

Support inventory valuation and inventory controls.
• Conduct monthly physical verification of SFG and open production orders.
• Support fixed asset verification and cleansing activities.
• Monitor working capital related inventory performance.
Cost Audit & Compliance

Coordinate cost audit activities and documentation.
• Prepare cost audit data and statutory costing reports.
• Maintain costing records and audit compliance.
• Support internal and external audit requirements.
SAP Costing & Absorption

Execute monthly SAP absorption runs.
• Release standard costs in SAP S/4 HANA.
• Monitor cost center allocations and absorption accuracy.
• Ensure integrity of costing master data.
Cost Improvement Initiatives

Validate SLIM and productivity projects.
• Support savings tracking and realization.
• Generate cost optimization opportunities.
• Support operational excellence initiatives from a finance perspective.
CAPEX Evaluation

Conduct financial evaluation of CAPEX proposals.
• Track post-implementation benefits and ROI.
• Support capital investment decision-making.

JOB DESCRIPTION
ACCOUNTS DEPARTMENT
Industry: Tourism / Travel / Hospitality
Department: Accounts Finance
Designation: Accounts Executive / Accountant
Reporting To: Accounts Manager / Management
1. Job Purpose
To Manage The Companys Day-to-day Accounting, Financial Transactions, Billing, Payments, Collections, And Financial Records Accurately And On Time, While Supporting The Smooth Financial Operations Of The Tourism Business.
2. Key Responsibilities
A. Daily Accounting
Maintain Daily Accounting Entries In Tally/ERP/accounting Software.
Record Sales, Purchases, Receipts, Payments, Expenses, And Journal Entries.
Maintain Cash And Bank Books.
Check And Verify Invoices, Bills, Receipts, And Supporting Documents.
Maintain Proper Records Of Company Expenses.
B. Tour Travel Accounts
Prepare And Verify Invoices For Tour Packages, Hotel Bookings, Transportation, And Other Travel Services.
Maintain Customer-wise And Booking-wise Payment Records.
Track Advance Payments Received From Customers.
Monitor Pending Customer Payments And Outstanding Balances.
Verify Vendor Bills For Hotels, Transporters, Guides, Agents, And Other Service Providers.
Maintain Vendor-wise Outstanding Statements.
Reconcile Tour Package Costs With Actual Expenses.
C. Bank Cash Management
Prepare Bank Reconciliation Statements.
Monitor Daily Bank Transactions.
Maintain Petty Cash Records.
Verify Cash Receipts And Payments.
Ensure All Cash And Bank Transactions Are Properly Documented.
D. Receivables Payables
Follow Up On Outstanding Customer Payments.
Maintain Accounts Receivable And Payable Reports.
Process Vendor Payments After Proper Verification And Approval.
Ensure Payments Are Made According To Company Policy And Agreed Terms.
E. GST Taxation Support
Maintain GST-related Sales And Purchase Records.
Assist In Preparation Of GST Returns And Other Statutory Reports.
Maintain Proper Tax Invoices And Supporting Documents.
Coordinate With CA/tax Consultants For Taxation-related Requirements.
Maintain TDS Records And Assist With TDS Compliance Wherever Applicable.
F. Salary Employee Accounts
Assist In Monthly Salary Preparation.
Maintain Employee Advances, Deductions, Incentives, And Reimbursements.
Verify Employee Expense Claims And Supporting Bills.
Maintain Records Related To Full Final Settlement.
G. Financial Reporting
Prepare Daily, Weekly, And Monthly Accounting Reports.
Prepare Outstanding Reports For Customers And Vendors.
Provide Management With Revenue, Expense, And Payment Reports.
Assist In Monthly Closing And Preparation Of Financial Statements.
3. Required Skills
Basic Knowledge Of Accounting Principles.
Knowledge Of Tally/ERP/accounting Software.
Good Knowledge Of MS Excel.
Basic Knowledge Of GST, TDS, And Taxation.
Good Calculation And Analytical Skills.
Good Communication And Coordination Skills.
Accuracy And Attention To Detail.
Ability To Maintain Confidential Financial Information.
Ability To Work Under Deadlines.
4. Qualification Experience
Qualification: B.Com / M.Com / Equivalent Accounting Qualification.
Experience: 1-4 Years In Accounts, Any Company.
Candidates Having Good Accounting Knowledge And Computer Skills, Email Drafting Skills.
